candidates.description: Manufacturing facility managers foresee the maintenance and routine operational planning of buildings intended to be used for manufacturing activities. They control and manage health and safety procedures, supervise the work of contractors, plan and handle buildings maintenance operations, fire safety and security issues, and oversee buildings' cleaning activities.

candidates.title: performance production manager
candidates.description: Performance production managers take care of a range of practical issues concerning the production of a performance or entertainment event. They deal with matters ranging from the recruitment of staff, procurement of materials and services, to freight, customs coordination, telecommunications, labor relations, logistics, information technology, government liaison, venue booking, scheduling, operations management, mending delay problems and workplace safety.

candidates.title: production supervisor
candidates.description: Production supervisors coordinate, plan and direct manufacturing and production processes. They are responsible for reviewing production schedules or orders as well as dealing with staff in these production areas.

candidates.title: metal production manager
candidates.description: Metal production managers organise and manage the day-to-day and long-term project work in a metal fabrication factory, to process basic metals into fabricated metals. They create and schedule production plans, recruit new staff, enforce safety and company policies, and strive for customer satisfaction through guaranteeing the product's quality.

description: Ship Hull Manager plans, organises, and oversees shipbuilding and hull maintenance activities, ensuring structural integrity, safety, and compliance with regulatory and performance standards. They supervise engineers and technicians, manage repair and construction projects within budget and schedule, and coordinate with contractors and relevant personnel. The role includes conducting inspections, performing risk assessments, and preparing technical reports to ensure ships meet international maritime regulations.
tasks: Supervise hull production, maintenance, repair, and modification activities within shipyard operations. Conduct inspections of hull structures to assess damage, wear, and structural condition. Develop and implement maintenance and repair schedules for ship hulls. Coordinate and manage teams of engineers, technicians, and support staff involved in hull operations. Ensure compliance with maritime safety standards and regulatory requirements. Plan and implement production strategies and operational procedures for hull-related works. Review and approve technical drawings, plans, and specifications for hull construction and repair. Liaise with ship owners, contractors, and suppliers to coordinate project activities. Ensure timely completion of hull projects within budget and quality standards. Prepare technical reports, maintenance documentation, and progress records.

candidates.title: ship duty engineer
candidates.description: Ship duty engineers share responsibility for most of the content of the ship's hull. They ensure operation of the main engines, steering mechanism, electrical generation and other major subsystems. They communicate with the ship chief engineer to perform technical operations.

candidates.title: ship planner
candidates.description: Ship planners manage the performance of a vessel. They ensure the safety of the vessel and its cargo, its operationality and link available vessels to available cargos in order to maximise the profitability of the voyages. They ensure that each container ship is loaded to its optimal capacity, while keeping berth times and handling costs to a minimum. They also plan the maintenance and overhaul of the ship, as well as the crew needed.

candidates.title: vessel operations coordinator
candidates.description: Vessel operations coordinators manage chartered vessels' transit and performance optimizing the schedulers but also assessing the capabilities and the risks for vessels according to the different types of cargo such as crude oil or other chemical cargos. They make sure all necessary certifications are according to the regulations and all employees have up-to-date passports and licenses. Vessel operations coordinators schedule and maintain records of vessels' maintenance. At the operational level they have contact with the customers, following up customer complains, identifying new opportunities and providing customers with solutions.

candidates.title: vessel assembly supervisor
candidates.description: Vessel assembly supervisors coordinate the employees involved in boat and ship manufacturing and schedule their activities. They prepare production reports and recommend measures to reduce the cost and improve productivity. Vessel assembly supervisors train employees in company policies, job duties and safety measures. They check compliance with applied working procedures and engineering. Vessel assembly supervisors oversee the supplies and communicate with other departments to avoid unnecessary interruptions of the production process.

candidates.title: shipwright
candidates.description: Shipwrights build and repair small type of water vessels from pleasure craft to naval vessels. They prepare preliminary sketches and create templates. They use hand and power tools to construct smaller boat themselves or supervise a team of shipbuilders. They also construct cradles and slipways for the ship’s construction, transportation, launching and slipping. Depending on the vessels, they might work with different materials such as metal, wood, fibreglass, aluminium etc.

candidates.title: ship assistant engineer
candidates.description: Ship assistant engineers assist the ship chief engineer and the ship duty engineer in the operations of the ship's hull. They support the operation of the main engines, steering mechanism, electrical generation and other major subsystems. They communicate with maritime engineers about the performance of technical operations. They also ensure appropriate safety and regulatory standards compliance and are able to take on higher level positions if needed.

candidates.title: ship captain
candidates.description: Ship captains are in charge of a vessel for the transportation of goods and passengers, operating in offshore and coastal waters. The size of the vessel can range from a small vessel to a cruise liner depending on the tonnage that they are certified to sail. Ship captains have vast experience with ships and their operation, and are likely to have worked their way through the ranks of other ship-related positions.

candidates.title: maritime water transport general manager
candidates.description: Maritime water transport general managers coordinate the administrative activities that go with the management of vessels in the context of maritime water transport. They prepare vessels, check availability, liaise with clients, manage budgets, and oversee operations from an economic standpoint, following regulation for maritime operations.

description: Mechanical Manager plans, directs, and oversees all mechanical engineering activities within an organisation. The manager manages design, development, installation, operation, and maintenance of machinery and mechanical systems, ensuring efficiency, safety, and compliance with industry standards. The manager’s role includes supervising engineering teams, coordinating with other departments, and managing budgets, resources, and project timelines.
tasks: Plan, implement, and monitor production strategies and operational policies to achieve organisational targets. Manage and supervise engineers and technicians, providing operational guidance and oversight. Ensure efficient use of resources and achievement of production targets. Ensure compliance with workplace safety, health, and environmental regulations. Coordinate with other departments to support smooth production and project execution. Develop project plans, schedules, and budgets, and monitor related expenditures. Oversee machinery maintenance programmes and ensure timely resolution of mechanical issues. Lead the implementation of new mechanical technologies and recommend process improvements. Prepare performance reports and manage procurement of equipment, parts, and materials.

candidates.title: mechanical engineer
candidates.description: Mechanical engineers research, plan and design mechanical products and systems and supervise the fabrication, operation, application, installation and repair of systems and products. They research and analyse data.

candidates.title: manufacturing manager
candidates.description: Manufacturing managers plan, oversee and direct the manufacturing process in an organisation. They ensure products and services are efficiently produced within the timeframe and budget given.

candidates.title: industrial machinery mechanic
candidates.description: Industrial machinery mechanics work on new machinery and equipment in operation. They set up for the specific application and build accessories if necessary, perform maintenance and repair, and run diagnostics to find faults in systems or parts that need replacing.

candidates.title: metallurgical manager
candidates.description: Metallurgical managers coordinate and implement short and medium term metallurgical or steel-making production schedules, and coordinate the development, support and improvement of steel-making processes, and the reliability efforts of the maintenance and engineering departments. They also partner with ongoing remediation initiatives.

candidates.title: mechanical engineering technician
candidates.description: Mechanical engineering technicians provide technical support to mechanical engineers in producing and manufacturing mechanical machinery. They help make designs and adjustments, and perform tests. They also develop layouts and drawings, collate and interpret data and write reports.

candidates.title: manufacturing facility manager
candidates.description: Manufacturing facility managers foresee the maintenance and routine operational planning of buildings intended to be used for manufacturing activities. They control and manage health and safety procedures, supervise the work of contractors, plan and handle buildings maintenance operations, fire safety and security issues, and oversee buildings' cleaning activities.

candidates.title: industrial production manager
candidates.description: Industrial production managers oversee the operations and the resources needed in industrial plants and manufacturing sites for a smooth running of the operations. They prepare the production schedule by combining the requirements of clients with the resources of the production plant. They organise the journey of incoming raw materials or semi finished products in the plant until a final product is delivered by coordinating inventories, warehouses, distribution, and support activities.

candidates.title: operations manager
candidates.description: Operations managers plan, oversee and coordinate the daily operations of production of goods and provision of services. They also formulate and implement company policies and plan the use of human resources and materials.

description: Welding Manager plans, directs, and oversees all welding and mechanical activities within an organisation, ensuring that operations comply with safety standards and quality requirements. They manage welding teams, coordinate activities between production and engineering units, maintain equipment, and implement process improvements to meet project objectives efficiently.
tasks: Oversee welding operations to ensure safety, quality, and productivity targets are achieved. Lead and manage welding teams, including task allocation and monitoring of project progress. Review welding blueprints, schematics, and engineering drawings to ensure compliance with specifications. Conduct inspections to verify welding quality and adherence to standards. Develop and implement welding processes and procedures to maintain quality standards. Plan and coordinate welding schedules to ensure projects are completed within deadlines. Manage welding resources, including manpower, equipment, and materials, to ensure efficient utilisation. Identify and implement improvements to welding processes to enhance productivity and reduce waste. Manage welding materials and inventory to support production requirements.

candidates.title: welding coordinator
candidates.description: Welding coordinators supervise the workflow of welding applications. They monitor welding processes performed by other welders, supervise the staff, being sometimes responsible for vocational training. They also weld particularly demanding parts. Welding coordinators ensure that the necessary welding equipment is ready for usage. They mostly coordinate welding applications and related professional activities.

candidates.title: welding engineer
candidates.description: Welding engineers research and develop optimal effective welding techniques and design the corresponding, equally efficient equipment to aid in the welding process. They also conduct quality control and evaluate inspection procedures for welding activities. Welding engineers have advanced knowledge and critical understanding of welding technology application. They are able to manage high complex technical and professional activities or projects related to welding applications, while also taking responsibility for the decision making process.

candidates.title: welding inspector
candidates.description: Welding inspectors examine the connections and bonds between metals. They utilise visual tools and electrical instruments to inspect and ensure the quality and safety of connections. Welding inspectors ensure that all related welding activities, plans and materials follow the appropriate guidelines, in accordance with safety regulations. In addition to working in the field completing their examinations of welding projects, inspectors spend time in an office setting compiling their reports.

candidates.title: welder
candidates.description: Welders operate welding equipment in order to join metal workpieces together. They can use fusion welding processes based on different techniques and materials. They also perform simple visual inspection of welds.

candidates.title: metal production manager
candidates.description: Metal production managers organise and manage the day-to-day and long-term project work in a metal fabrication factory, to process basic metals into fabricated metals. They create and schedule production plans, recruit new staff, enforce safety and company policies, and strive for customer satisfaction through guaranteeing the product's quality.

candidates.title: spot welder
candidates.description: Spot welders set up and tend spot welding machines designed to press and join metal workpieces together. The metal resistance to the passage of electrical current and the subsequent heat created in the process allows for the local melting and joining of the parts.

candidates.title: manufacturing manager
candidates.description: Manufacturing managers plan, oversee and direct the manufacturing process in an organisation. They ensure products and services are efficiently produced within the timeframe and budget given.

description: Oil Mill Manager oversees and directs all operations of an oil mill, ensuring efficient, safe, and compliant production. They manage the milling process from raw material intake, such as fresh fruit bunches or palm kernels, to the production of finished products including crude palm oil, crude palm kernel oil, palm kernel, and palm kernel expeller. candidates.title: land surveyor

candidates.title: real estate surveyor
candidates.description: Real estate surveyors undertake research in order to assess the value of property for tax purposes. They investigate multiple properties at once, using accurate appraisal techniques. They provide their services usually to local and governmental bodies for taxation reasons.

candidates.title: mine surveyor
candidates.description: Mine surveyors prepare and maintain mining plans in line with statutory and management requirements. They keep records of the physical progress of mining operations and of ore or mineral production.

candidates.title: land planner
candidates.description: Land planners visit sites in order to create projects and plans for land usage and development. They collect and analyse data about the land. Land planners provide advice on the efficiency and safety of development plans.

candidates.title: hydrographic surveyor
candidates.description: Hydrographic surveyors measure and map, by means of specialised equipment, marine environments. They collect scientific data in order to study the underwater topography and morphology of bodies of water.

candidates.title: real estate manager
candidates.description: Real estate managers handle and oversee the operational aspects of commercial or residential properties such as private apartments, office buildings and retail stores. candidates.title: marine surveyor
candidates.description: Marine surveyors inspect vessels intended for operations in maritime or open sea waters. candidates.title: soil surveying technician
candidates.description: Soil surveying technicians analyse soil by carrying out technical surveying tasks, using soil surveying techniques. description: Railway Station Master oversees the day-to-day operation of a railway station to ensure safe, efficient, and orderly train services and passenger movement. The role involves coordinating station activities and staff, managing station facilities and services, and ensuring compliance with operational, safety, and security requirements. It also includes responsibility for passenger service standards, handling operational issues at station level, and liaising with relevant personnel to maintain smooth station and train operations.
tasks: Supervise daily railway station operations to ensure timely train movements and efficient service delivery. Ensure passenger safety by providing assistance, information, and handling enquiries and conflicts. Coordinate with train drivers, control centres, and relevant stakeholders to manage schedules and service disruptions. Oversee station facilities, including maintenance, cleanliness, and proper functioning of equipment. Respond to emergency situations and implement established safety and security procedures. Monitor compliance with transport regulations, safety standards, and organisational procedures. Manage station resources, including budget control and procurement of operational supplies. Prepare reports on station performance, staffing needs, and operational issues. Liaise with suppliers, customers, and relevant organisations to support station operations.

candidates.title: railway station manager
candidates.description: Railway station managers are in charge of organising tasks linked to the operation of train stations. Their tasks cover the organisation of the maintenance and repairment works for buildings and interior equipment. They care for the comfort, service, safety and security of passengers, other clients and the commercial use of buildings. Depending on the size of the station, the number of staff that railway station managers are directly responsible for can be high.

candidates.title: rail operations manager
candidates.description: Rail operations managers are concerned with overseeing, designing, and controlling the processes of transport operation. They plan the construction and maintenance work.

candidates.title: rail construction supervisor
candidates.description: Rail construction supervisors monitor the construction and maintenance of railway infrastructure. They assign tasks, either on the ground or from a control room, and make quick decisions to resolve problems.

candidates.title: occupational railway instructor
candidates.description: Occupational railway instructors teach future occupational drivers of railway transportation, such as train, tram, metro and trolley drivers how to operate their railway vehicle according to regulations. They teach their students theory and techniques on how to optimally drive and maintain their specific railway vehicle, observe and evaluate the students' practice. They also focus on non-driving related subjects such as customer service (in case of person transportation) and safety measure regulations.

candidates.title: train conductor
candidates.description: Train conductors assist passengers in the boarding and leaving of the train. candidates.title: railway passenger service agent
candidates.description: Railway passenger service agents spend time with railway station customers, answer their questions and react quickly and safely to unexpected situations. description: Transport Manager plans, directs, and oversees all transportation operations within an organisation, ensuring the efficient, safe, and compliant movement of goods, services, and personnel. candidates.title: transport planner

candidates.title: destination manager

candidates.title: transport engineer

candidates.title: motor vehicle shop manager
candidates.description: Motor vehicle shop managers assume responsibility for activities and staff in a vehicle showroom. ​They manage employees, monitor the sales of the store, manage budgets and order supplies when a product is out of supply and perform administrative duties if required.

candidates.description: Chemical plant managers coordinate the day-to-day production of chemical products ensuring the quality of products and equipment, the safety of personnel and protection of the environment. They define and implement the investment budget, deploy industrial objectives and manage the unit as a profit center representing the company in its economic and social environment.

candidates.title: drugstore manager
candidates.description: Drugstore managers are responsible for activities and staff in drugstores that sell items such as magazines, household products, medicines, cosmetics, candy or refreshments. ​They manage employees, monitor the sales of the store, manage budgets and order supplies when a product is out of supply and perform administrative duties if required.

candidates.title: fruit and vegetables shop manager
candidates.description: Fruit and vegetables shop managers assume responsibility for activities and staff in specialised shops for fruit and vegetables.

candidates.title: food production manager
candidates.description: Food production managers oversee and monitor production and have overall responsibility for staffing and related issues. Hence, they have a detailed knowledge of the manufacturing products and their production processes. On the one hand, they control process parameters and their influence on the product and on the other hand, they ensure that staffing and recruitment levels are adequate.

candidates.title: product manager
candidates.description: Product managers are responsible for managing the lifecycle of a product. They research and develop new products in addition to managing existing ones through market research and strategic planning. Product managers perform marketing and planning activities to increase profits.

candidates.title: botanicals specialist
candidates.description: Botanicals specialists bring a deep knowledge in the science of plants and botanicals to the production of alcoholic beverages based on herbs. These professionals combine knowledge of flavour chemistry, biological sciences and technology process. They may operate botanical milling machines ensuring that the crushing process retains as much flavour and aroma as possible.

candidates.title: herbal therapist
candidates.description: Herbal therapists use herbal medicine to relief pain and treat illnesses such as allergies, chronic physical conditions or stress-related conditions. They study the properties and benefits of plants and create a personalised treatment plan for the patients.

candidates.title: chemical production manager
candidates.description: Chemical production managers are responsible for the technical coordination and control of the chemical production processes. They steer one or more manufacturing units and oversee the implementation of technical and human means, within the framework of objectives of volume, quality and planning. Chemical production managers design and ensure that the production plans and schedules are met. They are responsible for implementation of the processes designed to ensure quality of the manufactured product, good working conditions and environmental practices, and safety of the workplace.

description: Health Educator develops, implements, and evaluates programs to promote healthy lifestyles and prevent disease. They provide education on nutrition, physical activity, and risk avoidance, working with individuals, schools, hospitals, and community organisations. The role includes assessing community needs, creating educational materials, and collaborating with healthcare professionals to enhance public health outcomes.
tasks: Assess the health education needs of individuals and communities. Develop and implement health education programmes and materials. Create and distribute educational resources such as posters, pamphlets, and digital content. Conduct workshops, seminars, and presentations on health topics. Evaluate the effectiveness of health education initiatives. Assist individuals in accessing health services and information. Collaborate with healthcare providers and community organisations. Advocate for improved health resources and community wellness programmes through education and outreach activities.

candidates.title: public health policy officer
candidates.description: Public health policy officers develop and implement strategies for the improvement of a community's health care policy. They advise governments on policy changes and identify problems in current health care policies.

candidates.title: community health worker
candidates.description: Community health workers provide advice and information about various health subjects to the community. They can assist with pre- and post-natal care, give nutritional advice and help individuals stop smoking. Community health workers develop health and prevention programmes.

candidates.title: health psychologist
candidates.description: Health psychologists deal with the various aspects of health related behaviour of individuals and groups, by helping individuals or groups prevent illness and promote healthy behaviours by also providing counseling services. They perform tasks for the development of health promotion activities and projects on the basis of psychological science, research findings, theories, methods and techniques. They also engage in research about health related issues to influence public policy on health care issues.

candidates.title: healthcare specialist lecturer
candidates.description: Healthcare specialist lecturers are subject professors, teachers, or lecturers, and often doctors who instruct students who have obtained an upper secondary education diploma in their own specialised field of healthcare, which is predominantly academic in nature. They work with their university research assistants and university teaching assistants for the preparation of lectures and of exams, for grading papers and exams, for leading laboratory practices, and for leading review and feedback sessions for the students. They also conduct academic research in their respective field of specialist healthcare, publish their findings and liaise with other university colleagues.

candidates.title: healthcare consultant
candidates.description: Healthcare consultants advise health care organisations on the development of plans to improve patient care and safety. They analyse health care policies and identify issues, and aid in the development of improvement strategies.

candidates.title: physical education teacher secondary school
candidates.description: Physical education teachers at secondary schools provide education to students, commonly children and young adults, in a secondary school setting. They are usually subject teachers, specialised and instructing in their own field of study, physical education . They prepare lesson plans and materials, monitor the students’ progress, assist individually when necessary, and evaluate the students’ knowledge and performance on the subject of physical education through practical, usually physical, tests and examinations.

candidates.title: dietitian
candidates.description: Dietitians assess specific nutritional requirements of populations or individuals throughout their lives and translate this into advice which will maintain, reduce risk to, or restore people’s health. Using evidence-based approaches, dietitians work to empower individuals, families and groups to provide or select food which is nutritionally adequate, safe, tasty and sustainable. Beyond healthcare, dietitians improve the nutritional environment for all through governments, industry, academia and research.

candidates.title: health and safety officer
candidates.description: Health and safety officers execute plans for the improvement of work environments and cultures. They assess risks and interview employees to ensure the work environment is compliant with health and safety rules, as well as ensuring the interaction within the workplace occurs in a positive and productive manner. If employed in a healthcare facility the health and safety officer has to investigate infections spreading across a facility and advice all employees how to combat and prevent infections. Furthermore health physics is applied at facilities where people are exposed to ionizing radiation such as nuclear power plants and research institutions.

description: Chief Nurse oversees and leads a nursing team in a hospital or medical facility, ensuring high-quality patient care and adherence to healthcare standards. The chief nurse manages nursing operations, including staff performance, infection control, policy implementation, and compliance with Malaysian laws and Ministry of Health regulations. The role also involves strategic planning, budgeting, coordinating with other departments, updating nursing procedures, and supporting staff recruitment and development.
tasks: Lead and manage the nursing team to ensure high-quality patient care. Oversee recruitment, training, supervision, and performance evaluation of nursing staff. Develop, implement, and review nursing policies and procedures to ensure legal compliance and quality standards. Manage staffing levels, duty rosters, and workload allocation across hospital units. Coordinate with medical staff and other departments to ensure integrated patient care. Oversee operational performance and service delivery across hospital units, including Outpatient Department (OPD), wards, Intensive Care Unit (ICU), Operating Theatre (OT), and day care services. Implement quality improvement initiatives and ensure compliance with clinical regulations, including waste disposal. Provide oversight of patient admission processes and nursing care standards across the organisation. Address patient and staff concerns, promoting a safe and supportive working environment.

candidates.title: nurse responsible for general care
candidates.description: Nurses responsible for general care are in charge of promoting and restoring patients` health by providing physical and psychological support to patients, friends, and families. They also supervise assigned team members.

candidates.title: specialist nurse
candidates.description: Specialist nurses promote and restore people's health, and diagnose and care within a specific branch of the nursing field. Examples of such specialist nursing jobs include but are not restricted to; ambulatory care nurse, advanced practice nurse, cardiac nurse, dental nurse, community health nurse, forensic nurse, gastroenterology nurse, hospice and palliative care nurse, paediatric nurse, public health nurse, rehabilitation nurse, renal nurse and school nurse. Specialist nurses are general care nurses prepared beyond the level of a nurse generalist and authorised to practice as specialists with specific expertise in a branch of the nursing field.

candidates.title: nurse assistant
candidates.description: Nurse assistants provide basic patient care under direction of nursing staff. They perform duties such as feed, bathe, dress, groom, move patients or change linens and may transfer or transport patients.

candidates.title: advanced nurse practitioner
candidates.description: Advanced nurse practitioners are in charge of promoting and restoring patients` health, provide diagnosis and care in advanced settings, coordinating care within areas of chronic disease management, providing integrated care, and supervising assigned team members. Advanced nurse practitioners are general care nurses who have acquired an expert knowledge base, complex decision making skills and clinical competencies for expanded clinical practice on advanced level.

candidates.title: chief fire officer
candidates.description: Chief fire officers supervise a fire department. They coordinate the operations of the department, and supervise and lead the fire and rescue staff during firefighting and rescue activities to ensure the safety of the staff and limitation of risks. They perform administrative duties to ensure record maintenance, and implement policies to improve the department's operations.

candidates.title: chief operating officer
candidates.description: Chief operating officers are the right hand and second in command of a company's chief executive officer. They ensure that the daily operations of the company run smoothly. Chief operating officers also develop company policies, rules and goals.

candidates.title: veterinary nurse
candidates.description: Veterinary nurses support animals undergoing veterinary treatment and give advice to veterinary clients in the promotion of animal health and disease prevention in accordance with national legislation.

candidates.title: chief conductor
candidates.description: Chief conductors are responsible for the safe performance of all operational tasks on board of passenger trains outside the drivers cab, such as supervising safe opening and closing of the train's doors. They supervise and ensure the continuous care for the safety of passengers, especially in the case of technical incidents and emergency situations. They ensure the operational communication to the driver and to traffic control staff as defined in operational regulations. In case of several staff members attending the train, they supervise the team of conductors. They also carry out commercial activities such as ticket control and selling, and provide support and information to passengers as well as gastronomic services.

description: Physicist studies and analyses physical phenomena across a range of scales, from subatomic particles to the universe. They conduct research, experiments, and simulations to develop theories, understand natural laws, and solve practical problems in areas such as energy, materials, electronics, aerospace, and healthcare. Their work includes data analysis, model development, and collaboration with academic, industrial, or government organisations, applying findings to improve technology, vehicle design, space exploration, and societal outcomes.
tasks: Conduct research to develop and improve physical and astrophysical concepts, theories, methods, and models. Design and perform experiments, observations, simulations, and tests to investigate physical, aerodynamic, and astronomical phenomena. Collect, analyse, and interpret complex experimental, observational, and computational data using mathematical and statistical techniques. Develop and apply computational models and simulations, including numerical and fluid dynamics models, to study physical systems. Contribute to the analysis and evaluation of materials, devices, or systems for applications in aerospace, industry, and space science. Conduct laboratory, wind tunnel, field, flight, or space-based experiments to evaluate physical behaviour and system performance. Evaluate research and test results, draw conclusions, and validate findings against theoretical predictions. Collaborate with engineers, scientists, and project teams on research, development, and applied science projects. Prepare technical reports, scientific papers, and documentation, and present findings to stakeholders and at professional forums. Contribute to the application of research outcomes in industry, technology development, and space exploration.

candidates.title: physicist
candidates.description: Physicists are scientists who study physical phenomena. They focus their research depending on their specialisation, which can range from atomic particle physics to the study of phenomena in the universe. They apply their findings for the improvement of society by contributing to the development of energy supplies, treatment of illness, game development, cutting-edge equipment, and daily use objects.

candidates.title: astronomer
candidates.description: Astronomers research the formation, structures, properties, and development of celestial bodies and interstellar matter. They use ground-based equipment and space-based equipment to collect data about the space for research purposes.

candidates.title: physics technician
candidates.description: Physics technicians monitor physical processes and perform tests for manufacturing, educational or scientific purposes. They work in laboratories, schools or production facilities where they assist physicists in their work. Physics technicians perform technical or practical work and report about their results.

candidates.title: physics lecturer
candidates.description: Physics lecturers are subject professors, teachers, or lecturers who instruct students who have obtained an upper secondary education diploma in their own specialised field of study, physics, which is predominantly academic in nature. They work with their university research assistants and university teaching assistants for the preparation of lectures and of exams, for leading laboratory practices, grading papers and exams and for leading review and feedback sessions for the students. They also conduct academic research in their field of physics, publish their findings and liaise with>other university colleagues.

candidates.title: cosmologist
candidates.description: Cosmologists focus on the study of the universe as a whole, which is made up by its origin, evolution and ultimate fate. They use tools and scientific instruments to observe and study other galaxies and astronomical objects such as stars, black holes, planets and other celestial bodies.

candidates.title: physiologist
candidates.description: Physiologists study and exert research on the functioning of different living organisms, the parts they are composed of, and their interactions. They understand the fashion in which living systems react to factors such as diseases, physical activity, and stress, and use that information to develop methods and solutions to even out the effect that those stimuli have in living bodies.

candidates.title: biophysicist
candidates.description: Biophysicists study the existing relation between living organisms and physics. They conduct research on living organisms based on the methods of physics that aim to explain the complexity of life, predict patterns, and draw conclusions about aspects of life. Biophysicists' research fields cover DNA, proteins, molecules, cells, and environments.

candidates.title: medical physics expert
candidates.description: Medical physics experts advice on matters related to radiation physics applied to medical exposure. They are responsible for dosimetry and the optimisation of the radiation protection of patients and other individuals subjected to medical exposure, including the application and use of diagnostic reference levels. Medical physics experts are involved in the selection of medical radiological equipment, the quality assurance including acceptance testing, the preparation of technical specifications, and the installation, design and surveillance of the medical radiological installations. They also analyse the events involving accidental or unintended medical exposures and are responsible for the training of practitioners and other staff in relevant aspects of radiation protection.

description: Astronaut commands and operates spacecraft beyond low Earth orbit, conducting scientific research, experiments, satellite launches, and space station construction. They perform spacewalks, monitor spacecraft systems, and support mission objectives, collaborating with international space agencies while undergoing extensive physical and technical training to operate safely and effectively in space.
tasks: Conduct scientific experiments and research in microgravity and spacecraft environments. Operate spacecraft systems, robotic equipment, and onboard instruments to support mission objectives. Perform extravehicular activities to carry out maintenance, assembly, repair, or research tasks. Monitor and operate life-support, environmental, and spacecraft systems to ensure crew safety and mission continuity. Identify, troubleshoot, and respond to system malfunctions and in-flight emergencies. Coordinate and work closely with crew members and mission control centres during missions. Collect, handle, and document data, samples, and observations for scientific analysis. Participate in mission planning, training, simulations, and emergency preparedness activities.

candidates.title: astronaut
candidates.description: Astronauts are crew members commanding spacecrafts for operations beyond low Earth orbit or higher than the regular altitude reached by commercial flights. They orbit the Earth in order to perform operations such as scientific research and experiments, launching or release of satellites, and building of space stations.

candidates.title: astronomer
candidates.description: Astronomers research the formation, structures, properties, and development of celestial bodies and interstellar matter. They use ground-based equipment and space-based equipment to collect data about the space for research purposes.

candidates.title: space science lecturer
candidates.description: Space science lecturers are subject professors, teachers, or lecturers who instruct students who have obtained an upper secondary education diploma in their own specialised field of study, space science, which is predominantly academic in nature. They work with their university research assistants and university teaching assistants for the preparation of lectures and of exams, grading papers and leading review and feedback sessions for the students. They also conduct academic research in their field of space science, publish their findings and liaise with other university colleagues.

candidates.title: drone pilot
candidates.description: Drone pilots remotely operate unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs). They navigate the drone as well as activate other equipment as cameras, sensors as LIDARS to calculate distances, or any other instrumentation.

candidates.title: aircraft pilot
candidates.description: Aircraft pilots control and navigate aircraft. They operate the mechanical and electrical systems of the aircraft and transport people, mail and freight.

candidates.title: air force pilot
candidates.description: Air force pilots operate aircrafts in combat missions, patrol missions, or search and rescue missions. They ensure aircraft maintenance, and communicate with air force bases and other vessels to ensure safety and efficiency in operations.

candidates.title: missionary
candidates.description: Missionaries supervise the execution of missions of outreach from a church foundation. They organise the mission and develop the mission's goals and strategies, and ensure the mission's goals are executed, and policies implemented. They perform administrative duties for record maintenance, and facilitate communication with the relevant institutions in the mission's location.

candidates.title: navy officer
candidates.description: Navy officers command missions during conflict and peace times, and supervise training and development of their teams. They supervise combat operations of their team, as well as aid missions, and patrolling missions to ensure peace-keeping. Often they collaborate on a regular basis with the HR department of the HQCS for the best planning of the future needs.

description: Meteorologist studies the atmosphere's composition, structure, and dynamics to provide accurate weather forecasts and analyse climate patterns. They conduct research and develop models to predict short-term weather events and long-term climate trends, using data from satellites, radar, and weather stations. Their work supports aviation, shipping, agriculture, disaster preparedness, environmental monitoring, and policy-making related to climate and societal planning.
tasks: Collect and analyse atmospheric and climate data from weather stations, satellites, radars, and other observation systems. Interpret meteorological observations and analyse atmospheric patterns to understand weather and climate conditions. Develop, apply, and validate weather and climate models, including numerical weather prediction models. Generate weather forecasts and climate outlooks based on meteorological data and modelling results. Issue weather forecasts, advisories, and warnings to authorities, stakeholders, and the public, particularly during hazardous weather events. Conduct research on atmospheric processes, climate variability, and climate change, and assess their potential impacts. Prepare scientific reports, technical documentation, and presentations on meteorological and climate findings. Collaborate with disaster management agencies, environmental organisations, and research institutions to support disaster preparedness, environmental monitoring, and weather-sensitive sectors.

candidates.title: meteorologist
candidates.description: Meteorologists study climate processes, measure and predict weather patterns and provide consultancy services to a variety of weather information users. They work out models for weather forecasting, develop instruments to collect meteorological data and compile statistics and databases.

candidates.title: aviation meteorologist
candidates.description: Aviation meteorologists forecast weather conditions in airports. They provide day-to-day, hour-to-hour observations, analysis, forecasts, warnings, and advice to pilots, airport operators and airlines in meteorological matters. They report weather conditions expected at airports, current conditions, and en route forecasts.

candidates.title: meteorology technician
candidates.description: Meteorology technicians collect large amounts of meteorological information for weather information users such as aviation companies or meteorological institutions. They operate specialised measuring instruments to make accurate weather predictions and report their observations. Meteorology technicians assist meteorologists in their scientific operations.

candidates.title: weather forecaster
candidates.description: Weather forecasters gather meteorological data. They predict the weather according to these data. Weather forecasters present these forecasts to the audience via radio, television or online.

candidates.title: environmental scientist
candidates.description: Environmental scientists identify problems and find solutions in order to minimize environmental hazards by performing analysis on samples such as air, water or soil. They advise on or develop environmental policies and aim to improve water supplies preservation and manage waste disposal sites. Environmental scientists perform environmental risk assessments and analyse the environmental impact of new solutions, construction sites or environmental changes ensuring the environmental regulations are followed.

candidates.title: climatologist
candidates.description: Climatologists study the average change in weather and climate from a long-term perspective. They research and analyse historic weather conditions in order to forecast climatic conditions trends such as changes in temperature, global warming, or regional evolutive weather conditions. They use these findings for advising on environmental policy, construction, agricultural projects, and societal matters.

candidates.title: hydrologist
candidates.description: Hydrologists research and study the quality, current challenges, and distribution of water in the Earth. They study water supply from rivers, streams, and springs to determine their adequate and sustainable use. Together with a cross functional team of professionals, they plan and develop how water can be supplied to cities and urban areas while ensuring efficiency and resource conservation.

candidates.title: environmental expert
candidates.description: Environmental experts search for technological solutions to tackle environmental problems. They detect and analyse environmental issues and develop new technological production processes to counter these problematic issues. They research the effect of their technological innovations and present their findings in scientific reports.

description: Meteorologist (Environmental) studies and analyses weather and atmospheric conditions to understand their impact on human habitats and the environment. They interpret atmospheric data to assess air quality, climate trends, and pollution, providing insights that support environmental management and policy development for sustainability.
tasks: Monitor atmospheric conditions and weather patterns. Analyse meteorological, climate, and environmental data to assess weather, air quality, and pollution conditions. Prepare and communicate weather and environmental advisories and forecasts to support risk mitigation and informed decision-making. Conduct scientific research, data collection, and analysis on weather phenomena and environmental impacts. Investigate atmospheric phenomena such as air movement, pressure, temperature, and humidity to support environmental assessment. Provide meteorological and environmental advisory services to support environmental management and sustainability-related activities. Collaborate with environmental agencies and organisations on weather and environmental matters. Prepare reports on climate, weather, air quality, and environmental impacts. Support environmental management and policy development through meteorological and environmental analysis.

candidates.title: environmental geologist
candidates.description: Environmental geologists study how mineral operations may impact the composition and physical characteristics of the earth and its resources. They provide advice on issues such as land reclamation and environmental pollution.

candidates.title: weather forecaster
candidates.description: Weather forecasters gather meteorological data. They predict the weather according to these data. Weather forecasters present these forecasts to the audience via radio, television or online.

candidates.title: ecologist
candidates.description: Ecologists carry out assessments of the health and distribution of organisms, namely people, plants, and animals, and the relationship between organisms and their environment. Ecologists usually have a specialisation area, e.g. freshwater, marine, terrestrial, fauna, and flora about which they conduct research and perform related tasks.

description: Meteorologist (Numerical Weather Prediction Modelling) studies atmospheric processes and weather patterns, using mathematical and computational models to simulate and forecast conditions. They collect, analyse, and interpret meteorological data from satellites, radar, and other instruments to develop accurate short- and long-term weather predictions. Their work supports public information, government planning, and sectors such as agriculture, aviation, and disaster management.
tasks: Gather and analyse meteorological data from multiple sources to monitor atmospheric conditions. Develop, implement, validate, and calibrate numerical models for weather prediction. Investigate atmospheric phenomena such as air movement, pressure, temperature, humidity, cloud formation, and precipitation. Issue model-based weather forecasts, warnings, and advisories on meteorological hazards. Analyse forecast outputs and weather changes to assess potential impacts and risk mitigation measures. Provide meteorological advisory services to customers, stakeholders, and relevant authorities. Communicate model-based weather forecasts and warnings to media, government agencies, and the public. Collaborate with disaster management teams and scientists to improve forecasting accuracy. Maintain meteorological datasets, modelling systems, and participate in research to enhance forecasting techniques.

candidates.title: forecast manager
candidates.description: Forecast managers have a deep understanding of the operations of the company, the inventory levels, production batches, requirements and costs of production per product, and trends in the demand levels. They use all that information in combination with forecasting software in order to define production orders aiming for the most efficient production combinations.

They study water supply from rivers, streams, and springs to determine their adequate and sustainable use. Together with a cross functional team of professionals, they plan and develop how water can be supplied to cities and urban areas while ensuring efficiency and resource conservation.

candidates.title: predictive maintenance expert
candidates.description: Predictive maintenance experts analyse data collected from sensors located in factories, machineries, cars, railroads and others to monitor their conditions in order to keep users informed and eventually notify the need to perform maintenance.

candidates.title: climatologist
candidates.description: Climatologists study the average change in weather and climate from a long-term perspective. They research and analyse historic weather conditions in order to forecast climatic conditions trends such as changes in temperature, global warming, or regional evolutive weather conditions. They use these findings for advising on environmental policy, construction, agricultural projects, and societal matters.

description: Meteorological Officer Grade C9 issuing weather forecasts, weather warnings, monitoring and issuing information about earthquakes and tsunamis so that property damage and deaths can be reduced, analysing weather changes professionally and identifying impacts and measures to reduce the impacts, analysing meteorological charts and conducting research on weather phenomena to reduce the impact of bad weather. Providing advisory services efficiently and effectively to meet customer needs and expectations of interested parties (stakeholders) to increase socio-economic activities for the people and country
tasks: Issuing public, special, and severe weather forecasts/warnings, and provides briefings to the Disaster Committee and the media. Providing aviation meteorological briefings and prepares Terminal Aerodrome Forecast (TAFOR), Two Hours Trend Type Landing Forecast (TREND), flight documentation, and weather warnings to ensure operational safety. Continuously monitoring weather conditions, waves, and winds in Malaysian waters, particularly in the presence of tropical storms in national waters or typhoons in adjacent waters. Conducting earthquake monitoring, processes seismological data, manages databases, and disseminates earthquake information. Producing weather and climate information available in databases, performs quality control, and ensures the smooth operation of the Climate Information System (MAKLIM). Managing agrometeorological data and ensures the quality of data from the station network. Managing the operation, processing, and maintenance of meteorological satellite systems and data, as well as the provision of imagery. Planning and coordinating inspection, maintenance, and overhaul programmes for conventional meteorological observation equipment at principal stations and those operated by external agencies. Managing meteorological ICT systems, including the Global Telecommunication System (GTS), Aeronautical Fixed Telecommunication Network (AFTN), message switching, databases, and compliance with World Meteorological Organization (WMO) and International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO) standards. Conducting research, manages international relations, oversees corporate communications, and develops departmental human resources and quality.
