candidates.description: Biomedical scientists perform all laboratory methods required as part of medical examination, monitoring, treatment, and research activities which involves designing, planning, organizing, applying, evaluating, interpreting and validating all analytical processes. This requires the application of qualitative and quantitative laboratory methods, including image analysis and digital pathology, to provide an investigative report and diagnostic opinion on products of a biological nature.

candidates.title: immunologist
candidates.description: Immunologists research the immune system of living organisms (e.g. human body) and the way it reacts to external infections or invasive harmful agents (e.g. virus, bacteria, parasites). They focus their study on those diseases that affect the immunology of living organisms in order to classify them for treatment.

description: Bio-Fermentation Specialist studies microorganisms and their roles in fermentation processes, applying this knowledge to develop and optimise the production of bio-products such as pharmaceuticals, enzymes, and biofuels. They conduct research, analyse fermentation systems, and develop new applications, while overseeing, monitoring, and troubleshooting fermentation batches to ensure product quality and efficiency, collaborating closely with research and production teams.
tasks: Design and optimise fermentation protocols and production processes for microbial bioproduct manufacturing. Prepare and sterilise fermentation media, equipment, and bioreactors using aseptic procedures and contamination control practices. Monitor and control fermentation parameters and analyse microbial growth, metabolic activity, and product formation to optimise performance, yield, and quality. Conduct microbiological research to improve microbial strains, fermentation systems, and process efficiency. Troubleshoot fermentation batch and process issues in collaboration with research, production, and technical teams. Ensure compliance with laboratory, safety, and quality standards in fermentation operations.

candidates.title: food biotechnologist
candidates.description: Food biotechnologists study the life cycle of food from its preservation up to the spoilage and the food-borne pathogens. They research and understand food-borne diseases in order to prevent them. They ensure that food products abide by government regulations regarding food health and safety.

candidates.title: microbiologist
candidates.description: Microbiologists study and research the life forms, characteristics, and processes of microscopic organisms. They study microorganisms such as bacteria, protozoa, fungi, etc. in order to diagnose and counteract the effects that these microorganisms might have in animals, in the environment, in the food industry, or in the health care industry.

candidates.title: cider fermentation operator
candidates.description: Cider fermentation operators control the fermentation process of mash or wort inoculated with yeast.

candidates.title: botanicals specialist
candidates.description: Botanicals specialists bring a deep knowledge in the science of plants and botanicals to the production of alcoholic beverages based on herbs. These professionals combine knowledge of flavour chemistry, biological sciences and technology process. They may operate botanical milling machines ensuring that the crushing process retains as much flavour and aroma as possible.

candidates.title: food technologist
candidates.description: Food technologists develop processes for manufacturing foodstuffs and related products based on chemical, physical, and biological principles and technology. They design and plan layouts or equipment, oversee staff, engage in controlling, and improve food technologies in food production processes.

candidates.title: food safety specialist
candidates.description: Food safety specialists organise processes and implement procedures to avoid problems with food safety. They comply with regulations.

candidates.title: biochemical engineer
candidates.description: Biochemical engineers research on the field of life science striving for new discoveries. They convert those findings into chemical solutions that can improve the wellbeing of society such as vaccines, tissue repair, crops improvement and green technologies advances such as cleaner fuels from natural resources.

candidates.title: food production manager
candidates.description: Food production managers oversee and monitor production and have overall responsibility for staffing and related issues. Hence, they have a detailed knowledge of the manufacturing products and their production processes. On the one hand, they control process parameters and their influence on the product and on the other hand, they ensure that staffing and recruitment levels are adequate.

candidates.title: bee breeder

candidates.title: food technologist

description: Ceramics Technologist applies engineering and technological principles to research, develop, and produce ceramic materials and products. They design and improve manufacturing processes, build and test prototypes, evaluate performance, and implement quality control measures. Their work focuses on enhancing the properties, applications, and overall productivity of ceramic products through collaboration with design and production teams.
tasks: Conduct research on ceramic materials, formulations and processing techniques to support product development. Develop and test new ceramic formulations and prototypes to evaluate their performance and applications. Review and design production schedules, processes and specifications, and implement improvements to maximise efficiency and reduce waste. Design and apply process control measures to minimise production costs and manufacturing issues. Prepare material lists, purchase orders, cost analyses and production cost estimates. Implement quality control measures throughout ceramic manufacturing. Collaborate with design and production teams to integrate new ceramic materials into products and processes. Ensure compliance with safety and environmental regulations in ceramic production. Train staff on new ceramic processes and troubleshoot production issues.

candidates.title: ceramicist
candidates.description: Ceramicist have an in-depth knowledge of materials and the relevant know-how to develop their own methods of expression and personal projects through ceramic. Their creations can include ceramic sculptures, jewellery, domestic and commercial tablewares and kitchenwares, giftware, garden ceramics, wall and floor tiles.

candidates.title: ceramic painter
candidates.description: Ceramic painters design and create visual art on ceramic surfaces and objects such as tiles, sculptures, tableware and pottery. They use a variety of techniques to produce decorative illustrations ranging from stenciling to free-hand drawing.

candidates.title: materials engineer
candidates.description: Materials engineers research and design new or improved materials for a diverse number of applications. They analyse the composition of materials, conduct experiments, and develop new materials for industry-specific use that can range from rubber, to textiles, glass, metals, and chemicals. They advise companies in damage assessments, quality assurance of materials, and recycling of materials.

candidates.title: rubber technologist
candidates.description: Rubber technologists develop compound formulations to respond to specific needs and attain the required in-rubber properties, starting from technical specifications and application demands. They have knowledge of physical and chemical characteristics of raw rubber material and the process to convert it into market products.

candidates.title: textile technologist
candidates.description: Textile technologists are in charge of the optimisation of the textile manufacturing system management, both traditional and innovative. They develop and supervise the textile production system according to the quality system: processes of spinning, weaving, knitting, finishing namely dyeing, finishes, printing with appropriate methodologies of organisation, management and control and using emerging textile technologies.

candidates.title: clothing technologist
candidates.description: Clothing technologists work on the design, development and production of textile and apparel products. They carry out a range of technical, investigative and quality control work to ensure the end product (from clothing to household up to industrial textiles). They perform to specifications, improve production efficiency and quality while liaising with those involved in the production process. They liaise with designers, adapt designs to suit production methods, make and size pre-production garments, source fabrics and accessories, undertake quality evaluations of materials, check the quality of the final product, and consider ecological aspects.

candidates.title: food technologist
candidates.description: Food technologists develop processes for manufacturing foodstuffs and related products based on chemical, physical, and biological principles and technology. They design and plan layouts or equipment, oversee staff, engage in controlling, and improve food technologies in food production processes.

candidates.title: porcelain painter
candidates.description: Porcelain painters design and create visual art on porcelain surfaces and objects such as tiles and pottery. They use a variety of techniques to produce decorative illustrations ranging from stenciling to free-hand drawing.

description: Photonic Engineer works with the generation, transmission, and detection of light to design, develop, and test photonic components and systems. They apply their expertise to areas such as optical communications, medical instrumentation, sensing, and material processing, focusing on improving performance and advancing technology. Their work involves developing devices and solutions using photons, including lasers, fiber optics, sensors, and imaging systems, often collaborating with multidisciplinary teams to integrate photonic innovations into practical applications.
tasks: Design and simulate photonic components, optical devices, and optical systems. Conduct laboratory experiments, optical measurements, and performance tests on photonic components and systems. Develop prototypes, evaluate existing optical devices, and implement design or process improvements to enhance performance. Establish design, testing, and quality standards for photonic products and processes in consultation with management and users. Collaborate with engineers, scientists, and product teams to develop, integrate, and apply photonic technologies in practical applications. Analyse experimental and performance data, and prepare technical reports and design documentation. Ensure compliance with safety, quality, and relevant technical standards in photonic design, development, and testing. Participate in research and development activities to innovate and optimise photonic technologies and applications.

candidates.title: photonics engineer
candidates.description: Photonics engineers are concerned with the generation, transmission, transformation, and detection of light. They conduct research, design, assemble, test and deploy photonic components or systems in multiple application fields, from optical communications to medical instrumentation, material processing or sensing technology.

candidates.title: photonics engineering technician
candidates.description: Photonics engineering technicians collaborate with engineers in the development of photonic systems or components, usually in the form of optical equipment, such as lasers, lenses, and fibre optic equipment. Photonics engineering technicians build, test, install and calibrate optical equipment. They read blueprint and other technical drawings to develop testing and calibrating procedures.

candidates.title: optical engineer
candidates.description: Optical engineers design and develop different industrial applications with optics. They have knowledge of light, light transmission principles, and optics in order to design engineering specs of equipment such as microscopes, lenses, telescopes, and other optical devices.

candidates.title: optoelectronic engineer
candidates.description: Optoelectronic engineers design and develop optoelectronic systems and devices, such as UV sensors, photodiodes, and LEDs. Optoelectronic engineering combines optical engineering with electronic engineering in the design of these systems and devices. They conduct research, perform analysis, test the devices, and supervise the research.

candidates.title: optomechanical engineer
candidates.description: Optomechanical engineers design and develop optomechanical systems, devices, and components, such as optical mirrors and optical mounts. Optomechanical engineering combines optical engineering with mechanical engineering in the design of these systems and devices. They conduct research, perform analysis, test the devices, and supervise the research.

candidates.title: optoelectronic engineering technician
candidates.description: Optoelectronic engineering technicians collaborate with engineers in the development of optoelectronic systems and components, such as photodiodes, optical sensors, lasers and LED's. Optoelectronic engineering technicians build, test, install and calibrate optoelectronic equipment. They read blueprint and other technical drawings to develop testing and calibrating procedures.

candidates.title: intelligent lighting engineer
candidates.description: Intelligent lighting engineers set up, prepare, check and maintain digital and automated lighting equipment in order to provide optimal lighting quality for a live performance. They cooperate with road crew to unload, set up and operate lighting equipment and instruments.

candidates.title: microelectronics engineer
candidates.description: Microelectronics engineers design, develop, and supervise the production of small electronic devices and components such as micro-processors and integrated circuits.

description: Scada Engineer designs, implements, and maintains supervisory control and data acquisition (SCADA) systems to monitor and control industrial processes in manufacturing, utilities, and infrastructure. They configure system components, ensure operational reliability, troubleshoot faults, and optimise performance to support efficient and continuous operations.
tasks: Design and implement Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) system architecture, hardware, and software for industrial process monitoring and control. Develop and implement SCADA process improvements and technological upgrades to enhance operational efficiency and continuous performance. Design and program control systems, SCADA applications, and Human-Machine Interface (HMI) functions to support reliable system operation. Monitor SCADA system performance, respond to alarms and faults, and maintain, troubleshoot, and upgrade systems to ensure operational reliability. Collaborate with engineers, technicians, and other relevant teams to support SCADA system integration and implementation. Document technical specifications, maintenance procedures, and system modifications accurately.

candidates.title: industrial engineer
candidates.description: Industrial engineers design a vast array of production systems aiming to present efficient and effective solutions. They integrate a varied number of variables such as workers, technology, ergonomics, production flows, and product specifications for the design and implementation of production systems. They can specify and design for microsystems as well.

candidates.title: equipment engineer
candidates.description: Equipment engineers design and maintain the machinery and equipment in manufacturing facilities. They design machinery that adjusts to the manufacturing requirements and processes. Moreover, they envision the maintenance of the machines and equipment for uninterrupted functioning.

candidates.title: automation engineer
candidates.description: Automation engineers research, design, and develop applications and systems for the automation of the production process. They implement technology and reduce, whenever applicable, human input to reach the full potential of industrial robotics. Automation engineers oversee the process and ensure all systems run safely and smoothly.

candidates.title: production engineer
candidates.description: Production engineers review and evaluate production performance, perform data analysis and identify under-performing production systems. They search for long or short term solutions, plan production enhancements and process optimizations.

candidates.title: military engineer
candidates.description: Military engineers perform technical and scientific functions in the military, such as the development of concepts for military technical equipment, support of the manufacturing of military equipment, and technical research, maintenance, and quality assurance.

candidates.title: industrial engineering technician
candidates.description: Industrial engineering technicians assist industrial engineers in improving efficiency, safety and productivity in manufacturing plants. They conduct production studies, prepare layouts for machinery and equipment and suggest solutions to remedy quality problems.

candidates.title: mechatronics engineer
candidates.description: Mechatronics engineers design and develop intelligent systems, such as robotic devices, smart home appliances, and aeroplanes, through combining technologies from mechanical, electronic, computer, and control engineering. They create blueprints or design documents for parts, assemblies or finished products using software programs, and also oversee and manage projects.

candidates.title: manufacturing engineer
candidates.description: Manufacturing engineers design manufacturing processes for different kinds of production processes. They integrate those specificities and constraints posed by the industry or the product being produced with general and wide-spread manufacturing engineering principles into the design and planification of manufacturing processes.

description: Energy Engineer designs, develops, and implements efficient, sustainable, and environmentally friendly energy systems. They work with both conventional sources such as oil and gas and renewable sources including wind and solar, analysing energy use, evaluating existing systems, and recommending improvements to enhance efficiency and reduce environmental impact. They ensure compliance with regulations, conduct technical assessments, and support the integration of advanced energy technologies to promote conservation and sustainable energy solutions.
tasks: Conduct energy audits, analyse energy use, and evaluate existing systems to identify efficiency improvements and potential energy savings. Design and implement energy-efficient and sustainable energy systems, including renewable energy technologies such as wind, solar, and biomass. Develop and implement process improvements, technological upgrades, and energy management measures to enhance system efficiency and reduce environmental impact. Monitor, analyse, and report on energy consumption, system performance, energy savings, and environmental outcomes. Review processes and system specifications to optimise energy efficiency, reduce waste, and support sustainable operations. Collaborate with engineers, architects, and environmental specialists to develop integrated energy solutions. Prepare technical reports, documentation, cost analyses, and procurement requirements to support energy projects. Oversee the installation, commissioning, maintenance, and performance optimisation of energy systems. Train staff and advise stakeholders on operational procedures, best practices, and regulatory compliance in energy systems. Coordinate project schedules, budgets, resources, and documentation for energy engineering activities.

candidates.title: energy engineer
candidates.description: Energy engineers design new, efficient and clean ways to produce, transform, and distribute energy to improve environmental sustainability and energy efficiency. They deal with the extraction of energy through natural resources, such as oil or gas, or renewable and sustainable sources, such as wind or solar power.

candidates.title: energy systems engineer
candidates.description: Energy systems engineers supervise the energy conversion and distribution processes. They analyse the energy supply and consumption efficiency developing new ways to improve the existing processes, taking into account both the technical and the financial aspects. They also study the environmental impact of energy usage and combine the production of renewable energy in the current power systems.

candidates.title: renewable energy engineer
candidates.description: Renewable energy engineers research alternative sources of energy in order to design systems for renewable energy production. They strive to optimise energy production from renewable sources, and reduce production expenses and environmental strain. They design systems which focus on energy sustainability and efficiency.

candidates.title: solar energy engineer
candidates.description: Solar energy engineers design systems which generate electrical energy from sunlight, such as photovoltaic systems. They design and construct systems which optimise the energy output from solar power, and the sustainability of the production process of solar systems.

candidates.title: electric power generation engineer
candidates.description: Electric power generation engineers design and develop systems which generate electrical power, and develop strategies for the improvement of existing electricity generation systems. They strive to conciliate sustainable solutions with efficient and affordable solutions. They engage in projects where supply of electrical energy is required.

candidates.title: energy manager
candidates.description: Energy managers coordinate the energy use in an organisation, and aim to implement policies for increased sustainability, and minimisation of cost and environmental impact. They monitor the energy demands and use, and develop improvement strategies, as well as researching the most beneficial source of energy for the organisation's needs.

candidates.title: electrical engineer
candidates.description: Electrical engineers design and develop electrical systems, electrical equipment, components, motors, and equipment with the feature of energy transmission. They engage in large scale projects such as the design and maintenance of power stations, and the distribution of power to smaller applications such as household appliances.

candidates.title: offshore renewable energy engineer
candidates.description: Offshore renewable energy engineers design and supervise the installation of offshore energy farms and equipment. They research and test locations to find the most productive location, ensure the successful execution of the design plan and make any necessary modifications or provide targeted advice. Offshore renewable energy engineers test equipment such as wind-turbine blades, tidal stream and wave generators. They develop strategies for more efficient energy production, and environmental sustainability.

description: Renewable Energy Engineer researches, designs, and implements systems to generate energy from renewable sources such as solar, wind, hydro, and biomass. They focus on optimising energy production, improving system efficiency, and minimising environmental impact while ensuring compliance with safety and environmental standards. Their work supports sustainable energy initiatives and contributes to reducing carbon emissions.
tasks: Conduct site assessments and feasibility studies for renewable energy projects. Develop and implement technical improvements and technological upgrades to enhance renewable energy generation efficiency and system performance. Design, test, and implement renewable energy systems and components. Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to optimise renewable energy generation and system integration. Prepare technical specifications, material and equipment lists, and cost analyses for renewable energy projects. Monitor the performance of renewable energy systems, troubleshoot issues, and optimise operation. Develop design, technical, and operational standards for renewable energy systems with management and relevant personnel. Prepare technical documentation, system reports, and project findings for renewable energy projects. Ensure renewable energy projects comply with regulatory, safety, and environmental standards.

candidates.title: renewable energy engineer
candidates.description: Renewable energy engineers research alternative sources of energy in order to design systems for renewable energy production. They strive to optimise energy production from renewable sources, and reduce production expenses and environmental strain. They design systems which focus on energy sustainability and efficiency.

candidates.title: offshore renewable energy engineer
candidates.description: Offshore renewable energy engineers design and supervise the installation of offshore energy farms and equipment. They research and test locations to find the most productive location, ensure the successful execution of the design plan and make any necessary modifications or provide targeted advice. Offshore renewable energy engineers test equipment such as wind-turbine blades, tidal stream and wave generators. They develop strategies for more efficient energy production, and environmental sustainability.

candidates.title: solar energy engineer

candidates.title: energy systems engineer
candidates.description: Energy systems engineers supervise the energy conversion and distribution processes. They analyse the energy supply and consumption efficiency developing new ways to improve the existing processes, taking into account both the technical and the financial aspects. They also study the environmental impact of energy usage and combine the production of renewable energy in the current power systems.

candidates.title: renewable energy consultant
candidates.description: Renewable energy consultants advise clients on the advantages and disadvantages of different renewable energy sources. They conduct surveys and interviews to research demand of and opinions on renewable energy, and strive to advise clients on the most advantageous source of renewable energy for their purpose.

candidates.title: electric power generation engineer
candidates.description: Electric power generation engineers design and develop systems which generate electrical power, and develop strategies for the improvement of existing electricity generation systems. They strive to conciliate sustainable solutions with efficient and affordable solutions. They engage in projects where supply of electrical energy is required.

candidates.title: onshore wind energy engineer
candidates.description: Onshore wind energy engineers design, install and maintain wind energy farms and equipment. They research and test locations to find the most productive location, test equipment and components such as wind-turbine blades, and develop strategies for more efficient energy production, and environmental sustainability.

description: Environment Engineer plans, designs, and implements solutions to manage environmental resources and reduce pollution. They integrate sustainable practices into projects, develop systems for waste management and pollution control, assess environmental impacts, ensure regulatory compliance, and collaborate with industries and government agencies to preserve natural resources and support environmental protection.
tasks: Conduct environmental impact assessments and site evaluations. Design and implement pollution control and waste management systems. Monitor air, water, and soil quality to assess environmental conditions and ensure compliance with standards. Ensure compliance with environmental laws and regulations. Prepare technical reports and provide recommendations on environmental protection and resource management. Collaborate with industries, government agencies, and other stakeholders on sustainability and environmental initiatives. Develop and implement environmental process improvements and technological upgrades to reduce pollution and support sustainable practices. Design and improve systems and processes to maximise resource efficiency and minimise waste. Train staff on environmental procedures and systems, and prepare instructional materials.

candidates.title: environmental engineer
candidates.description: Environmental engineers integrate environmental and sustainable measures in the development of projects of various natures. They seek to preserve natural resources and natural sites. They work together with engineers from other fields to envision all the implications that projects might have in order to design ways to conserve natural reserves, prevent pollution, and deploy sanitary measures.

candidates.title: environmental scientist
candidates.description: Environmental scientists identify problems and find solutions in order to minimize environmental hazards by performing analysis on samples such as air, water or soil. They advise on or develop environmental policies and aim to improve water supplies preservation and manage waste disposal sites. Environmental scientists perform environmental risk assessments and analyse the environmental impact of new solutions, construction sites or environmental changes ensuring the environmental regulations are followed.

candidates.title: environmental mining engineer
candidates.description: Environmental mining engineers oversee the environmental performance of mining operations. They develop and implement environmental systems and strategies to minimise environmental impacts.

candidates.title: environmental technician
candidates.description: Environmental technicians investigate sources of pollution and aid in the development of pollution prevention and environment protection plans. They take samples of soil, water or other materials and perform tests to analyse the pollution level and identify its source.

candidates.title: environmental education officer
candidates.description: Environmental education officers are responsible for promoting environmental conservation and development. They visit schools and businesses to give talks, they produce educational resources and websites, they lead guided nature walks, they provide relevant training courses, and they help with volunteer activities and conservation projects. Many gardens employ an environmental education officer to offer guidance during school visits.

candidates.title: energy engineer
candidates.description: Energy engineers design new, efficient and clean ways to produce, transform, and distribute energy to improve environmental sustainability and energy efficiency. They deal with the extraction of energy through natural resources, such as oil or gas, or renewable and sustainable sources, such as wind or solar power.

candidates.title: water engineer
candidates.description: Water engineers research and develop methods for the provision of clean water, water treatment and flood damage prevention and reaction. They research water needs in a location and develop methods for meeting those needs, such as designing and developing projects for managing water resources such as treatment plants, pipelines, pump systems, irrigation or draining systems and other water supply systems. Water engineers also ensure proper installation of these systems on construction sites. Water engineers also maintain, repair and build structures that control water resources, such as bridges, canals and dams.

candidates.title: environmental expert
candidates.description: Environmental experts search for technological solutions to tackle environmental problems. They detect and analyse environmental issues and develop new technological production processes to counter these problematic issues. They research the effect of their technological innovations and present their findings in scientific reports.

description: Energy Auditor assesses and analyses energy use and efficiency in residential, commercial, and industrial buildings. They conduct detailed energy audits, identify areas of waste, quantify potential savings, and prepare reports with actionable recommendations. Their work supports organisations and property owners in reducing energy consumption, lowering costs, and meeting sustainability and regulatory requirements.
tasks: Conduct walk-through and detailed energy audits of residential, commercial, and industrial buildings and facilities using appropriate diagnostic tools and assessment methods. Analyse utility bills, energy consumption data, and building systems to identify inefficiencies, waste, and opportunities for improved energy performance. Assess the condition and efficiency of energy-related systems, including heating, ventilation and air conditioning (HVAC), lighting, insulation, and other building services. Prepare technical audit reports with findings, quantified savings potential, and actionable recommendations for energy efficiency improvement. Propose cost-effective energy conservation measures to reduce energy consumption and operating costs. Estimate potential energy and cost savings from recommended energy efficiency measures. Support the implementation of recommended energy-saving measures and projects. Conduct compliance reviews to ensure adherence to relevant energy regulations, standards, and sustainability requirements.

candidates.title: energy analyst
candidates.description: Energy analysts evaluate the consumption of energy in buidings owned by consumers and businesses. By analysing existing energy systems, they recommend cost-effective alternatives. Energy analysts suggest efficiency improvements, make business analyses and participate in the development of policies concerning the use of traditional fuels, transportation, and other factors relating to energy consumption.

candidates.title: energy consultant
candidates.description: Energy consultants advise clients on the advantages and disadvantages of different energy sources. They help clients to understand energy tariffs and try to reduce their energy consumption and carbon footprint by using energy efficient products and methods.

candidates.title: energy assessor
candidates.description: Energy assessors determine the energy performance of buildings. They create an Energy Performance Certificate (EPC) which indicates what the estimated energy consumption of a property is. Furthermore they give advice on how to improve energy conservation.

candidates.title: energy manager
candidates.description: Energy managers coordinate the energy use in an organisation, and aim to implement policies for increased sustainability, and minimisation of cost and environmental impact. They monitor the energy demands and use, and develop improvement strategies, as well as researching the most beneficial source of energy for the organisation's needs.

candidates.title: domestic energy assessor
candidates.description: Domestic energy assessors advise individuals on energy supply for their homes. They assess the individual's needs and recommend the appropriate source of energy and supplier, attempting to secure energy sales. They also advise on economic and environmental advantages of types of energy, and create energy plans compliant with regulations and the technical requirements and conditions of the residence.

candidates.title: financial auditor
candidates.description: Financial auditors collect and examine financial data for clients, organisations and companies. They ensure the financial data is properly maintained and free of material misstatements due to error or fraud, that it adds up, and functions legally and effectively. They review lending and credit policies or numbers in databases and documents, evaluate, consult and assist the source of the transaction if necessary. They use their review of the client's financial governance as assurance to give testimony to the shareholders, stakeholders and board of directors of the organisation or company that all is up to par.

candidates.title: energy conservation officer
candidates.description: Energy conservation officers promote the conservation of energy in both residential homes as in businesses. They advise people on ways te reduce their power consumption by enforcing energy efficiency improvements and implementing energy demand management policies.

candidates.title: energy trader
candidates.description: Energy traders sell or buy shares of energy, sometimes from different sources. They analyse the energy market and investigate trends in prices to decide when to buy or sell shares and ensure the most profit. They make calculations, and write reports on energy trades procedures, and make predictions on the development of the market.

description: Materials Engineer research, develop, and evaluate materials for a wide range of industrial applications, including metals, alloys, rubber, textiles, glass, and chemicals. They analyse material composition, conduct experiments and tests, and apply scientific and engineering principles to improve product performance, durability, safety, and cost efficiency. Their role includes material selection, failure analysis, quality assurance, and advising on recycling or damage assessments, while collaborating with design, production, and manufacturing teams to optimise materials for specific applications.
tasks: Design and optimise materials-related production processes to improve efficiency, reduce waste, and maximise material use. Select and evaluate suitable materials for products and manufacturing applications. Conduct material testing and analysis, including strength, durability, corrosion resistance, failure investigations, and interpretation of results to support material selection and improvement. Develop and implement process improvements, technological upgrades, and quality control measures to enhance material performance and reliability. Collaborate with design, production, manufacturing, and multidisciplinary teams to ensure material suitability and performance for specific applications. Prepare technical reports, documentation, and cost analyses on material performance, testing outcomes, and improvement recommendations. Ensure compliance with safety, quality, and environmental regulations in materials engineering activities and processes. Advise on material failures, damage assessments, recycling, and sustainability considerations. Conduct research and development activities to improve existing materials and develop new materials for industrial applications.

candidates.title: materials engineer
candidates.description: Materials engineers research and design new or improved materials for a diverse number of applications. They analyse the composition of materials, conduct experiments, and develop new materials for industry-specific use that can range from rubber, to textiles, glass, metals, and chemicals. They advise companies in damage assessments, quality assurance of materials, and recycling of materials.

candidates.title: paper engineer
candidates.description: Paper engineers ensure an optimal production process in the manufacture of paper and related products. They select primary and secondary raw materials and check their quality. In addition, they optimize machinery and equipment usage as well as the chemical additives for paper making.

candidates.title: plastic heat treatment equipment operator
candidates.description: Plastic heat treatment equipment operators manipulate plastic products using machinery such as furnaces or flame-hardening machines in order to temper, anneal or heat-treat. They set up the machinery and read the production instructions to determine the furnace temperature. Plastic heat treatment equipment operators remove products from machines, let them cool down, examine and test products to see if they conform to specifications.

candidates.title: synthetic materials engineer
candidates.description: Synthetic materials engineers develop new synthetic materials processes or improve existing ones. They design and construct installations and machines for the production of synthetic materials and examine samples of raw materials in order to ensure quality.

candidates.title: surface engineer
candidates.description: Surface engineers research and develop technologies for manufacturing processes that assist in altering the properties of the surface of bulk material, such as metal, in order to reduce degradation by corrosion or wear. They explore and design how to protect surfaces of (metal) workpieces and products utilising sustainable materials and testing with a minimum of waste.

candidates.title: chemical engineer
candidates.description: Chemical engineers design and develop large-scale chemical and physical production processes and are involved in the entire industrial process required for transforming raw materials into products.

candidates.title: mechanical engineer
candidates.description: Mechanical engineers research, plan and design mechanical products and systems and supervise the fabrication, operation, application, installation and repair of systems and products. They research and analyse data.

candidates.title: manufacturing engineer
candidates.description: Manufacturing engineers design manufacturing processes for different kinds of production processes. They integrate those specificities and constraints posed by the industry or the product being produced with general and wide-spread manufacturing engineering principles into the design and planification of manufacturing processes.

description: Civil Engineering Technologist directs and supervises construction and maintenance work for buildings, infrastructure, and public facilities. They apply practical engineering principles to support the design, planning, and execution of civil engineering projects, including roads, bridges, and water supply systems. The role includes defining construction methods and materials, preparing technical drawings, conducting site inspections, analysing construction data, and ensuring compliance with safety and regulatory standards, while coordinating between engineers, contractors, and stakeholders.
tasks: Conduct detailed site surveys and inspections to assess project conditions. Determine and specify construction methods, materials, and quality standards for civil engineering works. Prepare, review, and interpret technical drawings and plans to support project design and execution. Support the maintenance and repair of buildings and public facilities by overseeing technical and engineering aspects. Assist in project planning, scheduling, and progress monitoring to ensure timelines are met. Implement site control and quality assurance procedures to ensure structures comply with safety and environmental standards. Collect and analyse data on construction materials, environmental conditions, and site factors to support quality control and project assessment. Coordinate with engineers, contractors, government agencies, and stakeholders to ensure compliance with regulations and project specifications. Support contract administration and coordinate the implementation of Malaysian Standard International Organization for Standardization 9001 (MS ISO 9001) and other relevant standards. Prepare comprehensive reports and maintain accurate project documentation.

candidates.title: civil engineer
candidates.description: Civil engineers design, plan, and develop technical and engineering specifications for infrastructure and construction projects. They apply engineering knowledge in a vast array of projects, from the construction of infrastructure for transportation, housing projects, and luxury buildings, to the construction of natural sites. They design plans that seek to optimise materials and integrate specifications and resource allocation within the time constraints.

candidates.title: civil engineering technician
candidates.description: Civil engineering technicians help design and execute construction plans and take on organisational tasks, for example in the planning and monitoring, and in bidding and invoicing of construction work. They also calculate material requirements, and help with the purchasing and organising, and ensure the quality of the construction materials. Civil engineering technicians may perform technical tasks in civil engineering and develop and advise on policy implementing strategies for road works, traffic lights, sewerage and water management systems.

candidates.title: civil engineering worker
candidates.description: Civil engineering workers perform tasks concerning the cleaning and preparation of construction sites for civil engineering projects. This includes the work on building and maintenance of roads, railways and dams.

candidates.title: geological engineer
candidates.description: Geological engineers apply geological knowledge for the assessment of sites, soils, slope stability, sediments and other observable characteristics in the Earth. They integrate this information in the planning and development of projects in those places. They assess and answer questions concerning the geological characteristics of soils by performing research and experiments on the sites aimed to be intervened.

candidates.title: construction engineer
candidates.description: Construction engineers interpret building designs and add technical specifications to construction projects. They integrate engineering principles into the designs to ensure that structures are safe and resistant. They work together with architects and engineers to transform design ideas into executable plans.

candidates.title: rail project engineer
candidates.description: Rail project engineers maintain a safe, cost-effective, high-quality, and environmentally responsible approach across the technical projects in railway companies. They provide project management advice on all construction projects including testing, commissioning and site supervision. They audit contractors for safety, environment and quality of design, process and performance as to ensure that all projects follow in-house standards and relevant legislation.

candidates.title: industrial engineering technician
candidates.description: Industrial engineering technicians assist industrial engineers in improving efficiency, safety and productivity in manufacturing plants. They conduct production studies, prepare layouts for machinery and equipment and suggest solutions to remedy quality problems.

candidates.title: electronics engineering technician
candidates.description: Electronics engineering technicians work closely with electronics engineers in the development of electronic equipment and devices. Electronics engineering technicians are responsible for building, testing, and maintaining electronic devices.

description: Civil Engineer directs, plans, and supervises the construction, maintenance, and repair of buildings, infrastructure, and public facilities, ensuring safety, durability, and regulatory compliance. They design, analyse, and manage projects such as roads, bridges, drainage systems, and water supply networks, coordinate multidisciplinary teams, and oversee project execution from feasibility studies and detailed designs to budgeting and completion. The role involves applying engineering principles to optimise construction methods, materials, and resource allocation, monitoring progress, and implementing strategies for sustainable and efficient project delivery.
tasks: Develop detailed civil engineering plans, designs, and technical specifications for construction and infrastructure projects. Determine appropriate construction methods, materials, and quality standards in compliance with safety, environmental, and regulatory requirements. Conduct site inspections, surveys, and structural or hydrological assessments to evaluate site conditions and monitor project progress. Supervise and coordinate contractors, subcontractors, and multidisciplinary teams to ensure project requirements and objectives are achieved. Monitor project schedules, budgets, resources, and material availability to support timely and efficient project delivery. Carry out quality control, structural analysis, and condition assessments to support maintenance, reliability, and regulatory compliance. Prepare and review technical reports, project documentation, and regulatory submissions for approvals and stakeholder communication. Participate in site meetings and coordinate with clients, government agencies, and other stakeholders to resolve technical and implementation issues

candidates.title: civil engineer
candidates.description: Civil engineers design, plan, and develop technical and engineering specifications for infrastructure and construction projects. They apply engineering knowledge in a vast array of projects, from the construction of infrastructure for transportation, housing projects, and luxury buildings, to the construction of natural sites.
