role_title: Competent Person (CP) - Internal Combustion Engine Engineer
description: Competent Person (CP) - Internal Combustion Engine Engineer is responsible for ensuring engines, boilers, turbines, and related equipment operate safely, efficiently, and in compliance with environmental and safety regulations. They oversee performance, conduct inspections, diagnose and troubleshoot issues, implement maintenance and optimisation measures, and monitor fuel efficiency and emissions. The engineer works closely with technicians to support industries including automotive, manufacturing, energy, and heavy industries.
tasks: Inspect and diagnose internal combustion engines and related equipment to ensure safe, efficient, and compliant operation. Read and interpret technical drawings, schematics, manuals, and reports to support inspection, maintenance, and repair activities. Identify faults and troubleshoot mechanical, electrical, or hydraulic issues, and carry out or recommend appropriate repairs and replacements. Monitor engine performance, fuel efficiency, and emissions to optimise operation and reduce environmental impact. Plan, schedule, and oversee maintenance activities to prevent breakdowns and extend equipment lifespan. Ensure compliance with safety, environmental, and regulatory standards. Collaborate with technicians, engineers, and other relevant personnel to resolve malfunctions and provide technical guidance. Maintain detailed records of inspections, maintenance, repairs, and modifications for operational control and compliance.

candidates.title: engine designer
candidates.description: Engine designers carry out engineering duties in designing mechanical equipment such as machines and all types of engines. They also supervise their installation and maintenance.

candidates.title: gas production engineer
candidates.description: Gas production engineers develop methods to optimise the extraction and production of gas for energy and utilities. They design systems for gas production, supervise production operations and develop improvements on existing systems.

candidates.title: aircraft engine specialist
candidates.description: Aircraft engine specialists advise on maintaining procedures to engines of aircrafts and helicopters. They perform operability tests to components and parts of aircrafts to diagnose suitability for usage and possible operations to improve performance. They interpret and provide support to understand the technical specifications given by manufacturers for application at the airport's premises.

candidates.title: automotive engineer
candidates.description: Automotive engineers design and oversee the manufacturing process and operation of motor vehicles such as motorcycles, cars, trucks, buses and their respective engineering systems. They design new vehicles or mechanical parts, supervise modifications and resolve technical problems. They make sure the designs comply with cost specifications and other constraints. They also conduct research studying environmental, energy and safety aspects.

candidates.title: powertrain engineer
candidates.description: Powertrain engineer work on the design of propulsion mechanisms across the automotive sector. This includes technical implementation of powertrain components, such as mechanical engineering, the electronics and software used in modern vehicles, as well as coordination and optimisation of multiple energy sources in the powertrain context.

candidates.title: alternative fuels engineer
candidates.description: Alternative fuels engineers design and develop systems, components, motors, and equipment which replace the use of conventional fossil fuels as main power source for propulsion and power generation with the feature of using renewable energies and non-fossil fuels. They strive to optimise energy production from renewable sources and reduce production expenses and environmental strain. The alternative fuels employed mainly include Liquefied Natural Gas (LNG), Liquefied Petroleum Gas (LPG), biodiesel, bio-alcohol as well as electricity (i.e., batteries and fuel cells), hydrogen and fuels produced from biomass.

candidates.title: aircraft engine inspector
candidates.description: Aircraft engine inspectors inspect all types of engines used for aircrafts in factories to ensure compliance with safety standards and regulations. They conduct routine, post-overhaul, pre-availability and post-casualty inspections. They provide documentation for repair activities and technical support to maintenance and repair centres. They review administrative records, analyse the operating performance of engines and report their findings.

candidates.title: diesel engine mechanic
candidates.description: Diesel engine mechanics repair and maintain all types of diesel engines. They use hand tools, precision measuring instruments, and machine tools to diagnose trouble, disassemble engines, and to examine and exchange parts of defect and excessive wear.

description: Welding Engineer designs, develops, and maintains welding processes, equipment, and mechanical systems. They ensure welds meet quality, safety, and regulatory standards, oversee installation and operation of welding machinery, and optimise procedures for efficiency and reliability. The engineer also leads and trains welding teams, collaborates with engineering colleagues, and may contribute to research and development to advance welding technologies.
tasks: Design welding procedures and select appropriate materials in accordance with job specifications, quality requirements, and welding standards. Read and interpret technical drawings, schematics, and reports to support welding design and execution. Evaluate and troubleshoot welding processes to ensure quality, efficiency, and reliability. Inspect and assess welded materials for defects and compliance with quality, safety, and regulatory standards. Conduct or coordinate non-destructive testing (NDT) to identify weld flaws and verify weld integrity. Oversee welding operations and supervise welding personnel to ensure work is carried out effectively and in accordance with specifications. Ensure adherence to safety protocols and the proper operation and maintenance of welding equipment. Collaborate with engineering teams to integrate welding processes into projects and resolve technical issues. Evaluate new welding technologies and implement process improvements to enhance performance and reliability. Train and guide welding personnel on welding procedures, best practices, and safety requirements.

candidates.title: welding engineer
candidates.description: Welding engineers research and develop optimal effective welding techniques and design the corresponding, equally efficient equipment to aid in the welding process. They also conduct quality control and evaluate inspection procedures for welding activities. Welding engineers have advanced knowledge and critical understanding of welding technology application. They are able to manage high complex technical and professional activities or projects related to welding applications, while also taking responsibility for the decision making process.

candidates.title: welding inspector
candidates.description: Welding inspectors examine the connections and bonds between metals. They utilise visual tools and electrical instruments to inspect and ensure the quality and safety of connections. Welding inspectors ensure that all related welding activities, plans and materials follow the appropriate guidelines, in accordance with safety regulations. In addition to working in the field completing their examinations of welding projects, inspectors spend time in an office setting compiling their reports.

candidates.title: welding coordinator
candidates.description: Welding coordinators supervise the workflow of welding applications. They monitor welding processes performed by other welders, supervise the staff, being sometimes responsible for vocational training. They also weld particularly demanding parts. Welding coordinators ensure that the necessary welding equipment is ready for usage. They mostly coordinate welding applications and related professional activities.

candidates.title: welder
candidates.description: Welders operate welding equipment in order to join metal workpieces together. They can use fusion welding processes based on different techniques and materials. They also perform simple visual inspection of welds.

candidates.title: drilling engineer
candidates.description: Drilling engineers develop and supervise the drilling of gas and oil wells. They assist in the designing, testing and creation of wells and are employed on land or offshore platforms. Drilling engineers work with other mining professionals and oversee the drilling progress and safety of the site.

candidates.title: construction engineer
candidates.description: Construction engineers interpret building designs and add technical specifications to construction projects. They integrate engineering principles into the designs to ensure that structures are safe and resistant. They work together with architects and engineers to transform design ideas into executable plans.

candidates.title: pipe welder
candidates.description: Pipe welders assemble and install parts and components of pipelines for the transport of goods such as water, steam and chemicals through them. They interpret specs such as pneumatics, hydraulics, for installation on site according to the safety and production requirements.

candidates.title: industrial engineer
candidates.description: Industrial engineers design a vast array of production systems aiming to present efficient and effective solutions. They integrate a varied number of variables such as workers, technology, ergonomics, production flows, and product specifications for the design and implementation of production systems. They can specify and design for microsystems as well.

description: Engineering Technologist designs, develops, builds, and maintains mechanical devices, machines, and systems across industries such as manufacturing, automotive, aerospace, energy, and construction. They apply engineering principles to translate designs into practical solutions, oversee installation, operation, maintenance, and repair of equipment, and test systems to ensure safety, efficiency, and compliance with industry standards. The role bridges theory and practice, contributing to research and development, troubleshooting, and optimisation of mechanical and thermal devices, components, and production processes.
tasks: Design, develop, and evaluate mechanical devices, machines, systems, or components to ensure functionality, safety, and efficiency. Read, interpret, and analyse technical drawings, schematics, and computer-generated reports. Develop prototypes, conduct tests and simulations, and modify designs based on performance and manufacturability. Prepare and maintain technical documentation, including reports, technical drawings, and assembly instructions. Collaborate with engineers, product developers, and other personnel to implement designs and resolve technical issues. Investigate equipment failures, diagnose faults, and recommend remedial actions. Prepare machining instructions and coordinate manufacturing processes to ensure quality and feasibility. Install, operate, maintain, repair, and monitor mechanical systems and equipment as required. Ensure all engineering work complies with safety regulations, industry standards, and project specifications. Assess material selection, production methods, and design feasibility to optimise mechanical performance and efficiency.

candidates.title: mechanical engineer
candidates.description: Mechanical engineers research, plan and design mechanical products and systems and supervise the fabrication, operation, application, installation and repair of systems and products. They research and analyse data.

candidates.title: mechanical engineering technician
candidates.description: Mechanical engineering technicians provide technical support to mechanical engineers in producing and manufacturing mechanical machinery. They help make designs and adjustments, and perform tests. They also develop layouts and drawings, collate and interpret data and write reports.

candidates.title: electronics engineering technician
candidates.description: Electronics engineering technicians work closely with electronics engineers in the development of electronic equipment and devices. Electronics engineering technicians are responsible for building, testing, and maintaining electronic devices.

candidates.title: industrial engineering technician
candidates.description: Industrial engineering technicians assist industrial engineers in improving efficiency, safety and productivity in manufacturing plants. They conduct production studies, prepare layouts for machinery and equipment and suggest solutions to remedy quality problems.

candidates.title: equipment engineer
candidates.description: Equipment engineers design and maintain the machinery and equipment in manufacturing facilities. They design machinery that adjusts to the manufacturing requirements and processes. Moreover, they envision the maintenance of the machines and equipment for uninterrupted functioning.

candidates.title: robotics engineering technician
candidates.description: Robotics engineering technicians collaborate with engineers in the development of robotic devices and applications through a combination of mechanical engineering, electronic engineering, and computer engineering. Robotics engineering technicians build, test, install and calibrate robotic equipment.

candidates.title: computer hardware engineering technician
candidates.description: Computer hardware engineering technicians collaborate with computer hardware engineers in the development of computer hardware, such as motherboards, routers, and microprocessors. Computer hardware engineering technicians are responsible for building, testing, monitoring, and maintaining the developed computer technology.

candidates.title: automotive engineering technician
candidates.description: Automotive engineering technicians work with automotive engineers to operate, repair, maintain and test equipment used in motor vehicles. In some environments, such as an airport they are responsible for keeping equipment and vehicles serviceable. They review blueprints and designs to determine test specifications and procedures. Automotive engineering technicians use software to make sure that parts of a motor vehicle are functioning properly. They record test procedures and results, and make recommendations for changes.

description: Robotic Technologist researches, designs, develops, and maintains robotic systems and applications across industries such as manufacturing, healthcare, logistics, and automation. They integrate mechanical, electronic, and software components to ensure efficient, reliable, and safe operation, performing testing, diagnostics, and optimisation of robotic systems. Their work supports improved productivity, precision, and innovation in production and operational environments.
tasks: Design, build, configure, prototype, and test robotic systems and applications to meet technical specifications. Develop and implement robot control programmes and programming logic for robotic operations. Integrate robotic systems into production or operational environments in collaboration with multidisciplinary engineers. Perform maintenance, troubleshooting, debugging, and optimisation of robotic systems and programmes. Process, monitor, and interpret sensor signals and operational data from robotic systems. Provide technical support and user training for operators and end-users of robotic systems. Create and maintain backups of robot programmes and system parameters. Apply relevant emerging robotics technologies to improve system efficiency, reliability, and innovation.

candidates.title: robotics engineering technician
candidates.description: Robotics engineering technicians collaborate with engineers in the development of robotic devices and applications through a combination of mechanical engineering, electronic engineering, and computer engineering. Robotics engineering technicians build, test, install and calibrate robotic equipment.

candidates.title: robotics engineer
candidates.description: Robotics engineers design and develop robotic devices and applications in combination with mechanical engineering principles. They use pre-established designs and current developments for improving or inventing systems, machinery and equipment. They combine several knowledge fields such as computing, engineering, and electronics in the development of new engineering applications.

candidates.title: mechatronics engineer
candidates.description: Mechatronics engineers design and develop intelligent systems, such as robotic devices, smart home appliances, and aeroplanes, through combining technologies from mechanical, electronic, computer, and control engineering. They create blueprints or design documents for parts, assemblies or finished products using software programs, and also oversee and manage projects.

candidates.title: artificial intelligence engineer
candidates.description: Artificial intelligence engineer apply methods of artificial intelligence in engineering, robotics and computer science to design programs which simulate intelligence including thinking models, cognitive and knowledge-based systems, problem solving, and decision making. They also integrate structured knowledge into computer systems (ontologies, knowledge bases) in order to solve complex problems normally requiring a high level of human expertise or artificial intelligence methods.

candidates.title: mechatronics engineering technician
candidates.description: Mechatronics engineering technicians collaborate with engineers in the development of mechatronic devices and applications through a combination of mechanical engineering, electronic engineering, and computer engineering. They build, test, install, and calibrate mechatronics and solve technical problems.

candidates.title: assistive technologist
candidates.description: Assistive technologists work to improve access to learning or/and improving independence and participation for individuals with disabilities. They do this through learner support and staff support with activities such as assessments, training and guidance. Assistive technologists have a good understanding of learners’ needs and a wide technology knowledge relevant to learning, living or work context. The role requires knowledge of assistive technology hardware and software such as text to speech, prediction, dictation, vision and physical access tools.

candidates.title: rubber technologist
candidates.description: Rubber technologists develop compound formulations to respond to specific needs and attain the required in-rubber properties, starting from technical specifications and application demands. They have knowledge of physical and chemical characteristics of raw rubber material and the process to convert it into market products.

candidates.title: equipment engineer
candidates.description: Equipment engineers design and maintain the machinery and equipment in manufacturing facilities. They design machinery that adjusts to the manufacturing requirements and processes. Moreover, they envision the maintenance of the machines and equipment for uninterrupted functioning.

description: Aerospace Engineer develops, designs, and tests aircraft, spacecraft, missiles, and related systems, ensuring they meet safety, performance, and regulatory standards. They optimise efficiency and functionality for military, civilian, or space applications, working across all project phases from conceptual design to manufacturing and testing, and collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to advance aerospace technologies.
tasks: Design and test aircraft, spacecraft, missile, and related system components. Create technical designs and develop prototypes using computer-aided design (CAD) tools. Perform simulations and stress tests to ensure designs meet performance standards. Collaborate with engineers and technicians to refine designs for safety and reliability. Read and interpret technical drawings, schematics, and reports. Troubleshoot existing aerospace systems, investigate failures, and recommend improvements or corrective solutions. Ensure designs comply with national and international aviation regulations. Conduct research to develop or enhance aerospace technologies.

candidates.title: aerospace engineer
candidates.description: Aerospace engineers develop, test and oversee the manufacture of flight vehicles such as aircrafts, missiles, and spacecrafts. The field of engineering they are active in, can be divided into two branches: aeronautical engineering and astronautical engineering.

candidates.title: aerospace engineering technician
candidates.description: Aerospace engineering technicians work with aerospace engineers to operate, maintain and test equipment used on aircraft and spacecraft. They review blueprints and instructions to determine test specifications and procedures. They use software to make sure that parts of a spacecraft or aircraft are functioning properly. They record test procedures and results, and make recommendations for changes.

candidates.title: aerospace engineering drafter
candidates.description: Aerospace engineering drafters convert the aerospace engineers' designs into technical drawings usually using computer-aided design programs. Their drawings detail dimensions, fastening and assembling methods and other specifications used in the manufacture of aircrafts and spacecrafts.

candidates.title: flight test engineer
candidates.description: Flight test engineers work with other systems engineers to plan the tests in detail and to make sure that the recording systems are installed for the required data parameters. They analyse the data collected during test flights and produce reports for individual test phases and for the final flight test. They are also responsible for the safety of the test operations.

candidates.title: mechanical engineer
candidates.description: Mechanical engineers research, plan and design mechanical products and systems and supervise the fabrication, operation, application, installation and repair of systems and products. They research and analyse data.

candidates.title: military engineer
candidates.description: Military engineers perform technical and scientific functions in the military, such as the development of concepts for military technical equipment, support of the manufacturing of military equipment, and technical research, maintenance, and quality assurance.

candidates.title: aircraft maintenance engineer
candidates.description: Aircraft maintenance engineers make preflight and postflight inspections, adjustments, and minor repairs to ensure safe and sound performance of aircrafts. They inspect aircraft prior to takeoff to detect malfunctions such as oil leaks, electrical or hydraulic problems. They verify passenger and cargo distribution and amount of fuel to ensure that weight and balance specifications are met.

candidates.title: aerodynamics engineer
candidates.description: Aerodynamics engineers perform aerodynamics analysis to make sure the designs of transport equipment meet aerodynamics and performance requirements. They contribute to designing engine and engine components, and issue technical reports for the engineering staff and customers. They coordinate with other engineering departments to check that designs perform as specified. Aerodynamics engineers conduct research to assess adaptability of equipment and materials. They also analyse proposals to evaluate production time and feasibility.

description: Mine Ventilation Engineer designs, implements, and manages ventilation systems in underground mines to ensure a constant supply of fresh air and safe air circulation. They control hazardous gases, dust, and temperature, monitor system performance, and work with mine management and safety teams to maintain safe and efficient mining operations in compliance with environmental health and safety regulations.
tasks: Design and plan mine ventilation systems based on mine layout, equipment, and workforce needs. Analyse and simulate airflow patterns to ensure safe and effective air distribution throughout the mine. Monitor and evaluate ventilation system performance to maintain safety and environmental standards. Ensure compliance with mine safety legislation and ventilation regulations. Inspect and troubleshoot ventilation issues, including blocked airways, fan failures, or damaged ducts. Control hazardous gases, dust, temperature, and air quality through appropriate ventilation systems and equipment. Prepare technical reports and documentation on ventilation system performance. Manage ventilation operations and support emergency preparedness for safe mine operation. Collaborate with engineers, safety teams, and mine management to maintain safe and efficient ventilation systems.

candidates.title: mine ventilation engineer
candidates.description: Mine ventilation engineers design and manage systems and equipment to ensure fresh air supply and air circulation in underground mines and the timely removal of noxious gases. They co-ordinate ventilation system design with mine management, mine safety engineer and mine planning engineer.

candidates.title: mine health and safety engineer
candidates.description: Mine health and safety engineers develop and implement systems and procedures to prevent employee injury and sickness, improve mine working conditions, reduce health and safety risks and prevent damage to equipment and property.

candidates.title: mine mechanical engineer
candidates.description: Mine mechanical engineers supervise the procurement, installation, removal and maintenance of mining mechanical equipment, using their knowledge of mechanical specifications. They organise the replacement and repair of mechanical equipment and components.

candidates.title: mine electrical engineer
candidates.description: Mine electrical engineers supervise the procurement, installation and maintenance of mining electrical equipment, using their knowledge of electrical and electronic principles. They organise the replacement and repair of electrical equipment and components.

candidates.title: heating, ventilation, air conditioning engineer
candidates.description: Heating, ventilation, air conditioning engineers design and develop heating, ventilation, air conditioning and possibly refrigeration systems for usage in residences, manufacturing sites, offices, commercial buildings, etc. They strive for solutions that serve the needs of clients and respond to architectural restrictions of sites.

candidates.title: mine development engineer
candidates.description: Mine development engineers design and coordinate mine development operations such as crosscutting, sinking, tunnelling, in-seam drivages, raising, and removing and replacing overburden.

candidates.title: mine planning engineer
candidates.description: Mine planning engineers design future mine layouts capable of achieving production and mine development objectives, taking into account the geological characteristics and structure of the mineral resource. They prepare production and development schedules and monitor progress against these.

candidates.title: environmental mining engineer
candidates.description: Environmental mining engineers oversee the environmental performance of mining operations. They develop and implement environmental systems and strategies to minimise environmental impacts.

description: Chemical Engineer designs, develops, and optimises large-scale chemical and physical processes to transform raw materials into useful products. They work in industries such as pharmaceuticals, food and drink, plastics, rubber, cement, paper, energy, and oil and gas, applying principles of chemistry, physics, biology, and engineering to improve efficiency, safety, and environmental compliance. The role involves scaling laboratory processes to industrial production, enhancing yields, reducing waste, and ensuring adherence to regulatory and safety standards while collaborating with multidisciplinary teams.
tasks: Conduct research and use laboratory data to develop or improve chemical processes. Design and develop commercial-scale chemical processes and equipment for production and refining. Scale up laboratory processes for industrial use, ensuring safety, efficiency, and regulatory compliance. Establish production methods, material specifications, and quality standards for chemical processes and products. Analyse and troubleshoot production issues, including equipment failures and material defects. Optimise processes to improve yield, reduce costs, and enhance efficiency. Develop operating and control procedures to support safety, environmental protection, and process performance. Use software to simulate chemical reactions and model production systems. Conduct safety analyses, such as Hazard and Operability Study (HAZOP), to identify and mitigate risks. Collaborate with operations, quality control, and product development teams to support process implementation and improvement.

candidates.title: chemical engineer
candidates.description: Chemical engineers design and develop large-scale chemical and physical production processes and are involved in the entire industrial process required for transforming raw materials into products.

candidates.title: chemist
candidates.description: Chemists perform laboratory research by testing and analysing the chemical structure of substances.They translate the research results into industrial production processes which are further used in the development or improvement of products. Chemists are also testing the quality of the manufactured products and their environmental impact.

candidates.title: liquid fuel engineer
candidates.description: Liquid fuel engineers evaluate liquid fuel extraction sites. They design and develop methods for extracting liquid fuels from underneath the earth surface, these fuels include petroleums, natural gas, liquefied petroleum gas, non-petroleum fossil fuels, biodiesel and alcohols. They maximise the recovery of hydrocarbon at a minimum cost, pursuing minimal impact on the environment.

candidates.title: chemical engineering technician
candidates.description: Chemical engineering technicians transform raw materials in order to develop and test chemical products. They also work on improving chemical plant operations and processes.

candidates.title: chemical production manager
candidates.description: Chemical production managers are responsible for the technical coordination and control of the chemical production processes. They steer one or more manufacturing units and oversee the implementation of technical and human means, within the framework of objectives of volume, quality and planning. Chemical production managers design and ensure that the production plans and schedules are met. They are responsible for implementation of the processes designed to ensure quality of the manufactured product, good working conditions and environmental practices, and safety of the workplace.

candidates.title: biochemical engineer
candidates.description: Biochemical engineers research on the field of life science striving for new discoveries. They convert those findings into chemical solutions that can improve the wellbeing of society such as vaccines, tissue repair, crops improvement and green technologies advances such as cleaner fuels from natural resources.

candidates.title: pharmaceutical engineer
candidates.description: Pharmaceutical engineers design and develop technologies used in pharmaceutical research and drugs manufacture, advising the pharmaceutical manufacturing plants to maintain and operate those technologies and ensuring the customers` and workers` safety requirements are met. They may also be involved in the conception and design of pharmaceutical manufacturing plants and research centers.

candidates.title: chemical application specialist
candidates.description: Chemical application specialists develop chemical products according to the needs and expectation of the clients. They conduct development of formulas and processes of formulation as well as evaluation of the efficiency and performances of the formulations.

description: Mining Engineer plans, designs, and manages the extraction of minerals, metals, coal, and other natural resources from the earth. They oversee all stages of a mining operation—including exploration, feasibility studies, extraction, processing, and closure—ensuring efficiency, safety, regulatory compliance, and environmental sustainability. The role involves applying engineering and geological principles to optimise resource recovery, manage equipment and teams, and maintain the economic viability of the project while minimising environmental impacts.
tasks: Conduct feasibility studies and interpret geological survey findings to assess mining project viability and resource potential. Plan and design mines, including shafts, tunnels, layouts, and support structures, to optimise extraction efficiency. Determine and implement appropriate mining methods and select suitable machinery to optimise mineral extraction. Develop and apply safety protocols, perform risk assessments, and ensure compliance with health, safety, and environmental regulations. Supervise daily mining operations and coordinate workforce, equipment, and production activities to achieve safe and efficient output. Monitor and manage environmental impacts, including waste, water, and air quality, to ensure compliance with environmental requirements. Oversee mineral processing and quality control to maximise recovery and meet product and industry requirements. Prepare and monitor operating budgets, assess economic feasibility, and optimise project costs. Collaborate with geologists, geophysicists, and other technical specialists to improve mine design, extraction methods, and project outcomes. Document mining activities, performance, and compliance through detailed reports and recommendations.

candidates.title: quarry engineer
candidates.description: Quarry engineers analyse which extraction methods such as excavating, drilling and blasting are most suited to extract raw materials from the ground. They develop plans before a new quarry is opened, assessing if the quarry is profitable. Quarry engineers manage the everyday operations in a quarry, create and maintain progress reports, oversee the staff, ensure health and safety and assess the environmental impact a quarry has on its environment.

candidates.title: mine manager
candidates.description: Mine managers control, direct, plan and coordinate mining production activities. They have statutory responsibility for safety and are also responsible for environmental impact. They oversee the acquisition, installation, maintenance and storage of mining plant and equipment. They lead and manage according to the organisation's code of conduct.

candidates.title: mine production manager
candidates.description: Mine production managers coordinate and implement short and medium term mine production schedules and plans, such as drilling, blasting, ore and mineral extraction, and waste management.

candidates.title: environmental mining engineer
candidates.description: Environmental mining engineers oversee the environmental performance of mining operations. They develop and implement environmental systems and strategies to minimise environmental impacts.

candidates.title: mine planning engineer
candidates.description: Mine planning engineers design future mine layouts capable of achieving production and mine development objectives, taking into account the geological characteristics and structure of the mineral resource. They prepare production and development schedules and monitor progress against these.

candidates.title: mine development engineer
candidates.description: Mine development engineers design and coordinate mine development operations such as crosscutting, sinking, tunnelling, in-seam drivages, raising, and removing and replacing overburden.

candidates.title: mine mechanical engineer
candidates.description: Mine mechanical engineers supervise the procurement, installation, removal and maintenance of mining mechanical equipment, using their knowledge of mechanical specifications. They organise the replacement and repair of mechanical equipment and components.

candidates.title: mine electrical engineer
candidates.description: Mine electrical engineers supervise the procurement, installation and maintenance of mining electrical equipment, using their knowledge of electrical and electronic principles. They organise the replacement and repair of electrical equipment and components.

description: Petroleum Mining Engineer evaluates oil and gas fields and designs methods to extract hydrocarbons efficiently, safely, and with minimal environmental impact. They plan, develop, and manage drilling and production operations, optimise reservoir performance, and oversee the construction and operation of extraction systems. The engineer collaborates with geologists, drilling teams, and other specialists to resolve technical challenges, improve processes and equipment, and ensure compliance with safety, regulatory, and environmental standards across onshore and offshore sites.
tasks: Plan, design, and manage oil and gas drilling and extraction operations. Analyse geological and reservoir data to determine suitable extraction methods, equipment, and well placement. Develop and implement extraction and production processes to maximise recovery, efficiency, and safety. Oversee the installation, operation, and maintenance of drilling equipment and associated support systems. Monitor and evaluate drilling and production operations, and adjust methods to reduce downtime and improve output. Conduct research and development to improve extraction techniques, equipment, and operational performance. Ensure compliance with safety, environmental, and regulatory standards across drilling and production operations. Prepare technical documentation, reports, budgets, and operational project plans. Coordinate with multidisciplinary teams, contractors, and specialists to optimise drilling and production operations. Support technical audits and operational readiness assessments to maintain safe and efficient operations.

candidates.title: petroleum engineer
candidates.description: Petroleum engineers evaluate gas and oil fields. They design and develop methods for extracting oil and gas from underneath the earth's surface. They maximise the recovery of hydrocarbon at a minimum cost, pursuing minimal impact on the environment.

candidates.title: drilling engineer
candidates.description: Drilling engineers develop and supervise the drilling of gas and oil wells. They assist in the designing, testing and creation of wells and are employed on land or offshore platforms. Drilling engineers work with other mining professionals and oversee the drilling progress and safety of the site.

candidates.title: environmental mining engineer
candidates.description: Environmental mining engineers oversee the environmental performance of mining operations. They develop and implement environmental systems and strategies to minimise environmental impacts.

candidates.title: gas production engineer
candidates.description: Gas production engineers develop methods to optimise the extraction and production of gas for energy and utilities. They design systems for gas production, supervise production operations and develop improvements on existing systems.

candidates.title: mineral processing engineer
candidates.description: Mineral processing engineers develop and manage equipment and techniques to successfully process and refine valuable minerals from ore or raw mineral.

candidates.title: mining geotechnical engineer
candidates.description: Mining geotechnical engineers in mining perform engineering, hydrological and geological tests and analyses to improve the safety and efficiency of mineral operations. They oversee the collection of samples and the taking of measurements using geotechnical investigation methods and techniques. They model the mechanical behaviour of the rock mass and contribute to the design of the mine geometry.

candidates.title: quarry engineer
candidates.description: Quarry engineers analyse which extraction methods such as excavating, drilling and blasting are most suited to extract raw materials from the ground. They develop plans before a new quarry is opened, assessing if the quarry is profitable. Quarry engineers manage the everyday operations in a quarry, create and maintain progress reports, oversee the staff, ensure health and safety and assess the environmental impact a quarry has on its environment.

candidates.title: geological engineer
candidates.description: Geological engineers apply geological knowledge for the assessment of sites, soils, slope stability, sediments and other observable characteristics in the Earth. They integrate this information in the planning and development of projects in those places. They assess and answer questions concerning the geological characteristics of soils by performing research and experiments on the sites aimed to be intervened.

description: Metallurgist conducts research and develops methods for extracting metals, minerals, and other resources, as well as creating and testing new alloys, ceramics, and materials. They optimise material performance, improve durability, ensure product quality, and address causes of material failures, collaborating with engineering and design teams to meet project requirements. Their expertise supports industries such as mining, manufacturing, energy, aerospace, and construction, with a focus on efficient, safe, and sustainable resource and material utilisation.
tasks: Conduct metallurgical research to improve the properties, durability, and performance of metals, alloys, ceramics, and related materials. Test metals and alloys using specialised equipment to evaluate their performance, durability, and failure behaviour under various conditions. Develop and optimise metal extraction, alloy production, and refining processes to improve efficiency, quality, safety, recovery, and environmental performance. Analyse and select suitable materials for manufacturing based on performance, cost, fabrication requirements, and product quality needs. Collaborate with engineers, geologists, and design teams to ensure materials meet specifications, safety standards, and project requirements. Plan, supervise, and monitor metallurgical and extraction operations, including the effective use and maintenance of process equipment. Assess environmental, safety, and operational risks, and develop control measures to ensure compliance and prevent process or material failures. Prepare technical reports, document research and operational findings, and provide recommendations for process and product improvements.

candidates.title: metallurgist
candidates.description: Metallurgists specialise in the extraction and processing of metals such as iron, steel, zinc, copper and aluminium. They work to mold or combine both pure and mixed metals (alloys) into new shapes and properties. Metallurgists handle the extraction of metal ores and develop their use in metal processing techniques. They may work in both manufacturing or do scientific research about the performance of metals.

candidates.title: metallurgical technician
candidates.description: Metallurgical technicians provide technical support in researching and performing experiments on minerals, metals, alloys, oil and gas. They also assist in improving the methods of extraction.

candidates.title: chemical metallurgist
candidates.description: Chemical metallurgists are involved in the extraction of useable metals from ores and recycleable material. They study the properties of metal, such as corrosion and fatigue.

candidates.title: process metallurgist
candidates.description: Process metallurgists study the characteristics of ores including copper, nickel and iron ores and the performance of various metals and alloys.

candidates.title: metallurgical manager
candidates.description: Metallurgical managers coordinate and implement short and medium term metallurgical or steel-making production schedules, and coordinate the development, support and improvement of steel-making processes, and the reliability efforts of the maintenance and engineering departments. They also partner with ongoing remediation initiatives.

candidates.title: metal production manager
candidates.description: Metal production managers organise and manage the day-to-day and long-term project work in a metal fabrication factory, to process basic metals into fabricated metals. They create and schedule production plans, recruit new staff, enforce safety and company policies, and strive for customer satisfaction through guaranteeing the product's quality.

candidates.title: metal polisher
candidates.description: Metal polishers use metal working equipment and machinery to polish and buff almost finished metal workpieces in order to enhance their smoothness and appearance and to remove oxidisation, tarnishing the metal after the other fabrication processes. They may operate equipment using diamond solutions, silicon-made polishing pads, or working wheels with a leather polishing strop, and tend to these materials ensuring their effectiveness.

candidates.title: metal production supervisor
candidates.description: Metal production supervisors oversee the day-to-day working process and activities of the labourers in a metal fabrication factory. They supervise staff, create work schedules, maintain a safe work environment and serve as the first, most accessible management representative for the workers to contact when there is need.

description: Assayer conducts precise analyses of metals, minerals, and ores to determine their composition, purity, and quality. They apply chemical and physical techniques in laboratory or field settings to provide accurate data that supports mining, metallurgy, and manufacturing processes, ensuring quality control, regulatory compliance, and informed decision-making on production and valuation.
tasks: Prepare and process samples of ores, metals, or raw materials for analysis. Conduct chemical and physical tests. Interpret and analyse test results, and prepare detailed reports to support quality control, compliance, and production or valuation decisions. Ensure all testing complies with legal, environmental, and quality control requirements. Maintain, calibrate, and troubleshoot laboratory equipment to ensure accurate results. Review and improve testing methods and analytical techniques to enhance accuracy and reliability. Develop and refine procedures for material analysis. Collaborate with geologists, metallurgists, and other technical experts. Support mining and material processing operations by providing accurate laboratory analysis and test results.

candidates.title: assayer
candidates.description: Assayers test and analyse precious metals such as silver and gold to determine the value and properties of components using chemical and physical techniques. They also seperate precious metals or other components from other materials.

candidates.title: chemical tester
candidates.description: Chemical testers are responsible for the rapid on-the-spot analysis of steel test pieces incoming from the metal production shop for the purpose of timely corrections of the chemical composition of the liquid metal.

candidates.title: chemistry technician
candidates.description: Chemistry technicians monitor chemical processes and conduct tests to analyse chemical substances for manufacturing or scientific purposes. They work in laboratories or production facilities where they assist chemists in their work. Chemistry technicians perform laboratory activities, test chemical substances, analyse data and report about their work.

candidates.title: chemist
candidates.description: Chemists perform laboratory research by testing and analysing the chemical structure of substances.They translate the research results into industrial production processes which are further used in the development or improvement of products. Chemists are also testing the quality of the manufactured products and their environmental impact.

candidates.title: leather laboratory technician
candidates.description: Leather laboratory technicians perform and report chemical analyses and physical tests of leather. They also perform and report chemical analyses of auxiliaries, environmental emissions and discharges. They ensure that the tests are carried out according to appropriate national, international or customer standards.

candidates.title: enameller
candidates.description: Enamellers embellish metals such as gold, silver, copper, steel, cast iron or platinum by painting it. The enamel they apply, consists of coloured powdered glass.

candidates.title: agricultural technician
candidates.description: Agricultural technicians collect and conduct experiments and tests on agriculture and aquaculture specimens. They provide support to scientists and farmers and also analyse and report on conditions in the collected specimens' environments.

candidates.title: mine surveying technician
candidates.description: Mine surveying technicians conduct boundary and topographic surveys and surveys of the progress of mining operations. They operate surveying equipment and utilise programs to retrieve and interpret relevant data, and perform computations as required.

description: Marine Section Leader oversees and manages a specific section within the marine industry, ensuring the safe and efficient operation of vessels, crew, and maritime logistics. The role involves supervising marine activities, maintaining equipment, enforcing regulatory compliance, and coordinating with other departments to support smooth operations, while developing operational strategies and acting as the primary point of contact for operational matters and emergencies.
tasks: Oversee daily vessel operations and ensure compliance with safety and maritime regulations. Manage the maintenance and operational readiness of marine equipment through inspections, repairs, and follow-up actions. Coordinate marine logistics and operational activities with the marine team and other company divisions. Conduct risk assessments, facilitate safety drills, and implement emergency procedures for marine operations. Manage operational resources to support safe, efficient, and cost-effective marine operations. Report marine performance data, operational issues, and follow-up actions to senior management. Liaise with external partners, suppliers, contractors, and regulatory authorities on operational and compliance matters. Provide technical advice and operational support to improve marine activities and vessel readiness. Develop and implement strategies to enhance operational efficiency and continuous improvement in the marine section.

candidates.title: marine chief engineer
candidates.description: Marine chief engineers are responsible for the entire technical operations of the vessel including engineering, electrical, and mechanical divisions. They are the head of the entire engine department aboard the ship and have overall responsibility for all technical operations and equipment on-board the ship. Marine chief engineers collaborate on security, survival and health care on board and observe the national and international standards of application.

candidates.title: marine mechanic
candidates.description: Marine mechanics are in charge of the engines and mechanical parts of the vessel and replace defective equipment and parts. They communicate with other crew members on the operational level. Marine mechanics maintain and repair the engines and other machinery of vessels such as boilers, generators and electrical equipment.

candidates.title: marine firefighter
candidates.description: Marine firefighters are responsible for emergency response in case of a fire outbreak or other hazardous situations in marine environments. They actively respond to contain fires and the outbreak of other hazardous on vessels, docks and other marine facilities. They ensure the marine installation complies with health and safety regulations. They also regulate the clean-up of the scene and assess the damage.

candidates.title: marine electronics technician
candidates.description: Marine electronics technicians lay out, install and repair electronic systems and equipment in vessels. They assemble electronic components and wiring according to blueprints and assembly drawings.

candidates.title: zoo section leader
candidates.description: Zoo section leaders are responsible for managing and leading a team of zoo keepers. They will carry out daily care and management of animals as well as, in cooperation with colleagues, long term management and organisation of the species and exhibits in their section. They are also accountable for various aspects of staff management for the keepers in their section. Depending on the size of the zoo and animal section they may have additional responsibility for appointing staff and budgeting.

candidates.title: marine electrician
candidates.description: Marine electricians install, maintain and repair electrical and electronic systems in vessels such as air conditioning systems, lamps, radios, heating systems, batteries, electrical wiring and alternators. They use diagnostic testing equipment to inspect vessels and find faults. To do repair work, they use hand tools and specialised electrical instruments and machines.

candidates.title: marine engineer
candidates.description: Marine engineers design, build, maintain and repair the hull, mechanical, electronic equipment and auxiliary systems such as engines, pumps, heating, ventilation, generator sets. They work on all types of boats from pleasure crafts to naval vessels, including submarines.

candidates.title: vessel operations coordinator
candidates.description: Vessel operations coordinators manage chartered vessels' transit and performance optimizing the schedulers but also assessing the capabilities and the risks for vessels according to the different types of cargo such as crude oil or other chemical cargos. They make sure all necessary certifications are according to the regulations and all employees have up-to-date passports and licenses. Vessel operations coordinators schedule and maintain records of vessels' maintenance. At the operational level they have contact with the customers, following up customer complains, identifying new opportunities and providing customers with solutions.

description: Hydraulics Engineer designs, analyses, and implements hydraulic systems, applying fluid mechanics and dynamics to ensure efficient and reliable operation. They develop systems for industries such as construction, manufacturing, and energy, assess fluid behaviour under varying conditions, and ensure compliance with safety and regulatory standards. The engineer collaborates with multidisciplinary teams to integrate hydraulic solutions into machinery, infrastructure, and industrial projects.
tasks: Design and test hydraulic systems for machinery, industrial equipment, and infrastructure projects. Analyse fluid flow, pressure, and temperature to ensure system efficiency and safety. Select and specify hydraulic components such as pumps, valves, filters, and actuators. Perform simulations and calculations to model hydraulic system behaviour under real-world conditions. Troubleshoot hydraulic system issues and support maintenance activities to ensure effective operation. Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to optimise system performance using fluid mechanics expertise. Conduct research and development to innovate new hydraulic system solutions. Ensure hydraulic systems comply with safety regulations and industry standards. Advise on hydraulic engineering methods for machinery, infrastructure, and industrial applications. Prepare technical documentation and coordinate technical consultations with experts.

candidates.title: water engineer
candidates.description: Water engineers research and develop methods for the provision of clean water, water treatment and flood damage prevention and reaction. They research water needs in a location and develop methods for meeting those needs, such as designing and developing projects for managing water resources such as treatment plants, pipelines, pump systems, irrigation or draining systems and other water supply systems. Water engineers also ensure proper installation of these systems on construction sites. Water engineers also maintain, repair and build structures that control water resources, such as bridges, canals and dams.

candidates.title: fluid power engineer
candidates.description: Fluid power engineers supervise the assembly, installation, maintenance, and testing of fluid power equipment in accordance with specified manufacturing processes. They create designs with schematics and assembly models, make drawings and bills of materials for components, and analyse equipment.

candidates.title: drainage engineer
candidates.description: Drainage engineers design and construct drainage systems for sewers and storm water systems. They evaluate the options to design drainage systems that meet the requirements while ensuring compliance with legislation and environmental standards and policies. Drainage engineers choose the most optimal drainage system to prevent floods, control irrigation and direct sewage away from water sources.

candidates.title: mechanical engineer
candidates.description: Mechanical engineers research, plan and design mechanical products and systems and supervise the fabrication, operation, application, installation and repair of systems and products. They research and analyse data.

candidates.title: hydropower engineer
candidates.description: Hydropower engineers research, design and plan the building of facilities that generate electricity from the movement of water. They search optimal locations, conduct trials and try different materials to achieve the best result. Hydropower engineers develop strategies for more efficient energy production and analyse environmental consequences.

candidates.title: pipeline engineer
candidates.description: Pipeline engineers design and develop the engineering aspects for the construction of pipeline infrastructures in various kinds of sites (e.g. inland, maritime). They envision and create the specifications for pumping systems and for the general transport of goods through pipelines.

candidates.title: water systems engineering technician
candidates.description: Water systems engineering technicians aid engineers in the development and implementation of water supply and water treatment systems. They monitor the operations to ensure compliance with health and safety regulations, check water quality and ensure implementation of water-related legislation.

candidates.title: hydraulic forging press worker
candidates.description: Hydraulic forging press workers set up and tend hydraulic forging presses, designed to shape ferrous and non-ferrous metal workpieces including pipes, tubes and hollow profiles and other products of the first processing of steel in their desired form by use of compressive forces generated by a piston and fluid pressure.

description: Water Management Engineer researches, designs, and implements systems for the sustainable management of water resources. They develop and oversee projects such as water supply networks, treatment plants, irrigation and drainage systems, stormwater management, and flood control structures, ensuring compliance with environmental and legal standards. Their work includes assessing water quality, conducting hydrological studies, preparing technical reports, and collaborating with authorities and stakeholders to optimise water use and improve accessibility, sustainability, and safety in both urban and rural areas.
tasks: Design and oversee water storage, supply, distribution, and treatment systems to ensure efficiency, quality, and sustainability. Plan and implement wastewater, stormwater, and flood control solutions in compliance with environmental and legal standards. Conduct hydrological modelling, environmental impact assessments, and water quality evaluations to support water resource planning. Collaborate with government authorities, environmental agencies, private sector partners, and technical specialists to ensure compliance, sustainability, and effective project delivery. Prepare technical reports and assess the feasibility of water infrastructure projects.

candidates.description: Wastewater engineers design sewage systems and networks for the removal and treatment of wastewater from cities and other residential areas. They design systems which are compliant with environmental standards, and aim to minimise impact on the ecosystem and on citizens in the vicinity of the network.

candidates.title: water treatment plant manager
candidates.description: Water treatment plant managers supervise water treatment, storage and distribution in a water plant. They ensure the plant's operations are compliant with regulation, and supervise staff. They also implement new policies, and oversee equipment maintenance.

candidates.title: water plant technician
candidates.description: Water plant technicians maintain and repair water treatment and supply equipment in a water plant. They ensure the provision of clean water by measuring the water quality, ensuring it is filtered and treated correctly, and maintaining distribution systems.

candidates.title: hydropower engineer

They search optimal locations, conduct trials and try different materials to achieve the best result. Hydropower engineers develop strategies for more efficient energy production and analyse environmental consequences.

candidates.title: environmental engineer
candidates.description: Environmental engineers integrate environmental and sustainable measures in the development of projects of various natures. They seek to preserve natural resources and natural sites. They work together with engineers from other fields to envision all the implications that projects might have in order to design ways to conserve natural reserves, prevent pollution, and deploy sanitary measures.

description: Pipeline Mechanical Engineer designs, develops, and maintains pipeline systems for industries such as oil and gas, water distribution, and chemical processing. They ensure the safe, efficient, and reliable operation of pipelines, including pumping systems and transport infrastructure, while complying with industry standards and environmental regulations. The role involves planning, monitoring performance, conducting inspections, resolving technical issues, and collaborating with project teams to deliver projects to quality, budget, and schedule requirements.
tasks: Design and develop pipeline systems for transporting oil, gas, water, or other materials, ensuring required flow, pressure, reliability, and safety performance. Conduct feasibility studies to assess construction viability, environmental impacts, project risks, and schedule requirements. Perform mechanical calculations to determine appropriate materials, wall thicknesses, and pipeline dimensions. Supervise pipeline installation and commissioning activities, ensuring compliance with safety requirements, quality standards, budget, and schedule. Inspect pipelines, pumping systems, and related equipment to identify wear, damage, performance issues, or potential failures. Recommend and implement repairs, modifications, or maintenance solutions to improve pipeline efficiency and reliability. Evaluate and recommend improved engineering methods and maintenance practices for pipeline systems. Prepare technical documentation, including reports, manuals, specifications, and safety procedures. Collaborate with project teams and technical specialists to resolve engineering issues and support project delivery.

candidates.title: pipeline engineer
candidates.description: Pipeline engineers design and develop the engineering aspects for the construction of pipeline infrastructures in various kinds of sites (e.g. inland, maritime). They envision and create the specifications for pumping systems and for the general transport of goods through pipelines.

candidates.title: pipeline maintenance worker
candidates.description: Pipeline maintenance workers operate different equipment to keep the suitability of the pipelines. They perform checks for deviations and administer chemicals according to the needs and cleaning aim (e.g. corrosion shunning).

candidates.title: pipeline superintendent
candidates.description: Pipeline superintendents manage the direction and overall development of pipeline transport projects. They envision the planning, the route selection, the management of resources, and the daily operations. They develop long-term vision safeguarding efficiency of the infrastructure.

candidates.title: mechanical engineer
candidates.description: Mechanical engineers research, plan and design mechanical products and systems and supervise the fabrication, operation, application, installation and repair of systems and products. They research and analyse data.

candidates.title: drilling engineer
candidates.description: Drilling engineers develop and supervise the drilling of gas and oil wells. They assist in the designing, testing and creation of wells and are employed on land or offshore platforms. Drilling engineers work with other mining professionals and oversee the drilling progress and safety of the site.

candidates.title: pipeline environmental project manager
candidates.description: Pipeline environmental project managers ensure the accomplishment of environmental preservation within pipeline transport projects. They, together with a group of managers and specialists, analyse the sites and routes of pipelines in order to advice on environmental issues to be considered and addressed.

candidates.title: pipeline pump operator
candidates.description: Pipeline pump operators tend pump equipment and systems to transfer liquids and substances (e.g. such as chemical solutions, crude oil, gases, and others) from one point to the next. They operate hoses, pumps, and other equipment according to the good to be transferred. They ensure smooth circulation and flow of the goods in the pipelines.

candidates.title: pipeline compliance coordinator
candidates.description: Pipeline compliance coordinators track, compile and summarise all the compliance and conformance activities in pipeline infrastructures and fields. They ensure that works are carried out within regulatory frameworks. They strive to develop and implement compliance policies and recommend ways to minimize risk. They inspect sites, collect evidence, and report compliance needs to the management.

description: Pipe Stress Engineer evaluates and ensures the structural integrity and performance of piping systems across industries. They perform detailed stress analyses, considering factors such as thermal expansion, internal pressure, seismic forces, and mechanical loads, to ensure safe and reliable operation. The role involves collaborating with engineering teams to optimise designs, select supports and brackets, monitor system performance, and address potential failures, applying principles of mechanical and civil engineering, material science, and fluid dynamics.
tasks: Conduct stress analysis of piping systems using specialised software, taking into account thermal expansion, internal pressure, seismic forces, and mechanical loads. Design and specify pipe supports, hangers, and expansion joints to maintain the structural integrity and performance of piping systems. Ensure compliance with local and international codes and standards. Review piping drawings and technical specifications to verify safety, compliance, and adherence to design requirements. Prepare technical reports and documentation for design reviews, engineering assessments, and project execution. Assist in material selection based on system conditions and fluid properties. Identify and resolve technical problems during project execution in collaboration with engineering teams. Conduct site inspections to verify proper installation and operational performance of piping systems.

candidates.title: pipeline engineer
candidates.description: Pipeline engineers design and develop the engineering aspects for the construction of pipeline infrastructures in various kinds of sites (e.g. inland, maritime). They envision and create the specifications for pumping systems and for the general transport of goods through pipelines.

candidates.title: fluid power engineer
candidates.description: Fluid power engineers supervise the assembly, installation, maintenance, and testing of fluid power equipment in accordance with specified manufacturing processes. They create designs with schematics and assembly models, make drawings and bills of materials for components, and analyse equipment.

candidates.title: pipe welder
candidates.description: Pipe welders assemble and install parts and components of pipelines for the transport of goods such as water, steam and chemicals through them. They interpret specs such as pneumatics, hydraulics, for installation on site according to the safety and production requirements.

candidates.title: gas distribution engineer
candidates.description: Gas distribution engineers design and construct transport systems for natural gas, connecting the gas distribution network to the consumer by designing piping works and mains. They research methods to ensure sustainability, and to decrease environmental impact, as well as optimising cost efficiency.

candidates.title: pipeline maintenance worker
candidates.description: Pipeline maintenance workers operate different equipment to keep the suitability of the pipelines. They perform checks for deviations and administer chemicals according to the needs and cleaning aim (e.g. corrosion shunning).

Water engineers also ensure proper installation of these systems on construction sites. Water engineers also maintain, repair and build structures that control water resources, such as bridges, canals and dams.

candidates.title: test engineer
candidates.description: Test engineers plan and perform detailed quality tests during various phases of the design process to make sure that the systems are properly installed and function correctly. They analyse the data collected during tests and produce reports. They are also responsible for the safety of the test operations.

candidates.title: construction engineer
candidates.description: Construction engineers interpret building designs and add technical specifications to construction projects. They integrate engineering principles into the designs to ensure that structures are safe and resistant. They work together with architects and engineers to transform design ideas into executable plans.

description: Blasting Expert (Mine) plans, designs, and executes blasting operations to loosen, remove, or displace earth, rock, or other materials in a mining environment. They assess geological conditions, determine suitable explosives, and develop blast patterns to optimise extraction while maintaining safety and mine stability. The role involves managing explosives, monitoring blast sites, and coordinating with engineers and safety personnel to ensure efficient and compliant operations.
tasks: Conduct geological assessments to determine rock formation characteristics. Design blasting patterns to ensure safe, efficient extraction and minimise environmental impact. Select and calculate appropriate types and quantities of explosives for each project. Manage the safe storage, handling, and transportation of explosives in compliance with regulations. Coordinate and supervise blast crews to ensure blasting activities are carried out safely and in accordance with operational procedures and safety protocols. Evaluate blast results and adjust techniques for future operations. Conduct regular site inspections to identify hazards, including unstable rocks and gas emissions. Maintain detailed records and reports of blasting operations and safety compliance. Advise on and improve blasting methods to enhance extraction efficiency, safety, and compliance. Collaborate with geologists, engineers, and safety personnel to optimise blasting operations.

candidates.title: explosives engineer
candidates.description: Explosives engineers design drilling patterns and determine the amount of explosives required. They organise and supervise controlled blasts and report and investigate misfires. They manage explosives magazines.

candidates.title: abrasive blasting operator
candidates.description: Abrasive blasting operators use the proper equipment and machinery to smoothen rough surfaces by abrasive blasting. Abrasive blasting is commonly used in the finishing process of metal workpieces and for blasting building materials used in masonry such as bricks, stones and concrete. They operate blasters or sand cabinets which forcibly thrust a stream of abrasive material such sand, soda or water, under high pressure, propelled by a centrifigal wheel, in order to shape and smoothen surfaces.

candidates.title: mine safety officer
candidates.description: Mine safety officers oversee health and safety systems at mining operations. They report workplace accidents, compile accident statistics, estimate risks to employee safety and health, and suggest solutions or new measurements and techniques.

candidates.title: mine manager
candidates.description: Mine managers control, direct, plan and coordinate mining production activities. They have statutory responsibility for safety and are also responsible for environmental impact. They oversee the acquisition, installation, maintenance and storage of mining plant and equipment. They lead and manage according to the organisation's code of conduct.

candidates.title: mine planning engineer
candidates.description: Mine planning engineers design future mine layouts capable of achieving production and mine development objectives, taking into account the geological characteristics and structure of the mineral resource. They prepare production and development schedules and monitor progress against these.

candidates.title: mine supervisor
candidates.description: Mine supervisors coordinate and supervise the activities related to mining and quarrying in underground and surface mines and quarries. They oversee the workers, schedules, processes and organisation in the mines and quarries.

candidates.title: mine production manager
candidates.description: Mine production managers coordinate and implement short and medium term mine production schedules and plans, such as drilling, blasting, ore and mineral extraction, and waste management.

candidates.title: bomb disposal technician
candidates.description: Bomb disposal technicians search areas using special equipment such as metal detectors, or using trained animals, for the presence of land mines and bombs, and remove the explosive materials according to safety regulations. After the search for and location of mines and bombs, they disarm them aiming to avoid any risk of detonation, and ensure the area is cleared before disarming and removal procedures.

description: Explosive Ordnance Engineer designs, tests, and oversees the manufacture of explosive devices in line with military or safety standards. They identify, analyse, and safely neutralise explosives such as bombs, landmines, and improvised explosive devices, often operating in high-risk environments. The role includes developing risk management strategies, researching disarming techniques, and training personnel to ensure the protection of civilians, military personnel, and emergency responders.
tasks: Identify, locate, and assess explosive devices in various environments. Operate advanced tools such as bomb disposal robots and X-ray machines to assess explosive threats. Test, coordinate, and review the manufacture of explosive ordnance to meet specifications. Safely neutralise or dispose of explosive devices through disarming, rendering inert, or controlled detonation. Conduct safety inspections, risk assessments, and develop emergency protocols for areas handling explosives. Assess damage from explosive incidents and support technical evaluation of follow-up operations. Advise on engineering aspects of explosive manufacturing and handling processes. Maintain accurate records of explosives, their locations, and disposal methods.

candidates.description: Explosives engineers design drilling patterns and determine the amount of explosives required. They organise and supervise controlled blasts and report and investigate misfires. They manage explosives magazines.
