They work with their university research assistants and university teaching assistants for the preparation of lectures and of exams, for grading papers and exams, for leading laboratory practices, and for leading review and feedback sessions for the students. They also conduct academic research in their respective field of dentistry, publish their findings and liaise with other university colleagues.

candidates.title: health and safety officer
candidates.description: Health and safety officers execute plans for the improvement of work environments and cultures. They assess risks and interview employees to ensure the work environment is compliant with health and safety rules, as well as ensuring the interaction within the workplace occurs in a positive and productive manner. If employed in a healthcare facility the health and safety officer has to investigate infections spreading across a facility and advice all employees how to combat and prevent infections. Furthermore health physics is applied at facilities where people are exposed to ionizing radiation such as nuclear power plants and research institutions.

candidates.title: police officer
candidates.description: Police officers use investigation methods to prevent crime, to pursue and apprehend criminals, and protect the public from violent and criminal activities. They perform surveillance and patrol activities to prevent crimes and apprehend offenders. They provide support to victimised parties and the public at large, and fulfil administrative duties.

description: Pharmacist is a licensed healthcare professional responsible for preparing, dispensing, and advising on the safe and effective use of medicines to optimise patient outcomes. They work in a hospital, clinic, community pharmacy, or specialised outpatient service, monitoring drug therapies, promoting medication adherence, educating patients on safe use, and collaborating with physicians and other healthcare professionals. In addition, the pharmacist may engage in pharmaceutical research, quality control, and regulatory compliance, ensuring medicines meet safety, efficacy, and legal standards.
tasks: Conduct medication reviews to assess adherence and identify drug-related problems. Interpret prescriptions accurately, verify dosages, and identify potential drug interactions. Dispense and compound medicines according to prescriptions, and maintain accurate patient records. Provide counselling to patients on the proper use, storage, side effects, and safe handling of medicines. Monitor medication adherence and adverse drug reactions, and support individualised therapy management. Collaborate with physicians and other healthcare professionals to optimise pharmacotherapy and patient outcomes. Ensure compliance with pharmaceutical regulations, ethical standards, and quality control requirements. Manage pharmacy inventory and procurement, and supervise pharmacy assistants or support staff.

candidates.title: pharmacist
candidates.description: Pharmacists prepare, dispense, and provide prescriptions for, over the counter medication. They offer clinical information on medicines, report suspected adverse reactions, and provide personalised support to patients. Pharmacists formulate and test medications in laboratories, and store, preserve, and distribute them.

candidates.title: hospital pharmacist
candidates.description: Hospital pharmacists prepare, dispense and provide medication to patients in hospitals. They collaborate with healthcare personnel such as doctors and nurses to treat patients and also offer advice and information on medications.

candidates.title: specialist pharmacist
candidates.description: Specialist pharmacists provide specialist services for companies in the pharmacy industry and in hospital pharmacies. The role of the specialist pharmacist varies throughout Europe, subject to national rules and training.

candidates.title: industrial pharmacist
candidates.description: Industrial pharmacists are involved in the research and creation of medications. They develop new medicines, perform tests, assure quality and ensure that medication complies with regulations.

candidates.title: pharmacologist
candidates.description: Pharmacologists study the manner in which drugs and medicaments interact with organisms, living systems, and their parts (i.e. cells, tissues, or organs). Their research aims at identifying substances that can be ingested by humans and that exert adequate biochemical functions for curing illnesses.

candidates.title: pharmacy technician
candidates.description: Pharmacy technicians, under the supervision of a pharmacist, check incoming goods, control stock, handle and store pharmaceuticals properly. Where permitted by national rules, they dispense medication and provide advice on their appropriate use.

candidates.title: pharmacy assistant
candidates.description: Pharmacy assistants perform general duties, such as stock management, serving at the cash desk, or performing administrative duties. They deal with the inventory within the pharmacy under the supervision of a pharmacist.

candidates.title: pharmaceutical quality specialist
candidates.description: Pharmaceutical quality specialists perform inspections and precision measurements in order to test and ensure the quality of pharmaceutical products. They are involved in the whole development phase of a pharmaceutical product until it is ready for the market. This includes the process of acquiring clinical trial licences, advising the pharmaceutical development staff on regulatory requirements and evaluating the content of the package leaflet and other documentation on the product. Moreover, pharmaceutical quality specialists collect and evaluate information on side effects of the product and communicate this knowledge both internally and to the relevant authorities.

description: Pharmacist Grade UF9 responsible for improving public health through the delivery of pharmaceutical services and empowering the community in the use of quality, safe, and effective medicines.
tasks: Supplying medicines to outpatients to ensure that patients’ pharmacotherapy is safe, effective, and achieves optimal therapeutic outcomes, while enhancing medication adherence. Providing pharmaceutical care services to patients through medication counselling services, including activities such as Medication Therapy Adherence Clinic (MTAC) and Pharmacy Home Care Services (PFHC). Drug information services, drug enquiries, medication safety, and quality use of medicines to ensure that services provided by the Pharmacy Department are at the optimum level. Managing pharmacy logistics to ensure adequate availability of medical supplies (medicines, non-medicines, vaccines, and medical gases) to meet customer needs through efficient, planned management systems in accordance with circular policies and regulations in force. Manufacture and preparation of sterile and non-sterile pharmaceutical preparations in accordance with Standard Operating Procedures and aseptic practices to ensure product quality and safety. Implementation of enforcement and licensing activities in accordance with the provisions of the Poisons Act 1952 and the Medicines (Advertisement and Sale) Act 1956. Planning, managing, coordinating, and implementing activities for handling complaints and information, sampling, screening and profiling, intelligence, and raids on targets suspected of violating the enforced Acts involving commercial activities (sale of pharmaceutical, traditional, and cosmetic products) through conventional channels and new media. Implementing product registration/cosmetic notification schemes through evaluation of technical data, laboratory analysis, as well as studies and information received from international agencies. Implementing regulatory control over the quality of pharmaceutical products in the market through random sampling and analytical testing. Managing product recall schemes for pharmaceutical products that are of poor quality and hazardous to consumers.

candidates.title: pharmacist
candidates.description: Pharmacists prepare, dispense, and provide prescriptions for, over the counter medication. They offer clinical information on medicines, report suspected adverse reactions, and provide personalised support to patients. Pharmacists formulate and test medications in laboratories, and store, preserve, and distribute them.

candidates.title: hospital pharmacist
candidates.description: Hospital pharmacists prepare, dispense and provide medication to patients in hospitals. They collaborate with healthcare personnel such as doctors and nurses to treat patients and also offer advice and information on medications.

candidates.title: industrial pharmacist
candidates.description: Industrial pharmacists are involved in the research and creation of medications. They develop new medicines, perform tests, assure quality and ensure that medication complies with regulations.

candidates.title: specialist pharmacist
candidates.description: Specialist pharmacists provide specialist services for companies in the pharmacy industry and in hospital pharmacies. The role of the specialist pharmacist varies throughout Europe, subject to national rules and training.

candidates.title: pharmacologist
candidates.description: Pharmacologists study the manner in which drugs and medicaments interact with organisms, living systems, and their parts (i.e. cells, tissues, or organs). Their research aims at identifying substances that can be ingested by humans and that exert adequate biochemical functions for curing illnesses.

candidates.title: pharmacy technician
candidates.description: Pharmacy technicians, under the supervision of a pharmacist, check incoming goods, control stock, handle and store pharmaceuticals properly. Where permitted by national rules, they dispense medication and provide advice on their appropriate use.

candidates.title: pharmacy assistant
candidates.description: Pharmacy assistants perform general duties, such as stock management, serving at the cash desk, or performing administrative duties. They deal with the inventory within the pharmacy under the supervision of a pharmacist.

candidates.title: pharmaceutical quality specialist
candidates.description: Pharmaceutical quality specialists perform inspections and precision measurements in order to test and ensure the quality of pharmaceutical products. They are involved in the whole development phase of a pharmaceutical product until it is ready for the market. This includes the process of acquiring clinical trial licences, advising the pharmaceutical development staff on regulatory requirements and evaluating the content of the package leaflet and other documentation on the product. Moreover, pharmaceutical quality specialists collect and evaluate information on side effects of the product and communicate this knowledge both internally and to the relevant authorities.

description: Pharmacist Grade UF10 responsible for improving public health through the delivery of pharmaceutical services and empowering the community in the use of quality, safe, and effective medicines.
tasks: Supplying medicines to outpatients to ensure that patients’ pharmacotherapy is safe, effective, and achieves optimal therapeutic outcomes, while enhancing medication adherence. Providing pharmaceutical care services to patients through medication counselling services, including activities such as Medication Therapy Adherence Clinic (MTAC) and Pharmacy Home Care Services (PFHC). Drug information services, drug enquiries, medication safety, and quality use of medicines to ensure that services provided by the Pharmacy Department are at the optimum level. Managing pharmacy logistics to ensure adequate availability of medical supplies (medicines, non-medicines, vaccines, and medical gases) to meet customer needs through efficient, planned management systems in accordance with circular policies and regulations in force. Manufacture and preparation of sterile and non-sterile pharmaceutical preparations in accordance with Standard Operating Procedures and aseptic practices to ensure product quality and safety. Implementation of enforcement and licensing activities in accordance with the provisions of the Poisons Act 1952 and the Medicines (Advertisement and Sale) Act 1956. Planning, managing, coordinating, and implementing activities for handling complaints and information, sampling, screening and profiling, intelligence, and raids on targets suspected of violating the enforced Acts involving commercial activities (sale of pharmaceutical, traditional, and cosmetic products) through conventional channels and new media. Implementing product registration/cosmetic notification schemes through evaluation of technical data, laboratory analysis, as well as studies and information received from international agencies. Implementing regulatory control over the quality of pharmaceutical products in the market through random sampling and analytical testing. Managing product recall schemes for pharmaceutical products that are of poor quality and hazardous to consumers.

candidates.title: pharmacist
candidates.description: Pharmacists prepare, dispense, and provide prescriptions for, over the counter medication. They offer clinical information on medicines, report suspected adverse reactions, and provide personalised support to patients. description: Occupational Safety and Health Adviser plans, implements and manages workplace safety and health programmes to identify, assess and control environmental and occupational hazards that may affect employees’ health and safety. They conduct workplace inspections, risk assessments and incident investigations, and develop policies, procedures and training to prevent injury and disease arising from chemical, physical, biological, radiological and ergonomic risks.
tasks: Identify and assess workplace hazards through inspections and risk assessments. Develop, implement and maintain workplace safety and health policies, procedures and programmes. Implement control measures to reduce workplace risks and prevent injury and disease. Conduct safety audits, emergency drills and training sessions to promote safe work practices. Lead investigations of incidents and accidents, and document causes and corrective actions. Prepare and maintain workplace safety compliance reports and related documentation. Advise on environmental and occupational hazards affecting employees’ health and safety. Maintain records of inspections, incidents and training activities.

candidates.title: occupational health and safety inspector
candidates.description: Occupational health and safety inspectors perform workplace audits to ensure compliance with government and environment legislation. They also investigate work accidents. Occupational health and safety inspectors interview employees to ensure the work environment is compliant with health and safety rules, inspect the physical work site and analyse legal paperwork.

candidates.title: health and safety officer
candidates.description: Health and safety officers execute plans for the improvement of work environments and cultures. They assess risks and interview employees to ensure the work environment is compliant with health and safety rules, as well as ensuring the interaction within the workplace occurs in a positive and productive manner. If employed in a healthcare facility the health and safety officer has to investigate infections spreading across a facility and advice all employees how to combat and prevent infections. Furthermore health physics is applied at facilities where people are exposed to ionizing radiation such as nuclear power plants and research institutions.

candidates.title: health safety and environmental manager
candidates.description: Health, safety and environmental managers design and execute corporate policies and procedures related to occupational health and safety and environmental protection. They analyse business processes to ensure compliance with government and environment legislation, conduct risk assessment in the domain of occupational health and safety, evaluate the environmental impact of economic activities and design the appropriate measures for the improvement of work environments and cultures. They coordinate the implementation of an integrated health, safety and environmental management system, defining effective indicators, organizing audits and eventually participating in accident investigation and reporting. They promote an integrated approach to sustainability and occupational health within business organisations, liaising with corporate and line managers and training employees. They are responsible for drafting technical documentation related to the compliance with health and safety and environmental legislation.

candidates.title: health and safety inspector
candidates.description: Health and safety inspectors investigate the implementation and application of labour standards and policies in a workplace. They advise employers as well as employees on the improvement of policy and legislation implementation, ensure that the law is adhered to, and that matters of equality and labour rights are respected. They write reports and communicate with authorities.

candidates.title: health and safety engineer
candidates.description: Health and safety engineers design objects and programs by combining engineering principles and health and safety requirements. They envision the protection and well-being of the people using designed objects or performing work under designed health and safety programs. They assess facilities and the risks that they might pose (e.g. contaminant materials, ergonomics, handling of dangerous substances, etc.) in order to design and improve health and safety measures.

candidates.title: dangerous goods safety adviser
candidates.description: Dangerous goods safety advisers inspect and make transport recommendations in line with the European regulations regarding the transport of dangerous goods. They may advise on the transport of dangerous goods by road, rail, sea and air. Dangerous goods safety advisers also prepare safety reports and investigate safety infringements. They provide individuals with the procedures and instructions to follow during the loading, unloading and transporting of these goods.

candidates.title: construction safety manager
candidates.description: Construction safety managers inspect, enforce and control health and safety measures at construction sites. They also manage workplace accidents and take action to make sure that safety policies are correctly implemented.

candidates.title: transport health and safety inspector
candidates.description: Transport health and safety inspectors are responsible for maintaining safety standards, reducing risk to company, staff and customers and achieving industry standards. They evaluate existing security systems to determine potential risks in all transport sectors such as road and sea transport, and develop policies and procedures that minimise the risk to properties, employees and computer systems.
candidates.matched_label: road occupational health and safety manager

description: Competent Person (CP) - Assessor conducts specialised workplace risk assessments, including chemical and indoor air quality evaluations, to ensure compliance with occupational safety, health and environmental regulations in Malaysia. They assess hazards, analyse findings, document non-compliance and provide recommendations for corrective and preventive measures to safeguard worker health and maintain regulatory standards. The role also involves preparing formal reports and advising employers on improvements to workplace practices and control measures across various sectors.
tasks: Perform on-site inspections of workplace premises to identify occupational and environmental health hazards and unsanitary conditions. Collect and analyse air and environmental samples to assess pollutants, particulates, microbial contamination, and other workplace hazards. Prepare detailed assessment reports that document findings, non-compliance, and recommendations for corrective and preventive actions. Recommend, review, and monitor control measures to minimise occupational and environmental hazards in the workplace. Liaise with regulatory bodies to ensure compliance with occupational safety, health, and environmental requirements. Deliver consultation and awareness training on compliance requirements and corrective actions related to workplace assessments. Coordinate assessment activities and follow-up actions to maintain regulatory compliance.

candidates.title: energy assessor
candidates.description: Energy assessors determine the energy performance of buildings. They create an Energy Performance Certificate (EPC) which indicates what the estimated energy consumption of a property is. Furthermore they give advice on how to improve energy conservation.

candidates.title: monitoring and evaluation officer
candidates.description: Monitoring and evaluation officers are responsible for the conceptualisation, design, implementation and follow-up of the monitoring and evaluation activities of projects, programmes, policies, strategies, institutions or processes, along the relevant programming cycle. They develop monitoring, inspection and evaluation methods and instruments needed to collect and analyse data, and report on results by applying structured M&E frameworks, theories, approaches and methodologies. M&E officers inform decision-making through reporting, learning products or activities and knowledge management. They can also engage in capacity development activities by providing training and capacity building support within their organizations or for clients and partners.

candidates.title: domestic energy assessor
candidates.description: Domestic energy assessors advise individuals on energy supply for their homes. They assess the individual's needs and recommend the appropriate source of energy and supplier, attempting to secure energy sales. They also advise on economic and environmental advantages of types of energy, and create energy plans compliant with regulations and the technical requirements and conditions of the residence.

candidates.title: health and safety inspector
candidates.description: Health and safety inspectors investigate the implementation and application of labour standards and policies in a workplace. They advise employers as well as employees on the improvement of policy and legislation implementation, ensure that the law is adhered to, and that matters of equality and labour rights are respected. They write reports and communicate with authorities.

candidates.title: occupational health and safety inspector
candidates.description: Occupational health and safety inspectors perform workplace audits to ensure compliance with government and environment legislation. They also investigate work accidents. Occupational health and safety inspectors interview employees to ensure the work environment is compliant with health and safety rules, inspect the physical work site and analyse legal paperwork.

candidates.title: real estate surveyor
candidates.description: Real estate surveyors undertake research in order to assess the value of property for tax purposes. They investigate multiple properties at once, using accurate appraisal techniques. They provide their services usually to local and governmental bodies for taxation reasons.

candidates.title: health and safety officer
candidates.description: Health and safety officers execute plans for the improvement of work environments and cultures. They assess risks and interview employees to ensure the work environment is compliant with health and safety rules, as well as ensuring the interaction within the workplace occurs in a positive and productive manner. If employed in a healthcare facility the health and safety officer has to investigate infections spreading across a facility and advice all employees how to combat and prevent infections. Furthermore health physics is applied at facilities where people are exposed to ionizing radiation such as nuclear power plants and research institutions.

candidates.title: surveying technician
candidates.description: Surveying technicians carry out technical surveying tasks. They assist surveyors, architects or engineers in surveying related technical tasks such as mapping land, creating construction drawings and operating precise measuring equipment.

description: Competent Person (CP) - Waste Management oversees the management and operation of waste treatment and disposal systems to safeguard environmental quality and workplace health. They assess and monitor waste management processes in industrial, commercial and municipal settings, ensure compliance with environmental legislation and regulatory standards, and maintain required records and reporting. The role includes supervising treatment operations, coordinating maintenance and safety procedures, and supporting measures to prevent environmental pollution and health risks arising from waste handling and disposal.
tasks: Supervise the operation and maintenance of waste treatment and disposal systems to meet regulatory standards. Monitor waste treatment performance, effluent quality, and other environmental parameters regularly. Inspect treatment facilities, systems, and equipment to ensure proper functioning. Maintain records and prepare compliance and performance reports in accordance with regulatory requirements. Investigate environmental and health hazards arising from waste handling and disposal, and implement corrective measures. Develop, implement, and review waste management and safety procedures to minimise environmental and occupational risks. Manage the safe storage and use of treatment chemicals. Coordinate with environmental agencies and internal teams on regulatory compliance matters.

candidates.title: waste management officer
candidates.description: Waste management officers advise and enforce regulations on facilities managing waste disposal, collection and recycling. They develop and implement rules and evaluate the compliance with existing legislation.

candidates.title: waste management supervisor
candidates.description: Waste management supervisors coordinate waste collection, recycling, and disposal facilities. They supervise waste management operations, ensuring compliance with environmental standards, and oversee staff. They aid in the development of waste management methods, aiming for increased waste reduction, and aid in the prevention of violations of waste treatment legislation.

candidates.title: solid waste operator
candidates.description: Solid waste operators operate and maintain solid waste treatment and distribution equipment, and test samples to monitor pollution. They assist in the collection and disposal of solid waste, such as construction and demolition debris, and ensure treatment is compliant to safety regulations. They ensure community waste containers are emptied, ensure proper differentiation between waste which needs to be recycled or disposed of, and monitor equipment.

candidates.title: waste broker
candidates.description: Waste brokers act as mediating party between clients and waste management industries. They ensure the waste is collected from the client by a specialised professional, and transported to a waste mangement facility where it is processed.

candidates.title: industrial waste inspector
candidates.description: Industrial waste inspectors conduct controls in companies to ensure they comply with waste and environmental regulations. They check the documentation related to waste management, they collect samples for analysis and observe the industrial practices. They may advise or preventive or corrective actions to improve industrial waste management and disposal.

candidates.title: recycling specialist
candidates.description: Recycling specialists research recycling policies and legislation, and supervise implementation in an organisation to ensure that waste management occurs according to regulations. They perform inspections, provide recycling equipment, and supervise recycling workers. They also advise organisations on ways they can improve their waste management procedures.

candidates.title: hazardous waste inspector
candidates.description: Hazardous waste inspectors inspect industrial sites to ensure they adhere to waste disposal legislation, and inspect their equipment to see if it is operational and functions according to regulations. They also aim to educate the public on hazardous substances and on hazardous waste handling regulations.

candidates.title: waste treatment engineer
candidates.description: Waste treatment engineers design processes, facilities and equipment used in the collection, treatment, and distribution of waste. They research environmental standards and policies in order to optimise waste treatment procedures and ensure minimal strain on the environment by analysing and classifying the processed waste.

description: Building Auditor conducts systematic inspections and audits of buildings to assess structural integrity, safety standards, and compliance with relevant building codes and regulatory requirements. The role involves identifying defects, non-compliance and environmental factors that may affect occupant health and safety, and evaluating overall building performance. They prepare formal reports with findings and recommendations to support corrective actions and promote safe, compliant and sustainable built environments.
tasks: Conduct on-site audits and inspections of buildings to assess structural integrity, safety standards, and compliance with relevant building codes and regulatory requirements. Identify defects, health and safety hazards, environmental factors, and non-compliance issues that may affect building performance and occupant wellbeing. Review architectural and engineering plans for compliance with safety and building standards. Prepare detailed audit reports with findings and recommendations for corrective actions. Review and support the implementation of measures to minimise building-related environmental and occupational risks. Collaborate with construction and property managers to address audit findings and implement corrective actions. Provide advice on building safety, compliance, and risk mitigation measures. Ensure continued adherence to safety, quality, and regulatory standards in building operations and maintenance.

candidates.title: building inspector
candidates.description: Building inspectors perform inspections of buildings to determine compliance with specifications for various focuses of assessment. They observe and determine the suitability of construction, quality and resistance, and general compliance with regulations.

candidates.title: financial auditor
candidates.description: Financial auditors collect and examine financial data for clients, organisations and companies. They ensure the financial data is properly maintained and free of material misstatements due to error or fraud, that it adds up, and functions legally and effectively. They review lending and credit policies or numbers in databases and documents, evaluate, consult and assist the source of the transaction if necessary. They use their review of the client's financial governance as assurance to give testimony to the shareholders, stakeholders and board of directors of the organisation or company that all is up to par.

candidates.title: IT auditor
candidates.description: IT auditors perform audits of information systems, platforms, and operating procedures in accordance with established corporate standards for efficiency, accuracy and security. They evaluate ICT infrastructure in terms of risk to the organisation and establish controls to mitigate loss. They determine and recommend improvements in the current risk management controls and in the implementation of system changes or upgrades.

candidates.title: construction quality inspector
candidates.description: Construction quality inspectors monitor the activities at larger construction sites to make sure everything happens according to standards and specifications. They pay close attention to potential safety problems and take samples of products to test for conformity with standards and specifications.

candidates.title: construction safety inspector
candidates.description: Construction safety inspectors monitor construction sites and their conformity to health and safety regulations. They perform inspections, identify safety hazards and report on their findings.

candidates.title: architect
candidates.description: Architects investigate, design, and oversee the construction and development of buildings, urban spaces, infrastructure projects, and social spaces. They design in accordance with the surroundings and regulations applicable in specific geographic areas, taking into account factors that include function, aesthetics, costs, and public health and safety. They are aware of social contexts and environmental factors, which include the relationships between people and buildings, and buildings and the environment. They engage in multidisciplinary projects aimed at developing the social fabric of a geographic area and advancing in social urbanism projects.

candidates.title: night auditor
candidates.description: Night auditors oversee night customer care in hospitality establishment and perform a wide variety of activities from front desk to bookkeeping.

candidates.title: ICT auditor manager
candidates.description: ICT auditor managers monitor ICT auditors responsible for auditing information systems, platforms, and operating procedures in accordance with established corporate standards for efficiency, accuracy and security. They evaluate ICT infrastructure in terms of risk to the organisation and establish controls to mitigate loss. They determine and recommend improvements in the current risk management controls and in the implementation of system changes or upgrades.

description: Halal Executive ensures that products, services, and operational processes comply with Islamic law and national halal certification requirements. The role manages and coordinates the halal certification and recertification process, conducts internal audits, maintains Halal Assurance Systems, and oversees compliance across production, processing, slaughtering, storage, packaging, logistics, and distribution to safeguard halal integrity throughout the supply chain. They also maintain documentation, provide staff training, support internal halal committees, and liaise with relevant authorities such as Department of Islamic Development Malaysia (JAKIM) to ensure continued certification and regulatory compliance.
tasks: Develop, implement, and maintain the Halal Assurance System (HAS) across food production, meat processing, slaughtering, storage, packaging, logistics, and distribution operations. Prepare, manage, and maintain Halal certification and recertification documentation, applications, and renewals in compliance with Shariah requirements and the Department of Islamic Development Malaysia (JAKIM). Monitor production, processing, handling, storage, and logistics activities to ensure continuous Halal compliance and proper segregation of Halal and non-Halal materials. Conduct internal and external Halal audits, including supplier, slaughterhouse, and premises inspections, and coordinate with relevant authorities during audit and certification processes. Verify the Halal status of raw materials, ingredients, suppliers, and slaughterers to ensure validity of accreditation and compliance with relevant standards. Provide Halal-related training and guidance to staff and management on procedures, standards, and Good Hygiene Practices (GHP). Evaluate audit findings, manage non-compliance issues, implement corrective actions, and support continuous improvement of Halal practices. Keep updated with local and international Halal standards, regulations, and best practices to ensure continued compliance. Support quality control and quality assurance activities to maintain Halal integrity throughout operations.

candidates.title: halal butcher
candidates.description: Halal butchers order, inspect and buy meat to prepare it and sell it as consumable meat products in accordance with Islamic practices. They perform activities such as cutting, trimming, boning, tying, and grinding beef and poultry meat. They prepare halal meat for consumption.

candidates.title: halal slaughterer
candidates.description: Halal slaughterers slaughter animals and process carcasses of halal meat from cows and chickens for further processing and distribution. They slaughter animals as stated in Islamic law and ensure that the animals are fed, slaughtered and hung up accordingly.

candidates.title: chief executive officer
candidates.description: Chief executive officers hold the highest ranking in a pyramidal corporate structure. They are able to hold a complete idea of the functioning of the business, its departments, risks, and stakeholders. They analyse different kinds of information and create links among them for decision-making purposes. They serve as a communication link with the board of directors for reporting and implementation of the overall strategy.

candidates.title: chief operating officer
candidates.description: Chief operating officers are the right hand and second in command of a company's chief executive officer. They ensure that the daily operations of the company run smoothly. Chief operating officers also develop company policies, rules and goals.

candidates.title: executive assistant
candidates.description: Executive assistants are advanced administrative professionals who work with top-level executives or in international facilities in various industries. They organise meetings, organise and maintain files, arrange travel, train staff members, communicate in other languages, and manage the day-to-day operations of the office.

candidates.title: food regulatory advisor
candidates.description: Food regulatory advisors are extra-judicial or judiciary technical experts. They ensure food industry practices comply with the regulatory norms. They perform audits, make diagnosis and monitor activities of inspection. These experts have expertise in food processing, food analysis, quality, safety, certification, traceability. They update, review, and approve labelling designs, develop nutrition facts panels, and ensure that products and labels meet appropriate standards and regulations.

candidates.title: bank manager
candidates.description: Bank managers oversee the management of one or several bank activities. They set policies which promote safe banking operations, ensure the economic, social and commercial targets are met and that all the bank departments, activities and commercial policies are in compliance with legal requirements. They also manage employees and maintain an effective working relationship among the staff.

candidates.title: waste management officer
candidates.description: Waste management officers advise and enforce regulations on facilities managing waste disposal, collection and recycling. They develop and implement rules and evaluate the compliance with existing legislation.

description: Food and Drinks Technologist develops, tests and improves food and beverage products to meet consumer expectations, regulatory requirements and industry standards. They apply scientific principles to product formulation, quality assurance and process optimisation, ensuring products are safe, nutritious, stable and commercially viable. The role also involves monitoring and controlling factors that may affect product safety and workplace hygiene throughout production and distribution.
tasks: Conduct laboratory research and testing to develop new food and beverage products. Improve product formulations to enhance taste, texture, nutritional value, stability, and commercial viability. Inspect, test, and monitor raw materials, ingredients, and finished products to ensure quality, safety, and compliance with Hazard Analysis and Critical Control Points (HACCP) and Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) standards. Oversee pilot-scale production trials and optimise processes to ensure products meet established standards. Inspect production areas to ensure sanitation, workplace hygiene, and compliance with food safety requirements. Establish and update product, process, and procedure standards for food and beverage production. Prepare reports on product performance, research findings, and development progress.

candidates.title: food technologist
candidates.description: Food technologists develop processes for manufacturing foodstuffs and related products based on chemical, physical, and biological principles and technology. They design and plan layouts or equipment, oversee staff, engage in controlling, and improve food technologies in food production processes.

candidates.title: food and beverage packaging technologist
candidates.description: Food and beverage packaging technologists assess appropiate packaging for various food products. They manage matters in relation to packaging while ensuring customer specifications and company targets. They develop packaging projects as required.

candidates.title: food biotechnologist
candidates.description: Food biotechnologists study the life cycle of food from its preservation up to the spoilage and the food-borne pathogens. They research and understand food-borne diseases in order to prevent them. They ensure that food products abide by government regulations regarding food health and safety.

candidates.title: food analyst
candidates.description: Food analysts perform standardised tests to determine the chemical, physical, or microbiological features of products for human consumption.

candidates.title: food technician
candidates.description: Food technicians assist food technologists in the deveolpment of processes for manufacturing foodstuffs and related products based on chemical, physical, and biological principles. They perform research and experiments on ingredients, additives and packaging. Food technicians also check product quality to ensure compliance with legislation and regulations.

candidates.title: food safety specialist
candidates.description: Food safety specialists organise processes and implement procedures to avoid problems with food safety. They comply with regulations.

candidates.title: food production engineer
candidates.description: Food production engineers oversee the electrical and mechanical needs of the equipment and machinery required in the process of manufacturing food or beverages. They strive to maximise plant productivity by engaging in preventive actions in reference to health and safety, good manufacturing practices (GMP), hygiene compliance, and performance of routine maintenance of machines and equipment.

candidates.title: food regulatory advisor
candidates.description: Food regulatory advisors are extra-judicial or judiciary technical experts. They ensure food industry practices comply with the regulatory norms. They perform audits, make diagnosis and monitor activities of inspection. These experts have expertise in food processing, food analysis, quality, safety, certification, traceability. They update, review, and approve labelling designs, develop nutrition facts panels, and ensure that products and labels meet appropriate standards and regulations.

description: Landfill Engineer designs, manages and monitors landfill sites to ensure the safe and environmentally sound disposal of solid waste. The role involves planning and overseeing landfill operations, including leachate and landfill gas management systems, implementing pollution control measures, maintaining related infrastructure, and ensuring compliance with environmental legislation and standards. They also prepare regulatory reports, supervise contractors, and liaise with relevant authorities to support sustainable waste management practices.
tasks: Design and plan landfill site structures and layouts. Develop and oversee landfill operational programmes to ensure safe operations and compliance with environmental regulations. Conduct environmental impact assessments and support pollution control measures for landfill operations. Oversee leachate and landfill gas collection, treatment, and control systems. Implement measures to minimise environmental and occupational hazards at landfill sites. Supervise the maintenance and construction of landfill facilities and related infrastructure. Prepare and submit regulatory and operational reports to relevant authorities. Coordinate site safety procedures for staff, equipment, and contractors.

candidates.title: landfill supervisor
candidates.description: Landfill supervisors coordinate the activities and operations of landfills and landfill staff. They research legislation concerning waste management and ensure the operations of the landfill are compliant, and direct waste disposal operations.

candidates.title: waste treatment engineer
candidates.description: Waste treatment engineers design processes, facilities and equipment used in the collection, treatment, and distribution of waste. They research environmental standards and policies in order to optimise waste treatment procedures and ensure minimal strain on the environment by analysing and classifying the processed waste.

candidates.title: drainage engineer
candidates.description: Drainage engineers design and construct drainage systems for sewers and storm water systems. They evaluate the options to design drainage systems that meet the requirements while ensuring compliance with legislation and environmental standards and policies. Drainage engineers choose the most optimal drainage system to prevent floods, control irrigation and direct sewage away from water sources.

candidates.title: environmental engineer
candidates.description: Environmental engineers integrate environmental and sustainable measures in the development of projects of various natures. They seek to preserve natural resources and natural sites. They work together with engineers from other fields to envision all the implications that projects might have in order to design ways to conserve natural reserves, prevent pollution, and deploy sanitary measures.

candidates.title: recycling specialist
candidates.description: Recycling specialists research recycling policies and legislation, and supervise implementation in an organisation to ensure that waste management occurs according to regulations. They perform inspections, provide recycling equipment, and supervise recycling workers. They also advise organisations on ways they can improve their waste management procedures.

candidates.title: hazardous waste technician
candidates.description: Hazardous waste technicians dispose of materials that have been in contact with or are ignitable, corrosive, reactive, toxic or a combination of the aforementioned hazardous traits. They remove the waste from industrial facilities or households and transport them to a treatment facility to ensure they are treated and disposed of according to regulations. They may also advise on the proper treatment of hazardous waste, and aid in the clean-up of hazardous waste spills.

candidates.title: geological engineer
candidates.description: Geological engineers apply geological knowledge for the assessment of sites, soils, slope stability, sediments and other observable characteristics in the Earth. They integrate this information in the planning and development of projects in those places. They assess and answer questions concerning the geological characteristics of soils by performing research and experiments on the sites aimed to be intervened.

candidates.title: wastewater engineer
candidates.description: Wastewater engineers design sewage systems and networks for the removal and treatment of wastewater from cities and other residential areas. They design systems which are compliant with environmental standards, and aim to minimise impact on the ecosystem and on citizens in the vicinity of the network.

description: Competent Person (CP) - Major Hazard is responsible for advising and overseeing manufacturers classified under Major Hazard Installations to ensure compliance with the Occupational Safety and Health (Control of Industrial Accident Hazards) Regulations 1996. The role involves conducting and reviewing risk assessments, implementing and monitoring hazard control measures, coordinating emergency preparedness and response arrangements, and preparing required industrial activity reports and emergency site plans. They ensure that effective systems are in place to prevent and mitigate major industrial accidents, particularly those arising from chemical, mechanical or environmental hazards.
tasks: Conduct scheduled and unscheduled safety audits for major hazard installations. Conduct and review risk assessments to identify and assess potential hazards. Implement and monitor hazard control measures to prevent major industrial accidents. Provide consultation and safety training on major hazard prevention, hazardous material handling, and emergency preparedness. Prepare, review, and submit required industrial activity, safety, and compliance reports. Maintain and improve effective safety management systems to prevent and mitigate major industrial accidents. Liaise with external safety and environmental regulatory authorities on major hazard compliance matters. Coordinate the preparation and updating of Site Emergency Plans and related emergency preparedness arrangements. Ensure compliance with the related Malaysian legislation on major hazard installations.

candidates.title: health safety and environmental manager
candidates.description: Health, safety and environmental managers design and execute corporate policies and procedures related to occupational health and safety and environmental protection. They analyse business processes to ensure compliance with government and environment legislation, conduct risk assessment in the domain of occupational health and safety, evaluate the environmental impact of economic activities and design the appropriate measures for the improvement of work environments and cultures. They coordinate the implementation of an integrated health, safety and environmental management system, defining effective indicators, organizing audits and eventually participating in accident investigation and reporting. They promote an integrated approach to sustainability and occupational health within business organisations, liaising with corporate and line managers and training employees. They are responsible for drafting technical documentation related to the compliance with health and safety and environmental legislation.

candidates.title: health and safety officer
candidates.description: Health and safety officers execute plans for the improvement of work environments and cultures. They assess risks and interview employees to ensure the work environment is compliant with health and safety rules, as well as ensuring the interaction within the workplace occurs in a positive and productive manner. If employed in a healthcare facility the health and safety officer has to investigate infections spreading across a facility and advice all employees how to combat and prevent infections. Furthermore health physics is applied at facilities where people are exposed to ionizing radiation such as nuclear power plants and research institutions.

candidates.title: dangerous goods safety adviser
candidates.description: Dangerous goods safety advisers inspect and make transport recommendations in line with the European regulations regarding the transport of dangerous goods. They may advise on the transport of dangerous goods by road, rail, sea and air. Dangerous goods safety advisers also prepare safety reports and investigate safety infringements. They provide individuals with the procedures and instructions to follow during the loading, unloading and transporting of these goods.

candidates.title: transport health and safety inspector
candidates.description: Transport health and safety inspectors are responsible for maintaining safety standards, reducing risk to company, staff and customers and achieving industry standards. They evaluate existing security systems to determine potential risks in all transport sectors such as road and sea transport, and develop policies and procedures that minimise the risk to properties, employees and computer systems.

candidates.title: dangerous goods driver
candidates.description: Dangerous goods drivers transport fuel and bulk liquid, hazardous products and chemicals by road.

candidates.title: health and safety inspector
candidates.description: Health and safety inspectors investigate the implementation and application of labour standards and policies in a workplace. They advise employers as well as employees on the improvement of policy and legislation implementation, ensure that the law is adhered to, and that matters of equality and labour rights are respected. They write reports and communicate with authorities.

candidates.title: hazardous materials inspector
candidates.description: Hazardous materials inspectors inspect facilities which handle hazardous materials to ensure compliance to health and safety regulations, and hazardous materials handling legislation. They investigate violations, oversee tests of emergency and risk response plans, and consult on the improvement of the facilities' operations and procedures, as well as on hazardous materials regulations. They also advise plants on potential sources of danger to a community, and on better safety regulations.

candidates.title: construction safety manager
candidates.description: Construction safety managers inspect, enforce and control health and safety measures at construction sites. They also manage workplace accidents and take action to make sure that safety policies are correctly implemented.

description: Ergonomist analyses, designs, and optimises a work environment, equipment, and system to enhance safety, health, and efficiency. They focus on improving worker comfort, reducing physical strain and injury risk, and increasing productivity by applying principles from anatomy, physiology, psychology, and engineering. Their work supports an organisation in creating a safer, more efficient, and human-centred workplace.
tasks: Conduct ergonomic assessments of workstations and work environments to identify ergonomic risk factors. Recommend and support ergonomic improvements to reduce injury risks, improve comfort, and enhance work efficiency. Collaborate with design and engineering teams to integrate ergonomic principles into workplaces, equipment, and systems. Advise on the suitability of materials, equipment, and product design from an ergonomic perspective. Prepare design specifications and sketches to support ergonomic improvements.

candidates.title: ergonomist
candidates.description: Ergonomists analyse the design of equipment, furniture, and systems in order to improve it toward safer, healthier, and more efficient ones. They strive to improve the interaction of people with equipment and the environment.

candidates.title: agronomist
candidates.description: Agronomists provide consulting services to companies, agricultural cooperatives, agronomical crop growers and horticultural crop growers on the cultivation of food crops. They study the science, technology and business related to growing plants. They examine crops and perform experiments in order to improve crop yields and farms' production. Agronomists also examine the most effective ways to harvest and cultivate plants.

candidates.title: typist
candidates.description: Typists operate computers to type and revise documents and compile material to be typed, such as correspondence, reports, statistical tables, forms, and audios. They read instructions accompanying material or follow verbal instructions to determine requirements such as number of copies needed, priority and desired format.

candidates.title: prosthetist-orthotist
candidates.description: Prosthetist-orthotists design and custom fit prostheses and orthoses for individuals who are missing a limb from accident, disease or congenital conditions or for individuals who have impairments, deficiences or weaknesses due to injury, pathology or congenital malformation. They mix patient care with the design and fabrication of these devices to address their patients' needs.

candidates.title: kinesiologist
candidates.description: Kinesiologists study and research the movement of the body; its muscles and parts. They analyse and use scientific data and methods to improve body motion, generally in humans, through an understanding of such areas as physiology, kinetics, neurology, and biology. They recognise the effects that some factors, such as body condition, have on motion and develop solutions to improve overall mechanics and mobility.

candidates.title: roustabout
candidates.description: Roustabouts maintain and repair oil field equipment and machinery using hand and power tools. They do general labor, such as cleaning, digging trenches, scraping and painting rig components.

candidates.title: enterprise development worker
candidates.description: Enterprise development workers support enterprises in solving big social problems by liaising with communities and customers. They strive to improve the productivity of employees and the health of their families by focusing on the work-life balance.

candidates.title: podiatrist
candidates.description: Podiatrists are foot specialists who study foot physiology and pathology from a structural and functional standpoint. They assess, diagnose, and treat physical, sporting injuries, rehabilitation, medical and surgical problems of the foot and lower limb in their clinical practice. Podiatrists are active outside the clinical environment in research, medico-legal, and forensic activities. Podiatrists act within the scope of their podiatry training, experience, and regulating authority of their member country.

role_title: Authorised Gas Tester and Entry Supervisor
cleaned_title: Authorised Gas Tester and Entry Supervisor
description: Authorised Gas Tester and Entry Supervisor conducts atmospheric testing and manages the safe entry and exit of personnel in confined spaces. They are responsible for assessing and monitoring environmental conditions, implementing safety precautions, overseeing the use of protective equipment, and ensuring compliance with regulatory standards. This role serves as the primary authority on confined space safety, coordinating with safety teams and managing permit-to-work systems across industries such as oil and gas, construction, manufacturing, and utilities.
tasks: Conduct pre-entry gas testing in confined spaces to detect oxygen deficiency, flammable gases, and toxic gases. Identify hazards and recommend control measures to ensure safe confined space entry and working conditions. Issue, verify, and manage confined space entry permits and ensure compliance with safety protocols. Supervise workers during confined space entry, work, and exit, ensuring proper use of personal protective equipment (PPE). Maintain, calibrate, and verify the accuracy of gas detection instruments. Carry out inspections to ensure procedures, equipment, and permit conditions are complied with. Conduct toolbox meetings and training sessions on confined space safety and emergency procedures. Prepare reports on confined space activities, gas readings, incidents, and compliance status. Lead emergency response and evacuation during hazardous confined space conditions.

candidates.title: gas processing plant supervisor
candidates.description: Gas processing plant supervisors supervise the processing of gas for utility and energy services by controlling compressors and other processing equipment to ensure standard operation. They supervise the maintenance of the equipment, and perform tests to detect problems or deviations, and to ensure quality.

candidates.title: gas service technician
candidates.description: Gas service technicians install and maintain gas service appliances and systems in facilities or buildings. They install the equipment in accordance with regulations, repair faults, and investigate leaks and other problems. They test the equipment and advise on the use and care of appliances and systems which use gas energy.

candidates.title: gas processing plant control room operator
candidates.description: Gas processing plant control room operators perform a range of tasks from the control room of a processing plant. They monitor the processes through electronic representations shown on monitors, dials, and lights. They make changes to variables and communicate with other departments to make sure processes keep running smoothly and according to established procedures. They take appropriate actions in case of irregularities or emergencies.

candidates.title: gas station operator
candidates.description: Gas station operators process gases for compression, transmission or recovery by using gas, steam or electric engine compressors. They perform chemical tests on gases and are responsible for pumps and pipelines operations.

candidates.title: gas processing plant operator
candidates.description: Gas processing plant operators operate and maintain distribution equipment in a gas distribution plant. They distribute gas to utility facilities or consumers, and ensure the correct pressure is maintained on gas pipelines. They also oversee compliance with scheduling and demand.

candidates.title: oil refinery control room operator
candidates.description: Oil refinery control room operators perform a range of tasks from the control room of an oil refinery. They monitor the processes through electronic representations shown on monitors, dials, and lights. Control room operators make changes to variables and communicate with other departments to make sure processes keep running smoothly and according to established procedures. They take appropriate actions in case of irregularities or emergencies.

candidates.title: baggage flow supervisor
candidates.description: Baggage flow supervisors monitor the flow of baggage in airports to ensure baggage makes connections and arrives at the destinations in a timely manner. They communicate with baggage managers to ensure compliance with regulations and apply solutions. Baggage flow supervisors collect, analyse and maintain records on airline data, passenger, and baggage flow, as well as create and distribute daily reports regarding staff needs, safety hazards, maintenance needs and incident reports. They ensure cooperative behaviour and resolve conflicts.

candidates.title: data entry supervisor
candidates.description: Data entry supervisors manage the day-to-day operations of data entry staff. They organise the workflow and tasks.

description: Environmental Health Officer Grade U9 responsible for implementing duties in the aspects of management, planning, control, prevention, legislation, and legal enforcement related to public health and environmental health activities, namely disease control, food safety and quality, water supply and environmental sanitation (BAKAS), drinking water quality control (KMAM), and health at points of entry (airports, seaports, and land).
tasks: Planning, managing, and evaluating Disease Control programmes, including communicable diseases, non-communicable diseases, and vector-borne diseases, as well as outbreak and natural disaster management. Planning and implementing Food Safety and Quality programmes and Drinking Water Quality Control (KMAM). Implementing legislation and enforcement activities, including prosecution and case analysis. Planning human resources, financial, and logistical requirements. Conducting research and development, and planning intervention programmes.

candidates.title: environmental programme coordinator
candidates.description: Environmental programme coordinators develop programmes for the improvement of environmental sustainability and efficiency within a organisation or institution. They inspect sites in order to monitor an organisation's or institution's compliance with environmental legislation. They also ensure education for the public on environmental concerns.

candidates.title: occupational health and safety inspector
candidates.description: Occupational health and safety inspectors perform workplace audits to ensure compliance with government and environment legislation. They also investigate work accidents. Occupational health and safety inspectors interview employees to ensure the work environment is compliant with health and safety rules, inspect the physical work site and analyse legal paperwork.

candidates.title: environmental policy officer
candidates.description: Environmental policy officers research, analyse, develop and implement policies related to the environment. They give expert advice to entities such as commercial organisations, government agencies and land developers. Environmental policy officers work on reducing the impact of industrial, commercial and agricultural activities on the environment.

candidates.title: environmental education officer
candidates.description: Environmental education officers are responsible for promoting environmental conservation and development. They visit schools and businesses to give talks, they produce educational resources and websites, they lead guided nature walks, they provide relevant training courses, and they help with volunteer activities and conservation projects. Many gardens employ an environmental education officer to offer guidance during school visits.

candidates.title: health and safety officer
candidates.description: Health and safety officers execute plans for the improvement of work environments and cultures. They assess risks and interview employees to ensure the work environment is compliant with health and safety rules, as well as ensuring the interaction within the workplace occurs in a positive and productive manner. If employed in a healthcare facility the health and safety officer has to investigate infections spreading across a facility and advice all employees how to combat and prevent infections. Furthermore health physics is applied at facilities where people are exposed to ionizing radiation such as nuclear power plants and research institutions.

candidates.title: environmental protection manager
candidates.description: Environmental protection managers provide advice on the development of environmental policies to governmental and official institutions. They analyse possible threats for the well being of the people and the environment in a region and manage campaigns aimed at tackling problems such as waste collection, landfills, and preservation of green areas.

candidates.title: environmental health inspector
candidates.description: Environmental health inspectors carry out investigations to ensure that areas, organisations and companies comply with environmental and public health legislation. They evaluate environmental complaints, provide reports on their findings and work to prevent future hazards or noncompliance with current policies. Environmental health inspectors perform consultations to promote public health and safety.

candidates.title: health safety and environmental manager
candidates.description: Health, safety and environmental managers design and execute corporate policies and procedures related to occupational health and safety and environmental protection. They analyse business processes to ensure compliance with government and environment legislation, conduct risk assessment in the domain of occupational health and safety, evaluate the environmental impact of economic activities and design the appropriate measures for the improvement of work environments and cultures. They coordinate the implementation of an integrated health, safety and environmental management system, defining effective indicators, organizing audits and eventually participating in accident investigation and reporting. They promote an integrated approach to sustainability and occupational health within business organisations, liaising with corporate and line managers and training employees. They are responsible for drafting technical documentation related to the compliance with health and safety and environmental legislation.

description: Orthopaedic Physical Therapist assesses, diagnoses and treats musculoskeletal and neuromusculoskeletal conditions affecting bones, joints, muscles and related structures, with the aim of restoring movement, reducing pain and improving functional independence. They design and implement individualised rehabilitation programmes using physical and manual therapy, therapeutic exercise and patient education to manage injuries, congenital conditions, age-related impairments and chronic diseases. They may collaborate within multidisciplinary teams to support recovery, prevent complications and promote long-term mobility and physical wellbeing.
tasks: Perform comprehensive assessments of patients with musculoskeletal and neuromuskuloskeletal conditions to identify dysfunctions, pain sources, and functional limitations. Develop and implement individualised rehabilitation and therapeutic exercise programmes to restore movement, reduce pain, and improve functional independence. Administer physiotherapy interventions, including manual therapy, joint mobilisation, stretching, massage, and the use of rehabilitation equipment as appropriate. Conduct clinical assessments and interpret findings to support diagnosis, treatment planning, and the use of orthotic or supportive interventions where required. Provide guidance on the selection, fitting, and use of orthotic, prosthetic, or other supportive rehabilitation devices as appropriate. Monitor patient progress, adjust treatment plans, and maintain accurate records of care, rehabilitation outcomes, and follow-up needs. Collaborate with healthcare professionals and caregivers to ensure coordinated multidisciplinary management and continuity of care. Maintain professional knowledge and apply evidence-based practices to improve rehabilitation outcomes and patient care.

candidates.title: physiotherapist
candidates.description: Physiotherapists are autonomous health professionals who are responsible for developing, maintaining or restoring motor function and movement throughout the lifespan using evidence-based practice. They relieve pain and treat or prevent physical conditions associated with injury, disease or other impairments. Physiotherapists empower patients and their carers to manage the condition outside clinical settings. They work within their scope of practice and their professional Code of Conduct.

candidates.title: sport therapist
candidates.description: Sport therapists program and supervise rehabilitation exercises for individuals and groups. They work with individuals that have chronic health conditions or are at high risk of developing them. They communicate with medical and healthcare professionals about participants' conditions using correct medical terminology, and with an understanding of the standard treatment options for an individual’s condition. Sport therapists take a holistic approach to the wellness of their clients that includes advising on lifestyle, food or time management. They do not have a medical background and do not require medical qualifications.

candidates.title: advanced physiotherapist
candidates.description: Advanced physiotherapists are highly specialised. They make complex decisions and manage risks in unpredictable contexts and within a defined area. They may focus on a specific area of clinical practice, education, research or professional management.

candidates.title: orthopaedic footwear technician
candidates.description: Orthopaedic footwear technicians design footwear and make patterns, using manufacturing technology. They compensate and accommodate foot and ankle fitting problems and design and manufacture footwear and its orthopaedic components, including orthoses, insoles, soles and others.

candidates.title: recreational therapist
candidates.description: Recreational therapists offer treatment to persons who have behavioural disorders or conditions. They use techniques and interventions such as art, music, animals and dance to promote, maintain and restore the development and health of the patient.

candidates.title: physiotherapy assistant
candidates.description: Physiotherapy assistants work under supervision, within defined contexts using agreed treatment protocols and procedures such as collecting client data and maintaining the equipment required in physiotherapy interventions. The overall responsibility is retained by the delegating professional.

candidates.title: massage therapist
candidates.description: Massage therapists provide therapeutic massage treatments to improve the well-being of their clients. They perform a variety of massage types such as shiatsu and swedish massage, according to their client's needs and preferences.

candidates.title: osteopath
candidates.description: Osteopaths provide therapeutic treatment of disorders in the musculoskeletal system to patients with physical issues such as back pain, joint pain and digestive disorders. They mainly use manipulation of the body tissues, touch, stretching and massage techniques to relieve the patients` pain and promote a healthy lifestyle.

description: Medical Rehabilitation Officer Grade U9 responsible for the aspect of patient rehabilitation care in the field of related specialisation and making assessment, planning and management of rehabilitation programmes for patients.
tasks: Assessing, planning, and providing rehabilitative treatment in the specialised field to patients. Conducting and analysing diagnostic test results to identify the cause of the problem and the necessary treatment actions. Determining the type of assistive devices suitable according to patient needs and provides advice on proper use and care of the equipment. Referring patients requiring surgery or medical management to other professionals. Maintaining rehabilitation programmes, follow-up treatment, and counselling services. Planning and managing programmes related to raising awareness, providing information, and conducting research activities.

candidates.title: rehabilitation support worker
candidates.description: Rehabilitation support workers provide counselling to individuals dealing with birth defects or with major consequences caused by diseases, accidents, and burnouts. They help them to cope with personal, social and vocational issues. They assess the personal needs of clients, develop rehabilitation plans, get involved in the training, and help people undergoing a rehabilitation plan with job placement.

candidates.title: physiotherapist
candidates.description: Physiotherapists are autonomous health professionals who are responsible for developing, maintaining or restoring motor function and movement throughout the lifespan using evidence-based practice. They relieve pain and treat or prevent physical conditions associated with injury, disease or other impairments. Physiotherapists empower patients and their carers to manage the condition outside clinical settings. They work within their scope of practice and their professional Code of Conduct.
