Conduct functional, regression, integration, user acceptance, and performance testing activities. Collaborate with developers and stakeholders to report, track, and support the resolution of software defects. Use test management tools to log, monitor, and maintain test records and documentation. Participate in Agile development activities, including sprints, scrum meetings, and planning sessions. Contribute to the improvement of testing processes and methodologies. Review and maintain test documentation to ensure completeness and accuracy. Investigate software defects and system issues related to application performance and functionality.

candidates.title: ICT test analyst
candidates.description: ICT test analysts work in testing environments, assessing products, checking for quality and accuracy, or creating tests scripts. They design tests which are then implemented by testers.

candidates.title: software analyst
candidates.description: Software analysts elicit and prioritise user requirements, produce and document software specifications, test their application, and review them during software development. They act as the interface between the software users and the software development team.

candidates.title: test engineer
candidates.description: Test engineers plan and perform detailed quality tests during various phases of the design process to make sure that the systems are properly installed and function correctly. They analyse the data collected during tests and produce reports. They are also responsible for the safety of the test operations.

candidates.title: ICT business analyst
candidates.description: ICT business analysts are in charge of analysing and designing an organisation's processes and systems, assessing the business model and its integration with technology. They also identify change needs, assess the impact of the change, capture and document requirements and then ensure that these requirements are delivered whilst supporting the business through the implementation process.

candidates.title: data analyst
candidates.description: Data analysts import, inspect, clean, transform, validate, model, or interpret collections of data with regard to the business goals of the company. They ensure that the data sources and repositories provide consistent and reliable data. Data analysts use different algorithms and IT tools as demanded by the situation and the current data. They might prepare reports in the form of visualisations such as graphs, charts, and dashboards.

candidates.title: ICT business analysis manager
candidates.description: ICT business analysis managers identify areas where information system changes are needed to support business plans and monitor the impact in terms of change management. They contribute to the general ICT functional requirements of the business organisation. ICT business analysis managers analyse business needs and translate them into ICT solutions.

candidates.title: business analyst
candidates.description: Business analysts research and understand the strategic position of businesses and companies in relation to their markets and their stakeholders. They analyse and present their views on how the company, from many perspectives, can improve its strategic position and internal corporate structure. They assess needs for change, communication methods, technology, IT tools, new standards and certifications.

candidates.title: ICT system analyst
candidates.description: ICT system analysts specify the system needs to meet the end user requirements. They analyse system functions in order to define their goals or purposes and to discover operations and procedures for accomplishing them most efficiently. They also design new IT solutions to improve business efficiency and productivity, produce outline designs and estimate costs of new systems, specify the operations the system will perform, and the way data will be viewed by the end user. They present the design to the users and work closely with the users to implement the solution.

Manage and configure security infrastructure, including firewalls, intrusion detection systems, and endpoint protection tools. Analyse threat intelligence and emerging cybersecurity risks to support security improvements and system resilience.

candidates.description: Security guards observe, detect irregularities and protect people, buildings and assets. They maintain security at all times by patrolling designated property areas, controlling access at entrances, watching alarm and video recording systems, asking suspicious individuals for identification and reporting infractions and law breaching activities.

description: Internet Safety Evaluator reviews and assesses online content across digital platforms to support a safe and secure online environment. The role involves evaluating text, images, and other media to determine compliance with platform guidelines and relevant laws, identifying harmful, misleading, or inappropriate material, and recommending appropriate actions. They contribute to maintaining content quality, user protection, and the integrity of online information ecosystems.
tasks: Evaluate and analyse web search results and online content for relevance, accuracy, and quality. Review user-generated content to identify and report offensive, harmful, or misleading material in accordance with guidelines. Flag and escalate inappropriate or non-compliant content to relevant teams for further action. Use client-provided tools and platforms to perform content evaluation and moderation tasks. Monitor trends, emerging risks, cultural sensitivities, and current events related to online content. Provide feedback to improve content moderation processes, filters, algorithms, and user experience.

candidates.title: fire safety tester
candidates.description: Fire safety testers conduct a variety of tests on materials such as building, transportation and textiles materials, as well as on fire prevention and fire fighting systems. They measures, among other things, the flame resistance and behaviour of materials under extreme circumstances.

candidates.description: Airside safety managers supervise the airside operations' safety and security and advise the civil aviation authorities on the airport information systems changes. They write safety analysis reports, ensure compliance with standards and regulations and improve the airside safety procedures.

candidates.title: dangerous goods safety adviser
candidates.description: Dangerous goods safety advisers inspect and make transport recommendations in line with the European regulations regarding the transport of dangerous goods. They may advise on the transport of dangerous goods by road, rail, sea and air. Dangerous goods safety advisers also prepare safety reports and investigate safety infringements. They provide individuals with the procedures and instructions to follow during the loading, unloading and transporting of these goods.

candidates.title: monitoring and evaluation officer
candidates.description: Monitoring and evaluation officers are responsible for the conceptualisation, design, implementation and follow-up of the monitoring and evaluation activities of projects, programmes, policies, strategies, institutions or processes, along the relevant programming cycle. They develop monitoring, inspection and evaluation methods and instruments needed to collect and analyse data, and report on results by applying structured M&E frameworks, theories, approaches and methodologies. M&E officers inform decision-making through reporting, learning products or activities and knowledge management. They can also engage in capacity development activities by providing training and capacity building support within their organizations or for clients and partners.

candidates.title: ICT security administrator
candidates.description: ICT security administrators plan and carry out security measures to protect information and data from unauthorised access, deliberate attack, theft and corruption.

candidates.title: construction safety inspector
candidates.description: Construction safety inspectors monitor construction sites and their conformity to health and safety regulations. They perform inspections, identify safety hazards and report on their findings.

description: Compositor/Composite Artist combines visual elements from live-action footage, computer-generated imagery, matte paintings, and special effects to create seamless final images or sequences for films, television, advertisements, and video games. They correct visual inconsistencies, integrate elements convincingly, and may perform rotoscoping to isolate objects or characters, ensuring that all components appear natural and cohesive in the finished production.
tasks: Create masks and mattes using rotoscoping techniques, and perform digital cleanup to remove unwanted elements from footage. Composite and integrate two-dimensional (2D) and three-dimensional (3D) elements, including visual effects, into final scenes. Apply colour correction, grading, and lighting adjustments to ensure visual consistency across shots. Collaborate with animation, lighting, rendering, and visual effects teams to ensure continuity and quality. Plan and organise compositing workflows, including file management and shot consistency, to meet production deadlines. Interpret creative briefs and apply artistic and technical judgement to compositing tasks. Review and refine composited shots based on feedback from directors and supervisors.

candidates.title: special effects artist
candidates.description: Special effects artists create illusions for movies, videos and computer games. They use computer software.

candidates.title: make-up artist
candidates.description: Make-up artists assist and support artists before, during and after the performance and filming of movies or television programs to ensure the make-up is in line with the artistic vision of the director and the artistic team. They create images and characters through make-up and prosthetics. They maintain, check and repair prosthetics and assist with quick changes.

candidates.title: digital artist
candidates.description: Digital artists create art which applies digital technology as an essential part of the creative process. Digital art is usually created using computers or more specialised digital equipment. It may be enjoyed using the same instruments, shared over the internet, or presented using more traditional media.

candidates.title: performance artist
candidates.description: Performance artists create a performance which can be any situation that involves four basic elements: time, space, the performer's body, or presence in a medium, and a relationship between the performer and audience or onlookers. They are flexible with the medium of the art work, the setting and the length of time of the performance.

candidates.title: animation layout artist
candidates.description: Animation layout artists work with the cameramen and director to coordinate and create optimal 3D animation shots. They translate 2D storyboards into 3D animated shots and are responsible for camera angles, frames and lighting of animation scenes. Animation layout artists decide which action takes place in which animation scene.

candidates.title: artistic painter
candidates.description: Artistic painters create paintings in oil or water colours or pastel, miniatures, collages, and drawings executed directly by the artist and/or entirely under their control .

candidates.title: ceramic painter
candidates.description: Ceramic painters design and create visual art on ceramic surfaces and objects such as tiles, sculptures, tableware and pottery. They use a variety of techniques to produce decorative illustrations ranging from stenciling to free-hand drawing.

candidates.title: community artist
candidates.description: Community artists research, plan, organise and lead artistic activities for people brought together by a shared interest, capacity, environment or condition. They manage and coordinate creative projects with local groups and individuals to foster their artistic creativity and improve their quality of life. Community artists make the arts accessible to the community they work for, and provide opportunities for participants to shape their artistic programme.

description: Scriptwriter / Screenwriter develops and crafts a script for a film, television programme, web series, advertisement, or other media format. They create an original narrative, including plot, characters, dialogue, and settings, ensuring the story aligns with the intended theme, tone, and audience. The role involves collaborating with a director, producer, editor, and clients to refine and revise the script throughout the production process.
tasks: Write original and adapted scripts for television, film, digital platforms, or advertisements. Research topics, settings, and characters to ensure authenticity and accuracy. Collaborate with directors and producers to align scripts with creative vision and production requirements. Revise and edit scripts based on feedback and project needs. Create treatments, outlines, and synopses to pitch story ideas. Plan and coordinate script development workflow to ensure timely and quality delivery. Ensure scripts comply with industry standards and Malaysian censorship guidelines.

candidates.title: script writer
candidates.description: Script writers create scripts for motion pictures or television series. They write a detailed story that consists of plot, characters, dialogue and physical environment.

candidates.title: writer
candidates.description: Writers develop content for books. They write novels, poetry, short stories, comics and other forms of literature. These forms of writing can be fictional or non-fictional.

candidates.title: speechwriter
candidates.description: Speechwriters research and write speeches on multiple topics. They need to catch and hold the interest of an audience. Speechwriters create presentations in a conversational tone so it looks like if the text was not scripted. They write in a comprehensible manner so the audience gets the message of the speech.

candidates.title: script supervisor
candidates.description: Script supervisors are responsible for the continuity of the movie or television program. They watch every shot to make sure that it's according to the script. Script supervisors ensure that during editing the story makes visual and verbal sense and does not contain any continuity errors.

candidates.title: book editor
candidates.description: Book editors find manuscripts that can be published. They review texts from writers to evaluate the commercial potential or they ask writers to take on projects that the publishing company wishes to publish. Book editors maintain good relationships with writers.

candidates.title: casting director
candidates.description: Casting directors select actors for all roles in a motion picture or television series. They co-operate with the producer and director to determine what they are looking for. Casting directors contact talent agents and organise interviews and auditions for the parts. They determine the fees and contracts for the actors and extras.

candidates.title: advertising copywriter
candidates.description: Advertising copywriters are responsible for the written or verbal design of advertisements and commercials. They write slogans, catchphrases and work closely together with advertising artists.

candidates.title: medical writer
candidates.description: Medical writers produce and process scientific documents related to medical affairs. Work alongside scientists, doctors and other healthcare professionals.

Collaborate with creative and technical teams during production processes. Revise and refine artwork based on feedback from clients or directors.

candidates.title: graphic designer
candidates.description: Graphic designers create text and images to communicate ideas. They make visual concepts by hand or using computer software, intended for publishing in paper or online media such as advertisements, websites, and magazines.

candidates.title: computer vision engineer
candidates.description: Computer vision engineers research, design, develop, and train artificial intelligence algorithms and machine learning primitives that understand the content of digital images based on a large amount of data. They apply this understanding to solve different real-world problems such as security, autonomous driving, robotic manufacturing, digital image classification, medical image processing and diagnosis, etc.

candidates.title: reprographics technician
candidates.description: Reprographics technicians are responsible for the full or partial process of reproduction of graphical documents through mechanical-driven or digital means, such as photography, scanning or digital printing. These activities are commonly performed for purposes of maintaining archives or other structured catalogues.

candidates.title: data quality specialist
candidates.description: Data quality specialists review organisation's data for accuracy, recommend enhancements to record systems and data acquisition processes and assess referential and historical integrity of data. They also develop documents and maintain data quality goals and standards and oversee an organisation's data privacy policy and monitor compliance of data flows against data quality standards.

candidates.title: data scientist
candidates.description: Data scientists find and interpret rich data sources, manage large amounts of data, merge data sources, ensure consistency of data-sets, and create visualisations to aid in understanding data. They build mathematical models using data, present and communicate data insights and findings to specialists and scientists in their team and if required, to a non-expert audience, and recommend ways to apply the data.

candidates.title: graphologist
candidates.description: Graphologists analyse written or printed materials in order to draw conclusions and evidence about traits, personality, abilities and authorship of the writer. They interpret letter forms, the fashion of writing, and patterns in the writing.

candidates.title: data analyst
candidates.description: Data analysts import, inspect, clean, transform, validate, model, or interpret collections of data with regard to the business goals of the company. They ensure that the data sources and repositories provide consistent and reliable data. Data analysts use different algorithms and IT tools as demanded by the situation and the current data. They might prepare reports in the form of visualisations such as graphs, charts, and dashboards.

description: Computer Specialist is responsible for managing and maintaining a computer system and network, ensuring its security, reliability, and efficiency. They provide technical support to users, troubleshoot hardware and software issues, and implement solutions to optimise IT infrastructure. This role encompasses installing, configuring, and maintaining systems and applications to meet organisational requirements.
tasks: Install, configure, and maintain computer hardware and peripheral devices, and manage software and network systems. Monitor system and network performance and address issues promptly. Provide technical support to staff, including remote assistance. Set up user accounts and manage access permissions. Diagnose, repair, or replace faulty computer and network equipment. Test, evaluate, and recommend new technology and software applications. Train staff on the use of systems, tools, and applications. Plan and organise IT operations and technical workflows to ensure smooth system performance. Document procedures and maintain accurate system records.

candidates.title: computer scientist
candidates.description: Computer scientists conduct research in computer and information science, directed toward greater knowledge and understanding of fundamental aspects of ICT phenomena. They write research reports and proposals. Computer scientists also invent and design new approaches to computing technology, find innovative uses for existing technology and studies and solve complex problems in computing.

candidates.title: computer hardware repair technician
candidates.description: Computer hardware repair technicians install, examine, test and repair computer hardware and peripheral components. They test computers' functionality, identify the problems and replace damaged components and parts.

candidates.title: computer hardware engineering technician
candidates.description: Computer hardware engineering technicians collaborate with computer hardware engineers in the development of computer hardware, such as motherboards, routers, and microprocessors. Computer hardware engineering technicians are responsible for building, testing, monitoring, and maintaining the developed computer technology.

candidates.title: ICT technician
candidates.description: ICT technicians install, maintain, repair and operate information systems and any ICT related equipment (laptops, desktops, servers, tablets, smart phones, communications equipment, printers and any piece of computer related peripheral networks), and any type of software (drivers, operating systems, applications).

candidates.title: computer hardware engineer
candidates.description: Computer hardware engineers design and develop computer hardware systems and components, such as circuit boards, modems, and printers. They draught blueprints and assembly drawings, develop and test the prototypes, and supervise the production process.

candidates.title: ICT network administrator
candidates.description: ICT network administrators maintain operation of a reliable, secure, and efficient data communications network, including LAN, WAN, intranet, and internet. They perform network address assignment, management and implementation of routing protocols such as ISIS, OSPF, BGP, routing table configurations and certain implementations of authentication. They perform maintenance and administration of servers (file servers, VPN gateways, intrusion detection systems), desktop computers, printers, routers, switches, firewalls, phones, IP communications, personal digital assistants, smartphones, software deployment, security updates and patches as well as a vast array of additional technologies inclusive of both hardware and software.

candidates.title: computer hardware test technician
candidates.description: Computer hardware test technicians conduct testing of computer hardware such as circuit boards, computer chips, computer systems, and other electronic and electrical components. They analyse the hardware configuration and test the hardware reliability and conformance to specifications.

candidates.title: ICT system administrator
candidates.description: ICT system administrators are responsible for the upkeep, configuration, and reliable operation of computer and network systems, servers, workstations and peripheral devices. They may acquire, install, or upgrade computer components and software; automate routine tasks; write computer programs; troubleshoot; train and supervise staff; and provide technical support. They ensure optimum system integrity, security, backup and performance.

description: Story Content Writer conceptualises, plans, and creates digital content across text, graphics, animation, audio, and video for animation, visual effects, new media, and digital platforms. They develop compelling narratives and visual sequences that engage audiences, translating scripts or ideas into coherent storytelling for websites, social media, advertisements, and campaigns. The role combines creative and technical skills, requiring collaboration with a director, producer, or marketing team to ensure content aligns with brand voice, objectives, and audience interests.
tasks: Research topics, trends, and target audiences to develop story-based content. Write original stories, character-driven narratives, or brand-focused content. Collaborate with creative and marketing teams to ensure alignment with brand messaging. Create storyboards or visual plans to illustrate narrative sequences and digital content flow. Ensure consistency in voice, tone, visual style, and storytelling across platforms. Plan and organise workflow and production pipeline to meet deadlines and quality standards. Revise and edit stories and storyboards based on feedback to ensure quality and consistency.

candidates.title: writer
candidates.description: Writers develop content for books. They write novels, poetry, short stories, comics and other forms of literature. These forms of writing can be fictional or non-fictional.

candidates.title: storyboard artist
candidates.description: Storyboard artists draw out the scenes of a motion picture or television series according to the script in order to see what will be possible during production. They work together with the producer and video and motion picture director.

candidates.title: script writer
candidates.description: Script writers create scripts for motion pictures or television series. They write a detailed story that consists of plot, characters, dialogue and physical environment.

candidates.title: medical writer
candidates.description: Medical writers produce and process scientific documents related to medical affairs. Work alongside scientists, doctors and other healthcare professionals.

candidates.title: entertainment journalist
candidates.description: Entertainment journalists research and write articles about cultural and social events for newspapers, magazines, television and other media. They conduct interviews with artists and celebrities and attend events.

candidates.title: blogger
candidates.description: Bloggers write online articles on a wide range of subjects such as politics, fashion, economics and sports. They can relate objective facts, but often they also give their opinion on the related topic. Bloggers also interact with their readers via comments.

candidates.title: journalist
candidates.description: Journalists research, verify and write news stories for newspapers, magazines, television and other broadcast media. They cover political, economic, cultural, social and sport events. Journalists must conform to ethical codes such as freedom of speech and right of reply, press law and editorial standards in order to bring objective information.

candidates.title: business journalist
candidates.description: Business journalists research and write articles about economy and economic events for newspapers, magazines, television and other media. They conduct interviews and attend events.

description: 3D Generalist combines artistic and technical expertise to create and integrate digital content for animation, visual effects, games, films, and other multimedia formats. They are responsible for developing 3D assets and workflows across modelling, texturing, rigging, animation, lighting, effects, and rendering, ensuring all elements are cohesive and aligned with the project’s visual goals. Their work spans multiple stages of the production pipeline, supporting the creation of high-quality, visually compelling content across diverse digital media.
tasks: Conceptualise and develop digital content using artistic and technical knowledge. Create high-quality 3D models for characters, environments, props, and digital assets. Apply textures, materials, and lighting to achieve realistic or stylized visual effects. Rig and animate 3D models using animation principles to express movement, emotion, and intended functionality. Design and integrate visual effects, including particles, fluids, and simulations, into 3D and live-action scenes. Plan and manage workflows across modelling, animation, lighting, rendering, and effects pipelines to meet quality standards and deadlines. Render final images or sequences, optimising output quality and performance. Track and replicate camera and object movements for accurate scene integration. Collaborate with directors, artists, technical teams, and other departments to ensure cohesive visual storytelling. Conduct quality checks, troubleshoot technical issues, and implement necessary revisions or optimisations.

candidates.title: 3D modeller
candidates.description: 3D modellers design 3D models of objects, virtual environments, layouts, characters, and 3D virtual animated agents.

candidates.title: 3D animator
candidates.description: 3D animators are in charge of animating 3D models of objects, virtual environments, layouts, characters and 3D virtual animated agents.

candidates.title: footwear 3D developer
candidates.description: Footwear 3D developers design footwear models, make, adjust and modify patterns using computer aided design systems. They focus on the sustainable design of the model, the selection and design of lasts and components, the proper and efficient use of materials, the pattern making, the selection of the bottom and the elaboration of technical data sheets. They may supervise the development and evaluation of prototypes, the preparation of samples, the implementation of the necessary quality control tests on the samples, and the management of the technical documentation of the product.

candidates.title: 3D printing technician
candidates.description: 3D printing technicians assist in the designing and programming of products, ranging from prosthetic products to 3D miniatures. They may also provide 3D printing maintenance, check 3D renders for customers and run 3D printing tests. 3D printing technicians can also repair, maintain and clean 3D printers.

candidates.title: projectionist
candidates.description: Projectionists operate and maintain projection equipment in cinema theatres. They inspect the movie films before loading them into the projector. Projectionist make sure that everything runs smoothly during the projection of the movie. They also are responsible for the proper storage of movie films.

candidates.title: scenery technician
candidates.description: Scenery technicians setup, prepare, check and maintain pre-assembled sets in order to provide optimal scenery quality for a live performance. They cooperate with road crew to unload, set up and move equipment and sets.

candidates.title: model maker
candidates.description: Model makers create three-dimensional scale models or various designs or concepts and for various purposes, such as models of human skeletons or organs. They also mount the models on display stands so that they can be used for their final purpose such as inclusion in education activities.

candidates.title: general practitioner
candidates.description: General practitioners promote health, prevent, identify ill health, diagnose and treat diseases and promote recovery of physical and mental illness and health disorders of all kinds for all persons regardless of their age, sex or type of health problem.

description: Game Designer (Digital) develops and shapes the overall concept, structure, and interactive experience of digital games. They design game mechanics, storylines, characters, rules, and user interactions, collaborating with developers, artists, and other creative team members to create engaging and immersive gameplay. The role focuses on translating creative ideas into coherent and enjoyable digital experiences for players.
tasks: Design and document game mechanics, level layouts, and interactive features. Develop the story, visual style, and overall look and feel of the game. Create prototypes, mockups, and game assets to visualise and test ideas. Coordinate game content creation to meet deadlines and budget requirements. Collaborate with developers, artists, and audio designers to integrate all components. Conduct playtesting sessions and refine gameplay based on feedback. Produce concept art, prototypes, and design-level visual assets to support gameplay and development. Analyse player behaviour and feedback to improve game experience. Stay updated on industry trends and competitor games.

candidates.title: digital games designer
candidates.description: Digital games designers develop the layout, logic, concept and gameplay of a digital game. They focus on playfield design, specification writing, and entry of numeric properties that balance and tune the gameplay.

candidates.title: digital games developer
candidates.description: Digital games developers program, implement and document digital games. They implement technical standards in gameplay, graphics, sound and functionality.

candidates.title: gambling games designer
candidates.description: Gambling games designers design innovative gambling, betting and lottery games. They determine the design, gaming rules or structure of a game. Gambling games designers may also demonstrate the game to individuals.

candidates.title: digital media designer
candidates.description: Digital media designers create and edit graphics, animations, sound, text and video to assist in the creation of integrated multimedia products. They may perform activities related to the web, social networks, augmented reality and virtual reality but exclude the production of music using physical instruments and complex software sound synthesis tools. Digital media designers may program and build websites, mobile applications and other multimedia products.

candidates.title: graphic designer
candidates.description: Graphic designers create text and images to communicate ideas. They make visual concepts by hand or using computer software, intended for publishing in paper or online media such as advertisements, websites, and magazines.

candidates.title: games development manager
candidates.description: Games development managers supervise and coordinate the creation, development, distribution, and selling of games. They communicate with manufacturers to ensure the production of games.

candidates.title: digital games tester
candidates.description: Digital games testers review and test various genres of digital games by playing them in order to find bugs and glitches within the game's functionality or graphics. They may evaluate the capacity of attraction and playability of games. They may also debug the games themselves.

candidates.title: gambling games developer
candidates.description: Gambling games developers create, develop and produce content for lottery, betting and similar gambling games for large audiences.

description: QA Tester/Game Tester (Digital) evaluates and ensures the quality, functionality, and performance of digital games and interactive media. They develop and execute test plans, identify bugs and usability issues, and document findings, working closely with developers and designers to support content development for games, virtual reality, and other digital formats. The role focuses on verifying software functionality and enhancing the user experience prior to release.
tasks: Review game or software design documentation to understand features and requirements. Design and execute test cases, both manual and automated, to verify gameplay features, functionality, and user experience. Identify, log, track, and verify bugs and issues in coordination with developers and designers. Provide feedback on game balance, usability, and user experience through detailed test reports. Maintain detailed test documentation, including bug tracking logs and test results. Participate in test planning meetings and contribute to quality assurance discussions.

candidates.title: digital games tester
candidates.description: Digital games testers review and test various genres of digital games by playing them in order to find bugs and glitches within the game's functionality or graphics. They may evaluate the capacity of attraction and playability of games. They may also debug the games themselves.

candidates.title: software tester
candidates.description: Software testers perform software tests. They may also plan and design them. They may also debug and repair software although this mainly corresponds to designers and developers. They ensure that applications function properly before delivering them to internal and external clients.

candidates.title: ICT system tester
candidates.description: ICT system testers perform testing activities and some test planning activities. They may also debug and repair ICT systems and components although this mainly corresponds to designers and developers. They ensure that all systems and components function properly before delivering them to internal and external clients.

candidates.title: ICT usability tester
candidates.description: ICT usability testers ensure compliance with requirements and strive for optimal usability within the software engineering cycle phases (analysis, design, implementation, and deployment). They also work closely with users (analysts) to research for and document user profiles, analyse tasks, workflows, and user scenarios.

candidates.title: digital games developer

candidates.title: ICT integration tester
candidates.description: ICT integration testers perform tests in groups of system components, units or even applications. They group them in larger aggregates and apply integration test plans on them. They oversee the complexity of relations between different components.

candidates.title: gambling quality assurance engineer
candidates.description: Gambling quality assurance engineers design and plan methods to test the gambling, the lottery or betting games. They execute the tests. These games can be both for public or for private audience, and the tests are for both online and land-based gaming.

candidates.title: digital games designer

description: Game Producer (Digital) oversees the full development of digital games and interactive media, combining artistic and technical expertise to guide projects from concept to release. They coordinate cross-functional teams, manage production schedules, budgets, and technical standards, and ensure the creative vision is achieved while maintaining effective communication between development teams and stakeholders.
tasks: Plan and manage the full game production pipeline from concept to release. Coordinate with design, development, and art teams to ensure smooth progress. Monitor project timelines, deliverables, and milestones to keep on schedule. Manage budgets and allocate resources efficiently. Oversee the creation and integration of game content. Identify and mitigate production risks throughout development. Ensure the overall gameplay experience, visual style, and game quality meet objectives. Liaise with publishers, marketing, and external stakeholders for release plans. Maintain production documentation, reports, and workflow records. Continuously improve production workflows, tools, and team efficiency.

Develop mood boards, prototypes, and visual storytelling elements to guide the overall style and direction of projects. Collaborate with art directors, designers, developers, and other creative teams to align visuals with project goals and gameplay requirements. Refine visual assets based on stakeholder feedback to ensure quality and consistency. Ensure all artwork meets technical requirements and is suitable for integration into game engines or digital platforms. Organise production of visual content to meet project deadlines and technical requirements.

candidates.title: conceptual artist
candidates.description: Conceptual artists choose any material as an artistic tool or/and material to be presented as an artistic experience to the public. Their work, belonging to the fine arts, can be two-dimensional (drawing, painting, collage), three-dimensional (sculpture, installation) or four-dimensional (moving images, performance).

candidates.title: drawing artist
candidates.description: Drawing artists express concepts by providing a drawn representation corresponding to the idea.

candidates.description: Digital artists create art which applies digital technology as an essential part of the creative process. Digital art is usually created using computers or more specialised digital equipment. It may be enjoyed using the same instruments, shared over the internet, or presented using more traditional media.

candidates.title: artistic painter
candidates.description: Artistic painters create paintings in oil or water colours or pastel, miniatures, collages, and drawings executed directly by the artist and/or entirely under their control .

candidates.description: Animation layout artists work with the cameramen and director to coordinate and create optimal 3D animation shots. candidates.title: sound artist
candidates.description: Sound artists use sound as a main creative medium. They express, through the creation of sounds, their intention and identity. Sound art is interdisciplinary in nature and takes on hybrid forms.

candidates.title: body artist

They also advise on methods to avoid infection following the procedures on clients' bodies.

candidates.title: creative director

candidates.title: artistic director

They are responsible for the strategic vision, the visibility and the quality of all kind of artistic activities and services such as theatre and dance companies. Artistic directors also manage staff, finances and policies.

candidates.title: production designer
candidates.description: Production designers are responsible for the complete look (style, colouring and locations) of television programmes, series, motion pictures and commercials. They create the visual concept for the entire production such as set design, lighting, costumes and camera angles. Production designers work together with the director, designers and oversee the art department. They also create sketches, drawings, do colouring and location research and advise props and stage settings to the director.

candidates.title: art director
candidates.description: Art directors shape the visual layout of a concept. They create innovative designs, develop artistic projects and manage the cooperation between all aspects involved. Art directors may perform creative work in theatre, marketing, advertising, video and motion picture, fashion or online companies. They ensure that the work performed is visually appealing to audiences.

description: Graphics Creator designs, produces, and integrates visual and multimedia content across digital, print, and interactive platforms to meet commercial, promotional, or entertainment objectives. They may work with static and moving images, 2D and 3D animation, and audio-visual elements in video games, films, advertising, and virtual reality, ensuring that the content is engaging, visually consistent, and aligned with project or brand objectives.
tasks: Design and animate 2D and 3D graphics, characters, environments, and assets. Create and integrate soundtracks, sound effects, and music into multimedia project deliverables. Develop animations, motion graphics, and visual effects for games, films, and digital platforms. Understand project briefs and conceptualise creative ideas aligned with client or project requirements. Collaborate with creative, technical teams, and external partners to meet project goals. Collaborate with team members and provide guidance to maintain quality and productivity. Prepare and revise visual and audio content based on feedback from stakeholders or clients. Ensure technical performance, compatibility, and consistency across digital and print platforms. Use industry-standard software, digital tools, and game engines to produce and manage multimedia content.

candidates.title: graphic designer
candidates.description: Graphic designers create text and images to communicate ideas. They make visual concepts by hand or using computer software, intended for publishing in paper or online media such as advertisements, websites, and magazines.

candidates.title: animation layout artist
candidates.description: Animation layout artists work with the cameramen and director to coordinate and create optimal 3D animation shots. They translate 2D storyboards into 3D animated shots and are responsible for camera angles, frames and lighting of animation scenes. Animation layout artists decide which action takes place in which animation scene.

candidates.title: frame maker
candidates.description: Frame makers build frames, mostly out of wood, for pictures and mirrors. They discuss the specifications with customers and build or adjust the frame accordingly. They cut, shape and join the wooden elements and treat them to obtain the desired colour and protect them from corrosion and fire. They cut and fit the glass into the frame. In some cases, they carve and decorate the frames. They may also repair, restore or reproduce older or antique frames.

candidates.title: performance video designer
candidates.description: Performance video designers develop a projected image design concept for a performance and supervise the execution of it. Their work is based on research and artistic vision. Their design is influenced by and influences other designs and must be conform with these designs and the overall artistic vision. Therefore, the designers work closely with artistic directors, operators and the artistic team. Performance video designers prepare media fragments to be used in a performance, which can involve recording, composing, manipulating and editing. They develop plans, mapping, cue lists and other documentation to support the operators and production crew. They sometimes also work as autonomous artists, creating video art outside a performance context.

candidates.title: illustrator
candidates.description: Illustrators provide a visual representation that corresponds to the content of the associated text or idea. Illustrators can work for books, magazines, journals, comic books and other publications.

candidates.title: animation director
candidates.description: Animation directors supervise and recruit multimedia artists. They are responsible for the quality of the animation, that the production is delivered on time and within budget.

candidates.title: video artist
candidates.description: Video artists create videos using analogue or digital techniques to obtain special effects, animation, or other animated visuals using films, videos, images, computer or other electronic tools.

candidates.title: digital artist
candidates.description: Digital artists create art which applies digital technology as an essential part of the creative process. Digital art is usually created using computers or more specialised digital equipment. It may be enjoyed using the same instruments, shared over the internet, or presented using more traditional media.

description: Web Designer designs and develops the visual layout and user interface of websites to ensure they are functional, accessible, and aligned with organisational branding. They plan and implement page structures, navigation systems, and interactive elements, and test websites to ensure compatibility and usability across different browsers and devices. They are responsible for overseeing the design process from concept through to deployment, ensuring an effective and consistent user experience.
tasks: Develop original website design concepts to enhance usability and aesthetics. Create wireframes, user flows, storyboards, and site maps to define website structure and navigation. Execute visual user interface design from concept through to final implementation. Collaborate with developers and stakeholders to ensure design alignment with technical requirements and project objectives. Develop and maintain detailed user interface specifications and design documentation. Conduct user research and usability testing, and refine interfaces based on findings. Ensure website designs are responsive and compatible across devices and screen sizes. Present design concepts and outputs to stakeholders and refine designs based on feedback.

candidates.title: web designer
candidates.description: Web designers are in charge of creating the visual elements, layout and other aspects such as the easiness of use of a website. They follow the different phases of a website creation from the design to the implementation until it goes live. They work side by side with front-end developers to design user interfaces that met the needs of customers and are also appealing. They are responsible of developing mock-ups and of confirming the technical feasibility of the product. They can use and put together various types of elements for the website including graphics, animations, text, videos and photos. They are in contact with clients and stakeholders of the company to ensure that the design of the website meets their needs.

candidates.title: web developer
candidates.description: Web developers develop, implement and document web-accessible software based on the designs provided. They align the client's web presence with its business strategy, troubleshoot software problems and issues and look for ways to improve the application.

candidates.title: user interface designer
candidates.description: User interface designers are in charge of designing user interfaces for applications and systems. They perform layout, graphics and dialogues design activities as well as adaptation activities.

candidates.title: digital media designer
candidates.description: Digital media designers create and edit graphics, animations, sound, text and video to assist in the creation of integrated multimedia products. They may perform activities related to the web, social networks, augmented reality and virtual reality but exclude the production of music using physical instruments and complex software sound synthesis tools. Digital media designers may program and build websites, mobile applications and other multimedia products.

candidates.title: furniture designer
candidates.description: Furniture designers work on items of furniture and related products. They design the product and are involved in its production as craftsmen and designers or makers. The conception of furniture combines innovative design, functional requirements and aesthetic appeal.

candidates.title: graphic designer
candidates.description: Graphic designers create text and images to communicate ideas. They make visual concepts by hand or using computer software, intended for publishing in paper or online media such as advertisements, websites, and magazines.

candidates.title: instructional designer
candidates.description: Instructional designers develop instructional material for training courses using multimedia technology and authoring tools. They aim to create instructional experiences which make the acquisition of knowledge and skills more efficient, effective, and appealing.

candidates.title: fashion designer
candidates.description: Fashion designers work on designs for the haute couture and/or ready-to-wear, high street fashion markets, and more generally on items of clothing and fashion ranges. Fashion designers can operate in a specialised area, such as sportswear, childrenswear, footwear or accessories.

description: Graphics Designer creates and develops visual concepts to communicate information and ideas across print, digital and spatial media. They design layouts, illustrations and other graphic elements for advertisements, publications, branding, exhibitions and online content, ensuring visual clarity, aesthetic quality and consistency with agreed concepts and brand standards. The role involves conceptualising design solutions, translating briefs into effective visual outcomes, and coordinating with relevant stakeholders to deliver finished designs that support communication, promotional and publication objectives.
tasks: Design visual content for print, digital, and social media platforms. Translate client, brand, or project briefs into creative and effective visual designs. Develop layouts and illustrations for publications, advertising, packaging, and exhibitions. Collaborate with clients, marketing, content, and development teams to ensure cohesive design outputs. Revise and refine designs based on feedback, usability requirements, and brand guidelines. Prepare files and assets for print production, digital distribution, and online platforms. Manage multiple design tasks to meet deadlines and maintain quality standards. Research design trends and audience preferences to support creative development. Apply digital and traditional design tools to create and optimise visual content.

They create the visual concept for the entire production such as set design, lighting, costumes and camera angles. Production designers work together with the director, designers and oversee the art department. They also create sketches, drawings, do colouring and location research and advise props and stage settings to the director.

candidates.title: industrial designer
candidates.description: Industrial designers work out ideas and develop them into designs and concepts for a wide variety of manufactured products. They integrate creativity, aesthetics, production feasibility, and market relevance in the design of new products.

candidates.title: instructional designer
candidates.description: Instructional designers develop instructional material for training courses using multimedia technology and authoring tools. They aim to create instructional experiences which make the acquisition of knowledge and skills more efficient, effective, and appealing.

description: UX Designer (User Experience) researches and analyses how a user interacts with a product, system, or service to create an intuitive and accessible digital experience. They design and improve interfaces for websites, mobile apps, and other platforms through wireframes, prototypes, and usability testing, ensuring designs meet user needs and support effective interaction. The role integrates user insights with visual and interaction design to deliver a seamless, engaging, and functional experience.
tasks: Conduct user research and usability testing to understand user needs, behaviours, business requirements, and evaluate design effectiveness. Create wireframes, user flows, mock-ups, and interactive prototypes for web and mobile applications. Design user-centred interfaces based on research insights, usability findings, and stakeholder feedback. Develop personas and customer journey maps to inform and guide design decisions. Collaborate with developers, product managers, and stakeholders to ensure accurate implementation and alignment with project goals. Maintain user interface and user experience (UI/UX) design specifications, documentation, and ensure consistency with branding and accessibility standards across digital platforms. Present design concepts and solutions to stakeholders and incorporate feedback into design improvements. Keep up to date with user experience (UX) tools, trends, and best practices to support continuous improvement.

They make proposals for the improvement of the interface and usability of products, systems or services. In doing so, they take into consideration the practical, experiential, affective, meaningful and valuable aspects of human–computer interaction and product ownership, as well as the person's perceptions of system aspects such as utility, ease of use and efficiency, and user experience dynamics.

candidates.title: design engineer
candidates.description: Design engineers develop new conceptual and detailed designs. They create the look for these concepts or products and the systems used to make them. Design engineers work with engineers and marketers to enhance the functioning and efficiency of existing devices.

candidates.title: industrial designer

candidates.title: user interface developer

candidates.title: instructional designer

candidates.title: database designer
candidates.description: Database designers specify the database's logical structure, processes, and information flows. They design data models and databases to serve data acquisition.

description: Digital Designer creates and produces multimedia content, including graphics, animations, text, sound, and video, for digital platforms such as websites, social media, mobile applications, and online advertising. They combine creative design with technical skills to deliver visually engaging content that communicates messages, enhances user experience, and supports marketing or communication objectives.
tasks: Create and edit visual content for websites, social media platforms, and digital advertisements. Develop user-centred interface designs for websites and mobile applications based on user research and feedback. Produce animations and motion graphics to enhance digital content and user engagement. Develop wireframes, mock-ups, prototypes, layouts, and storyboards for web and mobile platforms. Collaborate with creative, marketing, and development teams to deliver design solutions that meet project objectives. Present design concepts to stakeholders for review and incorporate feedback into final outputs. Use digital content creation tools in accordance with established design specifications and brand guidelines. Stay updated on current trends in design, user experience, and digital marketing practices.
