Therefore, the designers work closely with artistic directors, operators and the artistic team. Sound designers prepare audio fragments to be used in a performance, which can involve recording, composing, manipulating and editing. Sound designers develop plans, cue lists and other documentation to support the operators and production crew. Sound designers sometimes also work as autonomous artists, creating sound art outside a performance context.

description: Creative Team Leader manages and guides a team in producing creative content, including advertisements, campaigns, and multimedia projects. They oversee the creative process from concept to delivery, ensuring work aligns with brand standards, timelines, and budgets, while inspiring and coordinating graphic designers, copywriters, and other creative professionals.
tasks: Lead brainstorming sessions and guide the development of creative concepts aligned with project objectives. Develop and manage creative briefs to ensure clear communication of client or business requirements. Oversee the production of visual and multimedia content, ensuring quality, accuracy, and brand consistency. Coordinate cross-functional projects, managing timelines, resources, and budgets to ensure timely delivery. Present creative outputs to clients or internal stakeholders to obtain feedback, alignment, and approval. Supervise the development of wireframes, mock-ups, prototypes, and other design deliverables. Mentor and support junior creative staff to enhance skills, performance, and professional development. Conduct quality assurance checks on all creative outputs to ensure standards are met before delivery. Maintain and improve workflow processes to enhance efficiency within creative and operational teams.

candidates.title: creative director
candidates.description: Creative directors manage the team that is responsible for the creation of advertisements and commercials. They oversee the whole creation process. Creative directors pitch the designs of their team to the client.

candidates.title: fruit production team leader
candidates.description: Fruit production team leaders are responsible for leading and working with a team. They organise daily work schedules for the production of fruit crops and participate in the production processes.

candidates.title: horticulture production team leader
candidates.description: Horticulture production team leaders are responsible for leading and working with a team. They organise daily work schedules for the production of horticulture crops and participate in the production.

candidates.title: production designer
candidates.description: Production designers are responsible for the complete look (style, colouring and locations) of television programmes, series, motion pictures and commercials. They create the visual concept for the entire production such as set design, lighting, costumes and camera angles. Production designers work together with the director, designers and oversee the art department. They also create sketches, drawings, do colouring and location research and advise props and stage settings to the director.

candidates.title: agronomic crop production team leader
candidates.description: Agronomic crop production team leaders are responsible for leading and working with a team of crop production workers. They organise the daily work schedules for crop production and participate in the production.

candidates.title: artistic coach
candidates.description: Artistic coaches research, plan, organise and lead arts activities for sport practitioners in order to provide them with artistic abilities such as dance, acting, expression and transmission that are important for their sport performance. Artistic coaches make technical, performance or artistic abilities accessible to sports practitioners with the goal of improving their sport performance.

candidates.title: activity leader
candidates.description: Activity leaders provide recreational services to people and children on vacation. They organise activities such as games for children, sport competitions, cycling tours, shows and museum visits. Recreational animators also advertise their activities, manage the available budget for each event and consult their colleagues.

candidates.title: artistic director
candidates.description: Artistic directors are in charge of the programme of an artistic project or a cultural organisation. They are responsible for the strategic vision, the visibility and the quality of all kind of artistic activities and services such as theatre and dance companies. Artistic directors also manage staff, finances and policies.

description: Character Rigger creates and implements control systems for 3D characters and creatures, enabling an animator to bring them to life in animation, video games, films, or simulations. They develop skeletal structures, deformation systems, and control rigs, including bones, joints, and facial controls, ensuring movements are realistic and efficient. Working closely with a modeller and an animator, they optimise rigs to meet both technical and artistic requirements throughout the production process.
tasks: Create and implement skeleton systems and control rigs for 3D characters and creatures. Apply skinning, weight painting, and deformation techniques to ensure natural movement. Develop and maintain custom rigging tools using scripting languages, and automate rigging workflows. Test, troubleshoot, and optimise rigs to ensure animation compatibility, flexibility, and performance. Collaborate with animators and integrate rigs into animation pipelines and game engines. Use digital content creation tools and visualisation software to support rigging and animation workflows. Stay updated with rigging techniques and coordinate with team members to improve workflow efficiency.

candidates.title: rigger
candidates.description: Riggers specialise in the lifting of heavy objects, often helped by a crane or derrick. They work with crane operators to attach and detach crane loads. They may also install the heavy object in place.

candidates.title: boat rigger
candidates.description: Boat riggers use hand and power tools to install motors, gauges, controls and accessories such as batteries, lights, fuel tanks and ignition switches. They also perform pre-delivery inspections.

candidates.title: high rigger
candidates.description: High riggers assemble and hoist temporary suspension structures on heights to support performance equipment. Their work is based on instruction, plans and calculations. Their job can include rope access, working above colleagues, assemble constructions to lift performers and lifting heavy loads, which makes it a high risk occupation. They work indoor as well as outdoor. They cooperate with ground riggers to unload and assemble constructions on ground level.

candidates.title: ground rigger
candidates.description: Ground riggers assist level riggers assembling temporary suspension structures to support performance equipment. Their work is based on instruction and plans. They work indoor as well as outdoor. They cooperate closely with high riggers.

candidates.title: rigging supervisor
candidates.description: Rigging supervisors oversee rigging operations. They manage and coordinate employees who operate lifting and rigging equipment. They organise the day-to-day working activities.

candidates.title: costume maker
candidates.description: Costume makers construct, sew, stitch, dye, adapt and maintain costumes to be used in events, live performances and in movies or television programs. Their work is based on artistic vision, sketches or finished patterns combined with knowledge of the human body to ensure the wearer maximum range of movement. They work in close cooperation with the designers.

candidates.title: coachbuilder
candidates.description: Coachbuilders execute work on vehicle bodies and coaches. They have skills to form body parts from panels, manufacture and assemble the frames and parts for vehicles.

candidates.title: gunsmith
candidates.description: Gunsmiths modify and repair metal fabricated firearms for special costumer specifications. They use machines and hand tools such as planers, grinders and millers to alter and restore guns, and they may also apply engravings, carvings and other decorative finishing touches to the otherwise finished product.

description: Coroner investigates deaths that are sudden, unnatural, unexplained or occur under suspicious circumstances in order to determine the cause and manner of death in accordance with the law. They oversee and coordinate post-mortem examinations and related inquiries, work closely with forensic specialists and law enforcement authorities, review relevant evidence, and ensure that proper records and legal documentation are completed. They may also issue findings or death certificates and provide testimony in court when required.
tasks: Review and investigate sudden, unexplained, suspicious, or unnatural deaths. Order, oversee, and review post-mortem examinations and autopsies. Collect, analyse, and interpret medical, forensic, and circumstantial evidence. Determine and certify the cause and manner of death according to legal standards. Collaborate with police, forensic experts, and other relevant authorities. Prepare and maintain detailed reports, legal documents, and official records. Testify in inquests, court proceedings, and public hearings. Coordinate death investigations and related inquiries with stakeholders. Ensure compliance with legal, regulatory, and public health requirements.

candidates.title: coroner
candidates.description: Coroners oversee the examination of deceased individuals in order to determine the cause of death in uncommon circumstances. They ensure records are maintained of the deaths within their jurisdiction, and facilitate communication with other officials to ensure the investigation is complete.

candidates.title: funeral services director
candidates.description: Funeral services directors coordinate the logistics of funerals. They support the deceased family by arranging the details concerning the location, dates and times of memorial services. Funeral services directors contact representatives of the cemetery to prepare the site, plan transportation for the deceased person, advise on the types of memorials and legal requirements or paperwork. Funeral services directors organise the daily operations of the crematorium. They oversee the staff's activities in the crematorium and ensure that they deliver services according to legal requirements. They monitor the crematorium service revenue budget and develop and maintain operational rules within the crematorium.

candidates.title: criminal investigator
candidates.description: Criminal investigators examine and process the scenes of crimes and the evidence found in them. They handle and protect the evidence compliant with rules and regulations, and isolate the scene from outside influence. They photograph the scene, ensure the maintenance of the evidence, and write reports.

candidates.title: funeral attendant
candidates.description: Funeral attendants lift and carry coffins prior and during the funeral service, placing it in the chapel and into the cemetery. They handle floral offerings around the coffin, direct mourners and assist with storing the equipment after the funeral.

candidates.title: police officer
candidates.description: Police officers use investigation methods to prevent crime, to pursue and apprehend criminals, and protect the public from violent and criminal activities. They perform surveillance and patrol activities to prevent crimes and apprehend offenders. They provide support to victimised parties and the public at large, and fulfil administrative duties.

candidates.title: judge
candidates.description: Judges preside over, review and handle court cases, hearings, appeals and trials. They ensure that court procedures conform to conventional legal processes and review evidence and juries. Judges preside over cases involving such areas as crime, family issues, civil law, small claims and juvenile offenses.

candidates.title: embalmer
candidates.description: Embalmers arrange for the removal of bodies of deceased persons from the place of death and they prepare the bodies for burials and cremations. They clean and disinfect the bodies, use make-up to create the impression of a more natural appearance and hide any visible damage. They are in close contact with funeral services directors in order to comply with the wishes of the deceased family members.

candidates.title: police detective
candidates.description: Police detectives gather and compile evidence which assists them in the solution of crimes. They use investigative techniques to gather evidence, and interview all parties connected to their line of enquiry, and cooperate with other police department divisions to gather the evidence.

description: Archaeologist studies past human activity by excavating, dating, and interpreting sites and artifacts of historical significance. They conduct fieldwork, carry out excavation projects, analyse physical remains, and document findings to contribute to the preservation and understanding of cultural heritage.
tasks: Conduct archaeological field surveys to locate and assess sites. Excavate and analyse artefacts, structures, and other physical remains. Record and document findings using Geographic Information System (GIS), photographs, drawings, and field notes. Examine, preserve, and manage artefacts for study and conservation purposes. Prepare detailed reports based on research and excavation findings. Collaborate with heritage, conservation, and research professionals to support archaeological work. Ensure compliance with heritage laws, regulations, and conservation standards. Plan, organise, and coordinate fieldwork and excavation activities.

candidates.title: archaeologist
candidates.description: Archaeologists research and study past civilisations and settlements through collecting and inspecting material remains. They analyse and draw conclusions on a wide array of matters such as hierarchy systems, linguistics, culture, and politics based on the study of objects, structures, fossils, relics, and artifacts left behind by these peoples. Archaeologists utilise various interdisciplinary methods such as stratigraphy, typology, 3D analysis, mathematics, and modelling.

candidates.title: archaeology lecturer
candidates.description: Archaeology lecturers are subject professors, teachers, or lecturers who instruct students who have obtained an upper secondary education diploma in their own specialised field of study, archaeology, which is predominantly academic in nature. They work with university research assistants and university teaching assistants for the preparation of lectures and of exams, for grading papers and exams and for leading review and feedback sessions for the students. They also conduct academic research in their respective field of archaeology, publish their findings and liaise with other university colleagues.

candidates.title: historian
candidates.description: Historians research, analyze, interpret, and present the past of human societies. They analyse documents, sources, and traces from the past in order to understand the past societies.

candidates.title: anthropologist
candidates.description: Anthropologists research all aspects of life pertaining to humans. They study the various civilisations that have existed along the time and their ways of organisation. They attempt to analyse the physical, societal, linguistic, political, economical, philosophical, and cultural aspects of different people. The aim of their studies is to understand and describe the past of humanity and solve topical societal problems. They explore different perspectives such as philosophical anthropology.

candidates.title: geologist
candidates.description: Geologists research the materials that form the earth. Their observations depend on the purpose of the research. Depending on their specialisation, geologists study how the Earth has been shaped over time, its geological layers, the quality of minerals for mining purposes, earthquakes and volcanic activity for private services, and similar phenomena.

candidates.title: palaeontologist
candidates.description: Palaeontologists research and analyse forms of life that existed in ancient eras of the planet Earth. They strive to define the evolutionary path and the interaction with different geological areas of all kinds of once organisms and such plants, pollen and spores, invertebrate and vertebrate animals, humans, traces such as footprints, and ecology and climate.

candidates.title: exploration geologist
candidates.description: Exploration geologists examine and prospect for mineral deposits. They identify, define and obtain legal title to an economically viable mineral deposit. They are responsible for design, management and execution of the exploration programme.

candidates.title: museum scientist
candidates.description: Museum scientists perform and/or manage the curatorial, preparatory and clerical work in general museums, botanical gardens, art galleries, fine arts related collections, aquariums or similar areas. They manage the collections of natural, historical and anthropological material that is educational, scientific or aesthetic in purpose.

description: Geographer studies the Earth’s physical features and human populations, examining how environments and human activities interact across local to global scales. They collect, analyse, and interpret spatial and geographic data to inform urban planning, environmental management, disaster response, and regional development. Their work integrates physical and human geography to support evidence-based decision-making.
tasks: Conduct fieldwork and collect spatial and geographic data from relevant sources. Analyse spatial data using Geographic Information System (GIS) and other geospatial mapping software. Create, update, and maintain digital and physical maps. Prepare technical reports and visual presentations to present geographic findings. Study the distribution of physical and cultural features and their relationships with human activities and environments. Advise on land use planning, environmental management, and regional development strategies. Conduct surveys, interviews, and focus groups to support geographic research.

candidates.title: geographer
candidates.description: Geographers are scholars who study human and physical geography. Depending on their specialisation, they study political, economical and cultural aspects of humanity contained within human geography. Moreover, they study land formations, soils, natural frontiers, and water flows contained in physical geography.

candidates.title: geographic information systems specialist
candidates.description: Geographic information systems specialists use specialised computer systems, engineering measures, and geological concepts to process land, geographic, and geospatial information into visually detailed digital maps and geomodels of a reservoir. They convert technical information like soil density and properties into digital representations to be used by engineers, governments and interested stakeholders.

candidates.title: cartographer
candidates.description: Cartographers create maps by combining various scientific informations depending of the purpose of the map (e.g. topographic, urban, or political maps). They combine the interpretation of mathematical notes and measurements with the aesthetics and visual depiction of the site for developing the maps. They may also work on developing and improving geographic information systems and may perform scientific research within cartography.

candidates.title: demographer
candidates.description: Demographers study a variety of parameters related with population. They develop, based on their observations, statistical analyses on the evolutions and changes of births, elderly, marriage and divorce, employment, mortality, immigration and related matters.

candidates.title: geotechnician
candidates.description: Geotechnicians collect and process rock and soil samples for geomechanical testing. They also describe the quality of rock mass, including structure, discontinuities, colour and weathering. Mine geotechnicians may measure the size of underground openings. They report the collected information to geologists and engineers as required.

candidates.title: geography teacher secondary school
candidates.description: Geography teachers at secondary schools provide education to students, commonly children and young adults, in a secondary school setting. They are usually subject teachers, specialised and instructing in their own field of study, geography. They prepare lesson plans and materials, monitor the students' progress, assist individually when necessary, and evaluate the students' knowledge and performance on the subject of geography through assignments, tests and examinations.

candidates.title: geophysicist
candidates.description: Geophysicists study the physical characteristics of the earth and apply physical measurements to geological situations. Geophysicists use the principles of gravity, seismicity and electromagnetics to identify the structure and composition of the earth.

candidates.title: geologist
candidates.description: Geologists research the materials that form the earth. Their observations depend on the purpose of the research. Depending on their specialisation, geologists study how the Earth has been shaped over time, its geological layers, the quality of minerals for mining purposes, earthquakes and volcanic activity for private services, and similar phenomena.

description: Criminologist examining a range of crimes, conducting extensive research on the social, biological and environmental factors that lead to deviant behavior, identifying criminal patterns, formulating criminal profiles, compiling research reports, and collaborating with law enforcement.
tasks: Gathering and analyzing data about the causes and nature of crime to determine criminal patterns and common traits among criminals. Researching and analyzing the biological, social, and psychological background of criminals to gain an understanding of the motivation behind their deviant behavior. Developing profiles of criminal types to assist law enforcement to identify potential criminals, understand their behavior, and apprehend them more efficiently. Examining crime scenes, evidence, and autopsies to determine what happened and which profile category the criminal falls into. Improving understanding and coordinating work execution. Performing related tasks.

candidates.title: criminologist
candidates.description: Criminologists study conditions pertaining to humans such as the social and psychological aspects that could lead them to commit criminal acts. They observe and analyse different factors ranging from behavioural conditions up to social background and environment of suspects in order to advise organisations on the prevention of crime.

candidates.title: criminal investigator
candidates.description: Criminal investigators examine and process the scenes of crimes and the evidence found in them. They handle and protect the evidence compliant with rules and regulations, and isolate the scene from outside influence. They photograph the scene, ensure the maintenance of the evidence, and write reports.

candidates.title: crime journalist
candidates.description: Crime journalists research and write articles about criminal events for newspapers, magazines, television and other media. They conduct interviews and attend court hearings.

candidates.title: seismologist
candidates.description: Seismologists study the movement of tectonic plaques in the Earth which causes the propagation of seismic waves and earthquakes. They study and observe the various sources causing earthquakes such as volcanic activity, atmospheric phenomena, or the behaviour of oceans. They provide their scientific observations to prevent dangers in construction and infrastructure.

candidates.title: criminal justice social worker
candidates.description: Criminal justice social workers tackle criminal behaviour and reduce risk of reoffending by promoting and establishing programs to prevent crime within communities. They assist in prosecutions and help to investigate criminal cases. They assist prisoners reinsert into the community after release from custody. They also support and supervise the offenders sentenced to community service and provide support to the victims and the people closely affected by the crime.

candidates.title: climatologist
candidates.description: Climatologists study the average change in weather and climate from a long-term perspective. They research and analyse historic weather conditions in order to forecast climatic conditions trends such as changes in temperature, global warming, or regional evolutive weather conditions. They use these findings for advising on environmental policy, construction, agricultural projects, and societal matters.

candidates.title: physiologist
candidates.description: Physiologists study and exert research on the functioning of different living organisms, the parts they are composed of, and their interactions. They understand the fashion in which living systems react to factors such as diseases, physical activity, and stress, and use that information to develop methods and solutions to even out the effect that those stimuli have in living bodies.

candidates.title: police detective
candidates.description: Police detectives gather and compile evidence which assists them in the solution of crimes. They use investigative techniques to gather evidence, and interview all parties connected to their line of enquiry, and cooperate with other police department divisions to gather the evidence.

description: Clinical Psychologist assesses, diagnoses, and treats an individual experiencing psychological, emotional, or behavioural difficulties. They develop and implement evidence-based treatment plans and provide psychotherapy to help a client manage conditions such as anxiety, depression, trauma, and other mental health disorders. Their work encompasses psychological evaluations, therapeutic interventions, and support for individuals, couples, families, or groups.
tasks: Conduct psychological assessments and diagnostic evaluations using tests, interviews, and observations. Develop and implement evidence-based treatment plans and personalised interventions tailored to clients’ needs. Provide individual, group, or family therapy to address psychological, emotional, and behavioural difficulties. Collaborate with healthcare professionals to evaluate and manage clients’ conditions. Maintain detailed and confidential client records in line with professional standards. Assess clients’ risk levels and consider psychological and social factors in clinical interventions. Refer clients to other specialists or support services when necessary. Perform administrative duties to support clinical service delivery.

candidates.title: clinical psychologist
candidates.description: Clinical psychologists diagnose, rehabilitate, and support individuals affected by mental, emotional, and behavioural disorders and problems as well as mental changes and pathogenic conditions through use of cognitive tools and appropriate intervention. They use clinical psychological resources on the basis of psychological science, its findings, theories, methods, and techniques for the investigation, interpretation, and prediction of human experience and behaviour.

candidates.title: psychologist
candidates.description: Psychologists study the behaviour and mental processes in humans. They provide services to clients who deal with mental health issues and life issues such as bereavement, relationship difficulties, domestic violence, and sexual abuse. They also provide counselling for mental health issues such as eating disorders, post-traumatic stress disorders, and psychosis in order to help the clients rehabilitate and reach a healthy behaviour.

candidates.title: health psychologist
candidates.description: Health psychologists deal with the various aspects of health related behaviour of individuals and groups, by helping individuals or groups prevent illness and promote healthy behaviours by also providing counseling services. They perform tasks for the development of health promotion activities and projects on the basis of psychological science, research findings, theories, methods and techniques. They also engage in research about health related issues to influence public policy on health care issues.

candidates.title: assistant clinical psychologist
candidates.description: Assistant clinical psychologists aid psychologists in their work. They work in healthcare facilities or private practices where they assist psychologists with their treatment of patients. Assistant clinical psychologists are healthcare professionals that can assess patients with psychological tests and aid with therapy, as well as performing administrative functions.

candidates.title: educational psychologist
candidates.description: Educational psychologists are psychologists employed by educational institutions to provide psychological and emotional support to students in need. They are specialised in the provision of direct support and interventions to students, conducting psychological testing and assessment, and consulting with families, teachers and other school-based student support professionals, such as school social workers and educational counsellors, about the students. They may also work with the school administration to improve practical support strategies in order to improve the students' well-being.

candidates.title: clinical social worker
candidates.description: Clinical social workers provide therapy, counselling, and intervention services to clients. They treat clients with personal struggles, namely mental illness, addiction, and abuse, advocating for them and helping them gain access to the necessary resources. They also focus on the impact of medical and public health issues within social aspects.

candidates.title: psychotherapist
candidates.description: Psychotherapists assist and treat healthcare users with varying degrees of psychological, psychosocial, or psychosomatic behavioural disorders and pathogenic conditions by means of psychotherapeutic methods. They promote personal development and well-being and provide advice on improving relationships, capabilities, and problem-solving techniques. They use science-based psychotherapeutic methods such as behavioural therapy, existential analysis and logotherapy, psychoanalysis or systemic family therapy in order to guide the patients in their development and help them search for appropriate solutions to their problems. Psychotherapists are not required to have academic degrees in psychology or a medical qualification in psychiatry. It is an independent occupation from psychology, psychiatry, and counselling.

candidates.title: psychology lecturer
candidates.description: Psychology lecturers are subject professors, teachers, or lecturers who instruct students who have obtained an upper secondary education diploma in their own specialised field of study, psychology, which is predominantly academic in nature. They work with their university research assistants and university teaching assistants for the preparation of lectures and of exams, for grading papers and exams and for leading review and feedback sessions for the students. They also conduct academic research in their respective field of psychology, publish their findings and liaise with other university colleagues.

description: Industrial Relations Officer Grade S9 responsible for the formulation of labour policy, administration of labour laws and standards, industrial harmony and trade union affairs, monitoring and enforcing relevant acts, providing labour advice and education, planning and conducting employment service activities and promoting to enhance welfare and interests industrial society.
tasks: Implementing, reviewing, and coordinating national and international labour policies, workforce management, labour research, as well as job standards and classifications. Examining social, economic, and industrial trends, analysing policy options, preparing briefing papers and recommendations, and engaging with stakeholders. Conducting statutory inspections, farm and night inspections, complaint investigations, investigation reports, and follow-up actions. Managing labour permits, foreign worker compensation, worker housing, employee termination, and job seeker placement. Conducting mentions and hearings for claims cases, maintaining registers, and undertaking follow-up actions on court orders. Undertaking prosecution/compound actions against violations of labour laws and regulations. Handling industrial relations cases, including Section 20 of Industrial Relations Act representation, industrial disputes, collective agreements, and workplace harmony. Managing the registration, modification, dissolution, and enforcement of trade unions. Conducting investigations, arbitration, preparation of investigation papers, affidavits, and proposals for amendments to trade union laws. Implementing enforcement, investigation, prosecution, conciliation, and arbitration activities under labour, industrial relations, trade union legislation, and the PSMB Act 2001.

candidates.title: labour relations officer
candidates.description: Labour relations officers implement labour policy in an organisation, and advise trade unions on policies and negotiation. They handle disputes, and advise management on personnel policy as well as facilitate communication between trade unions and managerial staff.

candidates.title: international relations officer
candidates.description: International relations officers ensure the development of cooperation between international public organisations and governments. They facilitate communication between their organisation and foreign organisations and develop collaboration strategies, promoting a collaborative relationship beneficial for both parties.

candidates.title: trade development officer
candidates.description: Trade development officers develop and implement trade policies both internally and in international import and export relations. They analyse the domestic and foreign markets in order to promote and establish business operations, and ensure trade proceedings are compliant with legislation and businesses are protected from distortions.

candidates.title: public relations officer
candidates.description: Public relations officers represent a company or organisation to stakeholders and the public. They use communications strategies to promote an understanding of the activities and image of their clients in a favourable way.

candidates.title: labour market policy officer
candidates.description: Labour market policy officers research, analyse and develop labour market policies. They implement policies ranging from financial policies to practical policies such as improving job searching mechanisms, promoting job training, giving incentives to start-ups and income support. Labour market policy officers work closely with partners, external organisations or other stakeholders and provide them with regular updates.

candidates.title: foreign affairs officer
candidates.description: Foreign affairs officers analyse foreign affairs policies and operations, and write reports outlining their analyses in a clear and comprehensible manner. They communicate with parties who benefit from their findings, and act as advisers in the development or implementation of or reporting on foreign policy. Foreign affairs officers may also perform administrative duties in the department, such as assisting with problems concerning passports and visas. They promote friendly and open communication between different nations' governments and institutions.

candidates.title: human resources officer
candidates.description: Human resources officers develop and implement strategies that help their employers select and retain appropriately qualified staff within that business sector. They recruit staff, prepare job advertisements, interview and short-list people, negotiate with employment agencies, and set up working conditions. Human resources officers also administer the payroll, review salaries and advise on remuneration benefits and employment law. They arrange for training opportunities to enhance employees' performance.

candidates.title: political affairs officer
candidates.description: Political affairs officers analyse developments in foreign politics and other policy matters, monitor conflicts and consult on mediation measures, as well as other developmental strategies. They write reports to ensure communication with governmental bodies, and develop policies and implementation methods.

description: Maritime Superintendent Officer Grade T8 responsible for carrying out management-level duties involving the Malaysian Maritime Zone in terms of enforcing laws and regulations under federal law; perform search and rescue tasks; prevent and restrict the commission of offenses; provide assistance in matters related to criminalisation when applied by a foreign country; perform air and coastal surveillance and provide transportation services to agencies in need. Additionally, the task carried out in the Malaysian Maritime Zone and the high seas is to search and rescue; control and prevention of maritime pollution; prevention and blocking of swarming as well as prevention and blocking of narcotic drug trafficking. Duties performed shall be placed under the general command and control of the Malaysian Armed Forces during an emergency, special crisis, or war.
tasks: Enforcing law and order under federal law within the Malaysian Maritime Zone. Formulating navigational policies and implementing security policies for the Malaysian Maritime Zone. Planning logistics management and operational planning. Carrying out maritime search and rescue duties, aerial and coastal surveillance, maritime pollution control and prevention, prevention and blocking of swarming, as well as prevention and blocking of illicit narcotic drug trafficking. Ensuring the smoothness and effectiveness of assistance in any criminal matter at the request of a foreign country as provided under the Mutual Assistance in Criminal Matters Act 2002 (Act 621). Ensuring rig services and support to relevant agencies are provided efficiently and effectively. Collecting and evaluating security intelligence information and proposing enhancements to operational effectiveness. Ensuring the efficiency and effectiveness of maritime and aerial patrols and operations conducted within the Malaysian Maritime Zone. Implementing and enhancing the quality of personnel training, operational training, and joint training within the country’s maritime areas. Establishing close relations with other departments/ agencies in relation to law enforcement within the Malaysian Maritime Zone.

candidates.title: maritime instructor
candidates.description: Maritime instructors teach all those occupationally piloting a boat or a ship, such as skippers and ship captains, how to operate their inland water boats or maritime ships according to regulations. They teach their students theory and techniques on how to optimally pilot, steer and navigate, and maintain their specific boat or ship, observe and evaluate the students' practice. They also focus on non-steering related subjects such as customer service (in case of person transportation) and safety measure regulations.

candidates.title: navy officer
candidates.description: Navy officers command missions during conflict and peace times, and supervise training and development of their teams. They supervise combat operations of their team, as well as aid missions, and patrolling missions to ensure peace-keeping. Often they collaborate on a regular basis with the HR department of the HQCS for the best planning of the future needs.

candidates.title: vessel operations coordinator
candidates.description: Vessel operations coordinators manage chartered vessels' transit and performance optimizing the schedulers but also assessing the capabilities and the risks for vessels according to the different types of cargo such as crude oil or other chemical cargos. They make sure all necessary certifications are according to the regulations and all employees have up-to-date passports and licenses. Vessel operations coordinators schedule and maintain records of vessels' maintenance. At the operational level they have contact with the customers, following up customer complains, identifying new opportunities and providing customers with solutions.

candidates.title: maritime water transport general manager
candidates.description: Maritime water transport general managers coordinate the administrative activities that go with the management of vessels in the context of maritime water transport. They prepare vessels, check availability, liaise with clients, manage budgets, and oversee operations from an economic standpoint, following regulation for maritime operations.

candidates.title: ship duty engineer
candidates.description: Ship duty engineers share responsibility for most of the content of the ship's hull. They ensure operation of the main engines, steering mechanism, electrical generation and other major subsystems. They communicate with the ship chief engineer to perform technical operations.

candidates.title: fleet commander
candidates.description: Fleet commanders ensure that naval vessels are ready for inclusion in operations, and are maintained in compliance with rules and regulations. They also supervise naval personnel and are responsible for the operations of the naval service.

candidates.title: ship assistant engineer
candidates.description: Ship assistant engineers assist the ship chief engineer and the ship duty engineer in the operations of the ship's hull. They support the operation of the main engines, steering mechanism, electrical generation and other major subsystems. They communicate with maritime engineers about the performance of technical operations. They also ensure appropriate safety and regulatory standards compliance and are able to take on higher level positions if needed.

candidates.title: coastguard watch officer
candidates.description: Coastguard watch officers patrol and survey coast and sea regions to prevent accidents, as well as perform search and rescue missions in the event of an emergency. They react to emergency calls, advise on safety procedures, and prevent accidents and illegal activity at sea. Coastguard watch officers investigate shipping activities and aid during pollution incidents and in flood relief.

description: Geophysics Technician operates and maintains geophysical and well logging instruments to support surveys for exploration, environmental assessment, and resource management. They collect, process, and analyse geological and geophysical data, including core samples, while maintaining accurate databases, undertaking field activities under varying conditions, and collaborating with geophysicists and engineers to ensure reliable data for decision-making in oil and gas, mining, and environmental projects.
tasks: Operate geophysical instruments to collect seismic and subsurface data during field surveys. Set up, calibrate, and maintain geophysical sensors and survey equipment in the field. Conduct field observations and measurements, including recording relevant environmental and weather data. Collect samples and prepare materials and equipment for geophysical tests and analyses. Assist in processing survey data using specialised geophysical software. Monitor equipment performance and ensure accurate data transmission and recording. Document survey procedures, observations, and test results in technical reports. Troubleshoot equipment issues and support logistical arrangements for field operations.

candidates.title: geology technician
candidates.description: Geology technicians assist in all the activities carried out by geologists. Under the supervision of geologists, they collect materials, carry out research and study the samples collected from the Earth. Geology technicians assist in determining the value of the land for oil or gas exploration. They perform various technical activities, including collecting samples during geochemical surveys, working on drill sites, and participating in geophysical surveys and geological studies.

candidates.title: physics technician
candidates.description: Physics technicians monitor physical processes and perform tests for manufacturing, educational or scientific purposes. They work in laboratories, schools or production facilities where they assist physicists in their work. Physics technicians perform technical or practical work and report about their results.

candidates.title: geothermal technician
candidates.description: Geothermal technicians install and maintain geothermal power plants and commercial and residential geothermal heating installations. They perform inspections, analyse problems and carry out repairs. They participate in the initial installation, testing and maintenance of geothermal equipment and ensure compliance with safety regulations.

candidates.title: meteorology technician
candidates.description: Meteorology technicians collect large amounts of meteorological information for weather information users such as aviation companies or meteorological institutions. They operate specialised measuring instruments to make accurate weather predictions and report their observations. Meteorology technicians assist meteorologists in their scientific operations.

candidates.title: geotechnician
candidates.description: Geotechnicians collect and process rock and soil samples for geomechanical testing. They also describe the quality of rock mass, including structure, discontinuities, colour and weathering. Mine geotechnicians may measure the size of underground openings. They report the collected information to geologists and engineers as required.

candidates.title: hydrographic surveying technician
candidates.description: Hydrographic surveying technicians perform oceanographic and surveying operations in marine environments. They assist hydrographic surveyors, using specialised equipment to map and study underwater topography and morphology of bodies of water. They assist in the installation and deployment of hydrographic and surveying equipment and report about their work.

candidates.title: soil surveying technician
candidates.description: Soil surveying technicians analyse soil by carrying out technical surveying tasks, using soil surveying techniques. They focus on the process of classifying soil types and other soil properties. Soil surveying technicians operate surveying equipment and utilise programs to retrieve and interpret relevant data, and perform computations as required.

candidates.title: instrumentation engineering technician
candidates.description: Instrumentation engineering technicians assist instrumentation engineers in the development of control equipment, such as valves, relays, and regulators, which can be used to monitor and control processes. Instrumentation engineering technicians are responsible for building, testing, monitoring, and maintaining of equipment. They use wrenches, beam cutters, grind saws, and overhead cranes to build and repair equipment.

description: Chemistry Technician assists chemists and scientists by conducting chemical and physical tests, monitoring and supporting chemical processes, and analysing substances in laboratories or production facilities. They perform hands-on laboratory work, prepare chemical solutions, record and report data, and help ensure product quality, safety, and process efficiency, supporting research and development, quality control, and production across industries such as pharmaceuticals, petrochemicals, food, and environmental testing.
tasks: Conduct chemical and microbiological analyses on samples using laboratory techniques such as spectroscopy, chromatography and titration. Collect, prepare and handle samples, reagents and laboratory materials for testing and analysis. Prepare chemical solutions and reagents accurately according to specified procedures. Operate, calibrate and maintain laboratory and process instruments and equipment. Monitor chemical processes and equipment to ensure operations comply with specified parameters and standards. Record and document experimental data, test results and process information, and prepare basic reports. Check product and sample quality to ensure compliance with required specifications and standards. Assist in troubleshooting technical or process issues during laboratory testing or production activities. Support research and development activities through laboratory testing and experimentation. Follow laboratory safety procedures, including the safe handling and disposal of hazardous chemicals and materials.

candidates.title: chemistry technician
candidates.description: Chemistry technicians monitor chemical processes and conduct tests to analyse chemical substances for manufacturing or scientific purposes. They work in laboratories or production facilities where they assist chemists in their work. Chemistry technicians perform laboratory activities, test chemical substances, analyse data and report about their work.

candidates.title: chemist
candidates.description: Chemists perform laboratory research by testing and analysing the chemical structure of substances.They translate the research results into industrial production processes which are further used in the development or improvement of products. Chemists are also testing the quality of the manufactured products and their environmental impact.

candidates.title: bacteriology technician
candidates.description: Bacteriology technicians provide technical assistance in researching and testing bacteria using laboratory equipment. They collect and analyse data for experiments, compile reports and maintain laboratory stock.

candidates.title: biochemistry technician
candidates.description: Biochemistry technicians provide technical assistance in researching, analysing and testing the reactions caused by chemicals in living organisms. They use laboratory equipment to help develop or improve chemical-based products and also collect and analyse data for experiments, compile reports and maintain laboratory stock.

candidates.title: chemical engineering technician
candidates.description: Chemical engineering technicians transform raw materials in order to develop and test chemical products. They also work on improving chemical plant operations and processes.

candidates.title: chemical manufacturing quality technician
candidates.description: Chemical manufacturing quality technicians perform inspections and precision measurements in order to test and ensure the quality of products, by using computer controlled machinery and systems.

candidates.title: scientific laboratory technician
candidates.description: Scientific laboratory technicians carry out laboratory-based research, analysis and testing and support life science professionals. They sample, test, measure, research and analyse in areas such as biology, biotechnology, environmental science, forensic science and pharmacology. Scientific laboratory technicians also observe and monitor laboratory activities, record test sequences and analyse the results.

candidates.title: biology technician
candidates.description: Biology technicians provide technical assistance in researching and analysing the relationship between living organisms and their environment. They use laboratory equipment to examine organic substances such as bodily fluids, medicines, plants and food. They collect and analyse data for experiments, compile reports and maintain laboratory stock.

description: Physics Science Laboratory Technician performs technical and practical tasks to support scientific research and educational activities in fields such as physics, chemistry, geology, geophysics, meteorology, and astronomy. They prepare, maintain, and operate laboratory equipment, assist in conducting experiments, collect and analyse data, and ensure compliance with safety and quality standards, enabling accurate and efficient scientific investigations.
tasks: Set up and prepare laboratory equipment, materials, and specimens for experiments and testing. Conduct laboratory tests, observations, and measurements to generate accurate and reliable data. Collect, record, and organise experimental data for analysis and reporting. Calibrate, maintain, and ensure proper functioning of laboratory instruments and research equipment. Troubleshoot and resolve basic technical issues with laboratory equipment and instruments. Assist researchers, scientists, or educators in conducting experiments and laboratory activities. Ensure compliance with laboratory safety procedures and proper handling of samples and equipment. Support laboratory activities and assist in research procedures as required. Manage laboratory inventory and assist with procurement and preparation of laboratory supplies.

candidates.title: mechanical engineering technician
candidates.description: Mechanical engineering technicians provide technical support to mechanical engineers in producing and manufacturing mechanical machinery. They help make designs and adjustments, and perform tests. They also develop layouts and drawings, collate and interpret data and write reports.

They analyse chemical substances, record and report data, and ensure compliance with safety protocols, contributing to quality control, research, and educational or industrial laboratory activities.
tasks: Prepare and label chemical reagents and standardise chemical solutions for laboratory use. Assist in setting up and carrying out laboratory experiments and routine chemical or microbiological analyses. Collect and prepare samples, materials, and equipment for laboratory testing and analysis. Operate, maintain, and calibrate laboratory instruments and equipment to ensure accurate results. Observe experiments, record test data, and assist in basic interpretation and documentation of results. Assist in preparing laboratory records and supporting documentation. Support research and development activities under the guidance of senior staff. Maintain laboratory reagent stocks, supplies, and inventory. candidates.description: Medical laboratory assistants work under supervision of the biomedical scientist and carry out basic laboratory procedures. They work in the pre-analytical handling of samples such as checking the details of specimens received for analysis, maintaining analysers, loading reagents, and packaging specimens. They also perform clerical tasks such as monitoring the stock levels of reagents used in analysis.

candidates.title: chemistry teacher secondary school

Healthcare assistants assist in the promotion and restoration of patients' health by providing physical and psychological support to patients, friends and families.

description: Assistant Meteorological Officer Grade C5 responsible for researching the latest technological requirements, overseeing the process of maintenance, testing and calibration of meteorological equipment, collecting meteorological data and preparing analyses and issuing reports in relation to issues arising.
tasks: Preparing data, graphics, and archives for client expertise, executes wave models, conducts ship visits, manages weather equipment inventory, monitors the Voluntary Observing Ships (VOS) programme, and recruits new vessels. Obtaining earthquake parameters, prepares data, manages the seismology database, improves data acquisition systems, and maintains seismological equipment. Examining autographic charts, weather study statements, and station data, inputs data into databases, prepares weather maps, and disseminates NALIS data. Monitoring radar operations, conducts major maintenance, supervises repair works, and maintains station buildings and radar towers. Monitoring air pollution instruments, performs maintenance, testing, and repairs, and manages stock and inventory records. Operating cloud seeding activities, manages logistics, conducts research, calculates and archives data, prepares graphical reports, and maintains equipment. Maintaining Automatic Weather Station (AWS) equipment and agricultural weather studies, and managing maintenance of buoys for oceanographic and marine meteorology purposes. Operating WAN/LAN networks, providing system and application advice, monitoring servers, and managing helpdesk operations. Maintaining computer systems and model control, managing dataset quality, archiving data, preparing annual reports, and producing Synoptic Bulletin graphics and research outputs. Preparing commercial reports and feedback, conducting client dialogue sessions, carrying out product research, monitoring staff databases, and managing courses, files, inventories, orders, and payments.

candidates.title: meteorology technician
candidates.description: Meteorology technicians collect large amounts of meteorological information for weather information users such as aviation companies or meteorological institutions. They operate specialised measuring instruments to make accurate weather predictions and report their observations. Meteorology technicians assist meteorologists in their scientific operations.

candidates.title: meteorologist
candidates.description: Meteorologists study climate processes, measure and predict weather patterns and provide consultancy services to a variety of weather information users. They work out models for weather forecasting, develop instruments to collect meteorological data and compile statistics and databases.

candidates.title: aviation meteorologist
candidates.description: Aviation meteorologists forecast weather conditions in airports. They provide day-to-day, hour-to-hour observations, analysis, forecasts, warnings, and advice to pilots, airport operators and airlines in meteorological matters. They report weather conditions expected at airports, current conditions, and en route forecasts.

candidates.title: aeronautical information service officer
candidates.description: Aeronautical information service officers maintain the operational timing from sunrise to sunset in order to ensure that the information passed by agencies is authentic. They strive to ensure safety, regularity and efficiency.

candidates.title: environmental policy officer
candidates.description: Environmental policy officers research, analyse, develop and implement policies related to the environment. They give expert advice to entities such as commercial organisations, government agencies and land developers. Environmental policy officers work on reducing the impact of industrial, commercial and agricultural activities on the environment.

candidates.title: airport operations officer
candidates.description: Airport operations officers perform supervisory and administrative work monitoring operational activities on an assigned shift at a large airport. They ensure the safe take-off and landing of aircrafts.

candidates.title: administrative assistant
candidates.description: Administrative assistants provide administrative and office support for supervisors. They perform a variety of tasks, such as answering telephone calls, receiving and directing visitors, ordering office supplies, maintaining the office facilities running smoothly, and ensuring that equipment and appliances work properly.

candidates.title: management assistant
candidates.description: Management assistants perform varied types of jobs, usually under general supervision. They carry out administrative tasks and support managers to ensure the entire department functions smoothly.

description: Assistant Science Officer Grade C5 assist Research Officers to carry out nuclear science and technology research work. They plan, coordinate, and manage laboratory maintenance operations, manage activities related to periodic maintenance, specialised equipment, monitor scientific equipment purchase records, assisting public relations activities related to research and development of the use of nuclear technology. Assistant Science Officers also assist in managing laboratory activities, particularly in laboratory research and development (R&D) services.
tasks: Supervising audits, maintenance, equipment calibration, analysis and sampling, laboratory procedures, budgeting, research projects related to legislation, and assists Research Officers in nuclear technology. Extracting DNA, conducts GMO analysis, registering samples, calibrating equipment, validating new methods, managing documentation, and performing occupational safety and health (OSH) activities in accordance with OHSAS 18001 requirements. Supervising the development, maintenance, and operation of galleries and exhibition materials, managing procurement of materials, providing advisory services, and implementing science awareness programmes and annual exhibitions. Examining documents, monitoring declaration systems, conducting patrols, preparing reports and notices related to hazardous cargo, and ensuring follow-up actions are taken. Supervising laboratory operations, managing LQM documents, Certificates of Analysis (COA), QC, and Measurement Uncertainty (MU) calculations, and monitoring microbiological analysis results. Supervising water plant operations, including pump systems, tanks, dams, water catchment security, water quality control, contractor work, and expenditure reporting for the Production Unit.

candidates.title: medical laboratory assistant
candidates.description: Medical laboratory assistants work under supervision of the biomedical scientist and carry out basic laboratory procedures. They work in the pre-analytical handling of samples such as checking the details of specimens received for analysis, maintaining analysers, loading reagents, and packaging specimens. They also perform clerical tasks such as monitoring the stock levels of reagents used in analysis.

candidates.title: health and safety officer
candidates.description: Health and safety officers execute plans for the improvement of work environments and cultures. They assess risks and interview employees to ensure the work environment is compliant with health and safety rules, as well as ensuring the interaction within the workplace occurs in a positive and productive manner. If employed in a healthcare facility the health and safety officer has to investigate infections spreading across a facility and advice all employees how to combat and prevent infections. Furthermore health physics is applied at facilities where people are exposed to ionizing radiation such as nuclear power plants and research institutions.

They also organise several social activities throughout the academic year.

description: Civil Engineering Technician provides technical support to engineers in the planning, design, construction, and maintenance of infrastructure projects such as roads, bridges, buildings, and other civil structures. They assist with preparing technical drawings, conducting site inspections and material tests, collecting and analysing data, and ensuring that projects comply with engineering specifications, safety, and environmental standards, working both on-site and in offices to bridge the gap between theoretical designs and practical implementation, and supporting project execution, documentation, and technical operations.
tasks: Assist civil engineers in the design, planning, and review of infrastructure projects such as roads, bridges, and buildings. Prepare and update engineering drawings, blueprints, and technical documentation using Computer-Aided Design (CAD) software. Conduct field surveys, site inspections, and collect data on soil, materials, and construction progress. Test and analyse construction materials to ensure compliance with standards and specifications. Monitor construction activities to ensure adherence to design plans, quality standards, and safety regulations. Provide technical support for equipment installation, calibration, maintenance, and operation. Prepare project reports, progress updates, basic cost estimates, and other documentation. Assist in coordinating with contractors, suppliers, and stakeholders for project execution and technical requirements. Identify and report site issues, deviations, or equipment faults, and assist in troubleshooting. Organise and support maintenance, repair, and quality control activities on infrastructure projects.

candidates.title: civil engineering technician
candidates.description: Civil engineering technicians help design and execute construction plans and take on organisational tasks, for example in the planning and monitoring, and in bidding and invoicing of construction work. They also calculate material requirements, and help with the purchasing and organising, and ensure the quality of the construction materials. Civil engineering technicians may perform technical tasks in civil engineering and develop and advise on policy implementing strategies for road works, traffic lights, sewerage and water management systems.

candidates.title: civil engineer
candidates.description: Civil engineers design, plan, and develop technical and engineering specifications for infrastructure and construction projects. They apply engineering knowledge in a vast array of projects, from the construction of infrastructure for transportation, housing projects, and luxury buildings, to the construction of natural sites. They design plans that seek to optimise materials and integrate specifications and resource allocation within the time constraints.

candidates.title: industrial engineering technician
candidates.description: Industrial engineering technicians assist industrial engineers in improving efficiency, safety and productivity in manufacturing plants. They conduct production studies, prepare layouts for machinery and equipment and suggest solutions to remedy quality problems.

candidates.title: electrical engineering technician
candidates.description: Electrical engineering technicians work together with electrical engineers in electrical engineering reasearch. They perform technical tasks and aid in the designing, testing, manufacturing and operation of electrical devices and facilities.

candidates.title: mechanical engineering technician
candidates.description: Mechanical engineering technicians provide technical support to mechanical engineers in producing and manufacturing mechanical machinery. They help make designs and adjustments, and perform tests. They also develop layouts and drawings, collate and interpret data and write reports.

candidates.title: civil engineering worker
candidates.description: Civil engineering workers perform tasks concerning the cleaning and preparation of construction sites for civil engineering projects. This includes the work on building and maintenance of roads, railways and dams.

candidates.title: production engineering technician
candidates.description: Production engineering technicians plan production, follow up production processes and develop and test solutions to solve technical problems. They work closely with engineers and technologists, inspect products, conduct tests, and collect data.

candidates.title: computer hardware engineering technician
candidates.description: Computer hardware engineering technicians collaborate with computer hardware engineers in the development of computer hardware, such as motherboards, routers, and microprocessors. Computer hardware engineering technicians are responsible for building, testing, monitoring, and maintaining the developed computer technology.

description: Civil Engineering Estimator prepares detailed cost estimates, budgets and tender submissions for civil engineering projects such as roads, bridges, dams and buildings. The role involves analysing drawings, specifications and contract documents to determine material, labour, equipment and subcontractor costs, as well as reviewing site conditions and project requirements. Civil Engineering Estimators support project planning and financial control by assessing cost risks, advising on pricing strategies and ensuring proposals are accurate, competitive and aligned with technical and regulatory requirements.
tasks: Review and interpret civil engineering drawings, specifications, and tender documents. Calculate quantities of materials and labour required for construction projects. Prepare detailed cost estimates, budgets, and bills of quantities. Analyse subcontractor and supplier quotations. Collaborate with project managers, engineers, and procurement teams to obtain cost information and clarify project requirements. Attend pre-bid meetings and site inspections. Maintain and update cost databases and historical project data. Monitor market prices for materials and labour. Ensure cost estimates comply with design specifications, legislation, and industry standards.

They conduct analyses to identify (alternative) cost effective technical designs and production processes. They develop and use methods and tools for cost planning, controlling and analysis. They also perform quantitative and qualitative risk analyses and report on the development of costs.

candidates.title: construction engineer
candidates.description: Construction engineers interpret building designs and add technical specifications to construction projects. They integrate engineering principles into the designs to ensure that structures are safe and resistant. candidates.title: rail project engineer
candidates.description: Rail project engineers maintain a safe, cost-effective, high-quality, and environmentally responsible approach across the technical projects in railway companies. They provide project management advice on all construction projects including testing, commissioning and site supervision. They audit contractors for safety, environment and quality of design, process and performance as to ensure that all projects follow in-house standards and relevant legislation.

candidates.title: tooling engineer
candidates.description: Tooling engineers design new tools for manufacturing equipment. They prepare tooling quotation requests. They estimate costs and delivery time, manage tooling construction follow-up and supervise the routine maintenance of tools. They also analyse data to determine the cause of major tooling difficulties and develop recommendations and action plans for solutions.

candidates.title: geological engineer
candidates.description: Geological engineers apply geological knowledge for the assessment of sites, soils, slope stability, sediments and other observable characteristics in the Earth. They integrate this information in the planning and development of projects in those places. They assess and answer questions concerning the geological characteristics of soils by performing research and experiments on the sites aimed to be intervened.

description: Engineering Designer develops and refines detailed designs for products, machinery, systems or structures in accordance with engineering specifications and regulatory requirements. The role involves preparing technical drawings, models and documentation, and working closely with engineers and other stakeholders to ensure designs are technically feasible, cost-effective and suitable for production or construction. Engineering Designers contribute to product development, improvement and quality assurance across a range of engineering projects.
tasks: Develop detailed two-dimensional and three-dimensional engineering drawings and models using Computer-Aided Design (CAD) software. Collaborate with engineers and project teams to convert concepts into manufacturable designs. Conduct design reviews and revise designs based on feedback, testing, and client requirements. Prepare technical documentation, including specifications, assembly instructions, and material lists. Ensure designs comply with relevant industry and organisational standards. Assist in building and testing prototypes to validate designs. Coordinate with manufacturing and quality control teams to support the resolution of design-related issues. Provide design support during prototyping and testing phases. Stay updated on new design tools, technologies, and engineering best practices.

candidates.title: design engineer
candidates.description: Design engineers develop new conceptual and detailed designs. They create the look for these concepts or products and the systems used to make them. Design engineers work with engineers and marketers to enhance the functioning and efficiency of existing devices.

candidates.title: industrial designer
candidates.description: Industrial designers work out ideas and develop them into designs and concepts for a wide variety of manufactured products. They integrate creativity, aesthetics, production feasibility, and market relevance in the design of new products.

candidates.title: construction engineer

candidates.title: engine designer
candidates.description: Engine designers carry out engineering duties in designing mechanical equipment such as machines and all types of engines. They also supervise their installation and maintenance.

candidates.title: manufacturing engineer
candidates.description: Manufacturing engineers design manufacturing processes for different kinds of production processes. They integrate those specificities and constraints posed by the industry or the product being produced with general and wide-spread manufacturing engineering principles into the design and planification of manufacturing processes.

description: Tunnel Boring Machine Technician operates, maintains and troubleshoots tunnel boring machines used in underground construction projects. The role ensures continuous and safe excavation by monitoring machine performance, conducting inspections, carrying out preventive and corrective maintenance, and diagnosing mechanical or electrical faults. They support the installation and dismantling of equipment, coordinate with engineering personnel to optimise operational performance, and ensure compliance with safety requirements and project schedules.

Troubleshoot and repair mechanical or electronic faults to minimise downtime. Monitor TBM data systems and adjust operational parameters as required. Assist engineers and site supervisors in machine movements and excavation activities. Provide on-the-job guidance to junior technicians and operators on TBM operations and safety procedures. Assist with assembly, disassembly, and relocation of TBMs at tunnel sites. Follow occupational health and safety standards, design specifications, and regulations. Maintain accurate maintenance and operational logs.

candidates.title: tunnel boring machine operator
candidates.description: Tunnel boring machine operators work on large pieces of tunnelling equipment commonly known as TBMs. They regulate the operation of the machine, adjusting the torque of the rotating cutting wheel and screw conveyor to maximise stability of the tunnel before tunnel rings are installed. Tunnel boring machine operators then put the reinforced concrete rings in place using remote controls.

candidates.title: boring machine operator
candidates.description: Boring machine operators prepare, operate, and maintain single or multiple spindle machines using a boring bar with a hardened, rotary, multipointed cutting tool in order to enlarge an existing hole in a fabricated workpiece.

candidates.description: Wood boring machine operators use milling machines or specialise boring jigs to cut holes in wood workpieces. Wood boring differs from routing mainly in that the main movement is into the workpiece as opposed to across its surface.
