description: Building Inspector inspects construction works and completed structures to ensure compliance with approved plans, building codes, regulations and safety standards. The role involves assessing structural integrity, materials and workmanship at various stages of construction, monitoring site conditions, and verifying that works meet contractual and statutory requirements. Building Inspectors prepare inspection reports, recommend corrective actions, and liaise with contractors, consultants and relevant authorities to safeguard quality, public safety and regulatory compliance.
tasks: Inspect construction sites at various stages to ensure compliance with approved plans, building codes, regulations, and safety standards. Verify the quality, quantity, and standards of materials used and workmanship performed. Measure and check dimensions, levels, and alignment of structures using appropriate tools and equipment. Identify defects, safety hazards, or non-compliance issues and recommend corrective actions. Maintain accurate records of inspections, tests, site activities, and progress reports. Coordinate with contractors, engineers, architects, clients, and regulatory agencies to ensure compliance with project requirements. Perform or assist in field and laboratory testing of construction materials and soils. Report violations, risks, or non-compliance issues to relevant authorities and provide guidance for corrective measures.

candidates.title: building inspector
candidates.description: Building inspectors perform inspections of buildings to determine compliance with specifications for various focuses of assessment. They observe and determine the suitability of construction, quality and resistance, and general compliance with regulations.

candidates.title: construction safety inspector
candidates.description: Construction safety inspectors monitor construction sites and their conformity to health and safety regulations. They perform inspections, identify safety hazards and report on their findings.

candidates.title: construction quality inspector
candidates.description: Construction quality inspectors monitor the activities at larger construction sites to make sure everything happens according to standards and specifications. They pay close attention to potential safety problems and take samples of products to test for conformity with standards and specifications.

candidates.title: bridge inspector
candidates.description: Bridge inspectors inspect bridge structures for joint break, cracks, rust and other faults. They also carry out or organise the maintenance of the structures.

candidates.title: government planning inspector
candidates.description: Government planning inspectors monitor the development and implementation of government plans and policies, as well as processing planning and policy proposals, and performing inspections of planning procedures.

candidates.title: utilities inspector
candidates.description: Utilities inspectors examine products, systems and machiney such as sewer, water, gas or electric turbines ensuring they are built and functioning according to regulations. They write inspection reports and provide recommendations to improve the systems and repair the broken components.

candidates.title: fire inspector
candidates.description: Fire inspectors conduct inspections of buildings and properties to ensure they are compliant with fire prevention and safety regulations, and enforce the regulations in facilities which are not compliant. They also perform educational activities, educating the public on fire safety and prevention methods, policies, and disaster response.

candidates.title: welding inspector
candidates.description: Welding inspectors examine the connections and bonds between metals. They utilise visual tools and electrical instruments to inspect and ensure the quality and safety of connections. Welding inspectors ensure that all related welding activities, plans and materials follow the appropriate guidelines, in accordance with safety regulations. In addition to working in the field completing their examinations of welding projects, inspectors spend time in an office setting compiling their reports.

description: Geotechnical Technician conducts field and laboratory investigations to assess soil, rock and groundwater conditions in support of the planning and design of buildings, infrastructure and earthworks. They collect and test samples, assist with site investigations, record and interpret data, and prepare technical documentation to inform geotechnical analysis and design. Their work supports engineers in evaluating ground stability, managing geological hazards, and ensuring that foundations and related works meet safety, technical and regulatory requirements.

Ensure compliance with site safety procedures and proper handling of hazardous materials during field and laboratory work.

description: Port Master/Dockmaster manages and oversees the docking, undocking, maintenance, and repair of ships, ensuring safe and efficient port operations. They coordinate with ship crews, supervise dock personnel, plan and execute dry-docking and related projects, and ensure compliance with safety, environmental, and regulatory standards while supporting operational and strategic activities within port facilities.

Inspect dock facilities and coordinate maintenance, repairs, and upgrades as required. Manage project timelines, budgets, and documentation for docking operations. Liaise with classification societies and maritime authorities to ensure compliance and operational requirements.

candidates.title: port coordinator
candidates.description: Port coordinators manage operations of traffic division for port authorities. They enforce rules and regulations, such as the berthing of ships, handling and storing of cargo, and the use of port facilities. They direct policing and cleaning activities of the harbour department land, streets, buildings, and water areas. Port coordinators also ensure that activities concerning revenue are documented and submitted to the accounting division. They advise port authorities on rates and revisions of port tariff, and solicit steamship companies to use port facilities. They direct activities concerned with compiling daily and annual ship and cargo statistics.

candidates.title: fisheries boatmaster
candidates.description: Fisheries boatmasters operate fishing vessels in coastal waters performing operations at the deck and engine. They control the navigation as well as capture and conservation of fish within the established boundaries in compliance with national and international regulations.

candidates.title: fisheries master
candidates.description: Fisheries masters plan, manage and execute the activities of fishing vessels inshore, coastal and offshore waters. They direct and control the navigation. Fisheries masters can operate on ships of 500 gross tonnage or more. They control the loading, unloading and stevedoring, as well as the collection, handling, processing and preservation of fishing.

candidates.title: maritime water transport general manager
candidates.description: Maritime water transport general managers coordinate the administrative activities that go with the management of vessels in the context of maritime water transport. They prepare vessels, check availability, liaise with clients, manage budgets, and oversee operations from an economic standpoint, following regulation for maritime operations.

candidates.title: container equipment assembly supervisor
candidates.description: Container equipment assembly supervisors monitor the assembly process of containers such as boilers or pressure vessels. They train and coach the workers involved in the assembly to achieve production goals.

candidates.title: deck officer
candidates.description: Deck officers or mates perform the watch duties on board of vessels like determining the course and speed, manoeuvring to avoid hazards, and continuously monitoring the vessels position using charts and navigational aids. They maintain logs and other records tracking the ship's movements. They ensure that the proper procedures and safety practices are followed, check that equipment is in good working order, and oversee the loading and discharging of cargo or passengers. They supervise crew members engaged in maintenance and the primary upkeep of the vessel.

candidates.title: fleet commander
candidates.description: Fleet commanders ensure that naval vessels are ready for inclusion in operations, and are maintained in compliance with rules and regulations. They also supervise naval personnel and are responsible for the operations of the naval service.

candidates.title: boat rigger

Report defects or unusual findings to supervisors for further action. Maintain inventory of hoses and fittings to support efficient job completion. Assist in supervising or coordinating hydraulic system maintenance tasks when needed.

candidates.title: fluid power technician
candidates.description: Fluid power technicians install and assemble equipment that uses liquid or gas pressure to transmit or regulate power. They also perform tests on and maintain this equipment.

candidates.title: irrigation technician

candidates.title: mechanical engineering technician

candidates.description: Water systems engineering technicians aid engineers in the development and implementation of water supply and water treatment systems. They test the equipment and advise on the use and care of appliances and systems which use gas energy.

candidates.title: pneumatic systems technician

candidates.title: drain technician
candidates.description: Drain technicians install and maintain drainage equipment used in sewer systems, such as pipes and valves. They analyse the design and ensure the proper installation of the drainage system, and perform maintenance and repair duties.

They are able to manage high complex technical and professional activities or projects related to welding applications, while also taking responsibility for the decision making process.

In addition to working in the field completing their examinations of welding projects, inspectors spend time in an office setting compiling their reports.

candidates.title: welder

candidates.description: Metallurgical technicians provide technical support in researching and performing experiments on minerals, metals, alloys, oil and gas. They also assist in improving the methods of extraction.

They may also assist in the designing of pipelines, analyse soil and write reports on technical issues.

candidates.description: Production engineering technicians plan production, follow up production processes and develop and test solutions to solve technical problems. They work closely with engineers and technologists, inspect products, conduct tests, and collect data.

candidates.title: industrial engineering technician

candidates.title: mechanical engineering technician
candidates.description: Mechanical engineering technicians provide technical support to mechanical engineers in producing and manufacturing mechanical machinery. Monitor hygiene conditions through routine checks and report any deviations or hazards. Maintain cleaning schedules and ensure accurate records of cleaning activities are updated. description: Mechatronics Engineering Assistant supports the design, development, testing, and maintenance of mechatronic systems that integrate mechanical, electronic, and software components. They assist engineers in assembling and programming automated systems, configuring industrial controls such as PLCs and SCADA, conducting system testing, troubleshooting technical issues, and improving operational efficiency, spanning research, prototype development, and on-site support to ensure machines and automated processes operate safely and consistently.
tasks: Assist in programming, configuring, calibrating, and testing Programmable Logic Controllers (PLCs), Human-Machine Interfaces (HMIs), and industrial control systems. Support the integration of Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) and automation systems, and assist in commissioning activities. Perform routine maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair of electromechanical and automated machinery. Prepare and update technical documentation, including reports, schematic diagrams, and records of system changes. Work with engineers and production teams to support process improvements and system enhancements. Assist in conducting equipment testing, quality checks, and validation of system performance. Support monitoring of mechanical and automation plant operations and assist in maintenance activities.

candidates.title: mechatronics engineer
candidates.description: Mechatronics engineers design and develop intelligent systems, such as robotic devices, smart home appliances, and aeroplanes, through combining technologies from mechanical, electronic, computer, and control engineering. They create blueprints or design documents for parts, assemblies or finished products using software programs, and also oversee and manage projects.

candidates.title: mechatronics engineering technician
candidates.description: Mechatronics engineering technicians collaborate with engineers in the development of mechatronic devices and applications through a combination of mechanical engineering, electronic engineering, and computer engineering. They build, test, install, and calibrate mechatronics and solve technical problems.

candidates.title: engineering assistant
candidates.description: Engineering assistants ensure the administration and monitoring of technical and engineering files for projects, assignments, and quality matters. They assist engineers with their experiments, participate in site visits, and administer the collection of information.

candidates.title: mechatronics assembler
candidates.description: Mechatronics assemblers assemble and maintain complex mechatronic equipment and machines, such as robots, elevators, and advanced home appliances. They build the mechanical, electrical, and electronic components, install software, set the systems in operation, and maintain and repair the components and systems.

candidates.title: marine mechatronics technician
candidates.description: Marine mechatronics technicians work on shipyards and vessels to configure and optimize industrial mechatronic systems and plans, supervise and execute their assembly and maintenance.

candidates.title: automation engineering technician
candidates.description: Automation engineering technicians collaborate with automation engineers in the development of applications and systems for the automation of the production process. Automation engineering technicians build, test, monitor, and maintain the computer-controlled systems used in automated production systems.

candidates.title: microsystem engineering technician
candidates.description: Microsystem engineering technicians collaborate with micro-system engineers in the development of microsystems or microelectromechanical systems (MEMS) devices, which can be integrated in mechanical, optical, acoustic, and electronic products. Microsystem engineering technicians are responsible for building, testing, and maintaining the microsystems.

candidates.title: equipment engineer
candidates.description: Equipment engineers design and maintain the machinery and equipment in manufacturing facilities. They design machinery that adjusts to the manufacturing requirements and processes. Moreover, they envision the maintenance of the machines and equipment for uninterrupted functioning.

description: CAD/CAM (Computer-Aided Design and Manufacturing) Technician supports the design, development, and production of machinery, equipment, and components using CAD and CAM software. They create, modify, and optimise 2D and 3D models, develop CNC programs, and translate engineering concepts into precise technical drawings and machining instructions, collaborating with engineers and production teams, maintaining documentation, troubleshooting CAD/CAM systems, and ensuring accuracy and efficiency in manufacturing processes.
tasks: Read and interpret blueprints, sketches, and technical drawings. Develop, modify, and maintain 2D and 3D Computer-Aided Design (CAD) models based on engineering specifications. Create and adjust Computer-Aided Manufacturing (CAM) programs for Computer Numerical Control (CNC) machining processes. Work with engineers, draftsmen, and designers to support manufacturing processes and workflow improvements. Prepare technical drawings and documentation for production use. Conduct machining simulations and troubleshoot CAD/CAM issues to verify process accuracy. Maintain CAD/CAM databases and libraries, and ensure data is updated and organised. Follow quality and safety standards in all CAD/CAM and machining-related activities. Support rapid prototyping and continuous improvement activities in manufacturing processes.

candidates.title: clothing CAD technician
candidates.description: Clothing CAD technicians use software to create design plans for clothing products. They work in 2D design which is known as surface modelling, or 3D design which is called solid modelling. They use surface modelling to draw a flat representation of the clothing product. In solid modelling, they create a 3D display of a structure or component in order to take a virtual look of the clothing product.

candidates.title: cadastral technician
candidates.description: Cadastral technicians design and create maps and blue-prints, converting new measurement results into the real estate cadastre of a community. They define and indicate the property boundaries and ownerships, land use, and create city and district maps using measurement equipment and specialised software.

candidates.title: computer-aided design operator
candidates.description: Computer-aided design operators use computer hardware and software in order to add the technical dimensions to computer aided design drawings. Computer-aided design operators ensure all additional aspects of the created images of products are accurate and realistic. They also calculate the amount of materials needed to manufacture the products. Later the finalised digital design is processed by computer-aided manufacturing machines that produce the finished product.

candidates.title: computer hardware engineering technician
candidates.description: Computer hardware engineering technicians collaborate with computer hardware engineers in the development of computer hardware, such as motherboards, routers, and microprocessors. Computer hardware engineering technicians are responsible for building, testing, monitoring, and maintaining the developed computer technology.

candidates.title: automotive engineering technician
candidates.description: Automotive engineering technicians work with automotive engineers to operate, repair, maintain and test equipment used in motor vehicles. In some environments, such as an airport they are responsible for keeping equipment and vehicles serviceable. They review blueprints and designs to determine test specifications and procedures. Automotive engineering technicians use software to make sure that parts of a motor vehicle are functioning properly. They record test procedures and results, and make recommendations for changes.

candidates.title: computer hardware repair technician
candidates.description: Computer hardware repair technicians install, examine, test and repair computer hardware and peripheral components. They test computers' functionality, identify the problems and replace damaged components and parts.

candidates.title: surveying technician
candidates.description: Surveying technicians carry out technical surveying tasks. They assist surveyors, architects or engineers in surveying related technical tasks such as mapping land, creating construction drawings and operating precise measuring equipment.

candidates.title: civil engineering technician
candidates.description: Civil engineering technicians help design and execute construction plans and take on organisational tasks, for example in the planning and monitoring, and in bidding and invoicing of construction work. They also calculate material requirements, and help with the purchasing and organising, and ensure the quality of the construction materials. Civil engineering technicians may perform technical tasks in civil engineering and develop and advise on policy implementing strategies for road works, traffic lights, sewerage and water management systems.

description: Equipment Technician installs, maintains and repairs machinery, instruments and related systems to ensure safe, reliable and efficient operation. The role involves conducting routine inspections, preventive maintenance and calibration, diagnosing faults, adjusting and testing equipment, and restoring systems in accordance with technical specifications and standards. Equipment Technicians interpret technical drawings and manuals, maintain maintenance and calibration records, and work with engineering and quality personnel to support operational and regulatory requirements across industrial and laboratory settings.
tasks: Conduct routine maintenance, inspection, and calibration of machinery and equipment to ensure proper performance. Diagnose and repair mechanical, electrical, and instrumentation faults using appropriate tools and equipment. Install, configure, and calibrate equipment according to technical specifications. Maintain accurate records of maintenance, repairs, calibration activities, and parts usage. Work with engineers, production, and technical staff to support troubleshooting and issue resolution. Follow safety regulations, company policies, and calibration standards during all maintenance activities. Manage inventory of spare parts, tools, and calibration instruments to ensure availability.

candidates.title: performance rental technician
candidates.description: Performance rental technicians prepare, maintain, issue, transport, set‐up, program, operate, take in, check, clean and store audiovisual, performance and event equipment. Their work is based on plans, instructions and order forms.

candidates.title: construction equipment technician
candidates.description: Construction equipment technicians inspect, maintain and repair heavy-duty vehicles used in construction, forestry and earthworks such as bulldozers, excavators and harvesters. They perform evaluations of the equipment, and ensure the safety and optimal efficiency of the machinery.

candidates.title: forge equipment technician
candidates.description: Forge equipment technicians maintain and repair forge machinery such as presses and material handling equipment. They perform evaluations of the equipment, perform preventative maintenance activities, and repair faults. They also assist in the installation of the equipment and ensure proper functionality.

candidates.title: office equipment repair technician
candidates.description: Office equipment repair technicians provide services to businesses related to installing, maintaining and repairing new or existing equipment such as printers, scanners and modems, on the clients' premises. They keep records of performed services and return equipment to a repair centre if needed.

candidates.title: sports equipment repair technician
candidates.description: Sports equipment repair technicians maintain and repair recreational sports equipment such as tennis rackets, archery tools and camping equipment. They use specialised hand tools or mechanical tools to restore damaged parts.

candidates.title: instrument technician
candidates.description: Instrument technicians assist and support musicians before, during and after the performance to ensure the instruments and the connected equipment, the backline, are setup properly. They maintain, check, tune and repair instruments and assist with quick changes.

candidates.title: equipment engineer
candidates.description: Equipment engineers design and maintain the machinery and equipment in manufacturing facilities. They design machinery that adjusts to the manufacturing requirements and processes. Moreover, they envision the maintenance of the machines and equipment for uninterrupted functioning.

candidates.title: electronics engineering technician
candidates.description: Electronics engineering technicians work closely with electronics engineers in the development of electronic equipment and devices. Electronics engineering technicians are responsible for building, testing, and maintaining electronic devices.

description: Assistant Equipment Engineer supports mechanical engineering activities related to the design, installation, operation and maintenance of machinery and mechanical equipment across industrial settings such as manufacturing, construction, oil and gas, and utilities. The role assists senior engineers in planning maintenance programmes, conducting inspections, troubleshooting equipment faults, coordinating with vendors and contractors, and preparing technical documentation to ensure safe, reliable and efficient equipment performance. They may also contribute to quality control processes and provide guidance to operators on proper equipment use and safety practices.
tasks: Assist in installation, commissioning, and routine maintenance of machinery and equipment. Conduct routine and preventive maintenance checks to ensure equipment reliability. Diagnose and troubleshoot mechanical and electrical faults under supervision. Support senior engineers in monitoring and assisting with equipment operations. Maintain accurate records and reports on equipment status and maintenance activities. Coordinate with vendors and service providers for repairs and spare parts. Ensure compliance with safety and environmental regulations. Assist in training operators on proper equipment handling and safety procedures.

candidates.title: equipment engineer
candidates.description: Equipment engineers design and maintain the machinery and equipment in manufacturing facilities. They design machinery that adjusts to the manufacturing requirements and processes. Moreover, they envision the maintenance of the machines and equipment for uninterrupted functioning.

candidates.title: engineering assistant
candidates.description: Engineering assistants ensure the administration and monitoring of technical and engineering files for projects, assignments, and quality matters. They assist engineers with their experiments, participate in site visits, and administer the collection of information.

candidates.title: ship assistant engineer
candidates.description: Ship assistant engineers assist the ship chief engineer and the ship duty engineer in the operations of the ship's hull. They support the operation of the main engines, steering mechanism, electrical generation and other major subsystems. They communicate with maritime engineers about the performance of technical operations. They also ensure appropriate safety and regulatory standards compliance and are able to take on higher level positions if needed.

candidates.title: construction equipment technician
candidates.description: Construction equipment technicians inspect, maintain and repair heavy-duty vehicles used in construction, forestry and earthworks such as bulldozers, excavators and harvesters. They perform evaluations of the equipment, and ensure the safety and optimal efficiency of the machinery.

candidates.title: fisheries assistant engineer
candidates.description: Fisheries assistant engineers assist the marine chief engineer with checking operations and maintenance of the propulsion plant, machinery and auxiliary equipment of the ship. They collaborate on security, survival and health care on board, observing the national and international standards of application.

candidates.title: office equipment repair technician
candidates.description: Office equipment repair technicians provide services to businesses related to installing, maintaining and repairing new or existing equipment such as printers, scanners and modems, on the clients' premises. They keep records of performed services and return equipment to a repair centre if needed.

candidates.title: electronic equipment inspector
candidates.description: Electronic equipment inspectors check electronic equipment for any defects and malfunctions. They ensure that the equipment is correctly assembled according to specifications and national and international regulations.

candidates.title: maintenance and repair engineer
candidates.description: Maintenance and repair engineers focus on the optimization of equipment, procedures, machineries and infrastructure. They ensure their maximum availability at minimum costs.

description: Assistant Welding Engineer supports the planning, coordination and supervision of welding operations across sectors such as manufacturing, construction, oil and gas, shipbuilding and automotive. The role assists in developing and implementing welding procedures, monitoring compliance with relevant codes and safety standards, and conducting inspection and quality control of welded work to ensure it meets technical specifications. Assistant Welding Engineers also contribute to troubleshooting, documentation and continuous improvement initiatives, working closely with design, production and quality personnel to support efficient and compliant welding activities.
tasks: Assist in creating, reviewing, and maintaining welding procedures and specifications according to standards. Monitor welding activities to ensure compliance with safety and quality requirements. Conduct pre-welding checks and prepare materials for welding operations. Perform supervised Non-Destructive Testing (NDT) including ultrasonic, magnetic particle, dye penetrant, or radiographic inspection. Assist in investigating weld defects and supporting failure analysis under guidance. Prepare technical reports and maintain accurate welding records. Coordinate with suppliers and vendors for welding consumables and equipment.

candidates.title: welding engineer
candidates.description: Welding engineers research and develop optimal effective welding techniques and design the corresponding, equally efficient equipment to aid in the welding process. They also conduct quality control and evaluate inspection procedures for welding activities. Welding engineers have advanced knowledge and critical understanding of welding technology application. They are able to manage high complex technical and professional activities or projects related to welding applications, while also taking responsibility for the decision making process.

candidates.title: welding inspector
candidates.description: Welding inspectors examine the connections and bonds between metals. They utilise visual tools and electrical instruments to inspect and ensure the quality and safety of connections. Welding inspectors ensure that all related welding activities, plans and materials follow the appropriate guidelines, in accordance with safety regulations. In addition to working in the field completing their examinations of welding projects, inspectors spend time in an office setting compiling their reports.

candidates.title: welding coordinator
candidates.description: Welding coordinators supervise the workflow of welding applications. They monitor welding processes performed by other welders, supervise the staff, being sometimes responsible for vocational training. They also weld particularly demanding parts. Welding coordinators ensure that the necessary welding equipment is ready for usage. They mostly coordinate welding applications and related professional activities.

candidates.title: welder
candidates.description: Welders operate welding equipment in order to join metal workpieces together. They can use fusion welding processes based on different techniques and materials. They also perform simple visual inspection of welds.

candidates.title: ship assistant engineer
candidates.description: Ship assistant engineers assist the ship chief engineer and the ship duty engineer in the operations of the ship's hull. They support the operation of the main engines, steering mechanism, electrical generation and other major subsystems. They communicate with maritime engineers about the performance of technical operations. They also ensure appropriate safety and regulatory standards compliance and are able to take on higher level positions if needed.

candidates.title: engineering assistant
candidates.description: Engineering assistants ensure the administration and monitoring of technical and engineering files for projects, assignments, and quality matters. They assist engineers with their experiments, participate in site visits, and administer the collection of information.

candidates.title: spot welder
candidates.description: Spot welders set up and tend spot welding machines designed to press and join metal workpieces together. The metal resistance to the passage of electrical current and the subsequent heat created in the process allows for the local melting and joining of the parts.

candidates.title: pipe welder
candidates.description: Pipe welders assemble and install parts and components of pipelines for the transport of goods such as water, steam and chemicals through them. They interpret specs such as pneumatics, hydraulics, for installation on site according to the safety and production requirements.

description: AutoCAD Designer prepares detailed 2D and 3D technical drawings and design documentation to support mechanical, architectural, engineering, manufacturing and construction projects. The role translates design concepts, specifications and calculations into accurate plans, blueprints and schematics that guide fabrication, installation and construction activities. AUTOCAD Designers ensure drawings comply with technical standards and regulatory requirements while supporting project planning and coordination with relevant technical personnel.
tasks: Create detailed technical drawings from design concepts and engineering calculations. Design and prepare layouts for machinery and mechanical equipment installations. Revise and update drawings based on engineering changes and project feedback. Convert rough sketches into accurate Computer-Aided Design (CAD) drawings. Coordinate with project teams to ensure accuracy and compliance of drawings. Ensure designs adhere to industry standards and building codes. Perform quality checks on CAD drawings to identify errors or inconsistencies. Support engineers in preparing technical documentation related to CAD drawings. Maintain a digital repository of design documents.

candidates.title: automotive designer
candidates.description: Automotive designers create model designs in 2D or 3D and prepare isometric drawings and graphics. They work closely with computer hardware engineers to develop hardware designs for the next generation of automotive applications including advanced driver-assistance and vehicle-to-everything systems. They re-evaluate vehicle design, materials and manufacturing technologies, anticipating changes to vehicle architecture and power management, vehicle features and seating functionality and safety.

candidates.title: user interface designer
candidates.description: User interface designers are in charge of designing user interfaces for applications and systems. They perform layout, graphics and dialogues design activities as well as adaptation activities.

candidates.title: computer-aided design operator
candidates.description: Computer-aided design operators use computer hardware and software in order to add the technical dimensions to computer aided design drawings. Computer-aided design operators ensure all additional aspects of the created images of products are accurate and realistic. They also calculate the amount of materials needed to manufacture the products. Later the finalised digital design is processed by computer-aided manufacturing machines that produce the finished product.

candidates.title: clothing CAD technician
candidates.description: Clothing CAD technicians use software to create design plans for clothing products. They work in 2D design which is known as surface modelling, or 3D design which is called solid modelling. They use surface modelling to draw a flat representation of the clothing product. In solid modelling, they create a 3D display of a structure or component in order to take a virtual look of the clothing product.

candidates.title: set designer
candidates.description: Set designers develop a set concept for a performance and supervise the execution of it. Their work is based on research and artistic vision. Their design is influenced by and influences other designs and must be conform with these designs and the overall artistic vision. Therefore, the designers work closely with artistic directors, operators and the artistic team. During rehearsals and performance they coach the operators to obtain optimal timing and manipulation. Set designers develop sketches, design drawings, models, plans or other documentation to support the workshop and performance crew. They may also design exhibition stands for fairs and other events.

candidates.title: clothing CAD patternmaker
candidates.description: Clothing CAD patternmakers design, evaluate, adjust and modify patterns, cutting plans and technical files for all kinds of wearing apparel using CAD systems, acting as interfaces with digital printing, cutting and assembly operations, being aware of the technical requirements on quality, manufacturability and cost assessment.

candidates.title: industrial designer
candidates.description: Industrial designers work out ideas and develop them into designs and concepts for a wide variety of manufactured products. They integrate creativity, aesthetics, production feasibility, and market relevance in the design of new products.

candidates.title: graphic designer
candidates.description: Graphic designers create text and images to communicate ideas. They make visual concepts by hand or using computer software, intended for publishing in paper or online media such as advertisements, websites, and magazines.

description: Pneumatic Supervisor oversees the installation, maintenance and troubleshooting of pneumatic systems, including compressed air equipment, to ensure safe, reliable and efficient operation in accordance with relevant standards. The role involves planning and coordinating maintenance activities, supervising technicians, diagnosing system faults, and recommending design improvements or modifications to enhance performance and operational efficiency.
tasks: Supervise the installation, operation, and maintenance of pneumatic systems. Conduct regular inspections and troubleshoot pneumatic equipment issues. Coordinate with engineering and production teams to ensure system efficiency. Maintain records of maintenance activities and system performance. Ensure compliance with safety standards and regulations. Assist in preparing layouts for machine and equipment installations. Support supervision of maintenance and repair of mechanical plants and engines. Train and mentor junior technicians in pneumatic system operations.

candidates.title: pneumatic engineering technician
candidates.description: Pneumatic engineering technicians evaluate operating pneumatic systems and assemblies such as compressed air machines, and recommend modifications for more efficiency. They are also involved in the design of pneumatic systems and components such as circuits.

candidates.title: pneumatic systems technician
candidates.description: Pneumatic systems technicians use blueprints and technical documentation to assemble and install equipment operated by gas or air under pressure. They set up the systems according to engineering specifications and test them to ensure good functioning order. They may also perform maintenance and repair work on installed pneumatic equipment.

candidates.title: machine operator supervisor
candidates.description: Machine operator supervisors coordinate and direct workers who set up and operate machines. They monitor the production process and the flow of materials, and they make sure that the products meet the requirements.

candidates.title: industrial maintenance supervisor
candidates.description: Industrial maintenance supervisors organise and supervise the activities and maintenance operations of machines, systems and equipment. They ensure inspections are done according to health, safety and environmental standards, and productivity and quality requirements.

candidates.title: precision mechanics supervisor
candidates.description: Precision mechanics supervisors oversee, train and manage workers who fit together complex parts of small-size machines such as measuring or control mechanisms.

candidates.title: gas processing plant supervisor
candidates.description: Gas processing plant supervisors supervise the processing of gas for utility and energy services by controlling compressors and other processing equipment to ensure standard operation. They supervise the maintenance of the equipment, and perform tests to detect problems or deviations, and to ensure quality.

candidates.title: rigging supervisor
candidates.description: Rigging supervisors oversee rigging operations. They manage and coordinate employees who operate lifting and rigging equipment. They organise the day-to-day working activities.

candidates.title: industrial assembly supervisor
candidates.description: Industrial assembly supervisors are in charge of organizing, planning and coordinating assembly operations. They keep track of all the work activities and manage the process for efficient functioning in order to tackle problems such as production loss. They answer to the industrial production and the manufacturing manager.

description: Repair and Maintenance (R&M) Technician is responsible for inspecting, servicing, and repairing machinery, equipment, and building systems to ensure their safe and efficient operation. The role involves diagnosing mechanical or electrical faults, carrying out preventive maintenance, replacing defective components, and maintaining accurate maintenance records to minimise downtime and extend asset lifespan. R&M Technicians work across industrial and commercial settings, collaborating with engineers or supervisors to support operational continuity and compliance with safety and quality standards.
tasks: Inspect and assess machinery and equipment for wear, damage, or malfunctions. Perform preventive maintenance, including lubrication, cleaning, adjustments, and part replacement. Diagnose mechanical, electrical, and electronic faults using diagnostic tools and manuals. Repair or replace defective components or systems to restore equipment functionality. Perform routine calibration and testing of machinery to ensure performance and safety. Read and interpret technical drawings, schematics, blueprints, and manuals. Maintain accurate maintenance logs, records, and reports. Assist in mentoring operators on basic troubleshooting, maintenance, and safe equipment use.

candidates.title: microelectronics maintenance technician
candidates.description: Microelectronics maintenance technicians are responsible for carrying out preventive and corrective activities and troubleshooting of microelectronic systems and devices. They diagnose and detect malfunctions in microelectronic systems, products, and components and remove, replace, or repair these components when necessary. They execute preventative equipment maintenance tasks.

candidates.title: road maintenance technician
candidates.description: Road maintenance technicians inspect and manage roads in enclosed areas for maintenance and repair. They help to relieve traffic safely and smoothly, and check if traffic signs, roads and pavements are in good condition.

candidates.title: aircraft maintenance technician
candidates.description: Aircraft maintenance technicians perform preventive maintenance to aircrafts, aircraft components, engines and assemblies, such as airframes and hydraulic and pneumatic systems. They perform inspections following strict protocols and aviation laws.

candidates.title: rail maintenance technician
candidates.description: Rail maintenance technicians execute routine inspections of railway tracks, powerlines, signage stations, switches, and other railway infrastructure. They are also sent out to repair defects quickly, safely, and at any time of the day or night.

candidates.title: office equipment repair technician
candidates.description: Office equipment repair technicians provide services to businesses related to installing, maintaining and repairing new or existing equipment such as printers, scanners and modems, on the clients' premises. They keep records of performed services and return equipment to a repair centre if needed.

candidates.title: consumer electronics repair technician
candidates.description: Consumer electronics repair technicians use electrical equipment to diagnose malfunctions and test functionality of consumer electronics such as TVs, video and audio systems and digital cameras. They read manufacturers' instructions and conduct the necessary repairs or replacements.

candidates.title: battery maintenance technician
candidates.description: Battery maintenance technicians are responsible for the maintenance and repair of the equipment used in the production of batteries. They work in battery manufacturing plants and are responsible for ensuring that the equipment is in good working order and is able to produce high-quality batteries. They need to have a strong understanding of mechanical, electrical, and control systems, as well as experience with maintenance and repair of manufacturing equipment.

candidates.title: airport maintenance technician
candidates.description: Airport maintenance technicians are in charge of the maintenance of all equipment necessary for ensuring the functionality of the airport, for example, visual aids, airport electrical systems, luggage systems, security systems, pavements, drainage, and maintenance of unpaved areas.

description: Optical Engineering Technician assists engineers in the design, development and testing of photonic systems and optical equipment, including precision instruments used in research and industrial applications. They assemble, install and calibrate optical components and systems, conduct testing and quality control procedures, and troubleshoot technical issues to ensure performance meets specified standards. The role also involves interpreting technical drawings, supporting research and development activities, and preparing technical documentation in compliance with safety and industry requirements.
tasks: Assist in the assembly and alignment of optical components and systems. Conduct performance testing and quality assurance on optical instruments. Calibrate optical devices and measuring equipment. Operate specialised software and tools for optical simulation and analysis under standard procedures. Assist in assembling eyeglasses from newly produced lenses. Manage machinery for grinding, cutting, and polishing lenses. Prepare technical documentation and reports. Maintain laboratory equipment and follow cleanroom protocols. Assist in troubleshooting and repairing optical devices.

candidates.title: optical technician
candidates.description: Optical technicians assemble, repair and design various parts of eyewear such as lenses, frames, patterns and eyewear. They cut, inspect, mount and polish all parts using various machinery and hand tools. Optical technicians shape, grind and coat lenses for prescription eyewear. They fit completed lenses into eyeglass frames. Optical technicians ensure that lenses conform to the dispensing optician’s, specialised doctor in ophtalmology's or optometrist's prescriptions. They may also work with other associated optical instrumentation and its maintenance.

candidates.title: optical engineer
candidates.description: Optical engineers design and develop different industrial applications with optics. They have knowledge of light, light transmission principles, and optics in order to design engineering specs of equipment such as microscopes, lenses, telescopes, and other optical devices.

candidates.title: photonics engineering technician
candidates.description: Photonics engineering technicians collaborate with engineers in the development of photonic systems or components, usually in the form of optical equipment, such as lasers, lenses, and fibre optic equipment. Photonics engineering technicians build, test, install and calibrate optical equipment. They read blueprint and other technical drawings to develop testing and calibrating procedures.

candidates.title: optomechanical engineering technician
candidates.description: Optomechanical engineering technicians collaborate with engineers in the development of optomechanical devices, such as optical tables, deformable mirrors, and optical mounts. Optomechanical engineering technicians build, install, test, and maintain optomechanical equipment prototypes. They determine materials and assembly requirements.

candidates.title: optoelectronic engineering technician
candidates.description: Optoelectronic engineering technicians collaborate with engineers in the development of optoelectronic systems and components, such as photodiodes, optical sensors, lasers and LED's. Optoelectronic engineering technicians build, test, install and calibrate optoelectronic equipment. They read blueprint and other technical drawings to develop testing and calibrating procedures.

candidates.title: computer hardware engineering technician
candidates.description: Computer hardware engineering technicians collaborate with computer hardware engineers in the development of computer hardware, such as motherboards, routers, and microprocessors. Computer hardware engineering technicians are responsible for building, testing, monitoring, and maintaining the developed computer technology.

candidates.title: mechanical engineering technician
candidates.description: Mechanical engineering technicians provide technical support to mechanical engineers in producing and manufacturing mechanical machinery. They help make designs and adjustments, and perform tests. They also develop layouts and drawings, collate and interpret data and write reports.

candidates.title: industrial engineering technician
candidates.description: Industrial engineering technicians assist industrial engineers in improving efficiency, safety and productivity in manufacturing plants. They conduct production studies, prepare layouts for machinery and equipment and suggest solutions to remedy quality problems.

description: Chemical Engineering Technician assists chemical engineers in the development, design, and operation of chemical processes across laboratories and industrial plants. They support production and quality control of chemicals, fuels, pharmaceuticals, food products, and other materials by monitoring equipment, conducting tests, collecting data, and troubleshooting technical issues, ensuring safe, efficient, and compliant operations while maintaining documentation, optimising processes, and supporting the scale-up of pilot projects to full production.
tasks: Assist in conducting laboratory and field tests to analyse product quality, chemical composition, and process performance. Assist in the setup, operation, routine maintenance, and basic repair of chemical plants, pilot equipment, and processing machinery. Collect, record, and assist in analysing process data such as temperature, pressure, and chemical measurements to support engineers. Monitor daily production processes and ensure operations comply with safety, environmental, and workplace regulations. Troubleshoot equipment malfunctions, operational problems, and process irregularities under supervision. Maintain, calibrate, and safely store instruments, testing devices, and laboratory equipment. Prepare, update, and maintain technical reports, logs, documentation, and process records.

candidates.title: chemical engineering technician
candidates.description: Chemical engineering technicians transform raw materials in order to develop and test chemical products. They also work on improving chemical plant operations and processes.

candidates.title: chemistry technician
candidates.description: Chemistry technicians monitor chemical processes and conduct tests to analyse chemical substances for manufacturing or scientific purposes. They work in laboratories or production facilities where they assist chemists in their work. Chemistry technicians perform laboratory activities, test chemical substances, analyse data and report about their work.

candidates.title: chemical manufacturing quality technician
candidates.description: Chemical manufacturing quality technicians perform inspections and precision measurements in order to test and ensure the quality of products, by using computer controlled machinery and systems.

candidates.title: chemical engineer
candidates.description: Chemical engineers design and develop large-scale chemical and physical production processes and are involved in the entire industrial process required for transforming raw materials into products.

candidates.title: biochemistry technician
candidates.description: Biochemistry technicians provide technical assistance in researching, analysing and testing the reactions caused by chemicals in living organisms. They use laboratory equipment to help develop or improve chemical-based products and also collect and analyse data for experiments, compile reports and maintain laboratory stock.

candidates.title: industrial engineering technician
candidates.description: Industrial engineering technicians assist industrial engineers in improving efficiency, safety and productivity in manufacturing plants. They conduct production studies, prepare layouts for machinery and equipment and suggest solutions to remedy quality problems.

candidates.title: production engineering technician
candidates.description: Production engineering technicians plan production, follow up production processes and develop and test solutions to solve technical problems. They work closely with engineers and technologists, inspect products, conduct tests, and collect data.

candidates.title: sensor engineering technician
candidates.description: Sensor engineering technicians collaborate with sensor engineers in the development of sensors, sensor systems, and products that are equipped with sensors. Their role is to build, test, maintain, and repair the sensor equipment.

description: Oil Technologist performs technical and supervisory tasks to support the operation, maintenance, and improvement of chemical and petroleum processing plants. They oversee the extraction, processing, and refinement of petroleum products, ensuring production efficiency, safety, and compliance with industry standards, monitoring equipment, analysing production data, troubleshooting issues, and coordinating with engineering and operational teams to optimise processes and output.
tasks: Monitor process parameters such as temperature, pressure, and flow rates to ensure efficient production. Conduct sampling and testing of crude oil and other products to maintain quality control. Assist in installation, operation, and routine maintenance of oil extraction and processing equipment. Assist in coordinating maintenance and repair activities to maintain equipment reliability. Ensure compliance with safety regulations and environmental policies.

candidates.title: petroleum engineer
candidates.description: Petroleum engineers evaluate gas and oil fields. They design and develop methods for extracting oil and gas from underneath the earth's surface. They maximise the recovery of hydrocarbon at a minimum cost, pursuing minimal impact on the environment.

candidates.title: oil and gas production manager
candidates.description: Oil and gas production managers coordinate and implement short and medium term oil and gas production schedules and plans, such as drilling, extraction operations and waste management. They steer one or more units and oversee the implementation of technical and human means, within the framework of objectives of volume, quality and planning. Oil and gas production managers design and ensure that the production plans and schedules are met.

candidates.title: food technologist
candidates.description: Food technologists develop processes for manufacturing foodstuffs and related products based on chemical, physical, and biological principles and technology. They design and plan layouts or equipment, oversee staff, engage in controlling, and improve food technologies in food production processes.

candidates.title: gas production engineer
candidates.description: Gas production engineers develop methods to optimise the extraction and production of gas for energy and utilities. They design systems for gas production, supervise production operations and develop improvements on existing systems.

candidates.title: drilling engineer
candidates.description: Drilling engineers develop and supervise the drilling of gas and oil wells. They assist in the designing, testing and creation of wells and are employed on land or offshore platforms. Drilling engineers work with other mining professionals and oversee the drilling progress and safety of the site.

candidates.title: asphalt laboratory technician

candidates.title: geology technician
candidates.description: Geology technicians assist in all the activities carried out by geologists. Under the supervision of geologists, they collect materials, carry out research and study the samples collected from the Earth. Geology technicians assist in determining the value of the land for oil or gas exploration. They perform various technical activities, including collecting samples during geochemical surveys, working on drill sites, and participating in geophysical surveys and geological studies.

candidates.title: chemical engineering technician

candidates.description: Mining assistants perform routine duties in mining and quarrying operations. They assist the miners with maintaining equipment, with laying pipes, cables and tunnels, and with removing wast.

candidates.description: Mining electricians install, maintain and repair specialised electrical mining equipment using their knowledge of electrical principles. They also monitor mine electricity supply.

candidates.title: mine surveying technician

candidates.title: engineering assistant
candidates.description: Engineering assistants ensure the administration and monitoring of technical and engineering files for projects, assignments, and quality matters. They assist engineers with their experiments, participate in site visits, and administer the collection of information.

candidates.title: drafter
candidates.description: Drafters prepare and create technical drawings using a special software or manual techniques, to show how something is built or works.

candidates.title: mechanical engineering drafter
candidates.description: Mechanical engineering drafters convert mechanical engineers' designs and sketches into technical drawings detailing dimensions, fastening and assembling methods and other specifications used for example in manufacturing processes.

candidates.description: Marine engineering drafters convert the marine engineers’ designs into technical drawings usually using software. candidates.title: architectural drafter
candidates.description: Architectural drafters make drawings of the specifications and ideas provided by architects. They draw architectural drawings using computer-aided equipment and software, or using conventional methods like paper and pen.

candidates.description: Automotive engineering drafters convert the automotive engineers’ designs into technical drawings usually using software. candidates.description: Aircraft maintenance engineers make preflight and postflight inspections, adjustments, and minor repairs to ensure safe and sound performance of aircrafts. They inspect aircraft prior to takeoff to detect malfunctions such as oil leaks, electrical or hydraulic problems. They verify passenger and cargo distribution and amount of fuel to ensure that weight and balance specifications are met.

candidates.title: aircraft interior technician
candidates.description: Aircraft interior technicians manufacture, assemble and repair interior components for aircrafts such as seats, carpeting, door panels, ceiling, lighting, etc. They also replace entertainment equipment such as video systems. They inspect incoming materials and prepare the vehicle interior for new components.

role_title: Assistant Air Traffic Control Officer Grade A5
description: Assistant Air Traffic Control Officer Grade A5 responsible to the Management and Professional Group Officer for carrying out duties in providing air traffic services to Malaysian airspace users (FIR Kuala Lumpur and FIR Kota Kinabalu) in accordance with the rules set by the International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO) and in accordance with the powers given in the Aviation Act Malaysian Civil Aviation (MCAA 1969) and Malaysian Civil Aviation Regulations (MCAR 1996).
tasks: Providing flight information and aircraft movement information. Liaising with the Air Traffic Control Unit and airlines. Managing weather reports, navigation aids, and communications. Taking emergency action for aircraft in distress. Recording and entering weather data into the Automatic Terminal Information Service (ATIS) system. Preparing flight strips and recording flight statistics. Controlling aircraft movements on the taxiway and apron. Preparing and correcting flight routes, and managing electronic data. Informing Air Traffic Control Officers of anticipated flights.

candidates.title: air traffic manager
candidates.description: Air traffic managers coordinate the planning of ground control, the maintenance of the aircrafts, and the handling of customers. They strive for the most efficient use of resources in directing the aircraft. They manage safety, quality, and risks in everyday work. They also plan and compare performance with other air navigation service providers.

candidates.title: air traffic controller
candidates.description: Air traffic controllers assist pilots by providing information concerning the height, speed and course. They assist pilots in order to facilitate a safe take off and landing of aircrafts. They are responsible for maintaining a secure and orderly movement of aircraft along major air routes up in the sky and around airports. They control air traffic in and within vicinity of airports according to established procedures and policies to prevent collisions and to minimise delays arising from traffic congestion.

candidates.title: flight operations officer
candidates.description: Flight operations officers compile flight information to expedite movement of aircraft between and through airports. They compile aircraft dispatch data such as scheduled arrival and departure times at checkpoints and scheduled stops, amount of fuel needed for flight, and maximum allowable gross take-off and landing weight.

candidates.title: airport operations officer
candidates.description: Airport operations officers perform supervisory and administrative work monitoring operational activities on an assigned shift at a large airport. They ensure the safe take-off and landing of aircrafts.

candidates.title: aviation safety officer
candidates.description: Aviation safety officers plan and develop safety procedures for aviation companies. They study safety regulations and restrictions relative to aviation company operations. Hence, they direct activities of personnel in order to safeguard the application of safety measures in compliance with regulations.

candidates.title: air traffic instructor
candidates.description: Air traffic instructors train people in all the matters regarding with the operations in air navigation services such as the management of flight traffic and the communication for navigation in aerodromes. They teach all the directives issued by air traffic control for the purpose of passing to trainees the sense of safety and expeditious flow of air traffic.

candidates.title: aeronautical information service officer
candidates.description: Aeronautical information service officers maintain the operational timing from sunrise to sunset in order to ensure that the information passed by agencies is authentic. They strive to ensure safety, regularity and efficiency.

candidates.title: air traffic safety technician
candidates.description: Air traffic safety technicians provide technical support regarding the safety of air traffic control and navigation systems. They design, maintain, install and operate these systems both in the airport and on board the aeroplane according to regulations.

description: Berthing Master is responsible for the safe navigation and docking of vessels at ports, harbors, or terminals, ensuring compliance with maritime regulations and operational standards. This role involves coordinating ship movements, overseeing berthing operations, and liaising with captains, tug operators, port authorities, and crew to manage safe arrivals, departures, and cargo handling. The Berthing Master also monitors weather and tide conditions, supervises on-board operations, and ensures adherence to safety protocols to minimise risks and maintain efficient port activities.
tasks: Direct and control vessel movements into and out of port facilities to ensure safe berthing operations. Plan and advise on navigation routes based on weather, sea conditions, and vessel characteristics. Inspect docking areas and vessels to ensure safety, suitability, and compliance with regulations. Coordinate with tugboats, mooring teams, port staff, and ship crews to ensure smooth berthing and departure operations. Oversee and coordinate cargo handling activities to ensure safety and operational efficiency. Maintain accurate records of vessel movements and relevant operational documentation. Respond to emergency situations and implement safety and first-aid procedures when required. Advise on optimal berthing locations and support port operational planning. Support training and guidance for crew and port personnel involved in berthing operations.

candidates.title: fisheries boatmaster
candidates.description: Fisheries boatmasters operate fishing vessels in coastal waters performing operations at the deck and engine. They control the navigation as well as capture and conservation of fish within the established boundaries in compliance with national and international regulations.

candidates.title: skipper
candidates.description: Skippers are the highest authority on-board or on inland waterways, they are in charge of the vessel and are held responsible for the safety and well being of the clients and crew. They are licensed by the responsible authority and will determine the operations of the vessel at any time. They are the ultimate instance responsible for the crew, the ship, the cargo and/or passengers, and the voyage.

candidates.title: ship captain
candidates.description: Ship captains are in charge of a vessel for the transportation of goods and passengers, operating in offshore and coastal waters. The size of the vessel can range from a small vessel to a cruise liner depending on the tonnage that they are certified to sail. Ship captains have vast experience with ships and their operation, and are likely to have worked their way through the ranks of other ship-related positions.

candidates.title: fisheries master
candidates.description: Fisheries masters plan, manage and execute the activities of fishing vessels inshore, coastal and offshore waters. They direct and control the navigation. Fisheries masters can operate on ships of 500 gross tonnage or more. They control the loading, unloading and stevedoring, as well as the collection, handling, processing and preservation of fishing.

candidates.title: maritime instructor
candidates.description: Maritime instructors teach all those occupationally piloting a boat or a ship, such as skippers and ship captains, how to operate their inland water boats or maritime ships according to regulations. They teach their students theory and techniques on how to optimally pilot, steer and navigate, and maintain their specific boat or ship, observe and evaluate the students' practice. They also focus on non-steering related subjects such as customer service (in case of person transportation) and safety measure regulations.

candidates.title: boat rigger
candidates.description: Boat riggers use hand and power tools to install motors, gauges, controls and accessories such as batteries, lights, fuel tanks and ignition switches. They also perform pre-delivery inspections.

candidates.title: vessel operations coordinator
candidates.description: Vessel operations coordinators manage chartered vessels' transit and performance optimizing the schedulers but also assessing the capabilities and the risks for vessels according to the different types of cargo such as crude oil or other chemical cargos. They make sure all necessary certifications are according to the regulations and all employees have up-to-date passports and licenses. Vessel operations coordinators schedule and maintain records of vessels' maintenance. At the operational level they have contact with the customers, following up customer complains, identifying new opportunities and providing customers with solutions.

candidates.title: deck officer
candidates.description: Deck officers or mates perform the watch duties on board of vessels like determining the course and speed, manoeuvring to avoid hazards, and continuously monitoring the vessels position using charts and navigational aids. They maintain logs and other records tracking the ship's movements. They ensure that the proper procedures and safety practices are followed, check that equipment is in good working order, and oversee the loading and discharging of cargo or passengers. They supervise crew members engaged in maintenance and the primary upkeep of the vessel.

description: Ship Technician is responsible for ensuring the safe and efficient operation of a ship by inspecting, maintaining, and repairing mechanical, electrical, and structural systems. They conduct routine checks, diagnose malfunctions, and implement preventive maintenance on engines, propulsion systems, and auxiliary machinery, ensuring compliance with maritime safety, environmental, and regulatory standards, and may also supervise marine operations, coordinate crew activities, and support smooth vessel operations both onboard and at dockyards.
tasks: Perform inspections, preventive maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair of marine engines, including diesel, petrol, gas, and steam types, and associated mechanical and electrical systems. Maintain engine cooling, lubrication, and auxiliary systems to ensure optimal performance and reliability. Collaborate with engineers and ship crew to support maintenance activities and operational requirements. Ensure compliance with safety, health, and environmental regulations and maintain accurate maintenance and incident records. Respond to emergency repairs and operational incidents to ensure vessel safety and continuity of operations.

candidates.title: marine engineering technician
candidates.description: Marine engineering technicians carry out technical functions to help marine engineers with the design, development, manufacturing and testing processes, installation and maintenance of all types of boats from pleasure crafts to naval vessels, including submarines. They also conduct experiments, collect and analyse data and report their findings.

candidates.title: marine electronics technician
candidates.description: Marine electronics technicians lay out, install and repair electronic systems and equipment in vessels. They assemble electronic components and wiring according to blueprints and assembly drawings.

candidates.title: marine mechatronics technician
candidates.description: Marine mechatronics technicians work on shipyards and vessels to configure and optimize industrial mechatronic systems and plans, supervise and execute their assembly and maintenance.

candidates.title: ship duty engineer
candidates.description: Ship duty engineers share responsibility for most of the content of the ship's hull. They ensure operation of the main engines, steering mechanism, electrical generation and other major subsystems. They communicate with the ship chief engineer to perform technical operations.

candidates.title: ship assistant engineer
candidates.description: Ship assistant engineers assist the ship chief engineer and the ship duty engineer in the operations of the ship's hull. They support the operation of the main engines, steering mechanism, electrical generation and other major subsystems. They communicate with maritime engineers about the performance of technical operations. They also ensure appropriate safety and regulatory standards compliance and are able to take on higher level positions if needed.

candidates.title: vehicle technician
candidates.description: Vehicle technicians inspect, test and maintain vehicles, motorcycles, engine tune-ups and tyre replacements. They repair engine failures, lube replacements. Vehicle technicians replace vehicle components and evaluate warranty options.

candidates.title: marine mechanic
candidates.description: Marine mechanics are in charge of the engines and mechanical parts of the vessel and replace defective equipment and parts. They communicate with other crew members on the operational level. Marine mechanics maintain and repair the engines and other machinery of vessels such as boilers, generators and electrical equipment.

candidates.title: aircraft maintenance technician
candidates.description: Aircraft maintenance technicians perform preventive maintenance to aircrafts, aircraft components, engines and assemblies, such as airframes and hydraulic and pneumatic systems. They perform inspections following strict protocols and aviation laws.

description: Marine Assistant Grade A1 responsible for assisting in the smooth running of ship registration and security, maritime security, maritime and port affairs, maritime technical training, development projects as well as assisting in the study and evaluation of international conventions and maritime legislation.
tasks: Implementing revenue collection, compilation of government revenue collection data, office procurement, and asset and store management. Managing ISO documentation, as well as departmental financial and personnel records. Managing documents, records, statistics, and reports for ship and boat registration. Preparing investigation documents for the prosecution of marine cases, summonses, and compounds. Handling seafarer affairs, boat operations, asset and jetty maintenance, and port office administration. Assisting in research, development, promotion, evaluation, and documentation of training programmes and infrastructure.

candidates.description: Marine cargo inspectors investigate all baggage and freight listed on the ship's manifest. Often they collaborate on a regular basis with the HR department of the HQCS for the best planning of the future needs.
