They investigate violations, oversee tests of emergency and risk response plans, and consult on the improvement of the facilities' operations and procedures, as well as on hazardous materials regulations. They also advise plants on potential sources of danger to a community, and on better safety regulations.

candidates.title: food safety inspector
candidates.description: Food safety inspectors carry out inspections in food processing environments from a food safety standpoint. They are part of official control bodies who check and control food products and processes to ensure compliance with regulations and laws governing safety and health.

description: Product Quality Inspector ensures that a product, process, or environment meets established quality, safety, and regulatory standards. They examine raw materials, in-process items, or finished goods to detect defects, monitor compliance with production or environmental regulations, and assess occupational or environmental risks, including hazardous waste, chemical exposure, radiation, or pest control. The role involves conducting inspections or assessment, documenting findings, liaising with relevant authorities, and recommending corrective actions to maintain product quality, workplace safety, and environmental protection.
tasks: Conduct inspections of materials, products, workplaces, and production areas to ensure compliance with quality, safety, and environmental regulations. Identify defects, hazards, or deviations, document findings, and recommend appropriate corrective actions. Monitor and assess industrial processes, machinery, equipment, and work environments for compliance with safety, hygiene, and regulatory standards. Collect, analyse, and interpret samples related to product quality, industrial waste, radiation, and environmental hazards. Advise employers, workers, and relevant stakeholders on compliance with quality, safety, hygiene, environmental, and regulatory standards. Maintain accurate records, prepare detailed reports, and support audits and inspections for quality, safety, and environmental compliance. Monitor the handling, storage, and disposal of hazardous materials, waste management processes, and pest control programmes to ensure compliance. Review and monitor occupational health, safety, and environmental protocols, including emergency response plans, to ensure regulatory compliance. Collaborate with management, production teams, and regulatory bodies to address non-compliance issues and improve processes. Provide training and guidance on safe practices, industrial hygiene, product quality, and regulatory compliance.

candidates.title: product quality inspector
candidates.description: Product quality inspectors check products in order to assess their compliance in reference to a standard or reference guideline. They observe, measure, test, and form questions in order to fill in forms and present levels of compliance with comments after the inspection process. Product quality inspectors are employed or work externally for companies.

candidates.title: product grader
candidates.description: Product graders perform preventive and operational quality control on products and rescources. They inspect, grade and evaluate the materials at various stages to make sure it conforms to the desired standard, and send the product back for repair or improvement if necessary. They work in companies and industrial facilities to ensure the produced commodities achieve quality standards.

candidates.title: product quality controller
candidates.description: Product quality controllers check the quality of manufactured products. They work in manufacturing facilities where they perform basic inspection and evaluation of products before, during or after the production process. They track production problems and send inferior or malfunctioning items back for repair.

candidates.title: clothing quality inspector
candidates.description: Clothing quality inspectors inspect manufactured components and ready-made garments in order to classify them according to their quality by ensuring compliance with quality standards and identifying defects or deviations from specifications. They inspect and test products, parts and materials for conformity with specifications and standards. They ensure all work produced meets or exceeds the department's quality standards.

candidates.title: construction quality inspector
candidates.description: Construction quality inspectors monitor the activities at larger construction sites to make sure everything happens according to standards and specifications. They pay close attention to potential safety problems and take samples of products to test for conformity with standards and specifications.

candidates.title: consumer goods inspector
candidates.description: Consumer goods inspectors evaluate assembled parts of consumer goods and products for compliance with specifications and defects in-line with clients' requirements and organisational policies. Consumer goods inspectors provide results and findings for reports. Inspected defects can be identified as being cracks, scratches, errors in sanding, and defects of moving parts.

candidates.title: textile quality inspector
candidates.description: Textile quality inspectors ensure that the manufacture of textile products is compliant with predetermined specifications.

candidates.title: metal product quality control inspector
candidates.description: Metal product quality control inspectors perform preventive and operational quality control on the metal products. They examine the materials at various stages to make sure it conforms to the desired standard, test the products, and send them back for repair if necessary.

description: Water Inspector monitors, evaluates, and ensures the quality, safety, and regulatory compliance of water or wastewater systems in municipal, industrial, or environmental settings. They conduct inspections of treatment plants, collect and analyse water or sludge samples, oversee operational processes, and report on contamination or regulatory issues. Their work supports the protection of public health, environmental safety, and the integrity of water-related service and infrastructure.
tasks: Conduct field inspections of water and wastewater treatment facilities, distribution systems, and related infrastructure to ensure regulatory compliance. Collect and test water samples for contaminants, including bacteria, chemicals, and heavy metals, using standard testing methods. Monitor operational processes, including chemical dosing, aeration, sludge treatment, and overall system performance. Inspect machinery, equipment, and work environments to ensure compliance with safety, hygiene, and environmental regulations. Operate, calibrate, and perform routine maintenance checks on laboratory and field testing equipment. Record, document, and prepare detailed inspection findings and operational reports. Advise employers, workers, and relevant stakeholders on hygiene, sanitation, environmental standards, and water safety regulations. Respond to system malfunctions, alarms, and emergencies, and support troubleshooting and corrective actions. Monitor and verify plant startup, shutdown, and safety procedures to ensure operational compliance. Support regulatory compliance and water quality standards through monitoring, analysis, and reporting of water treatment operations.

candidates.title: water quality analyst
candidates.description: Water quality analysts safeguard the quality of water through scientific analysis, ensuring quality and safety standards are met. They take samples of the water and perform laboratory tests, and develop purification procedures so it can serve as drinking water, for irrigation purposes, and other water supply purposes.

candidates.title: utilities inspector
candidates.description: Utilities inspectors examine products, systems and machiney such as sewer, water, gas or electric turbines ensuring they are built and functioning according to regulations. They write inspection reports and provide recommendations to improve the systems and repair the broken components.

candidates.title: environmental health inspector
candidates.description: Environmental health inspectors carry out investigations to ensure that areas, organisations and companies comply with environmental and public health legislation. They evaluate environmental complaints, provide reports on their findings and work to prevent future hazards or noncompliance with current policies. Environmental health inspectors perform consultations to promote public health and safety.

candidates.title: water plant technician
candidates.description: Water plant technicians maintain and repair water treatment and supply equipment in a water plant. They ensure the provision of clean water by measuring the water quality, ensuring it is filtered and treated correctly, and maintaining distribution systems.

candidates.title: water conservation technician
candidates.description: Water conservation technicians install systems to recover, filter, store and distribute water from different sources such as rainwater and domestic greywater.

candidates.title: hazardous waste inspector
candidates.description: Hazardous waste inspectors inspect industrial sites to ensure they adhere to waste disposal legislation, and inspect their equipment to see if it is operational and functions according to regulations. They also aim to educate the public on hazardous substances and on hazardous waste handling regulations.

candidates.title: water engineer
candidates.description: Water engineers research and develop methods for the provision of clean water, water treatment and flood damage prevention and reaction. They research water needs in a location and develop methods for meeting those needs, such as designing and developing projects for managing water resources such as treatment plants, pipelines, pump systems, irrigation or draining systems and other water supply systems. Water engineers also ensure proper installation of these systems on construction sites. Water engineers also maintain, repair and build structures that control water resources, such as bridges, canals and dams.

candidates.title: agricultural inspector
candidates.description: Agricultural inspectors monitor agricultural operations in farms and other agricultural facilities. They inspect activities such as health and safety measures, costs and production processes to ensure that workers and their activities comply with proper legislation and standards. Agricultural inspectors also analyse and report on their findings.

description: Mine Safety Inspector oversees and enforces safety standards in mining operations to protect workers and the environment. They conduct inspections, identify hazards, monitor compliance with regulations, and implement safety measures. Their role also includes reporting incidents, analysing accident data, assessing risks, and recommending improvements to workplace safety practices.
tasks: Conduct safety inspections and audits of mining sites to ensure compliance with safety regulations. Identify potential hazards and recommend appropriate control measures to mitigate risks. Verify compliance with Occupational Safety and Health Act 1994 (OSHA 1994) and other relevant mining safety regulations. Advise employers, workers, and relevant stakeholders on safety regulations and safe work practices. Review and monitor safety policies and procedures to ensure alignment with regulatory requirements. Coordinate and deliver safety training and toolbox briefings for workers. Investigate accidents and incidents to determine root causes and recommend preventive measures. Prepare safety reports and maintain accurate inspection and compliance documentation. Inspect work environments, machinery, and equipment to ensure regulatory conformity.

candidates.title: mine safety officer
candidates.description: Mine safety officers oversee health and safety systems at mining operations. They report workplace accidents, compile accident statistics, estimate risks to employee safety and health, and suggest solutions or new measurements and techniques.

candidates.title: health and safety inspector
candidates.description: Health and safety inspectors investigate the implementation and application of labour standards and policies in a workplace. They advise employers as well as employees on the improvement of policy and legislation implementation, ensure that the law is adhered to, and that matters of equality and labour rights are respected. They write reports and communicate with authorities.

candidates.title: occupational health and safety inspector
candidates.description: Occupational health and safety inspectors perform workplace audits to ensure compliance with government and environment legislation. They also investigate work accidents. Occupational health and safety inspectors interview employees to ensure the work environment is compliant with health and safety rules, inspect the physical work site and analyse legal paperwork.

candidates.title: construction safety inspector
candidates.description: Construction safety inspectors monitor construction sites and their conformity to health and safety regulations. They perform inspections, identify safety hazards and report on their findings.

candidates.title: mine health and safety engineer
candidates.description: Mine health and safety engineers develop and implement systems and procedures to prevent employee injury and sickness, improve mine working conditions, reduce health and safety risks and prevent damage to equipment and property.

candidates.title: hazardous materials inspector
candidates.description: Hazardous materials inspectors inspect facilities which handle hazardous materials to ensure compliance to health and safety regulations, and hazardous materials handling legislation. They investigate violations, oversee tests of emergency and risk response plans, and consult on the improvement of the facilities' operations and procedures, as well as on hazardous materials regulations. They also advise plants on potential sources of danger to a community, and on better safety regulations.

candidates.title: transport health and safety inspector
candidates.description: Transport health and safety inspectors are responsible for maintaining safety standards, reducing risk to company, staff and customers and achieving industry standards. They evaluate existing security systems to determine potential risks in all transport sectors such as road and sea transport, and develop policies and procedures that minimise the risk to properties, employees and computer systems.

candidates.title: food safety inspector
candidates.description: Food safety inspectors carry out inspections in food processing environments from a food safety standpoint. They are part of official control bodies who check and control food products and processes to ensure compliance with regulations and laws governing safety and health.

description: Mine Examiner conducts inspections of underground or surface mining sites to ensure compliance with safety regulations and operational standards. They assess potential hazards, review ventilation systems, examine equipments, and monitor overall site safety, report findings to the relevant authority. Their work is essential for preventing accidents and maintaining a safe working environment in mining operations.
tasks: Conduct regular inspections of mining sites to identify safety hazards and non-compliance. Verify compliance with mining safety regulations and standards during inspections. Inspect machinery, equipment, and production areas to ensure safety and regulatory conformity. Document and report inspection findings accurately in accordance with regulatory requirements. Advise employers and workers on safety regulations and appropriate risk mitigation measures. Recommend corrective actions to address identified hazards and non-compliance issues. Collaborate with mining engineers and management to support the implementation of safety measures. Monitor the effectiveness of safety controls, interventions, and policies in mining operations. Provide training and guidance to mining personnel on safe work practices and procedures. Advise on workplace hygiene, sanitation, and compliance with occupational safety regulations.

candidates.title: mine safety officer
candidates.description: Mine safety officers oversee health and safety systems at mining operations. They report workplace accidents, compile accident statistics, estimate risks to employee safety and health, and suggest solutions or new measurements and techniques.

candidates.title: mine supervisor
candidates.description: Mine supervisors coordinate and supervise the activities related to mining and quarrying in underground and surface mines and quarries. They oversee the workers, schedules, processes and organisation in the mines and quarries.

candidates.title: mine manager
candidates.description: Mine managers control, direct, plan and coordinate mining production activities. They have statutory responsibility for safety and are also responsible for environmental impact. They oversee the acquisition, installation, maintenance and storage of mining plant and equipment. They lead and manage according to the organisation's code of conduct.

candidates.title: mine geologist
candidates.description: Mine geologists locate, identify, quantify and classify mineral resources and their geological characteristics and structure. They provide advice to mine managers and engineers at existing and prospective mineral operations.

candidates.title: mine surveyor
candidates.description: Mine surveyors prepare and maintain mining plans in line with statutory and management requirements. They keep records of the physical progress of mining operations and of ore or mineral production.

candidates.title: mine surveying technician
candidates.description: Mine surveying technicians conduct boundary and topographic surveys and surveys of the progress of mining operations. They operate surveying equipment and utilise programs to retrieve and interpret relevant data, and perform computations as required.

candidates.title: mine electrical engineer
candidates.description: Mine electrical engineers supervise the procurement, installation and maintenance of mining electrical equipment, using their knowledge of electrical and electronic principles. They organise the replacement and repair of electrical equipment and components.

candidates.title: mine health and safety engineer
candidates.description: Mine health and safety engineers develop and implement systems and procedures to prevent employee injury and sickness, improve mine working conditions, reduce health and safety risks and prevent damage to equipment and property.

role_title: Assistant Food Technology Officer Grade C5
description: Assistant Food Technology Officer Grade C5 responsible for performing food sample analysis, preparing media and chemical materials as well as analytical equipment, conducting quality control on media and chemicals, issuing food sample analysis reports, and disposing of food samples, toxic, and pathogenic materials in accordance with established procedures.
tasks: Reporting to the Chief of Laboratory/State Food Technology Officer/Head of Halal Hub Section, JAKIM. Assisting in the receipt of routine, crisis, and research food samples, and conducts sub-sampling and sample analysis processes. Preparing culture media, standard solutions, chemicals, and glassware, and performs quality control and calibration of laboratory equipment. Managing inventory of chemicals, media, and equipment, preparing inventory reports, and disposing of samples, toxic, and pathogenic materials in accordance with procedures. Assisting in the distribution of supplies for sampling activities and coordinating the allocation of educational and food safety materials. Supporting monitoring of food safety and quality, promotional exhibitions, and updating the official filing system of the Food Safety and Quality Unit. Conducting audits under MS 1500:2004, inspecting premises hygiene levels, preparing visit reports, and presenting inspection reports at Panel Meetings. Managing the collection, delivery, and analysis of food samples, ingredient data collection, and assisting in Halal Verification Panel Meetings and Help Desk operations.

candidates.title: food safety inspector
candidates.description: Food safety inspectors carry out inspections in food processing environments from a food safety standpoint. They are part of official control bodies who check and control food products and processes to ensure compliance with regulations and laws governing safety and health.

candidates.title: food technician
candidates.description: Food technicians assist food technologists in the deveolpment of processes for manufacturing foodstuffs and related products based on chemical, physical, and biological principles. They perform research and experiments on ingredients, additives and packaging. Food technicians also check product quality to ensure compliance with legislation and regulations.

candidates.title: food safety specialist
candidates.description: Food safety specialists organise processes and implement procedures to avoid problems with food safety. They comply with regulations.

candidates.title: food technologist
candidates.description: Food technologists develop processes for manufacturing foodstuffs and related products based on chemical, physical, and biological principles and technology. They design and plan layouts or equipment, oversee staff, engage in controlling, and improve food technologies in food production processes.

candidates.title: food regulatory advisor
candidates.description: Food regulatory advisors are extra-judicial or judiciary technical experts. They ensure food industry practices comply with the regulatory norms. They perform audits, make diagnosis and monitor activities of inspection. These experts have expertise in food processing, food analysis, quality, safety, certification, traceability. They update, review, and approve labelling designs, develop nutrition facts panels, and ensure that products and labels meet appropriate standards and regulations.

candidates.title: food production manager
candidates.description: Food production managers oversee and monitor production and have overall responsibility for staffing and related issues. Hence, they have a detailed knowledge of the manufacturing products and their production processes. On the one hand, they control process parameters and their influence on the product and on the other hand, they ensure that staffing and recruitment levels are adequate.

candidates.title: food analyst
candidates.description: Food analysts perform standardised tests to determine the chemical, physical, or microbiological features of products for human consumption.

candidates.title: food production engineer
candidates.description: Food production engineers oversee the electrical and mechanical needs of the equipment and machinery required in the process of manufacturing food or beverages. They strive to maximise plant productivity by engaging in preventive actions in reference to health and safety, good manufacturing practices (GMP), hygiene compliance, and performance of routine maintenance of machines and equipment.

role_title: Assistant Environmental Health Officer Grade U5
description: Assistant Environmental Health Officer Grade U5 responsible for carrying out duties in the aspects of management, planning, control, prevention, legislation, and law enforcement related to public health and environmental health activities, namely disease control, food safety and quality, Water Supply and Environmental Sanitation (BAKAS), Water Quality Control (KMAM), and entry point health (airport, port, and land).
tasks: Implementing public and environmental health activities in accordance with assigned duties. Controlling diseases through monitoring and data collection, outbreak investigation, control/prevention measures, law enforcement, health promotion, in-situ analysis, and environmental and occupational health. Ensuring food safety and quality through food sampling, premises inspection, report preparation, follow-up recommendations, import/export control, law enforcement, monitoring, and statistics. Implementing rural water supply projects, inspecting wastewater disposal, and maintaining and calibrates testing equipment for Water Supply and Environmental Sanitation (BAKAS) projects. Conducting Water Quality Control (KMAM) by preparing sampling programmes/schedules, performing sampling and analysis, undertaking corrective actions for quality breaches, and maintaining and calibrating testing equipment. Controling entry point health (airport, port, land) through ship inspection (Ship Health Clearance, Deratting Certificate/Exemption), assessment of Sanitary Airport/Sea Port, foreign worker screening, and imported food screening. Carrying out legislation and enforcement by acting as Investigating Officer, preparing investigation papers, managing documents/records/exhibits, and serving as a witness in prosecution cases.

candidates.title: environmental health inspector
candidates.description: Environmental health inspectors carry out investigations to ensure that areas, organisations and companies comply with environmental and public health legislation. They evaluate environmental complaints, provide reports on their findings and work to prevent future hazards or noncompliance with current policies. Environmental health inspectors perform consultations to promote public health and safety.

candidates.title: environmental education officer
candidates.description: Environmental education officers are responsible for promoting environmental conservation and development. They visit schools and businesses to give talks, they produce educational resources and websites, they lead guided nature walks, they provide relevant training courses, and they help with volunteer activities and conservation projects. Many gardens employ an environmental education officer to offer guidance during school visits.

candidates.title: environmental policy officer
candidates.description: Environmental policy officers research, analyse, develop and implement policies related to the environment. They give expert advice to entities such as commercial organisations, government agencies and land developers. Environmental policy officers work on reducing the impact of industrial, commercial and agricultural activities on the environment.

candidates.title: health safety and environmental manager
candidates.description: Health, safety and environmental managers design and execute corporate policies and procedures related to occupational health and safety and environmental protection. They analyse business processes to ensure compliance with government and environment legislation, conduct risk assessment in the domain of occupational health and safety, evaluate the environmental impact of economic activities and design the appropriate measures for the improvement of work environments and cultures. They coordinate the implementation of an integrated health, safety and environmental management system, defining effective indicators, organizing audits and eventually participating in accident investigation and reporting. They promote an integrated approach to sustainability and occupational health within business organisations, liaising with corporate and line managers and training employees. They are responsible for drafting technical documentation related to the compliance with health and safety and environmental legislation.

candidates.title: environmental programme coordinator
candidates.description: Environmental programme coordinators develop programmes for the improvement of environmental sustainability and efficiency within a organisation or institution. They inspect sites in order to monitor an organisation's or institution's compliance with environmental legislation. They also ensure education for the public on environmental concerns.

candidates.title: health and safety officer
candidates.description: Health and safety officers execute plans for the improvement of work environments and cultures. They assess risks and interview employees to ensure the work environment is compliant with health and safety rules, as well as ensuring the interaction within the workplace occurs in a positive and productive manner. If employed in a healthcare facility the health and safety officer has to investigate infections spreading across a facility and advice all employees how to combat and prevent infections. Furthermore health physics is applied at facilities where people are exposed to ionizing radiation such as nuclear power plants and research institutions.

candidates.title: airport environment officer
candidates.description: Airport environment officers monitor environmental issues such as emissions, contamination, and wildlife activity in the premises of airports. They report environmental attractors for animals such as nearby rubbish dumps or wetland areas. They can engage in studying the environmental impact that airports have in the surrounding communities in reference to the diverse contamination that airports produce. They implement the rules to ensure the sustainable development of the airport.

candidates.title: environmental protection manager
candidates.description: Environmental protection managers provide advice on the development of environmental policies to governmental and official institutions. They analyse possible threats for the well being of the people and the environment in a region and manage campaigns aimed at tackling problems such as waste collection, landfills, and preservation of green areas.

role_title: Assistant Environmental Control Officer Grade C5
description: Assistant Environmental Control Officer Grade C5 responsible for enforcing the Environmental Quality Act (EQA) 1974 and its subsidiary regulations, as well as the Exclusive Economic Zone Act 1984 and its subsidiary regulations, inspecting fuel-burning equipment, effluent treatment plants, and controlling environmental pollution.
tasks: Conducting integrated operations with other enforcement agencies such as the Police, Local Authorities, and the Road Transport Department for the enforcement of mobile sources. Assisting in carrying out enforcement inspections and investigations on prescribed premises, non-prescribed premises, and other sources of pollution. Assisting in preparing monthly and annual work schedules and surveillance programmes for environmental quality monitoring and scheduled waste activities. Assisting in preparing follow-up actions for investigations, including investigation reports, briefing notes, directive letters/field citation, notices of direction, compound offers, recommendations for prohibition orders, recommendations for licence suspension, and investigation papers. Assisting in conducting investigations of complaints received and preparing equipment requirements for carrying out surveillance work according to designated stations. Carrying out environmental quality monitoring activities (marine water, noise, air, groundwater, and others) together with technicians. Monitoring the implementation of environmental quality monitoring by ASMA, updating data obtained, and performing duties in the Control Room. Assisting in coordinating seminars, workshops, dialogues, Environmental Awareness Camps, and information dissemination activities such as awareness campaigns, exhibitions, and talks. Carrying out patrol operations for open burning (hotspot) activities and emergency/disaster cases. Conducting integrated operations with other enforcement agencies such as the Police, Local Authorities, and the Road Transport Department for the enforcement of mobile sources.

They give expert advice to entities such as commercial organisations, government agencies and land developers. They analyse possible threats for the well being of the people and the environment in a region and manage campaigns aimed at tackling problems such as waste collection, landfills, and preservation of green areas.

They implement the rules to ensure the sustainable development of the airport.

candidates.title: environmental technician
candidates.description: Environmental technicians investigate sources of pollution and aid in the development of pollution prevention and environment protection plans. They take samples of soil, water or other materials and perform tests to analyse the pollution level and identify its source.

candidates.title: nature conservation officer
candidates.description: Nature conservation officers manage and improve the local environment within all the sectors of a local community. They promote awareness of and understanding about the natural environment. This work can be very varied and involve projects related to species, habitats and communities. They educate people and raise overall awareness of environmental issues.

candidates.title: environmental health inspector
candidates.description: Environmental health inspectors carry out investigations to ensure that areas, organisations and companies comply with environmental and public health legislation. They evaluate environmental complaints, provide reports on their findings and work to prevent future hazards or noncompliance with current policies. Environmental health inspectors perform consultations to promote public health and safety.

description: Ambulance Officer provides emergency medical care and safe transportation for individuals who are critically ill or injured. They respond to urgent calls, assess the patient’s condition, deliver treatment on-site, and collaborate with other healthcare professionals, maintaining medical equipment and following established health and safety protocols. This role encompasses both immediate care and the management of patient transport to ensure timely and effective emergency response.
tasks: Respond promptly to emergency and non-emergency calls in accordance with established protocols. Assess patients’ conditions and provide appropriate pre-hospital care based on clinical guidelines and protocols. Administer basic and advanced life support interventions, including cardiopulmonary resuscitation (CPR), oxygen therapy, medication administration, and defibrillation. Monitor patients’ vital signs and condition during transport, and document all observations and interventions accurately. Operate, clean, and maintain ambulance vehicles and medical equipment to ensure operational readiness. Safely transport patients to healthcare facilities and coordinate patient handover with hospital staff.

candidates.title: emergency ambulance driver
candidates.description: Emergency ambulance drivers use emergency vehicles to respond to medical emergencies and support the work of paramedics, move patients safely, take note of changes in the patient's vital signs and report to the paramedics in charge, ensuring the medical equipment is well stored, transported and functional, under supervision and on order of a doctor of medicine.

candidates.title: emergency medical dispatcher
candidates.description: Emergency medical dispatchers respond to urgent calls made to the control center, take information about the emergency situation, the address and other details and dispatch the nearest ambulance or paramedic helicopter.

candidates.title: paramedic in emergency responses
candidates.description: Paramedics in emergency responses provide emergency care to sick, injured, and vulnerable persons in emergency medical situations, before and during transport to a medical facility. They implement and oversee the transfer of the patient in connection with transport. They provide assistance in acute situations, implement life-saving emergency measures, and monitor the performance of the transportation process. As allowed by national law they may also provide oxygen, certain drugs, the puncture of peripheral veins and infusion of crystalloid solutions and perform endotracheal intubation if needed for the immediate prevention of threats for the life or health of an emergency patient.

candidates.title: health and safety officer
candidates.description: Health and safety officers execute plans for the improvement of work environments and cultures. They assess risks and interview employees to ensure the work environment is compliant with health and safety rules, as well as ensuring the interaction within the workplace occurs in a positive and productive manner. If employed in a healthcare facility the health and safety officer has to investigate infections spreading across a facility and advice all employees how to combat and prevent infections. Furthermore health physics is applied at facilities where people are exposed to ionizing radiation such as nuclear power plants and research institutions.

candidates.title: police officer
candidates.description: Police officers use investigation methods to prevent crime, to pursue and apprehend criminals, and protect the public from violent and criminal activities. They perform surveillance and patrol activities to prevent crimes and apprehend offenders. They provide support to victimised parties and the public at large, and fulfil administrative duties.

candidates.title: emergency response coordinator
candidates.description: Emergency response coordinators analyse potential risks such as disasters and emergencies for a community or institution and develop a strategy for reacting to these risks. They outline guidelines for the response to an emergency in order to decrease the effects. They educate the parties at risk on these guidelines. They also test response plans and ensure that the necessary supplies and equipments are in place in compliance with health and safety regulations.

candidates.title: emergency response worker
candidates.description: Emergency response workers work in missions to aid in emergency and disaster situations, such as natural disasters or oil spills. They clean up the debris or waste caused by the event, ensure the people involved are brought to safety, prevent further damage, and transport goods such as food and medical supplies.

candidates.title: aviation safety officer
candidates.description: Aviation safety officers plan and develop safety procedures for aviation companies. They study safety regulations and restrictions relative to aviation company operations. Hence, they direct activities of personnel in order to safeguard the application of safety measures in compliance with regulations.

description: Emergency Paramedic provides urgent medical care to individuals who are injured, ill, or otherwise in critical condition during an emergency. They assess the patient, perform life-saving interventions, and ensure safe transport to a medical facilities, while maintaining accurate record of care. Their role is essential in delivering immediate treatment, supporting patient stability, and safeguarding health throughout the emergency response.
tasks: Respond promptly to emergency calls and provide on-site medical care. Assess patients’ conditions and determine appropriate treatment plans. Deliver care to preserve life and prevent deterioration, including administration of oxygen and emergency treatments. Perform emergency medical procedures, including cardiopulmonary resuscitation (CPR), defibrillation, and resuscitation. Operate and maintain ambulance and emergency medical equipment, including defibrillators and ventilators. Monitor patients’ vital signs and condition during transport. Transport patients safely to healthcare facilities using ambulance services. Document patient information, treatment provided, and participate in emergency response training and drills.

candidates.title: first aid instructor
candidates.description: First aid instructors teach students immediate lifesaving emergency measures, such as cardiopulmonary resuscitation, the recovery position, and injury care. They provided practice materials such as a specialised manikin.

candidates.title: rescue centre manager
candidates.description: Rescue centre managers supervise operations of a rescue centre, performing administrative duties and supervision of staff. They ensure that the centre operates according to policies and staff perform rescue missions in a safe, efficient and compliant manner.

candidates.title: firefighter
candidates.description: Firefighters are responsible for emergency response in case of a fire outbreak or other hazardous situations. They oversee the evacuation of the endangered premises and ensure victims are rescued and taken care of by the appropriate professionals. Once the premises are clear of victims, they ensure the fire is extinguished, compliant with health and safety regulations. They also regulate the clean-up of the scene and assess the damage.

description: Assistant Statistics Officer Grade E5 responsible for monitoring the implementation of data collection, processing, and dissemination programmes and activities as well as assisting data analysis in the areas of macroeconomics, trade, population, demographics, manpower, and environment for development planning and administration of the country.
tasks: Assisting in the preliminary planning of census/survey activities prior to fieldwork, including the preparation of questionnaires, task schedules, equipment, processing manuals, and sample selection. Preparing and updates household/establishment frames and selects samples according to the prescribed size. Preparing fieldwork observation reports. Supervising the preparation of documents/work manuals for data processing specifications. Supervising editing and coding activities, data capture, validation checks, and error correction, and prepares periodic progress reports. Carrying out data collection activities (primary and secondary) and analysing the data received for statistical compilation purposes, and reviewing tables for the preparation of publications. Updating the list of subscribers/mailing list and fulfils data requests received. Preparing reports on the department’s product sales results.

candidates.title: statistical assistant
candidates.description: Statistical assistants collect data and use statistical formulas to execute statistical studies and create reports. They create charts, graphs and surveys.

candidates.title: chief data officer
candidates.description: Chief data officers manage companies' enterprise-wide data administration and data mining functions. They ensure data are used as a strategic business asset at the executive level and implement and support a more collaborative and aligned information management infrastructure for the benefit of the organisation at large.

candidates.title: administrative assistant
candidates.description: Administrative assistants provide administrative and office support for supervisors. They perform a variety of tasks, such as answering telephone calls, receiving and directing visitors, ordering office supplies, maintaining the office facilities running smoothly, and ensuring that equipment and appliances work properly.

candidates.title: management assistant
candidates.description: Management assistants perform varied types of jobs, usually under general supervision. They carry out administrative tasks and support managers to ensure the entire department functions smoothly.

candidates.title: accounting assistant
candidates.description: Accounting assistants record and report ticketing accounting situations to the accountant they work with, verify deposits and prepare daily reports and income. They arrange authorised refund vouchers, maintain the returned check accounts and communicate with ticketing managers concerning about any issues with ticketing systems.

candidates.title: data protection officer
candidates.description: Data protection officers ensure that the processing of personal data in an organisation is compliant with data protection standards and with the obligations set out in the applicable legislation such as GDPR. They elaborate and implement the organisation policy related to data protection, are responsible for data protection impact assessments and handle complaints and requests from third parties and regulatory agencies. Data protection officers lead investigations into potential data breaches, conduct internal audits and act as point of contact within the organisation on any matters related to the processing of personal data. Data protection officers may develop training programmes and provide training to other employees on data protection procedures.

candidates.title: executive assistant
candidates.description: Executive assistants are advanced administrative professionals who work with top-level executives or in international facilities in various industries. They organise meetings, organise and maintain files, arrange travel, train staff members, communicate in other languages, and manage the day-to-day operations of the office.

candidates.title: intelligence officer
candidates.description: Intelligence officers develop and execute plans to gather information and intelligence. They investigate the lines of enquiry which would provide them with the necessary intelligence, and contact and interview people who may provide intelligence. Video and motion picture directors supervise and manage the film crew. They convey their creative vision on the actors, audio and video equipment operators, lighting technicians, etc and direct them. Video and motion picture directors also supervise the editing of the footage.

candidates.title: photographic developer
candidates.description: Photographic developers use chemicals, instruments, and darkroom photographic techniques in specialised rooms in order to develop photographic films into visible images.

candidates.title: art director
candidates.description: Art directors shape the visual layout of a concept. They create innovative designs, develop artistic projects and manage the cooperation between all aspects involved. Art directors may perform creative work in theatre, marketing, advertising, video and motion picture, fashion or online companies. They ensure that the work performed is visually appealing to audiences.

candidates.title: video and motion picture producer
candidates.description: Video and motion picture producers supervise the entire production of a movie or television programme. They select the scripts that will be turned into motion pictures or series. Video and motion picture producers find the financial means to make a movie or television series. They have the final decision on the whole project, from development and editing to distribution. During large-scale productions, video and motion picture producers can be part of a team of producers and may be responsible for some of these tasks.

candidates.title: camera operator
candidates.description: Camera operators setup and operate digital film cameras to shoot domestic motion pictures or television programs. They work together with the video and motion picture director, the director of photography, or the private client. Camera operators give advice on how to shoot scenes to actors, the video and motion picture director and other camera operators.

description: Motion Picture Assistant supports film, television, or theatre productions by assisting Producers and Directors in coordinating daily operations. They manage scripts, facilitate communication between cast and crew, handle props, and support technical setups such as lighting and sound. Their work ensures smooth production processes, including administrative tasks, logistics coordination, content preparation, and occasional personal assistance for key production staff.
tasks: Prepare studios or locations for filming, including setting up lighting, props, and equipment. Assist in coordinating on-set activities, ensuring schedules are followed and talent is supported. Manage and distribute scripts, schedules, and other essential documents. Operate and assist with audiovisual equipment, ensuring proper handling, safety, and maintenance of cameras, sound, and related tools. Handle and organise footage and media materials for editors and post-production. Assist with content research, brainstorming, and quality checking of scripts and media materials.

candidates.title: assistant video and motion picture director
candidates.description: Assistant video and motion picture directors are responsible for the organisation, scheduling and planning of the cast, crew and activities on a set. They assist the video and motion picture directors, maintain budgets and ensure that all production activities go according to schedule.

candidates.title: video and motion picture director
candidates.description: Video and motion picture directors are responsible for the overall production of a movie or television program. They edit and translate the script into audiovisual images. Video and motion picture directors supervise and manage the film crew. They convey their creative vision on the actors, audio and video equipment operators, lighting technicians, etc and direct them. Video and motion picture directors also supervise the editing of the footage.

candidates.title: video and motion picture editor
candidates.description: Video and motion picture editors are responsible for the assembly and cutting of raw footage into a logically and aesthetically-pleasant material for movies, television series, or domestic purposes. They reorganize scenes that have been shot and decide which special effects are needed. Video and motion picture editors work closely together with sound editors and music directors.

candidates.title: video and motion picture producer
candidates.description: Video and motion picture producers supervise the entire production of a movie or television programme. They select the scripts that will be turned into motion pictures or series. Video and motion picture producers find the financial means to make a movie or television series. They have the final decision on the whole project, from development and editing to distribution. During large-scale productions, video and motion picture producers can be part of a team of producers and may be responsible for some of these tasks.

candidates.title: motion picture film developer
candidates.description: Motion picture film developers develop film material into visible videos and material. They develop the footage into different formats and presentations, such as black and white and colour. They work small cine-films per request of clients.

candidates.title: assistant outdoor animator
candidates.description: Assistant outdoor animators assist in planning outdoor activities, outdoor risk assessment and equipment monitoring. They manage the outdoor resources and groups. Assistant outdoor animators may help with office administration and maintenance hence they may work indoors.

candidates.title: assistant stage director
candidates.description: Assistant stage directors support the needs of the stage director and the production for each assigned stage production, and serve as a liaison between performers, theatre staff and stage directors. They take notes, provide feedback, coordinate the rehearsal schedule, take blocking, rehearse or review scenes, prepare or distribute actor notes, and facilitate communication between designers, production staff, and stage director.

candidates.title: event assistant
candidates.description: Event assistant implement and follow plans detailed by event managers and planners. They specialise in a part of the planning either the coordination of the catering, transportation, or the facilities.

description: Sound Mixer is responsible for recording, mixing, and managing all audio elements across film, television, music, and live event productions to ensure clear, balanced, and high-quality sound. This role involves capturing, editing, and integrating dialogue, music, and sound effects, synchronizing audio with visual content, and overseeing the technical operation of audio equipment and the audio crew. They collaborate closely with directors, producers, and post-production teams to achieve the desired auditory experience across media formats.
tasks: Set up and operate audio and recording equipment for productions or events. Mix and balance dialogue, music, sound effects, and ambient sounds to achieve the desired audio quality. Edit, synchronise, and assemble audio with visual content in collaboration with directors and editors for final production. Apply audio effects, including equalisation, compression, and reverb, to enhance sound. Troubleshoot and maintain audio equipment and manage digital audio assets to ensure optimal performance. Collaborate with directors, producers, and editors to meet creative sound requirements. Ensure compliance with safety, technical, and quality standards during production.

candidates.title: sound operator
candidates.description: Sound operators control the sound of a performance based on the artistic or creative concept, in interaction with the performers. Their work is influenced by and influences the results of other operators. Therefore, the operators work closely together with the designers and performers. They prepare audio fragments, supervise the setup, steer the technical crew, program the equipment and operate the sound system. Their work is based on plans, instructions and other documentation.

candidates.title: recording studio technician
candidates.description: Recording studio technicians operate and maintain microphones and headsets in recording booths in recording studios. They operate mixing panels. Recording studio technicians manage all sound production requirements. They advise singers on the use of their voice. Recording studio technicians edit recordings into a finished product.

candidates.title: sound editor
candidates.description: Sound editors create the soundtrack and sound effects for motion pictures, television series or other multimedia productions. They are responsible for all the music and sound featured in the movie, series or videogames. Sound editors use equipment to edit and mix image and sound recordings and make sure that the music, sound and dialogue is synchronised with and fits in the scene. They work closely together with the video and motion picture editor.

candidates.title: chemical mixer
candidates.description: Chemical mixers operate and maintain mixing tanks and blenders in order to develop chemical products out of raw materials, making sure the end products are in conformance to the batch tickets specifications.

candidates.title: sound designer
candidates.description: Sound designers develop a sound design concept for a performance and supervise the execution of it. Their work is based on research and artistic vision. Their design is influenced by and influences other designs and must be conform with these designs and the overall artistic vision. Therefore, the designers work closely with artistic directors, operators and the artistic team. Sound designers prepare audio fragments to be used in a performance, which can involve recording, composing, manipulating and editing. Sound designers develop plans, cue lists and other documentation to support the operators and production crew. Sound designers sometimes also work as autonomous artists, creating sound art outside a performance context.

candidates.title: audio production technician
candidates.description: Audio production technicians set up, prepare, check and maintain equipment in order to provide optimal sound quality for a live performance. They cooperate with road crew to unload, set up and operate sound equipment and instruments.

candidates.title: sound mastering engineer
candidates.description: Sound mastering engineers convert finished recordings to the desired format such as CD, vinyl and digital. They ensure the quality of the sound on all formats.

candidates.title: paint mixer
candidates.description: Paint mixers operate and maintain machines that mix lacquers, solvents and paints in order to produce paint, making sure the end product is according to the specified formula.

description: Ships Radio Officer operates and maintains radio and electronic communication equipment aboard a vessel, ensuring continuous functionality of the Global Maritime Distress and Safety System (GMDSS) and other onboard systems. They manage communication logs, coordinate with maritime authorities for navigation and safety, and perform repairs and related duties to support safe and efficient ship operations, particularly during emergencies.
tasks: Operate and maintain shipboard radio communication equipment, including routine checks and troubleshooting. Monitor distress frequencies and respond to emergency calls. Keep accurate records of all communications. Coordinate communication activities with ship crew and maritime authorities. Ensure compliance with international maritime communication regulations. Install radio and communication systems and ensure proper functionality. Operate and maintain the Global Maritime Distress and Safety System (GMDSS).

candidates.title: navy officer
candidates.description: Navy officers command missions during conflict and peace times, and supervise training and development of their teams. They supervise combat operations of their team, as well as aid missions, and patrolling missions to ensure peace-keeping. Often they collaborate on a regular basis with the HR department of the HQCS for the best planning of the future needs.

candidates.title: ship duty engineer
candidates.description: Ship duty engineers share responsibility for most of the content of the ship's hull. They ensure operation of the main engines, steering mechanism, electrical generation and other major subsystems. They communicate with the ship chief engineer to perform technical operations.

candidates.title: deck officer
candidates.description: Deck officers or mates perform the watch duties on board of vessels like determining the course and speed, manoeuvring to avoid hazards, and continuously monitoring the vessels position using charts and navigational aids. They maintain logs and other records tracking the ship's movements. They ensure that the proper procedures and safety practices are followed, check that equipment is in good working order, and oversee the loading and discharging of cargo or passengers. They supervise crew members engaged in maintenance and the primary upkeep of the vessel.

candidates.title: fleet commander
candidates.description: Fleet commanders ensure that naval vessels are ready for inclusion in operations, and are maintained in compliance with rules and regulations. They also supervise naval personnel and are responsible for the operations of the naval service.

candidates.title: ship assistant engineer
candidates.description: Ship assistant engineers assist the ship chief engineer and the ship duty engineer in the operations of the ship's hull. They support the operation of the main engines, steering mechanism, electrical generation and other major subsystems. They communicate with maritime engineers about the performance of technical operations. They also ensure appropriate safety and regulatory standards compliance and are able to take on higher level positions if needed.

candidates.title: maritime pilot
candidates.description: Maritime pilots are mariners who guide ships through dangerous or congested waters, such as harbours or river mouths. They are expert ship handlers who possess detailed knowledge of local waterways.

candidates.title: ship captain
candidates.description: Ship captains are in charge of a vessel for the transportation of goods and passengers, operating in offshore and coastal waters. The size of the vessel can range from a small vessel to a cruise liner depending on the tonnage that they are certified to sail. Ship captains have vast experience with ships and their operation, and are likely to have worked their way through the ranks of other ship-related positions.

candidates.title: vessel operations coordinator
candidates.description: Vessel operations coordinators manage chartered vessels' transit and performance optimizing the schedulers but also assessing the capabilities and the risks for vessels according to the different types of cargo such as crude oil or other chemical cargos. They make sure all necessary certifications are according to the regulations and all employees have up-to-date passports and licenses. Vessel operations coordinators schedule and maintain records of vessels' maintenance. At the operational level they have contact with the customers, following up customer complains, identifying new opportunities and providing customers with solutions.

description: Broadcast Technician is responsible for setting up, operating, maintaining, and repairing equipment used to acquire, transmit, and reproduce audio and video signals across television, radio, live streaming, and event production. They ensure high-quality transmission by monitoring signal strength, clarity, and audio-visual performance, troubleshoot technical issues, perform routine maintenance, and coordinate with producers, engineers, and other staff to support smooth broadcasts and live events. Their work encompasses a range of equipment and settings, including studios, outdoor broadcasts, conferences, cinemas, and telecommunications systems, ensuring reliable and uninterrupted delivery of content.
tasks: Set up, test, and operate audio, video, and broadcasting equipment for productions and events. Monitor and adjust signal quality, sound, and visual output to ensure optimal transmission. Troubleshoot, repair, and maintain broadcasting equipment to minimise faults and ensure reliability. Install, configure, and upgrade broadcasting and audiovisual systems, including transmitters, antennas, and media hardware. Collaborate with production teams, directors, and clients to meet technical requirements and schedules. Record, edit, mix, and manage audio and visual materials for post-production and broadcast. Maintain logs and documentation of equipment performance, maintenance, and technical incidents. Ensure compliance with safety protocols, licensing requirements, and industry regulations. Provide technical support and guidance to staff and end-users during operations.

candidates.title: broadcast technician
candidates.description: Broadcast technicians install, start up, maintain, monitor and repair equipment used for the transmission and reception of television and radio broadcast signals. They ensure that all materials are available in a suitable format of transmittable quality according to the transmission deadline. Broadcast technicians also maintain and repair this equipment.

candidates.title: radio technician
candidates.description: Radio technicians install, adjust, test, maintain, and repair mobile or stationary radio transmitting and receiving equipment and two-way radio communications systems. They also monitor their performance and determine causes of faults.

candidates.title: video technician
candidates.description: Video technicians set up, prepare, check and maintain equipment in order to provide optimal projected image quality for a live performance. They cooperate with road crew to unload, set up and operate video equipment and instruments.

candidates.title: telecommunications technician
candidates.description: Telecommunications technicians install, test, maintain and troubleshoot telecommunications systems. They repair or replace defective devices and equipment and maintain a safe working environment and a complete inventory of supplies. They also provide user or customer assistance.

candidates.title: theatre technician
candidates.description: Theatre technicians execute all technical tasks to support live performances. candidates.title: audio production technician
candidates.description: Audio production technicians set up, prepare, check and maintain equipment in order to provide optimal sound quality for a live performance. They cooperate with road crew to unload, set up and operate sound equipment and instruments.

candidates.description: Telecommunications engineering technician deploy, maintain and monitor a telecommunication system that provides interactions between data and voice communications, such as telephone, video conferencing, computer, and voicemail systems. Telecommunications engineering technicians provide technical assistance in the research and development of telecommunication equipment.

candidates.title: production engineering technician
candidates.description: Production engineering technicians plan production, follow up production processes and develop and test solutions to solve technical problems. They work closely with engineers and technologists, inspect products, conduct tests, and collect data.

description: Land-Base Radio Equipment Technician installs, calibrates, maintains, and repairs radio communication systems and related hardware, including base stations, mobile transceivers, and remote units. They ensure the reliability and security of communication networks through diagnostic testing, RF spectrum analysis, and on-site support, while ensuring compliance with industry standards and government regulations.

Monitor radio frequency signals and ensure optimal system performance. Program, update, and troubleshoot software in radio communication devices and ensure integration with Radio Frequency (RF) systems. Perform diagnostics and fault isolation using radio frequency test instruments. Support integration of radio systems with other networked communication platforms. Document technical issues, maintenance activities, and solutions provided. Ensure compliance with safety and radio spectrum regulations set by the Malaysian Communications and Multimedia Commission (MCMC).

candidates.title: construction equipment technician
candidates.description: Construction equipment technicians inspect, maintain and repair heavy-duty vehicles used in construction, forestry and earthworks such as bulldozers, excavators and harvesters. They perform evaluations of the equipment, and ensure the safety and optimal efficiency of the machinery.

candidates.title: radiation protection technician
candidates.description: Radiation protection technicians monitor radiation levels in buildings and facilities to ensure compliance with health and safety standards, and to prevent dangerous elevations in the radiation level. They take measures to minimise radiation emissions, and to prevent further contamination in the event of radiation pollution, by developing radiation protection plans, in particular for nuclear plants and facilities.

candidates.title: land-based machinery technician
candidates.description: Land-based machinery technicians maintain, overhaul and repair agricultural equipment and machinery.

candidates.title: telecommunications technician
candidates.description: Telecommunications technicians install, test, maintain and troubleshoot telecommunications systems. They repair or replace defective devices and equipment and maintain a safe working environment and a complete inventory of supplies. They also provide user or customer assistance.

candidates.title: mobile devices technician
candidates.description: Mobile devices technicians carry out proper fault diagnosis to improve the quality of mobile devices and repair them. They provide information related to a number of services, including warranties and after-sale services.

candidates.title: nuclear technician
candidates.description: Nuclear technicians function as aids to physicists and engineers in nuclear laboratories and power plants. They monitor the procedures to ensure safety and quality control, and maintain equipment. They also handle and control radioactive equipment and measure radiation levels to ensure safety.

description: Flight Radio Equipment Technician installs, maintains, tests, and repairs aircraft radio communication and navigation systems, ensuring safe and efficient operation in compliance with aviation standards. They diagnose system faults, perform routine inspections, calibrate instruments, and document maintenance activities.
tasks: Install, configure, and calibrate aircraft radio communication and navigation equipment within avionics systems. Conduct maintenance, diagnostics, and repairs on avionics systems, including replacing faulty components and wiring. Document maintenance activities and prepare reports in accordance with aviation regulatory requirements. Collaborate with engineers and technicians to support avionics system upgrades and improvements. Ensure all installation and maintenance work complies with aviation safety regulations and standards.

candidates.title: avionics technician
candidates.description: Avionics technicians install, test, inspect and adjust electrical and electronic equipment, such as navigation, communication and flight control systems in aircrafts and spacecrafts. They carry out maintenance and repair work. They perform functional tests, diagnose problems and take corrective action.

candidates.title: air traffic safety technician
candidates.description: Air traffic safety technicians provide technical support regarding the safety of air traffic control and navigation systems. They design, maintain, install and operate these systems both in the airport and on board the aeroplane according to regulations.

candidates.title: aircraft maintenance technician
candidates.description: Aircraft maintenance technicians perform preventive maintenance to aircrafts, aircraft components, engines and assemblies, such as airframes and hydraulic and pneumatic systems. They perform inspections following strict protocols and aviation laws.

candidates.title: aerospace engineering technician
candidates.description: Aerospace engineering technicians work with aerospace engineers to operate, maintain and test equipment used on aircraft and spacecraft. They review blueprints and instructions to determine test specifications and procedures. They use software to make sure that parts of a spacecraft or aircraft are functioning properly. They record test procedures and results, and make recommendations for changes.

candidates.title: aircraft interior technician
candidates.description: Aircraft interior technicians manufacture, assemble and repair interior components for aircrafts such as seats, carpeting, door panels, ceiling, lighting, etc. They also replace entertainment equipment such as video systems. They inspect incoming materials and prepare the vehicle interior for new components.

candidates.title: airport maintenance technician
candidates.description: Airport maintenance technicians are in charge of the maintenance of all equipment necessary for ensuring the functionality of the airport, for example, visual aids, airport electrical systems, luggage systems, security systems, pavements, drainage, and maintenance of unpaved areas.

description: Videographer operates and manages video cameras in studios and on location to capture high-quality footage for films, television, advertisements, corporate content, live events, and social media. They plan and execute video shoots, oversee production equipment including lighting and audio, and collaborate with creative teams throughout pre-production, filming, and post-production to ensure the final video effectively conveys the intended narrative or message. This role combines technical proficiency with visual storytelling to produce professional video content across diverse media platforms.

Set up and operate video and audio equipment, ensuring appropriate lighting, sound, and camera settings. Capture high-quality video footage for events, interviews, advertisements, and other productions. Collaborate with directors, producers, clients, and technical teams to achieve creative objectives. Edit and process video footage using professional software, including adding effects, transitions, audio, and graphics. Perform post-production activities, including organising, archiving, and managing media assets. Maintain, troubleshoot, and perform basic repairs on audiovisual equipment.

candidates.description: Photographers take pictures using digital or film cameras and equipment. Photographers may develop negatives or use computer software in order to produce finished images and prints.

description: Assistant Telecommunications Engineer supports the development, installation, and maintenance of telecommunications systems, working under the guidance of a senior engineer. They assist in designing network solutions, troubleshooting issues, supervising sites, coordinating with vendors, and ensuring the integrity of cabling and network equipment. Their work contributes to the smooth operation and reliability of telecommunications infrastructure.
tasks: Assist in the design, setup, and configuration of telecommunication networks and systems. Support the installation, testing, maintenance, and configuration of network equipment, including routers, switches, and modems. Monitor network performance, perform routine troubleshooting, and resolve network issues to maintain system reliability. Assist with system upgrades, migrations, and basic network evaluations. Prepare technical reports and maintain documentation of network systems and activities. Collaborate with vendors, contractors, and team members during network installation and maintenance activities. Support the coordination and execution of small-scale telecommunication projects under supervision. Conduct site surveys and assist in network planning and expansion activities.

candidates.description:
Telecommunications engineers design, build, test and maintain telecommunication systems and networks, including radio and broadcasting equipment.
They analyse customer needs and requirements, ensure that the equipment meets regulations, and prepare and present reports and proposals on telecommunication-related problems. Telecommunications engineers design and oversee the service delivery in all it's phases, supervising the installation and use of telecommunications equipment and facilities, preparing documentation and providing training for company staff once new equipment has been installed.

candidates.title: telecommunications analyst
candidates.description: Telecommunications analysts review, analyse and evaluate an organisation's telecommunications needs and systems. They provide training on the telecommunications system features and functionalities.

candidates.title: engineering assistant
candidates.description: Engineering assistants ensure the administration and monitoring of technical and engineering files for projects, assignments, and quality matters. They assist engineers with their experiments, participate in site visits, and administer the collection of information.

candidates.description: Telecommunications equipment maintainers repair, install or maintain mobile or stationary radio transmitting, broadcasting, and receiving equipment, and two-way radio communications systems (cellular telecommunications, mobile broadband, ship-to-shore, aircraft-to-ground communications, radio equipment in service and emergency vehicles).
