candidates.description: Telecommunications engineering technician deploy, maintain and monitor a telecommunication system that provides interactions between data and voice communications, such as telephone, video conferencing, computer, and voicemail systems. They are also involved in the design, manufacturing, construction, maintenance and repair of telecommunication systems. Telecommunications engineering technicians provide technical assistance in the research and development of telecommunication equipment.

candidates.title: telecommunications engineer
candidates.description:
Telecommunications engineers design, build, test and maintain telecommunication systems and networks, including radio and broadcasting equipment.
They analyse customer needs and requirements, ensure that the equipment meets regulations, and prepare and present reports and proposals on telecommunication-related problems. Telecommunications engineers design and oversee the service delivery in all it's phases, supervising the installation and use of telecommunications equipment and facilities, preparing documentation and providing training for company staff once new equipment has been installed.

candidates.title: radio technician
candidates.description: Radio technicians install, adjust, test, maintain, and repair mobile or stationary radio transmitting and receiving equipment and two-way radio communications systems. They also monitor their performance and determine causes of faults.

candidates.title: telecommunications manager
candidates.description: Telecommunications managers coordinate telecommunications staff activities for installing, troubleshooting, repairing and maintaining telecommunications equipment and infrastructure. They oversee the research, evaluation and implementation of new technologies and ensure a safe working environment for the employees. They supervise the inventory of supplies as well as user and customer assistance actions.

candidates.title: electrical engineering technician
candidates.description: Electrical engineering technicians work together with electrical engineers in electrical engineering reasearch. They perform technical tasks and aid in the designing, testing, manufacturing and operation of electrical devices and facilities.

candidates.title: electronics engineering technician
candidates.description: Electronics engineering technicians work closely with electronics engineers in the development of electronic equipment and devices. Electronics engineering technicians are responsible for building, testing, and maintaining electronic devices.

candidates.title: telecommunications analyst
candidates.description: Telecommunications analysts review, analyse and evaluate an organisation's telecommunications needs and systems. They provide training on the telecommunications system features and functionalities.

description: Interior Designer conceptualises and develops an interior space that is both functional and visually appealing, tailored to meet a client’s needs. They plan and design residential, commercial, retail, and hospitality environments, ensuring compliance with safety and building regulations, and often collaborate with architects, contractors, and suppliers to implement the design plan. Their work may also extend to creating visual materials such as posters and other print media to support the overall design concept.
tasks: Consult with clients to determine design needs and functional requirements. Develop and present design concepts, including mood boards, floor plans, and elevations. Select and source materials, furnishings, and décor in line with the design vision. Coordinate with contractors, vendors, and professionals to ensure effective project execution. Supervise the development of models, patterns, or sample products as required. Oversee project implementation and conduct site visits to monitor progress and quality. Incorporate client feedback into design revisions and final outputs. Design interior schemes for residential, commercial, and public spaces based on project requirements.

candidates.title: interior designer
candidates.description: Interior designers design or renovate of internal spaces, including structural alterations, fixtures and fittings, lighting and colour schemes, furnishings. They combine the efficient and functional use of space with an understanding of aesthetics.

candidates.title: interior architect
candidates.description: Interior architects create plans of the interior of a home, building or other structure. They determine the specifications and distribution of the space. Interior architects combine an understanding of space with a sense for aesthetics in order to create a harmonious interior design. They draw architectural drawings using computer-aided equipment and software, or using conventional methods like paper and pen.

candidates.title: interior planner
candidates.description: Interior planners help clients in planning their interiors for commercial and private use.

candidates.title: furniture designer
candidates.description: Furniture designers work on items of furniture and related products. They design the product and are involved in its production as craftsmen and designers or makers. The conception of furniture combines innovative design, functional requirements and aesthetic appeal.

candidates.title: industrial designer
candidates.description: Industrial designers work out ideas and develop them into designs and concepts for a wide variety of manufactured products. They integrate creativity, aesthetics, production feasibility, and market relevance in the design of new products.

candidates.title: architect
candidates.description: Architects investigate, design, and oversee the construction and development of buildings, urban spaces, infrastructure projects, and social spaces. They design in accordance with the surroundings and regulations applicable in specific geographic areas, taking into account factors that include function, aesthetics, costs, and public health and safety. They are aware of social contexts and environmental factors, which include the relationships between people and buildings, and buildings and the environment. They engage in multidisciplinary projects aimed at developing the social fabric of a geographic area and advancing in social urbanism projects.

candidates.title: automotive designer
candidates.description: Automotive designers create model designs in 2D or 3D and prepare isometric drawings and graphics. They work closely with computer hardware engineers to develop hardware designs for the next generation of automotive applications including advanced driver-assistance and vehicle-to-everything systems. They re-evaluate vehicle design, materials and manufacturing technologies, anticipating changes to vehicle architecture and power management, vehicle features and seating functionality and safety.

candidates.title: fashion designer
candidates.description: Fashion designers work on designs for the haute couture and/or ready-to-wear, high street fashion markets, and more generally on items of clothing and fashion ranges. Fashion designers can operate in a specialised area, such as sportswear, childrenswear, footwear or accessories.

description: Carve Technician specialises in creating a detailed carving on a material such as wood, stone, or a synthetic substance for applications in furniture, architecture, interior design, and cultural heritage projects. They use manual and mechanical techniques to sculpt and shape a surface according to specifications or artistic designs, producing an intricate and visually appealing element. Their work is carried out in a workshop, studio, or on-site, contributing to both artistic and functional outcomes across multiple industries.
tasks: Read and interpret blueprints or sketches, and collaborate with designers, engineers, or clients to understand project requirements. Select appropriate tools and materials for carving based on project and material needs. Operate, maintain, and troubleshoot carving equipment safely and efficiently. Perform manual sculpting to create detailed designs, patterns, or sculptures. Ensure precision and quality of carved products through inspection and adjustment during and after production. Adhere to safety protocols when using tools and machinery.

candidates.title: vehicle technician
candidates.description: Vehicle technicians inspect, test and maintain vehicles, motorcycles, engine tune-ups and tyre replacements. They repair engine failures, lube replacements. Vehicle technicians replace vehicle components and evaluate warranty options.

candidates.title: cadastral technician
candidates.description: Cadastral technicians design and create maps and blue-prints, converting new measurement results into the real estate cadastre of a community. They define and indicate the property boundaries and ownerships, land use, and create city and district maps using measurement equipment and specialised software.

candidates.title: automotive engineering technician
candidates.description: Automotive engineering technicians work with automotive engineers to operate, repair, maintain and test equipment used in motor vehicles. In some environments, such as an airport they are responsible for keeping equipment and vehicles serviceable. They review blueprints and designs to determine test specifications and procedures. Automotive engineering technicians use software to make sure that parts of a motor vehicle are functioning properly. They record test procedures and results, and make recommendations for changes.

candidates.title: vehicle restoration technician
candidates.description: Vehicle restoration technicians overhaul old and classic vehicles as cars.

candidates.title: dental technician
candidates.description: Dental technicians manufacture dental custom-made devices like bridges, crowns, dentures and appliances under the supervision of dental practitioners following their directions and specifications.

candidates.title: food technician
candidates.description: Food technicians assist food technologists in the deveolpment of processes for manufacturing foodstuffs and related products based on chemical, physical, and biological principles. They perform research and experiments on ingredients, additives and packaging. Food technicians also check product quality to ensure compliance with legislation and regulations.

candidates.title: pulp technician
candidates.description: Pulp technicians perform technical tasks in the production of pulp. They work in pulp production teams where they maintain machines, resolve technical malfunctions and ensure the production process runs according to specifications.

candidates.title: roadside vehicle technician
candidates.description: Roadside vehicle technicians perform onsite repairs, tests and maintenance to roadside vehicles. They locate and travel to customers' vehicles to provide services such as tyre replacements and engine repairs.

description: Designer Grade B1 responsible for graphic design and multimedia work, exhibitions, and outdoor publicity for government campaigns, including visuals and displays to communicate policies and information to the public. Responsible in the creation of designs for performances and production props. Coordinates and prepares design materials for publications and FINAS trophies. Ensures stage setups and ceremony preparations for guest arrivals, and manages promotional materials for dissemination to states, magazines, radio, and media briefings.
tasks: Assisting in providing input for monthly and annual activity reports as well as various assigned papers. Preparing and recording daily task reports and other reports punctually. Designing and laying out visual communication materials that align with departmental programs and strategies according to the provided visual/dummy/concept. Assisting in executing effective and innovative multimedia production to support departmental/ministry campaigns and programmes. Assisting in designing audiovisual graphic effects for multimedia presentations. Assisting in selecting and editing materials for use in visual production. Assisting in designing exhibitions, plans, perspective and 3D graphic drawings, and other visual materials for effective, high-quality project/activity presentations based on the provided visuals. Assisting in assembling, collecting, installing, and dismantling equipment for exhibitions and outdoor publicity. Assisting in preparing checklists for exhibition and publicity materials and equipment. Assisting in obtaining sources, references, materials, or basic information needed for preparing exhibition and publicity materials.

candidates.title: art director
candidates.description: Art directors shape the visual layout of a concept. They create innovative designs, develop artistic projects and manage the cooperation between all aspects involved. Art directors may perform creative work in theatre, marketing, advertising, video and motion picture, fashion or online companies. They ensure that the work performed is visually appealing to audiences.

candidates.title: production designer
candidates.description: Production designers are responsible for the complete look (style, colouring and locations) of television programmes, series, motion pictures and commercials. They create the visual concept for the entire production such as set design, lighting, costumes and camera angles. Production designers work together with the director, designers and oversee the art department. They also create sketches, drawings, do colouring and location research and advise props and stage settings to the director.

candidates.title: industrial designer
candidates.description: Industrial designers work out ideas and develop them into designs and concepts for a wide variety of manufactured products. They integrate creativity, aesthetics, production feasibility, and market relevance in the design of new products.

candidates.title: fashion designer
candidates.description: Fashion designers work on designs for the haute couture and/or ready-to-wear, high street fashion markets, and more generally on items of clothing and fashion ranges. Fashion designers can operate in a specialised area, such as sportswear, childrenswear, footwear or accessories.

candidates.title: costume designer
candidates.description: Costume designers develop a costume design concept for events, a performance, a movie or a television program. They supervise the execution of it. Their work is based on research and artistic vision. Their design is influenced by and influences other designs and must be conform with these designs and the overall artistic vision. Therefore, the designers work closely with artistic directors, operators and the artistic team. Costume designers develop sketches, design drawings, patterns or other documentation to support the workshop and performance crew.

candidates.title: graphic designer
candidates.description: Graphic designers create text and images to communicate ideas. They make visual concepts by hand or using computer software, intended for publishing in paper or online media such as advertisements, websites, and magazines.

candidates.title: clothing fashion designer
candidates.description: Clothing fashion designers create concepts and make sketches of their creative ideas by hand or by using software. They analyse and interpret fashion trends in order to propose new ideas with high aesthetical value. They perform forecasting and market research to put together collections. They build collection lines by operating mood or concept boards, colour palettes, materials, drawings and sketches considering among others ergonomical criteria, etc.

candidates.title: sound designer
candidates.description: Sound designers develop a sound design concept for a performance and supervise the execution of it. Their work is based on research and artistic vision. Their design is influenced by and influences other designs and must be conform with these designs and the overall artistic vision. Therefore, the designers work closely with artistic directors, operators and the artistic team. Sound designers prepare audio fragments to be used in a performance, which can involve recording, composing, manipulating and editing. Sound designers develop plans, cue lists and other documentation to support the operators and production crew. Sound designers sometimes also work as autonomous artists, creating sound art outside a performance context.

description: Gallery/Museum Technician is responsible for preparing, handling, and maintaining an artwork, specimen, or artefact in a gallery or museum. They coordinate and install an exhibition, ensure proper preservation and environmental conditions, and support a curator and conservator in displaying and protecting the collection. Their work includes managing storage, transportation, and basic restoration tasks to maintain the integrity and accessibility of a cultural or historical object.
tasks: Prepare and set up galleries and exhibitions, including constructing displays and positioning artworks. Handle, preserve, and maintain artefacts and archival materials, ensuring proper environmental conditions. Document and catalogue objects, maintaining inventory and collection records. Assist with exhibition installation and provide technical support to curators and artists. Coordinate logistics for transportation, installation, and movement of artworks and objects. Support multimedia and technical installations in exhibitions. Conduct condition assessments and monitor preservation needs of collections. Prepare objects for storage, display, or research purposes. Carry out routine maintenance and cleaning of museum collections to ensure longevity.

candidates.title: museum scientist
candidates.description: Museum scientists perform and/or manage the curatorial, preparatory and clerical work in general museums, botanical gardens, art galleries, fine arts related collections, aquariums or similar areas. They manage the collections of natural, historical and anthropological material that is educational, scientific or aesthetic in purpose.

candidates.title: exhibition curator
candidates.description: Exhibition curators organise and display artworks and artefacts. They work in and for museums, art galleries, museums for science or history, libraries and archives, and in other cultural institutions. In general, exhibition curators work in artistic and cultural exhibition fields and events of all kinds.

candidates.title: museum director
candidates.description: Museum directors oversee the management of the art collections, artefacts, and exposition facilities. They secure and sell works of art on the one hand, and strive to preserve and maintain the art collection of a museum on the other hand. Moreover, they also manage finances, employees, and marketing efforts of the museum.

candidates.title: art handler
candidates.description: Art handlers are trained individuals who work directly with objects in museums and art galleries. They work in coordination with exhibition registrars, collection managers, conservator-restorers and curators, among others, to ensure that objects are safely handled and cared for. Often they are responsible for packing and unpacking art, installing and deinstalling art in exhibitions, and moving art around the museum and storage spaces.

candidates.title: reprographics technician
candidates.description: Reprographics technicians are responsible for the full or partial process of reproduction of graphical documents through mechanical-driven or digital means, such as photography, scanning or digital printing. These activities are commonly performed for purposes of maintaining archives or other structured catalogues.

candidates.title: commercial art gallery manager
candidates.description: Commercial art gallery managers manage the commercial and artistic success of the gallery.

candidates.title: scenery technician
candidates.description: Scenery technicians setup, prepare, check and maintain pre-assembled sets in order to provide optimal scenery quality for a live performance. They cooperate with road crew to unload, set up and move equipment and sets.

candidates.title: art administrator
candidates.description: Art administrators are among the professionals that manage the business needs of an organisation devoted to arts. They provide support for financial and corporative tasks, and they can work for a range of organizations from for-profit to governmental or non-profit organisations. Examples of these organisations are dance companies, film studios, theaters and art museums or galleries.

description: Library Technician prepares, organises, and manages a collection of books, artefacts, and other informational resources. They support day-to-day library operations by cataloguing materials, maintaining records, assisting users, and facilitating access to both physical and digital resources. In Malaysia, they often work under the supervision of a librarian or library officer, helping with acquisitions, circulation, and inventory management to ensure the efficient operation of the library.
tasks: Manage circulation systems, including lending, returns, and interlibrary loans. Catalogue and classify library and archival materials, ensuring accurate registration for reference and retrieval. Maintain library databases and inventory systems to ensure accurate records. Assist patrons in locating and accessing library resources. Receive and register archival materials according to established procedures. Conduct inventory checks and prepare basic reports on library usage. Carry out repair, conservation, and preservation work on library and archival materials. Provide basic technical support for library systems and public-access computers.

candidates.title: library assistant
candidates.description: Library assistants assist the librarian in the day-to-day activities of the library. They help clients find the materials they need, check out library materials and restock the shelves.

candidates.title: librarian
candidates.description: Librarians manage libraries and perform related library services. They manage, collect and develop information resources. They make information available, accessible and discoverable to any kind of user.

candidates.title: instrument technician
candidates.description: Instrument technicians assist and support musicians before, during and after the performance to ensure the instruments and the connected equipment, the backline, are setup properly. They maintain, check, tune and repair instruments and assist with quick changes.

candidates.title: scientific laboratory technician
candidates.description: Scientific laboratory technicians carry out laboratory-based research, analysis and testing and support life science professionals. They sample, test, measure, research and analyse in areas such as biology, biotechnology, environmental science, forensic science and pharmacology. Scientific laboratory technicians also observe and monitor laboratory activities, record test sequences and analyse the results.

candidates.title: radio technician
candidates.description: Radio technicians install, adjust, test, maintain, and repair mobile or stationary radio transmitting and receiving equipment and two-way radio communications systems. They also monitor their performance and determine causes of faults.

candidates.title: biology technician
candidates.description: Biology technicians provide technical assistance in researching and analysing the relationship between living organisms and their environment. They use laboratory equipment to examine organic substances such as bodily fluids, medicines, plants and food. They collect and analyse data for experiments, compile reports and maintain laboratory stock.

candidates.title: chemistry technician
candidates.description: Chemistry technicians monitor chemical processes and conduct tests to analyse chemical substances for manufacturing or scientific purposes. They work in laboratories or production facilities where they assist chemists in their work. Chemistry technicians perform laboratory activities, test chemical substances, analyse data and report about their work.

candidates.title: ICT technician
candidates.description: ICT technicians install, maintain, repair and operate information systems and any ICT related equipment (laptops, desktops, servers, tablets, smart phones, communications equipment, printers and any piece of computer related peripheral networks), and any type of software (drivers, operating systems, applications).

description: Stage/Broadcast Production Technician is responsible for planning, setting up, and operating technical and practical elements for film, television, theatre, and live events. Their work includes managing lighting, sound, stage equipment, props, sets, and special effects such as pyrotechnics or mechanical rigs to support the creative vision of a production. They collaborate closely with directors, designers, performers, and other crew members to ensure that the technical aspect is executed safely, efficiently, and in alignment with the overall artistic objectives.
tasks: Interpret technical requirements from production plans, scripts, and instructions provided by directors or producers. Set up, configure, and operate lighting, sound, video, and special effects equipment for performances or broadcasts. Assemble, maintain, and repair technical equipment, props, and stage sets to ensure functionality and safety. Rig and operate stage systems, including fly systems and mechanical props, according to technical specifications. Conduct equipment testing, rehearsals, and console programming to ensure proper operation during performances. Prepare and organise props and stage equipment according to production requirements. Coordinate the placement and movement of stage sets, props, and equipment during performances or recordings. Operate technical equipment and execute cues during live shows or recordings.

candidates.title: stage technician
candidates.description: Stage technicians control different aspects of a performance based on the artistic or creative concept, in interaction with the performers. They prepare and perform the setup, program the equipment and operate various systems. Stage technicians take care of lighting, sound, video, sets and/or fly systems. Their work is based on plans, instructions and calculations. They can work in small venues, theatres and other small artistic productions.

candidates.title: theatre technician
candidates.description: Theatre technicians execute all technical tasks to support live performances. They build and break down stages and decors, install and operate sound, light, recording and video equipment and organise the transport of decors and technical equipment for performances on displacement.

candidates.title: broadcast technician
candidates.description: Broadcast technicians install, start up, maintain, monitor and repair equipment used for the transmission and reception of television and radio broadcast signals. They ensure that all materials are available in a suitable format of transmittable quality according to the transmission deadline. Broadcast technicians also maintain and repair this equipment.

candidates.title: production engineering technician
candidates.description: Production engineering technicians plan production, follow up production processes and develop and test solutions to solve technical problems. They work closely with engineers and technologists, inspect products, conduct tests, and collect data.

candidates.title: audio production technician
candidates.description: Audio production technicians set up, prepare, check and maintain equipment in order to provide optimal sound quality for a live performance. They cooperate with road crew to unload, set up and operate sound equipment and instruments.

candidates.title: stage manager
candidates.description: Stage managers coordinate and supervise the preparation and execution of the show to ensure the scenic image and the actions on stage comply with the artistic vision of the director and the artistic team. They identify needs, monitor the technical and artistic processes during rehearsals and performances of live shows and events, according to the artistic project, the characteristics of the stage and technical, economic, human and security terms.

candidates.title: stage machinist
candidates.description: Stage machinists manipulate sets and other elements in a performance based on the artistic or creative concept, in interaction with the performers. Their work is influenced by and influences the results of other operators. Therefore, the stage machinists work closely together with the designers, operators and performers. Stage machinists prepare and perform the setup, execute changeovers and operate manual fly bar systems. Their work is based on plans, instructions and calculations.

candidates.title: footwear production technician
candidates.description: Footwear production technicians perform a wide range of activities regarding footwear manufacturing. They are involved in all phases of the process including product engineering and different types of construction. They aim at maximising productivity and reducing production costs, assuring the functionality and quality of product and customer satisfaction.

description: Economic Affairs Assistant Grade E1 responsible for implementing, monitoring, and reporting on operational matters related to marketing development programmes, agricultural development, quality and safety control, store management, domestic trade and export, processing and product development, conducting visits to business premises to carry out inspections of the Certificate of Business Registration and preparing inspection reports, implementing integrated project activities, investigating cases of breaches of Acts, and providing advisory services to target groups on industry direction.
tasks: Conducting monitoring visits, surveys, production inspections, and assessments of raw materials/commodities stock. Processing licences, monitoring seed production, and distributing raw materials/commodities. Monitoring quality standards with SIRIM/Department of Standards, verifying the quality of craft products, and assisting in the development of standards. Assisting Designers/instructors in teaching, modules, curriculum, teaching kits, examinations, and assessments, and monitoring the implementation of teaching and learning. Managing procurement processes (obtain quotations for indent preparation, letters of offer, and process for payment). Managing the finances/accounts of regional offices and submit reports to the headquarters. Collecting, updating, and maintaining information and data on local and foreign raw materials/commodities industries as input sources for the preparation of related industry papers/reports. Managing files, documents, correspondence, indexes, and docketing, and ensuing the security, maintenance, and updating of records. Preparing and recording matters related to staffing, salaries, allowances, leave, performance evaluation, and retirement. Conducting inspections at marketing centres and premises for handling and storage of raw materials/commodities.

candidates.title: accounting assistant
candidates.description: Accounting assistants record and report ticketing accounting situations to the accountant they work with, verify deposits and prepare daily reports and income. They arrange authorised refund vouchers, maintain the returned check accounts and communicate with ticketing managers concerning about any issues with ticketing systems.

candidates.title: economic policy officer
candidates.description: Economic policy officers develop economic strategies. They monitor aspects of economics such as competitiveness, innovation and trade. Economic policy officers contribute to the development of economic policies, projects and programs. They research, analyse and assess public policy problems and recommend appropriate actions.

candidates.title: administrative assistant
candidates.description: Administrative assistants provide administrative and office support for supervisors. They perform a variety of tasks, such as answering telephone calls, receiving and directing visitors, ordering office supplies, maintaining the office facilities running smoothly, and ensuring that equipment and appliances work properly.

candidates.title: executive assistant
candidates.description: Executive assistants are advanced administrative professionals who work with top-level executives or in international facilities in various industries. They organise meetings, organise and maintain files, arrange travel, train staff members, communicate in other languages, and manage the day-to-day operations of the office.

candidates.title: management assistant
candidates.description: Management assistants perform varied types of jobs, usually under general supervision. They carry out administrative tasks and support managers to ensure the entire department functions smoothly.

candidates.title: human resources assistant
candidates.description: Human resources assistants provide support in all the processes and efforts carried by human resources managers. They help in the preparation of recruitment processes by scanning CVs and narrowing the selection to the most suitable candidates. They perform administrative tasks, prepare communications and letters, and perform the tabulation of the surveys and assessments carried out by the department.

candidates.title: economic adviser
candidates.description: Economic advisers research economic developments and advise on economic problems. They forecast trends and behaviour in economics, and advise on finance, trade, fiscal and other related matters. They advise companies and organisations on techniques to gain economic profit.

candidates.title: marketing assistant
candidates.description: Marketing assistants support all the efforts and operations carried out by marketing managers and officers. They prepare reports in relation to the marketing operations needed by other departments, especially account and financial divisions. They ensure that resources needed by the managers to perform their job are in place.

description: Data Entry Clerk is responsible for accurately entering, updating, and maintaining data in computer systems and databases. The role involves verifying information, processing numerical and textual data from various sources, maintaining organised records, and ensuring data accuracy and completeness. They may assist with basic report preparation, document management, and administrative tasks to support daily office operations.
tasks: Enter and update data accurately into computer systems, databases, or spreadsheets from source documents. Verify data for completeness, correctness, and consistency, and correct errors when necessary. Review and prepare documents, forms, invoices, and records before data entry and processing. Maintain and update records, databases, and filing systems on a regular basis. Sort, classify, file, and archive physical and digital records for easy retrieval. Generate routine reports, listings, and summaries from recorded data for operational use. Check duplicate, missing, or inconsistent information and refer unresolved issues to relevant staff. Retrieve and provide recorded information to authorised personnel when required. Ensure confidentiality, data security, and compliance with organisational procedures during data handling. Assist with routine clerical and administrative duties related to data processing and record keeping.

candidates.title: data entry clerk
candidates.description: Data entry clerks update, maintain and retrieve information held on computer systems. They prepare source data for computer entry by compiling and sorting information, process customer and account source documents by reviewing data for deficiencies and verify entered customer and account data.

candidates.title: data entry supervisor
candidates.description: Data entry supervisors manage the day-to-day operations of data entry staff. They organise the workflow and tasks.

candidates.title: file clerk
candidates.description: File clerks are in charge of maintaining records of a company and managing forms and information. They organise and retrieve documents when necessary and ensure an efficient working system.

candidates.title: office clerk
candidates.description: Office clerks are responsible for performing clerical and administrative duties in an office setting and support of business operations within a department. They assist all the administrative staff, secretaries, and assistants by sorting mail, filing forms and documents, answering phones, greeting clients and scheduling meetings.

candidates.title: auditing clerk
candidates.description: Auditing clerks collect and examine financial data, such as inventory transactions, for organisations and companies and ensure they are accurate, properly maintained, and that they add up. They review and evaluate the numbers in databases and documents and consult and assist the source of the transaction if necessary, which includes accountants, managers or other clerks.

candidates.title: payroll clerk
candidates.description: Payroll clerks manage the time sheets and pay checks of the employees and ensure the accuracy and correctness of the information. They check overtime, sick days and vacations and distribute the pay checks.

candidates.title: medical records clerk
candidates.description: Medical records clerks organise, keep up-to-date and archive patients` records for medical staff availability. They transfer medical information from a patient’s paper records to an electronic template.

candidates.title: mail clerk
candidates.description: Mail clerks perform mail handling, sorting, recording and other duties in connection with mail services from post offices or related organisations. They keep records of the incoming and outgoing packages and letters in the establishment.

description: Enumerator/Survey Interviewer collects data by conducting structured interviews and surveys with individuals or groups to gather information on opinions, behaviours, and demographic or economic characteristics. They work across various sectors, including market research, government, and social programmes, using methods such as face-to-face, telephone, or online interviews to ensure accurate, timely, and confidential data collection. The information they gather supports research studies, policy development, and business decisions.
tasks: Prepare and organise survey materials, questionnaires, and respondent lists. Contact respondents and arrange interviews by telephone, in person, or online. Conduct interviews in accordance with survey guidelines, scripts, and sampling procedures. Ask questions clearly and provide clarification to help respondents understand the survey. Record responses accurately in paper forms or electronic data collection systems. Check completed questionnaires or records for completeness, accuracy, and consistency. Maintain confidentiality of respondent information and ensure data integrity throughout the survey process. Submit completed survey forms, records, and fieldwork updates to supervisors according to procedures. Perform routine administrative and survey support tasks as required.

candidates.title: survey enumerator
candidates.description: Survey enumerators perform interviews and fill in forms in order to collect the data provided by interviewees. They can collect information by phone, mail, personal visits or on the street. They conduct and help the interviewees administer the information that the interviewer is interested in having, usually related to demographic information for governmental statistical purposes.

candidates.title: field survey manager
candidates.description: Field survey managers organise and supervise investigations and surveys on the request of a sponsor. They monitor their implementation according to production requirements and lead a team of field investigators.

candidates.title: market research interviewer
candidates.description: Market research interviewers strive to collect information on the perceptions, opinions, and preferences of customers in relation to commercial products or services. They use interview techniques to draw as much information as possible by contacting people via telephone calls, by approaching them face-to-face or by by virtual means. They pass this information to experts for drawing analysis.

candidates.title: quantity surveyor
candidates.description: Quantity surveyors have under their helm complete management of the cost involved in building and construction projects from the inception of the project until the delivery. They strive for an efficient use of the resources whilst keeping an eye on quality, quality standards, and client's requirements.

candidates.title: surveying technician
candidates.description: Surveying technicians carry out technical surveying tasks. They assist surveyors, architects or engineers in surveying related technical tasks such as mapping land, creating construction drawings and operating precise measuring equipment.

candidates.title: real estate surveyor
candidates.description: Real estate surveyors undertake research in order to assess the value of property for tax purposes. They investigate multiple properties at once, using accurate appraisal techniques. They provide their services usually to local and governmental bodies for taxation reasons.

candidates.title: land surveyor
candidates.description: Land surveyors determine, by means of specialised equipment, the distances and positions of points at the surface of sites for construction purposes. They use measurements of the specific aspects of construction sites, such as electricity, distance measurements, and metal structure volumes to create architectural drawings and develop construction projects.

candidates.title: data entry clerk
candidates.description: Data entry clerks update, maintain and retrieve information held on computer systems. They prepare source data for computer entry by compiling and sorting information, process customer and account source documents by reviewing data for deficiencies and verify entered customer and account data.

description: Auction Clerk records final bid amounts and handles payments from successful bidders at auction events. They provide administrative and clerical support, including preparing auction catalogs, managing bidder registrations, issuing invoices, and ensuring compliance with auction procedures and regulations, facilitating the efficient and accurate operation of auctions.
tasks: Register bidders and verify their credentials. Record final bid amounts and update bid sheets or auction records during auctions. Receive deposits or full payments from successful bidders and prepare or process invoices. Prepare and distribute auction catalogues and related auction materials. Coordinate with buyers and sellers on auction documentation and transaction matters. Maintain accurate records of auction items, bids, and sales results. Provide clerical and administrative support during auction events. Check auction documentation and transactions for compliance with auction procedures and relevant regulations. description: E-Commerce Assistant supports the daily operations of online retail platforms by maintaining product listings, updating prices and stock information, processing customer orders, and assisting with promotional campaigns. Track sales performance and basic online analytics, and prepare reports on e-commerce activities. candidates.title: financial markets back office administrator
candidates.description: Financial markets back office administrators perform administrative tasks for all the transactions registered in the trading room. They process transactions involving securities, derivatives, foreign exchange, commodities, and manage the clearing and settling of trades.

description: Vocational Training Assistant Grade DV1 responsible for planning, developing, and implementing teaching and learning (T&L) tasks related to vocational skills according to training curricula based on the National Occupational Skills Standard (NOSS) or other relevant standards, encompassing infrastructure development, curriculum development, teaching and learning (T&L), skills development, research and development (R&D), advisory and consultancy services, organisational/institutional management, compliance with procedures, safety and hygiene, and strategic collaboration.
tasks: Teaching vocational skills training in accordance with the training curriculum based on NOSS or other prescribed standards. Assisting in the preparation of learning modules. Preparing and conducting theory and practical assessments, and evaluating student/trainee achievements. Recording and reporting assessment results. Assisting in identifying industrial training placements and related arrangements. Ensuring cleanliness, safety, and orderly arrangement within and outside workshops/classrooms before and after use. Monitoring compliance with discipline, safety, and hygiene procedures during teaching and learning programmes. Preparing, ensuring, and supervising training machines and equipment to maintain their proper and safe condition for use. Assisting in implementing motivation, guidance, and counselling programmes for students/trainees, and coordinating curriculum activities within the institute.

candidates.title: vocational teacher
candidates.description: Vocational teachers instruct students in their specialised field of study, which is predominantly practical in nature. They provide theoretical instruction in service of the practical skills and techniques that the students must subsequently master in the specialised vocation of their choice and aid in the development of the according attitudes and values. Vocational teachers monitor the students progress, assist individually when necessary, and evaluate their knowledge and performance on the subject through assignments, tests and examinations.

candidates.title: industrial arts vocational teacher
candidates.description: Industrial arts vocational teachers instruct students in their specialised field of study, industrial arts, which is predominantly practical in nature. They provide theoretical instruction in service of the practical skills and techniques the students must subsequently master for an industrial arts-related profession, working with wood and metal, such as carpenter or sheet metal worker. Industrial arts vocational teachers monitor the students' progress, assist individually when necessary, and evaluate their knowledge and performance on the subject of industrial arts through assignments, tests and examinations.

candidates.title: business administration vocational teacher
candidates.description: Business administration vocational teachers instruct students in their specialised field of study, business administration, which is predominantly practical in nature. Business administration vocational teachers monitor the students' progress, assist individually when necessary, and evaluate their knowledge and performance on the subject of business administration through assignments, tests and examinations.

candidates.title: employment and vocational integration consultant
candidates.description: Employment and vocational integration consultants offer assistance to unemployed individuals in finding jobs or vocational training opportunities, according to their educational or professional background and experience. They advise them on how to market their skills in the job-hunting process. Employment and vocational integration consultants help job-seekers write CVs and cover letters, prepare for a job interview and indicate where to search for new job or training opportunities.

candidates.description: Occupational therapy assistants support occupational therapists by working with people and communities to enhance their ability to engage in the occupations they want to, need to, or are expected to do, or by modifying the occupation or the environment to better support their occupational engagement. They work under the supervision of an occupational therapist.

They induce students in the convenient social frameworks of their field of study and teach the appropriate attitudes and values. Physical education vocational teachers monitor the students' progress, assist individually when necessary, and evaluate their knowledge and performance on the subject of physical education through assignments, tests and examinations.

description: Public Health Assistant Grade U1 responsible for implementing control and prevention work in environmental hygiene, food hygiene, and safety programmes as well as control of infectious diseases related to its duties by using primary health methods/approaches.
tasks: Controlling wastewater and solid waste disposal systems, including supervising construction and ensuring records, stocks of materials, and equipment are kept up to date. Monitoring the quality of rural drinking water, including sampling water and measuring acidity and alkalinity levels. Controlling infectious diseases, including active detection, assisting with disinfection, and reporting unusual incidents. Controlling vector-borne diseases, including enforcing the Destruction of Disease-Carrying Insects Act 1975, conducting preventive activities, actively detecting disease, and carrying out environmental surveys. Conducting health promotion activities. Controlling food safety and quality, including food sampling, maintaining and updating the Food Premises and Food Handlers Register, and assisting in food poisoning investigations. Managing health law enforcement, including assisting in premises inspections, closing premises when necessary, storing exhibits, serving notices and summonses, and preparing regular reports. Preparing daily, weekly, monthly, and annual activity reports. Monitoring general health, including conducting follow-up inspections at farms, mines, and schools, and providing feedback on pollution and toxic waste disposal. Participating in control and preventive measures during and after natural disasters.

candidates.title: public health policy officer
candidates.description: Public health policy officers develop and implement strategies for the improvement of a community's health care policy. They advise governments on policy changes and identify problems in current health care policies.

candidates.title: health and safety officer
candidates.description: Health and safety officers execute plans for the improvement of work environments and cultures. They assess risks and interview employees to ensure the work environment is compliant with health and safety rules, as well as ensuring the interaction within the workplace occurs in a positive and productive manner. If employed in a healthcare facility the health and safety officer has to investigate infections spreading across a facility and advice all employees how to combat and prevent infections. Furthermore health physics is applied at facilities where people are exposed to ionizing radiation such as nuclear power plants and research institutions.

candidates.title: medical laboratory assistant
candidates.description: Medical laboratory assistants work under supervision of the biomedical scientist and carry out basic laboratory procedures. They work in the pre-analytical handling of samples such as checking the details of specimens received for analysis, maintaining analysers, loading reagents, and packaging specimens. They also perform clerical tasks such as monitoring the stock levels of reagents used in analysis.

candidates.title: nurse assistant
candidates.description: Nurse assistants provide basic patient care under direction of nursing staff. They perform duties such as feed, bathe, dress, groom, move patients or change linens and may transfer or transport patients.

candidates.title: administrative assistant
candidates.description: Administrative assistants provide administrative and office support for supervisors. They perform a variety of tasks, such as answering telephone calls, receiving and directing visitors, ordering office supplies, maintaining the office facilities running smoothly, and ensuring that equipment and appliances work properly.

candidates.title: environmental health inspector
candidates.description: Environmental health inspectors carry out investigations to ensure that areas, organisations and companies comply with environmental and public health legislation. They evaluate environmental complaints, provide reports on their findings and work to prevent future hazards or noncompliance with current policies. Environmental health inspectors perform consultations to promote public health and safety.

role_title: Competent Person (CP) - Internal Combustion Engine Driver
description: Competent Person (CP) - Internal Combustion Engine Driver operates and maintains high-capacity internal combustion engines used in industrial settings, ensuring safe and efficient performance. The role involves conducting routine inspections, following safety protocols, and coordinating with maintenance teams to optimise engine operations, typically for engines between 1000 kW and 5000 kW. It requires relevant certification, practical experience, and adherence to regulatory safety standards.
tasks: Operate internal combustion engines safely and in compliance with regulations. Conduct regular inspections and perform routine maintenance to ensure engine performance. Diagnose and troubleshoot engine faults to minimise downtime. Maintain detailed logs of engine operations and performance. Coordinate with engineering teams for repairs and efficiency improvements. Ensure adherence to environmental, safety, and regulatory standards, including Department of Occupational Safety and Health requirements. Manage engine operations for outputs between 500 kilowatts and 5000 kilowatts. Monitor engine performance to maintain optimal efficiency. Follow Factories and Machinery regulations for internal combustion engines.

candidates.title: aircraft engine specialist
candidates.description: Aircraft engine specialists advise on maintaining procedures to engines of aircrafts and helicopters. They perform operability tests to components and parts of aircrafts to diagnose suitability for usage and possible operations to improve performance. They interpret and provide support to understand the technical specifications given by manufacturers for application at the airport's premises.

candidates.title: motor vehicle engine inspector
candidates.description: Motor vehicle engine inspectors inspect diesel, gas, petrol and electric engines used for cars, buses, trucks etc. in assembly facilities such as factories and mechanic shops to ensure compliance with safety standards and regulations. They conduct routine, post-overhaul, pre-availability and post-casualty inspections. They provide documentation for repair activities and technical support to maintenance and repair centres. They review administrative records, analyse the operating performance of engines and report their findings.

candidates.title: aircraft engine inspector
candidates.description: Aircraft engine inspectors inspect all types of engines used for aircrafts in factories to ensure compliance with safety standards and regulations. They conduct routine, post-overhaul, pre-availability and post-casualty inspections. They provide documentation for repair activities and technical support to maintenance and repair centres. They review administrative records, analyse the operating performance of engines and report their findings.

candidates.title: train driver
candidates.description: Train drivers operate trains providing passenger or cargo transport services. They are responsible for driving the locomotive in safe manner, respecting all relevant safety, operational and communication regulations, and have full responsibility for the safety of passengers and cargo. The task involves cooperation and communication with the relevant staff under the infrastructure manager, as well as with staff on board the train.

candidates.title: engine designer
candidates.description: Engine designers carry out engineering duties in designing mechanical equipment such as machines and all types of engines. They also supervise their installation and maintenance.

candidates.title: motor vehicle engine tester
candidates.description: Motor vehicle engine testers test the performance of diesel, petrol, gas and electric engines in specialised facilities such as laboratories. They position or give directions to workers positioning engines on the test stand. They use hand tools and machinery to position and connect the engine to the test stand. They use computerised equipment to enter, read and record test data such as temperature, speed, fuel consumption, oil and exhaust pressure.

candidates.title: vessel engine inspector
candidates.description: Vessel engine inspectors inspect ship and boat engines such as electric motors, nuclear reactors, gas turbine engines, outboard motors, two-stroke or four-stroke diesel engines, LNG, fuel dual engines and, in some cases, marine steam engines in assembly facilities to ensure compliance with safety standards and regulations. They conduct routine, post-overhaul, pre-availability and post-casualty inspections. They provide documentation for repair activities and technical support to maintenance and repair centres. They review administrative records, analyse the operating performance of engines and report their findings.

candidates.title: diesel engine mechanic
candidates.description: Diesel engine mechanics repair and maintain all types of diesel engines. They use hand tools, precision measuring instruments, and machine tools to diagnose trouble, disassemble engines, and to examine and exchange parts of defect and excessive wear.

description: Assembler is responsible for putting together components or parts to create finished products, subassemblies, or complex systems in industries such as manufacturing, automotive, aerospace, electronics, and industrial machinery. They interpret technical drawings and specifications to assemble mechanical, electromechanical, or electronic systems, install components, perform functional testing, and make adjustments to ensure products meet quality, safety, and operational standards. This role may involve using hand tools, machinery, or automated equipment and requires careful attention to detail to maintain product functionality and compliance throughout the assembly process.
tasks: Interpret and follow technical drawings, blueprints, and assembly instructions to assemble components accurately. Select, prepare, and fit parts using hand tools, power tools, or automated equipment. Assemble mechanical, mechatronic, or vehicle components and systems according to specifications. Inspect components and assemblies for defects and ensure compliance with alignment and quality standards. Conduct tests and functional checks to verify performance of completed assemblies. Adjust or troubleshoot components and assemblies to meet operational and quality requirements. Document assembly processes, test results, and issues for records and reporting. Maintain a safe, clean, and organised workspace throughout the assembly process. Collaborate with engineers and quality teams to improve assembly processes and ensure compliance.

candidates.title: metal products assembler
candidates.description: Metal products assemblers fit and fasten metal materials according to strictly laid down procedures in order to produce various parts or final products using power tools, hand tools, and other machinery.

candidates.title: motor vehicle assembler
candidates.description: Motor vehicle assemblers install and put prefabricated motor vehicle parts and components together. They inspect the motor vehicles for defects, and test the assembled equipment for proper performance and conformity to quality standards.

candidates.title: aircraft assembler
candidates.description: Aircraft assemblers use hand tools, power tools and other equipment such as CNC machines or robots to construct, fit and install prefabricated parts to manufacture fixed or rotary wing aircrafts and aircraft subassemblies such as flight controls, aircraft skins, rigging and other mechanical systems. They read and interpret blueprints. They operate control systems to determine functional performance of the assemblies and adjust accordingly.

candidates.title: industrial machinery assembler
candidates.description: Industrial machinery assemblers manufacture industrial equipment such as industrial robots, assembly line machines, and labeling machines. They use hand tools and computer-controlled machines.

candidates.title: mechatronics assembler
candidates.description: Mechatronics assemblers assemble and maintain complex mechatronic equipment and machines, such as robots, elevators, and advanced home appliances. They build the mechanical, electrical, and electronic components, install software, set the systems in operation, and maintain and repair the components and systems.

candidates.title: electronic equipment assembler
candidates.description: Electronic equipment assemblers are responsible for the assembly of electronic equipment and systems. They assemble electronic components and wiring according to blueprints and assembly drawings. They may assist in quality inspection and equipment maintenance.

candidates.title: bicycle assembler
candidates.description: Bicycle assemblers build, tune and ensure good working order of all types of bicycles such as mountain bikes, road bikes, children’s bikes etc. They also assemble accessory products like tag-alongs and trailers.

candidates.title: motorcycle assembler
candidates.description: Motorcycle assemblers fasten motorcycle parts and components together such as frames, wheels, engines etc. To do so, they use hand tools, power tools and other equipment such as CNC machines or robots. They read technical plans and use automated assembling equipment to build motorcycles. They inspect individual parts for malfunctions and check the quality of assemblies to make sure the standards are met and the specifications respected.
